text.SERavenBiter: Everyone's talking about the assassination, of course. Here. Take my copy of the new Black Horse Courier. Go ahead. Keep it.

text.Generic Argonian Female: Everyone's talking about the assassination, of course. Here. Take my copy of the new Black Horse Courier. Go ahead. Keep it.

text.Generic Argonian Male: All else is put aside to celebrate of our deliverance from evil. Thanks to Akatosh and his servant Martin.

text.Generic Argonian Female: All else is put aside to celebrate of our deliverance from evil. Thanks to Akatosh and his servant Martin.

text.Generic Argonian Male: The Fighters Guild is recruiting again. Not a bad way to make some money, if you've got the stones for it.

text.Generic Argonian Female: The Fighters Guild is recruiting again. Not a bad way to make some money, if you've got the stones for it.

text.Generic Argonian Male: Anyone looking for work should consider the Fighters Guild. I hear they're always looking for recruits.

text.Generic Argonian Female: Anyone looking for work should consider the Fighters Guild. I hear they're always looking for recruits.

text.Generic Argonian Male: I understand the Fighters Guild is hiring new members. Not bad work for some folks.

text.Generic Argonian Female: I understand the Fighters Guild is hiring new members. Not bad work for some folks.

text.Generic Argonian Male: Mannimarco is no more! The guild is saved, and we have a new Arch-Mage to lead us.

text.Generic Argonian Female: I can't believe Arch-Mage Traven sacrificed himself to save us all. How noble of him.

text.Generic Argonian Male: I don't know what it was, but something important was taken away from Mannimarco. Maybe there is a chance he can be defeated.
Traven might get us through this yet. I hear that the Necromancers were handed a significant defeat at Silorn.
The Council has turned on Traven. Things couldn't possibly get any worse for the guild.
Mannimarco himself is in Cyrodiil, hunting us down. None of us are safe!
Without the Council of Mages to guide us, how will we stand up to the King of Worms?
The Council of Mages has been dissolved. Arch-Mage Traven has been deserted. He's all we have left.
Necromancers have attacked our very homes. What could be next?

text.Generic Argonian Female: The Bruma guild hall has been decimated. Our hall could be next!
I've heard rumors about the Council of Mages consorting with outside sources. Why are outsiders interfering with our guild?
The Council of Mages has this Necromancer situation under control. They must, or else we'd know about it, right?

text.Generic Argonian Male: Something has gone seriously wrong at the Arcane University. I heard that a high-ranking member was killed in some sort of ambush.

text.Generic Argonian Female: I think the rumors about Necromancers are completely untrue. I've heard some crazy things, and I don't believe any of them.

text.Generic Argonian Male: The Council seems very interested in this new group of Necromancers that has sprung up. I wonder how things will play out.
Have you heard anything more about what the Council knows about these Necromancers? Something's not right.

text.Generic Argonian Female: It's good to know that valuable research is still going on, even though things seem to be a bit more tense lately.

text.Generic Argonian Male: Someone finally solved the problems with research at Vahtacen. You'd think the Council would know more about the Ayleids by now.

text.Generic Argonian Female: It sounds like the Council of Mages has been holding extra meetings recently. I'm not sure what that means.

text.Generic Argonian Male: I've heard rumors that the Council of Mages is taking advice from outsiders. I'm not sure how I feel about that.
Arch-Mage Traven was right to ban Necromancy from the guild. Look at what they've done; they've gone and killed several of us!

text.Generic Argonian Female: The Mages Guild has been attacked by Necromancers. This proves they can't be trusted!

text.Generic Argonian Male: I understand that Dagail is in much better control of her faculties now that Kalthar's plot has been exposed.
Kalthar tried to ruin the Leyawiin guild. Just goes to show you can't trust a Necromancer, even if he claims to be "reformed."

text.Generic Argonian Female: Did you hear that someone played yet another prank on Jeanne Frasoric in Bruma? I don't know how she keeps falling for these things.

text.Generic Argonian Male: It sounds like there are an awful lot of problems at the Bruma guild hall. Jeanne does a poor job of running that place.

text.Generic Argonian Female: The Chorrol guild hall had an unpleasant visit recently, from someone who had a grudge against Teekeeus.

text.TESTArgonian: I hear a new Associate came to Teekeeus's aid recently. Something about an old enemy of his storming into town.

text.Generic Argonian Male: The roads near Anvil are safer now, thanks to Carahil and her guild hall. She's an example for us all.

text.Generic Argonian Female: The Anvil guild has made quite a name for itself under Carahil. Did you hear about the recent murderer they caught?
Kud-Ei will do anything to help her girls out. She recently got Ardaline out of a bind, and I hear it wasn't completely within guild rules.

text.Generic Argonian Male: Kud-Ei runs a tight ship in Bruma. She may not always play by the rules, but I wouldn't want her on my bad side.
I can't believe a Mages Guild associate was found dead in Cheydinhal. What kind of place are they running there?

text.Generic Argonian Female: Did you hear that Falcar left the guild? I think Deetsan is in charge in Cheydinhal now.
I heard that one of the Skingrad mages was assaulted, but I don't know the details.

text.Generic Argonian Male: Sounds like the Skingrad branch of the guild can't even keep track of its members. How appalling.

text.Druja: I saw Erthor earlier. Guess someone rescued him again. Hide your scrolls while you can.

text.Generic Argonian Male: Things in the guild have been different since Traven was named Arch-Mage. They're more structured, but everyone seems tense.

text.Generic Argonian Female: Things in the guild have been different since Traven was named Arch-Mage. They're more structured, but everyone seems tense.

text.Generic Argonian Male: Half of the Council of Mages resigned when Traven took over the position of Arch-Mage.

text.Generic Argonian Female: Half of the Council of Mages resigned when Traven took over the position of Arch-Mage.

text.Generic Argonian Male: Arch-Mage Traven is the first to take such a hard stance on Necromancy. It upset more than a few people.

text.Generic Argonian Female: Arch-Mage Traven is the first to take such a hard stance on Necromancy. It upset more than a few people.

text.Generic Argonian Male: The Mages Guild runs more or less like it always did, but we lost quite a few members when the practice of Necromancy was banned.

text.Generic Argonian Female: The Mages Guild runs more or less like it always did, but we lost quite a few members when the practice of Necromancy was banned.

text.Generic Argonian Male: Necromancy may be legal in Cyrodiil, but few will openly admit to practicing it now that the Mages Guild has banned it.

text.Generic Argonian Female: Necromancy may be legal in Cyrodiil, but few will openly admit to practicing it now that the Mages Guild has banned it.

text.Generic Argonian Male: Some say that Traven is mis-using the power of the Arch-Mage's position to further his personal agendas.

text.Generic Argonian Female: Some say that Traven is mis-using the power of the Arch-Mage's position to further his personal agendas.

text.Generic Argonian Male: I don't know what Arch-Mage Traven has against Necromancy, but the first thing he did after taking over the Mages Guild was to ban its practice.

text.Generic Argonian Female: I don't know what Arch-Mage Traven has against Necromancy, but the first thing he did after taking over the Mages Guild was to ban its practice.

text.Generic Argonian Male: Not only has Necromancy been banned from practice in the Mages Guild, but the Guild won't deal with anyone who openly uses it.

text.Generic Argonian Female: Not only has Necromancy been banned from practice in the Mages Guild, but the Guild won't deal with anyone who openly uses it.

text.Generic Argonian Male: The Mages Guild has made more than a few enemies since Necromancy was banned.

text.Generic Argonian Female: The Mages Guild has made more than a few enemies since Necromancy was banned.

text.Generic Argonian Male: I saw that Earana woman hanging around the Mages Guild again.
I saw that Erthor is back in town again.

text.HalLiurz: I hear one of the guild mages has gone missing again.

text.Generic Argonian Male: It seems quieter than usual at the Mages Guild.
I saw Earana leaving town. She looked very excited.

text.HalLiurz: Things at the Mages Guild seem tense. That Falcar fellow sure keeps a tight rein on things.

text.Generic Argonian Male: Falcar at the Mages Guild seems to be angry all the time. I avoid him when I can.
Varon Vamori seems very glum lately. I guess things aren't going well with Ardaline.
Kud-Ei seems upset about something lately. I'd stay away from the Mages Guild if I were you.

text.Generic Argonian Female: Kud-Ei seems upset about something lately. I'd stay away from the Mages Guild if I were you.
Those new fellows here in town are making me nervous. Walking around with those big weapons; I hope they leave soon.

text.Generic Argonian Male: I heard someone broke into the Mages Guild.

text.Generic Argonian Female: I heard someone broke into the Mages Guild.

text.Generic Argonian Male: If the Council really did split up, the guild is done for. This is serious.

text.Generic Argonian Female: If the Council really did split up, the guild is done for. This is serious.

text.Generic Argonian Male: The Mages Guild seems more disorganized than usual lately.

text.Generic Argonian Female: The Mages Guild seems more disorganized than usual lately.
We threaten no one. Why can't they just leave us alone?

text.Generic Argonian Male: Daedra Lords demand offerings and services. If you won't do as you're told, just forget about it.

text.Teinaava: There are whispers in the halls of the Sanctuary. Some say there is a traitor among us. That the Brotherhood has been... compromised.

text.Ocheeva: I... I've heard some talk. This past year, some family members have been found... murdered! Could there be an assassin among assassins?

text.Generic Argonian Male: They say that when you murder someone, the Dark Brotherhood comes to you in your sleep. It's how they recruit new members.

text.Generic Argonian Female: They say that when you murder someone, the Dark Brotherhood comes to you in your sleep. It's how they recruit new members.

text.Generic Argonian Female: Count Leyawiin created a new order of knights -- the White Stallion -- for the ones who defeated Black Brugo.

text.Generic Argonian Male: I hear the Count's got someone to sort out that business with Mazoga the so-called knight.

text.Generic Argonian Female: Poor Tivela. I hear she is turning Cheydinhal inside out looking for her husband, Rythe. I hope nothing bad has happened to him.

text.Generic Argonian Male: Have you seen Valus Odiil recently? Spends all day in the tavern since his boys left.

text.Generic Argonian Female: Have you seen Valus Odiil recently? Spends all day in the tavern since his boys left.

text.Generic Argonian Male: I saw Valus Odiil at the Grey Mare again today. Hasn't been the same since his boys took off.

text.Generic Argonian Female: I saw Valus Odiil at the Grey Mare again today. Hasn't been the same since his boys took off.
So, the mighty Ulrich Leland has fallen. Apparently Llevana Nedaren snapped and killed him. Good riddance I say.
Did you hear the news? Ulrich Leland was thrown in the dungeons for stealing money from the city coffers. Haha! Justice for the little guy!
Thank goodness the gate is gone. I couldn't get a good night's sleep knowing it was out there!
Rythe Lythandas seems to be back in town. Wonder where he was off to?

text.Generic Argonian Male: The Honorblade has been returned to the Castle after all these years! This is certainly a good omen.

text.Generic Argonian Female: The Honorblade has been returned to the Castle after all these years! This is certainly a good omen.

text.Generic Argonian Male: The Countess still seems quite sad. I hear someone tried to find the item stolen from the castle, but they had no luck. Oh well.

text.Generic Argonian Female: The Countess still seems quite sad. I hear someone tried to find the item stolen from the castle, but they had no luck. Oh well.

text.Generic Argonian Male: The Countess seems much happier now that the item that was stolen from her was returned.

text.Generic Argonian Female: The Countess seems much happier now that the item that was stolen from her was returned.

text.Generic Argonian Female: Reynald Jemane has a terrible memory. We've met many times, but when I saw him in Cheydinhal, he walked right past me like we were strangers.

text.Generic Argonian Male: I was in Cheydinhal last week, and I'm sure I saw Reynald Jemane. He acted like he didn't know me, though.

text.Generic Argonian Female: I was in Cheydinhal last week, and I'm sure I saw Reynald Jemane. He acted like he didn't know me, though.

text.Generic Argonian Male: There's some strange Dark Elf in town, asking about Reynald Jemane and his brother.

text.Generic Argonian Female: There's some strange Dark Elf in town, asking about Reynald Jemane and his brother.

text.Generic Argonian Male: I can't believe that the Countess is more obsessed with that painting than the Oblivion Gate threatening the city!

text.Generic Argonian Female: I can't believe that the Countess is more obsessed with that painting than the Oblivion Gate threatening the city!

text.Generic Argonian Male: I heard that the Countess is quite upset lately. Apparently someone stole something very personal to her.

text.Generic Argonian Female: I heard that the Countess is quite upset lately. Apparently someone stole something very personal to her.
They charged me 5 gold for littering! Littering!! I barely make that in a year! These fines are ridiculous!
I can't believe the ridiculous new fines the guards are imposing. Ever since Ulrich took over as Captain of the Guard, this place is going downhill.

text.Generic Argonian Male: Have you been near Rosentia Gallenus's house recently? Smells horrible... like she left some meat out to spoil.

text.Generic Argonian Female: Have you been near Rosentia Gallenus's house recently? Smells horrible... like she left some meat out to spoil.

text.Generic Argonian Male: I was walking past Rosentia Gallenus' home the other day, and I heard these strange animal noises or something from inside... very odd.

text.Generic Argonian Female: I was walking past Rosentia Gallenus' home the other day, and I heard these strange animal noises or something from inside... very odd.

text.Generic Argonian Male: So, thanks to some hired help, the Jemanes recovered Weatherleah. Good thing... I never liked having ogres so close to Chorrol.

text.Generic Argonian Female: So, thanks to some hired help, the Jemanes recovered Weatherleah. Good thing... I never liked having ogres so close to Chorrol.
I'd stay inside the city walls if I were you, there's no telling what's going to come out of that gate.
Ever since that gate appeared, the city guards have been on alert. I hope they can protect us.

text.Generic Argonian Male: We're all talking about the emperor's murder. We have no emperor. And no heir. That's never happened before. I suppose we should all be worried.

text.Generic Argonian Female: We're all talking about the emperor's murder. We have no emperor. And no heir. That's never happened before. I suppose we should all be worried.
People are subdued. Troubled. A crisis like this tests the people's faith.
I think we're in for some hard times. The death of Uriel Septim and his heirs changes everything.

text.Generic Argonian Male: The Emperor and his three sons, dead, right under the noses of the Imperial Guard. It's a disgrace.
Have you heard about Kvatch? They say that daedra came from Oblivion and burned the whole city to the ground!

text.Generic Argonian Female: Everyone's saying there's trouble in Kvatch. The whole town destroyed. Only a few survivors.

text.Generic Argonian Male: Do you think what happened to Kvatch could happen here?
I heard that the Kvatch Guard is driving back the daedra! Maybe there's hope after all.

text.Generic Argonian Female: I heard that the Kvatch Guard is driving back the daedra! Maybe there's hope after all.
Everybody's talking about the Hero of Kvatch! They say he actually went into an Oblivion Gate and destroyed it.

text.Generic Argonian Male: Everybody's talking about the Hero of Kvatch! They say she actually went into an Oblivion Gate and destroyed it.
Hey, you're the one they call the Hero of Kvatch, aren't you? The one that closed the Oblivion Gate and saved the city?

text.Generic Argonian Female: Hey, you're the one they call the Hero of Kvatch, aren't you? The one that closed the Oblivion Gate and saved the city?

text.Generic Argonian Male: Good news from Kvatch for a change. The last of the daedra have been driven out.

text.Generic Argonian Female: Good news from Kvatch for a change. The last of the daedra have been driven out.

text.Generic Argonian Male: Do you believe any of that talk about more Oblivion Gates opening all over the place?

text.Generic Argonian Female: I've been hearing disturbing tales about Oblivion Gates opening all across Cyrodiil. I hope it's just wild talk.

text.Generic Argonian Male: They say that Oblivion Gates have opened outside cities all across Tamriel! Gods preserve us!

text.Generic Argonian Female: With those Oblivion Gates opening everywhere, it's only a matter of time before another city goes the way of Kvatch.
Did you hear? The lost heir of Uriel Septim rallied the Guard and smashed a horde of daedra outside Bruma!

text.Generic Argonian Male: They say a lost son of Uriel Septim has reappeared in Bruma. Troops are flocking to his banner from all over Cyrodiil!
I heard that some cult called the Mythic Dawn is behind the Emperor's assassination.

text.Generic Argonian Female: They're saying some cult murdered the Emperor and are opening the Oblivion Gates. Do you think any of it's true?

text.Generic Argonian Male: Thank Akatosh the Oblivion Crisis is over! Although with no Emperor and no heir, I wonder what will happen to the Empire?
I plan to visit the Imperial City soon to pay my respects at the Temple of the One. They say the Dragon Statue is 100 feet high!

text.Generic Argonian Female: I'm sure the Elder Council will find some way to hold the Empire together. At least the Oblivion invasion is over!
I heard that some of the provinces were talking about seceding from the Empire. Probably just talk though. Everything's a bit unsettled now.

text.Generic Argonian Male: Most people consider Martin's... transformation... a religious or political event, but what interests me is its metaphysical implications.

text.Generic Argonian Female: Most people consider Martin's... transformation... a religious or political event, but what interests me is its metaphysical implications.
I wish I had witnessed the avatar of divine Akatosh myself. Imagine! Upon the very altar of the Temple of the One!

text.RightWind: To think that Bruma was where Martin Septim chose to reveal himself as the true heir to the throne for the first time!

text.Generic Argonian Female: Don't run into the water to escape a Scalon. They'll follow you.

text.Generic Argonian Male: Have to watch for those Scalons. I hear they carry disease.

text.Generic Argonian Female: Have to watch for those Scalons. I hear they carry disease.

text.Generic Argonian Male: If you see a Gnarl, be careful what spells you use on them.

text.Generic Argonian Female: If you see a Gnarl, be careful what spells you use on them.
The Gnarl are strange creatures. Hit them with a fireball, and they get stronger, but they hate other elements even more.

text.Generic Argonian Male: Those Shambles are dangerous. Make sure to stand back if you kill one.

text.Generic Argonian Female: Those Shambles are dangerous. Make sure to stand back if you kill one.
If you see a Shambles dying, stand back. They'll take you with them.

text.Generic Argonian Male: Flesh Atronachs are dangerous. Some are smart enough to heal themselves when they're hurt.

text.Generic Argonian Female: Flesh Atronachs are dangerous. Some are smart enough to heal themselves when they're hurt.
If you have to fight a Flesh Atronach, a good shock spell is the way to go.

text.Generic Argonian Male: The poison of the Elytra can be debilitating.

text.Generic Argonian Female: The poison of the Elytra can be debilitating.
Watch for the Elytra's stingers; their poison can be deadly. They don't like magic much, though.

text.Generic Argonian Male: The Hunger is one of Lord Sheogorath's favorite pets.

text.Generic Argonian Female: The Hunger is one of Lord Sheogorath's favorite pets.
Like most lesser Daedra, the Hunger has a weakness to shock spells.

text.Generic Argonian Male: Some say the Grummites are the original inhabitants of the Shivering Isles.

text.Generic Argonian Female: Some say the Grummites are the original inhabitants of the Shivering Isles.
Try not to fight a Grummite in the water. Or in the rain. They seem to like that.

text.Generic Argonian Male: The Baliwog is a dangerous little creature. Some say they grow up to be Scalons.

text.Generic Argonian Female: The Baliwog is a dangerous little creature. Some say they grow up to be Scalons.
The Baliwog will return to the water to heal.

text.Generic Argonian Male: I've heard that Skinned Hounds don't like fire.

text.Generic Argonian Female: I've heard that Skinned Hounds don't like fire.
Best way to kill a Skinned Hound is with a fireball, or a good weapon.

text.Generic Argonian Male: Heretics are misguided worshippers of Arden-Sul.

text.Generic Argonian Female: Heretics are misguided worshippers of Arden-Sul.
If you want to get close to the Heretics, try putting on their robes.

text.Generic Argonian Male: The Zealots in the lands of Dementia believe they worship Arden-Sul. Poor, deluded souls.

text.Generic Argonian Female: The Zealots in the lands of Dementia believe they worship Arden-Sul. Poor, deluded souls.
If you want to sneak up on one of those Zealots, wear one of their robes. Fools them every time.

text.Generic Argonian Male: I understand there's been strange activity near the obelisks around the Isles.

text.Generic Argonian Female: I understand there's been strange activity near the obelisks around the Isles.
The crystal obelisks that dot the Isles have recently started behaving strangely.

text.Generic Argonian Male: Knights of Order have appeared in the Isles. I hear they come from the obelisks.

text.Generic Argonian Female: Knights of Order have appeared in the Isles. I hear they come from the obelisks.
I understand that the Hearts of Order you find on the Knights can be used to unlock special chests.

text.Generic Argonian Male: Raven-Biter runs the Choosy Beggar. Not a bad place.

text.SEWideEye: Raven-Biter runs the Choosy Beggar. Not a bad place.

text.Generic Argonian Male: Tilse Areleth has quite a collection of things for sale at Common Treasures.

text.Generic Argonian Female: Tilse Areleth has quite a collection of things for sale at Common Treasures.

text.Generic Argonian Male: The best armor in the city is at The Missing Pauldron.

text.Generic Argonian Female: The best armor in the city is at The Missing Pauldron.

text.Generic Argonian Male: Books of Bliss has quite a selection.

text.Generic Argonian Female: Books of Bliss has quite a selection.

text.Generic Argonian Male: Cutter sells weapons in Crucible, but you won't catch me going there.

text.Generic Argonian Female: Cutter sells weapons in Crucible, but you won't catch me going there.

text.Generic Argonian Male: That Museum of Oddities is a joke, although I hear Una Armina will pay for certain items.

text.Generic Argonian Female: That Museum of Oddities is a joke, although I hear Una Armina will pay for certain items.

text.Generic Argonian Male: I'd research my own spells before I'd buy them from Earil's Mysteries.

text.Generic Argonian Female: I'd research my own spells before I'd buy them from Earil's Mysteries.

text.Generic Argonian Male: Things Found? More like Things Found in the Trash.

text.Generic Argonian Female: Things Found? More like Things Found in the Trash.

text.Generic Argonian Male: I wouldn't be caught dead at Sickly Bernice's... though I imagine her customers might.

text.Generic Argonian Female: I wouldn't be caught dead at Sickly Bernice's... though I imagine her customers might.

text.Generic Argonian Male: Dumag gro-Bonk at The Missing Pauldron is collecting that Amber you find in the root tunnels.

text.Generic Argonian Female: Dumag gro-Bonk at The Missing Pauldron is collecting that Amber you find in the root tunnels.
There are smiths in New Sheoth that collect Amber and Madness Ore.

text.Generic Argonian Male: I've heard ghosts haunt the ruined city of Vitharn.

text.Generic Argonian Female: I've heard ghosts haunt the ruined city of Vitharn.
Take care venturing into the ruined city of Vitharn.

text.Generic Argonian Male: I understand there's a Knight of the Thorn in Hale.

text.Generic Argonian Female: I understand there's a Knight of the Thorn in Hale.
If you visit Hale, you may see Pyke, a Knight of the Thorn.

text.Generic Argonian Male: The merchants in Crucible are getting tired of Brithaur stealing from them.

text.Generic Argonian Female: The merchants in Crucible are getting tired of Brithaur stealing from them.
I understand the merchants of Crucible are having problems with Brithaur.

text.Generic Argonian Male: I understand Hirrus Clutumnus is begging for people to kill him.

text.Generic Argonian Female: I understand Hirrus Clutumnus is begging for people to kill him.
In Crucible, a man named Hirrus Clutumnus has been trying to convince people to kill him.

text.Generic Argonian Male: I've heard there's someone in Highcross trying to catalogue every living thing in the Isles.

text.Generic Argonian Female: I've heard there's someone in Highcross trying to catalogue every living thing in the Isles.
If you visit Highcross, speak with Mirili Ulven. She needs help with her project.

text.Generic Argonian Male: I don't visit the Museum of Oddities, but Una Armina is always looking for new items to display.

text.Generic Argonian Female: I don't visit the Museum of Oddities, but Una Armina is always looking for new items to display.

text.Generic Argonian Male: Cindanwe runs a tight ship in Fellmoor.

text.Generic Argonian Female: Cindanwe runs a tight ship in Fellmoor.
Fellmoor must be a terrible place to live.

text.Generic Argonian Male: Amiable Fanriene thinks his house is going to fall in on him.

text.Generic Argonian Female: Amiable Fanriene thinks his house is going to fall in on him.
There's a man in Bliss who believes his own house will collapse around him.

text.Generic Argonian Male: Sickly Bernice is convinced she's dying. No wonder no one wants to eat at her Taphouse.

text.Generic Argonian Female: Sickly Bernice is convinced she's dying. No wonder no one wants to eat at her Taphouse.
Sickly Bernice in Crucible believes she is dying.

text.Generic Argonian Male: I heard Tove the Unrestful is building something again.

text.Generic Argonian Female: I heard Tove the Unrestful is building something again.
Tove the Unrestful in Bliss is collecting items to build something.

text.Generic Argonian Male: Ushnar in Crucible is afraid of cats. Cats!

text.Generic Argonian Female: Ushnar in Crucible is afraid of cats. Cats!
There's an orc in Crucible who is deathly afraid of cats.

text.Generic Argonian Male: Ahjazda in Crucible believes the world is ending.

text.Generic Argonian Female: Ahjazda in Crucible believes the world is ending.
There is a Khajiit in Crucible who believes the world is about to end.

text.Generic Argonian Male: Poor Big Head will never find the Fork of Horripilation.

text.Generic Argonian Female: Poor Big Head will never find the Fork of Horripilation.
The Argonian Big Head is always searching for the Fork of Horripilation.

text.Generic Argonian Male: Every resident of Split has a double living in the town.

text.Generic Argonian Female: Every resident of Split has a double living in the town.
There are two of everything in Split. Even the residents.

text.Generic Argonian Male: My cousin says the beggars all work for the Gray Fox. It's rather frightening.

text.TarMeena: My cousin says the beggars all work for the Gray Fox. It's rather frightening.

text.Generic Argonian Male: Amantius Allectus is complaining about crime in the city. Someone actually broke into his house and stole his diary.

text.TarMeena: Amantius Allectus is complaining about crime in the city. Someone actually broke into his house and stole his diary.

text.Generic Argonian Male: Captain Lex blames the Gray Fox for stealing the tax collection. He wants a bounty put on the Gray Fox, but the Legion Commander has refused.

text.TarMeena: Captain Lex blames the Gray Fox for stealing the tax collection. He wants a bounty put on the Gray Fox, but the Legion Commander has refused.

text.Generic Argonian Female: There was a murder in the Chapel. It happened when a thief was caught trying to rob Llathasa's tomb.

text.Generic Argonian Male: Did you hear? The Countess was robbed. Someone stole her family ring.

text.Generic Argonian Female: Did you hear? The Countess was robbed. Someone stole her family ring.

text.Generic Argonian Male: The Gray Fox made a fool of Hieronymus Lex. While half the Watch was in the Waterfront, thieves made off with half the rest of the city.

text.TarMeena: The Gray Fox made a fool of Hieronymus Lex. While half the Watch was in the Waterfront, thieves made off with half the rest of the city.

text.Generic Argonian Male: Did you hear? Hieronymus Lex was reassigned to Anvil.

text.TarMeena: Did you hear? Hieronymus Lex was reassigned to Anvil.

text.Generic Argonian Male: Did you hear what happened? Someone robbed the wizard's tower. Fathis Aren got what he deserved, if you ask me.

text.Generic Argonian Female: Did you hear what happened? Someone robbed the wizard's tower. Fathis Aren got what he deserved, if you ask me.

text.Generic Argonian Male: They say a thief actually stole one of the Elder Scrolls from the Imperial Library. Who would have thought it was even possible?

text.Generic Argonian Female: They say a thief actually stole one of the Elder Scrolls from the Imperial Library. Who would have thought it was even possible?

text.Generic Argonian Male: I saw Ugak gra-Mogakh earlier. At least, I think it was her. Perhaps it was her sister.

text.Generic Argonian Female: I saw Ugak gra-Mogakh earlier. At least, I think it was her. Perhaps it was her sister.

text.Generic Argonian Male: Erina Jeranus isn't the most social inkeeper in the world, but she runs a good, clean house.

text.Generic Argonian Female: Erina Jeranus isn't the most social inkeeper in the world, but she runs a good, clean house.

text.Generic Argonian Male: Don't bring up religion around Else God-Hater. She's likely to use that sword of hers on you.

text.Generic Argonian Female: Don't bring up religion around Else God-Hater. She's likely to use that sword of hers on you.

text.Generic Argonian Male: I saw Agnete out drinking late again last night. It's no wonder they call her "the Pickled." She sure can repair armor, though.

text.Generic Argonian Female: I saw Agnete out drinking late again last night. It's no wonder they call her "the Pickled." She sure can repair armor, though.

text.Generic Argonian Male: Marie Palielle seems very happy working at the chapel. She's always working, but she's always got a smile on her face.

text.Generic Argonian Female: Marie Palielle seems very happy working at the chapel. She's always working, but she's always got a smile on her face.

text.Generic Argonian Male: I wouldn't want an Orc butler, but apparently the Count doesn't mind. Shum gro-Yarug has been there for years.

text.Generic Argonian Female: I wouldn't want an Orc butler, but apparently the Count doesn't mind. Shum gro-Yarug has been there for years.

text.Amusei: If you need to learn how to use a shield, you should talk to Fadus Calidius at the Fighters Guild.

text.Generic Argonian Female: If you need to learn how to use a shield, you should talk to Fadus Calidius at the Fighters Guild.

text.Generic Argonian Male: I hear Adrienne Berene is quite a mage. Of course, it's not like she'd bother to stop to talk to you in the street.

text.HalLiurz: I hear Adrienne Berene is quite a mage. Of course, it's not like she'd bother to stop to talk to you in the street.

text.Generic Argonian Male: Must be nice being in the Mages Guild. If they need something recharged, they just talk to Vigge the Cautious, and poof! All done.

text.HalLiurz: Must be nice being in the Mages Guild. If they need something recharged, they just talk to Vigge the Cautious, and poof! All done.

text.Generic Argonian Male: I heard Lazare Milvan challenged someone else to a duel. The man is ridiculous.

text.Generic Argonian Female: I heard Lazare Milvan challenged someone else to a duel. The man is ridiculous.

text.Generic Argonian Male: Ambroise Canne is really good with his shield. Even better than Falus Calidus, I think.

text.Generic Argonian Female: Ambroise Canne is really good with his shield. Even better than Falus Calidus, I think.

text.Generic Argonian Male: Undena Orethi has got some fine tomatoes. Some of the finest in Cyrodiil.

text.Generic Argonian Female: Undena Orethi has got some fine tomatoes. Some of the finest in Cyrodiil.

text.Generic Argonian Male: I've seen Shameer at the Tamika Vineyards practicing archery. He's really good. I might try to get some pointers from him.

text.Generic Argonian Female: I've seen Shameer at the Tamika Vineyards practicing archery. He's really good. I might try to get some pointers from him.

text.Generic Argonian Male: I bought some wine from Gaston Surilie a few days ago. I was very impressed by it.

text.Generic Argonian Female: I bought some wine from Gaston Surilie a few days ago. I was very impressed by it.

text.Generic Argonian Male: Varnado at The Best Defense knows a lot about Heavy Armor.

text.TarMeena: Varnado at The Best Defense knows a lot about Heavy Armor.

text.Generic Argonian Male: If you want to learn more about light armor, you might talk to Dul gro-Shug.

text.TarMeena: If you want to learn more about light armor, you might talk to Dul gro-Shug.

text.Generic Argonian Male: I understand Ida Vlinorman enjoys jumping off high things. Like buildings.

text.TarMeena: I understand Ida Vlinorman enjoys jumping off high things. Like buildings.

text.Generic Argonian Male: Lose the key to your house? Find Mandil. He can get in, I'll bet.

text.TarMeena: Lose the key to your house? Find Mandil. He can get in, I'll bet.

text.Generic Argonian Male: I understand Areldil is good at getting into places other people can't.

text.TarMeena: I understand Areldil is good at getting into places other people can't.

text.Generic Argonian Male: Ogier Georick has a good selection of ingredients at The Main Ingredient.

text.TarMeena: Ogier Georick has a good selection of ingredients at The Main Ingredient.

text.Generic Argonian Male: If you're looking to buy cheap spells, Edgar's is the place to look.

text.TarMeena: If you're looking to buy cheap spells, Edgar's is the place to look.

text.Generic Argonian Male: Viator Accius has a good shield selection at Stonewall Shields.

text.TarMeena: Viator Accius has a good shield selection at Stonewall Shields.

text.Generic Argonian Male: Three Brothers have some good merchandise. Don't know if I've met all three brothers, though.

text.TarMeena: Three Brothers have some good merchandise. Don't know if I've met all three brothers, though.

text.Generic Argonian Male: Looking for an axe or a mace? Head to Slash 'N Smash. The name says it all.

text.TarMeena: Looking for an axe or a mace? Head to Slash 'N Smash. The name says it all.

text.Generic Argonian Female: I think Tertia Viducia has a good supply of light armor.
Ohtesse is a wonderfully gifted healer. I sometimes worry that she spends too much time taking care of others, and not enough on herself.
There's something about Ra'qanar I just don't trust.

text.RightWind: Skjorta is a nuisance. She was running around town, drunk and naked again.
Good that we have a healer in town. Cirroc can fix most anything that ails you. After all these years, he almost seems like a Nord himself.
Bumph gra-Gash is very skilled in heavy armor use. I wouldn't want to get on her bad side.
Alga has a lot of good tales to tell. I wish I could tell a story like she does.

text.Generic Argonian Male: Uravasa Othrelas has a way with words. I wish she could teach me how to speak that well.

text.Generic Argonian Female: Uravasa Othrelas has a way with words. I wish she could teach me how to speak that well.

text.Generic Argonian Male: I understand that Fathis Aren is quite the conjurer.

text.Generic Argonian Female: I understand that Fathis Aren is quite the conjurer.

text.Generic Argonian Male: Kud-Ei is very protective of her sisters in the Mages Guild. And she's quite skilled at creating illusions.

text.Generic Argonian Female: Kud-Ei is very protective of her sisters in the Mages Guild. And she's quite skilled at creating illusions.

text.Generic Argonian Male: I heard Ita Rienus talking about the geography of Tamriel again. She's very knowledgeable.

text.Generic Argonian Female: I heard Ita Rienus talking about the geography of Tamriel again. She's very knowledgeable.

text.Generic Argonian Male: City-Swimmer certainly lives up to her name. I've seen her in the canals many times.

text.Generic Argonian Female: City-Swimmer certainly lives up to her name. I've seen her in the canals many times.

text.Generic Argonian Male: Bugak gro-Bol has some good books at Southern Books. He's an odd one, though. Always seems ready for a fight.

text.Generic Argonian Female: Bugak gro-Bol has some good books at Southern Books. He's an odd one, though. Always seems ready for a fight.

text.Generic Argonian Male: Brodras has been teaching Fighters Guild members how to better use heavy armor. Odd for a Bosmer, but he's apparently good at it.

text.Generic Argonian Female: Brodras has been teaching Fighters Guild members how to better use heavy armor. Odd for a Bosmer, but he's apparently good at it.

text.Generic Argonian Male: I understand that S'drassa is still trying to create a potion to cure skooma addiction.

text.Generic Argonian Female: I understand that S'drassa is still trying to create a potion to cure skooma addiction.

text.Generic Argonian Male: Norbert Lelles runs a fine store, but he's not the brightest fellow.

text.QuillWeave: Norbert Lelles runs a fine store, but he's not the brightest fellow.

text.Generic Argonian Male: Rhano is quite the swordsman. I've heard he'll train you for the right amount of money.

text.QuillWeave: Rhano is quite the swordsman. I've heard he'll train you for the right amount of money.

text.Generic Argonian Male: I saw Huurwen practicing shield technique at the Fighters Guild the other day. She could teach me a thing or two.

text.QuillWeave: I saw Huurwen practicing shield technique at the Fighters Guild the other day. She could teach me a thing or two.

text.Generic Argonian Male: I've heard that Feren Relas knows quite a bit about alchemy.

text.QuillWeave: I've heard that Feren Relas knows quite a bit about alchemy.

text.MS93Crewmember1: For someone who drinks so much, Hauls-Ropes-Faster is in peak physical condition. You could learn a lot from him.

text.QuillWeave: For someone who drinks so much, Hauls-Ropes-Faster is in peak physical condition. You could learn a lot from him.

text.Generic Argonian Male: I saw that Pinarus Inventius was out hunting again. He can shoot a bird on the wing without really trying.

text.QuillWeave: I saw that Pinarus Inventius was out hunting again. He can shoot a bird on the wing without really trying.

text.Teekeeus: Ah... pure magic. Research. Knowledge. That's why I love the Mages Guild.

text.Generic Argonian Male: Picked up a good book at Renoit's this week. Sure wish I could read it.

text.Generic Argonian Female: Picked up a good book at Renoit's this week. Sure wish I could read it.

text.Generic Argonian Male: You ever talk to Honditar? Odd fellow, but he seems to know his way around these parts.

text.Generic Argonian Female: You ever talk to Honditar? Odd fellow, but he seems to know his way around these parts.

text.Generic Argonian Male: Have you met Modryn Oreyn? Quiet man, but apparently he's an incredible fighter.

text.Generic Argonian Female: Have you met Modryn Oreyn? Quiet man, but apparently he's an incredible fighter.

text.Generic Argonian Male: That Rimalus Bruiant sure loves his dogs. A little too much, if you ask me.

text.Generic Argonian Female: That Rimalus Bruiant sure loves his dogs. A little too much, if you ask me.

text.Generic Argonian Male: Casta Scribonia has finished a new book. Nothing that interests me, though.

text.Generic Argonian Female: Casta Scribonia has finished a new book. Nothing that interests me, though.

text.Generic Argonian Male: I saw Rena Bruiant talking to her dogs the other day. I think she thinks they understand her.

text.Generic Argonian Female: I saw Rena Bruiant talking to her dogs the other day. I think she thinks they understand her.

text.Generic Argonian Male: You know, I think the mutton here in Chorrol is the best in all the Empire. Mmmm... that's good mutton.

text.Generic Argonian Female: You know, I think the mutton here in Chorrol is the best in all the Empire. Mmmm... that's good mutton.

text.Generic Argonian Male: Vilena Donton just hasn't been the same since her eldest son died. Still, she does a good job of running the Fighters Guild.

text.Generic Argonian Female: Vilena Donton just hasn't been the same since her eldest son died. Still, she does a good job of running the Fighters Guild.

text.Generic Argonian Male: I heard there is a good smith in Chorrol.

text.Generic Argonian Female: I heard there is a good smith in Chorrol.

text.Generic Argonian Male: Ancient Wayshrines of the Nine are scattered through the wilderness. The righteous who pray there receive powerful divine blessings.

text.Generic Argonian Female: Ancient Wayshrines of the Nine are scattered through the wilderness. The righteous who pray there receive powerful divine blessings.

text.Generic Argonian Male: If you've done good deeds, the Nine will bless you and cure diseases when you visit their wayshrines.

text.Generic Argonian Female: If you've done good deeds, the Nine will bless you and cure diseases when you visit their wayshrines.

text.Generic Argonian Male: Wayshrines of the Nine in the wilderness confer blessings on the righteous and faithful.

text.Generic Argonian Female: Wayshrines of the Nine in the wilderness confer blessings on the righteous and faithful.

text.Generic Argonian Male: Those famous for good deeds may receive Blessings of Intelligence and Magicka when they visit Wayshrines of Julianos.

text.Generic Argonian Female: Those famous for good deeds may receive Blessings of Intelligence and Magicka when they visit Wayshrines of Julianos.

text.Generic Argonian Male: Virtuous visitors to Wayshrines of Kynareth may receive Blessings of Agility.

text.Generic Argonian Female: Virtuous visitors to Wayshrines of Kynareth may receive Blessings of Agility.

text.Generic Argonian Male: When you visit a Wayshrine of Zenithar, and you've lived a good life by the Nine, you may receive a Blessing of Luck.

text.Generic Argonian Female: When you visit a Wayshrine of Zenithar, and you've lived a good life by the Nine, you may receive a Blessing of Luck.

text.Generic Argonian Male: Those who live by the Commands of the Nine receive Blessings of Strength when they visit Wayshrines of Tiber Septim.

text.Generic Argonian Female: Those who live by the Commands of the Nine receive Blessings of Strength when they visit Wayshrines of Tiber Septim.

text.Generic Argonian Male: A good man who honors the Nine may visit the Wayshrines of Akatosh for Blessings of Speed and Magicka.

text.Generic Argonian Female: A good man who honors the Nine may visit the Wayshrines of Akatosh for Blessings of Speed and Magicka.

text.Generic Argonian Male: If you've been good, Wayshrines of Dibella may bless your Personality.

text.Generic Argonian Female: If you've been good, Wayshrines of Dibella may bless your Personality.

text.Generic Argonian Male: Wayshrines of Arkay confer Blessings of Health on those who've pleased the Nine by righteous acts.

text.Generic Argonian Female: Wayshrines of Arkay confer Blessings of Health on those who've pleased the Nine by righteous acts.

text.Generic Argonian Male: Please the Nine with good works, and visit Wayshrines of Stendarr for Blessings of Endurance.

text.Generic Argonian Female: Please the Nine with good works, and visit Wayshrines of Stendarr for Blessings of Endurance.

text.Generic Argonian Male: You've seen wayshrines in the wilderness? Those who've pleased the Nine may receive Blessings of Willpower at the Wayshrines of Mara.

text.Generic Argonian Female: You've seen wayshrines in the wilderness? Those who've pleased the Nine may receive Blessings of Willpower at the Wayshrines of Mara.

text.Generic Argonian Male: The Heartlands and Nibenean Valley are the agricultural breadbaskets of Cyrodiil.

text.Generic Argonian Female: The Heartlands and Nibenean Valley are the agricultural breadbaskets of Cyrodiil.

text.Generic Argonian Male: Where does our food come from? The Heartlands. And the Nibenean Valley. And Skingrad? Great wines, cheeses, and tomatoes.

text.Generic Argonian Female: Where does our food come from? The Heartlands. And the Nibenean Valley. And Skingrad? Great wines, cheeses, and tomatoes.

text.Generic Argonian Male: The lowlands of the Great Forest rise to the upland plateau of the Colovian West.

text.Generic Argonian Female: The lowlands of the Great Forest rise to the upland plateau of the Colovian West.

text.Generic Argonian Male: The Great Forest was cleared for agriculture around Lake Rumare, but it's mostly wilderness outside of that.

text.Generic Argonian Female: The Great Forest was cleared for agriculture around Lake Rumare, but it's mostly wilderness outside of that.

text.Generic Argonian Male: The Colovian Highlands are barren wastelands along the border with Hammerfell.

text.Generic Argonian Female: The Colovian Highlands are barren wastelands along the border with Hammerfell.

text.Generic Argonian Male: The Colovian Highlands? Near the Hammerfell border? No one lives there. That's barren wastelands.

text.Generic Argonian Female: The Colovian Highlands? Near the Hammerfell border? No one lives there. That's barren wastelands.

text.Generic Argonian Male: High mountain ranges rise to the borders in the north and east, and marshes and rainforests extend to the southeast borders.

text.Generic Argonian Female: High mountain ranges rise to the borders in the north and east, and marshes and rainforests extend to the southeast borders.

text.Generic Argonian Male: It's our natural barriers that keep us safe, mostly. Mountain borders north and east, open sea to the west, and bogs and rainforest to south.

text.Generic Argonian Female: It's our natural barriers that keep us safe, mostly. Mountain borders north and east, open sea to the west, and bogs and rainforest to south.

text.Generic Argonian Male: Cyrodiil is surrounded to the north and east by the lofty Jerall and Valus mountain ranges.

text.Generic Argonian Female: Cyrodiil is surrounded to the north and east by the lofty Jerall and Valus mountain ranges.

text.Generic Argonian Male: No one wants to live in the Jerall Mountains. Well, maybe in Bruma, but they're like Nords. They don't feel the cold.

text.Generic Argonian Female: No one wants to live in the Jerall Mountains. Well, maybe in Bruma, but they're like Nords. They don't feel the cold.

text.Generic Argonian Male: Western Cyrodiil is called 'Colovia,' and includes the Gold Coast, West Weald, and Colovian Highlands regions.

text.Generic Argonian Female: Western Cyrodiil is called 'Colovia,' and includes the Gold Coast, West Weald, and Colovian Highlands regions.

text.Generic Argonian Male: In the west, in Old Colovia, that's where men are men. That's the Gold Coast, West Weald, and Colovian Highlands.

text.Generic Argonian Female: In the west, in Old Colovia, that's where men are men. That's the Gold Coast, West Weald, and Colovian Highlands.

text.Generic Argonian Male: Nibenay is a region of mixed farmland, parkland, and forest.

text.Generic Argonian Female: Nibenay is a region of mixed farmland, parkland, and forest.

text.Generic Argonian Male: With all the farms in Nibenay, there's still plenty of forest and wilderness open for settlement.

text.Generic Argonian Female: With all the farms in Nibenay, there's still plenty of forest and wilderness open for settlement.

text.Generic Argonian Male: Nibenay is bordered on north and east by rugged mountains and to the south by marshes and rainforest.

text.Generic Argonian Female: Nibenay is bordered on north and east by rugged mountains and to the south by marshes and rainforest.

text.Generic Argonian Male: The people of Nibenay consider themselves to be more civilized and sophisticated than Colovians.

text.Generic Argonian Female: The people of Nibenay consider themselves to be more civilized and sophisticated than Colovians.

text.Generic Argonian Male: I'm not saying Colovians are dumb. They're just hard-headed.

text.Generic Argonian Female: I'm not saying Colovians are dumb. They're just hard-headed.

text.Generic Argonian Male: The Nibeneans think they're slick. 'Slippery' is more like it.

text.Generic Argonian Female: The Nibeneans think they're slick. 'Slippery' is more like it.

text.Generic Argonian Male: Colovia is a land of rugged wastes and highland forests.

text.Generic Argonian Female: Colovia is a land of rugged wastes and highland forests.

text.Generic Argonian Male: Colovia is dotted with isolated farms and settlements, with most of the population in the coastal margin.

text.Generic Argonian Female: Colovia is dotted with isolated farms and settlements, with most of the population in the coastal margin.

text.Generic Argonian Male: The Colovians are proud of their reputation for being independent, rough, and rebellious.

text.Generic Argonian Female: The Colovians are proud of their reputation for being independent, rough, and rebellious.

text.Generic Argonian Male: The Imperial City is located on a large island surrounded by Lake Rumare.

text.Generic Argonian Female: The Imperial City is located on a large island surrounded by Lake Rumare.

text.Generic Argonian Male: The Imperial City is densely urbanized, with a few large parks and waterside dock areas.

text.Generic Argonian Female: The Imperial City is densely urbanized, with a few large parks and waterside dock areas.

text.Generic Argonian Male: The Imperial City itself is a walled city, with separate inner walls protecting the Imperial palace.

text.Generic Argonian Female: The Imperial City itself is a walled city, with separate inner walls protecting the Imperial palace.

text.Generic Argonian Male: The prettiest town in Cyrodiil? Don't know, but the ugliest is Bravil. Shabby, tumbledown shacks. They're big shacks, though.

text.Generic Argonian Female: The prettiest town in Cyrodiil? Don't know, but the ugliest is Bravil. Shabby, tumbledown shacks. They're big shacks, though.

text.Generic Argonian Male: Where to buy weapons? Where to buy anything, if you can afford to travel, is the Market District in the Imperial City.

text.Generic Argonian Female: Where to buy weapons? Where to buy anything, if you can afford to travel, is the Market District in the Imperial City.

text.Generic Argonian Male: My favorite town? Anvil. Lovely old stone buildings, and the harbor at sunset is beautiful.

text.Generic Argonian Female: My favorite town? Anvil. Lovely old stone buildings, and the harbor at sunset is beautiful.

text.Generic Argonian Male: Ayleid ruins? The big thing is to watch out for the traps. Thousands of years old, and still working. Amazing.

text.Generic Argonian Female: Ayleid ruins? The big thing is to watch out for the traps. Thousands of years old, and still working. Amazing.

text.Generic Argonian Male: I've seen plenty of Ayleid ruins. You'd think they'd be picked clean after 2000 years, but, no, there's still great treasures there.

text.Generic Argonian Female: I've seen plenty of Ayleid ruins. You'd think they'd be picked clean after 2000 years, but, no, there's still great treasures there.

text.Generic Argonian Male: It's still pretty wild east of the Niben. Few people, except for bandits, but at least it hasn't been picked clean by treasure-hunters.

text.Generic Argonian Female: It's still pretty wild east of the Niben. Few people, except for bandits, but at least it hasn't been picked clean by treasure-hunters.

text.Generic Argonian Male: Nobody goes into the mountains but hunters and thieves on the lam. Food and shelter is hard to come by.

text.Generic Argonian Female: Nobody goes into the mountains but hunters and thieves on the lam. Food and shelter is hard to come by.

text.Generic Argonian Male: Blackwood isn't so bad, once you get used to the flies. And being lost all the time. And the zombies and will-o-the-wisps.

text.Generic Argonian Female: Blackwood isn't so bad, once you get used to the flies. And being lost all the time. And the zombies and will-o-the-wisps.

text.Generic Argonian Male: There's islands in Niben Bay no one has visited in a hundred years. No telling what you'll find.

text.Generic Argonian Female: There's islands in Niben Bay no one has visited in a hundred years. No telling what you'll find.

text.Generic Argonian Male: Well, it's no problem traveling from the Imperial City to Leyawiin... if you're a wizard and can walk on water. I'd stay off the roads, though.

text.Generic Argonian Female: Well, it's no problem traveling from the Imperial City to Leyawiin... if you're a wizard and can walk on water. I'd stay off the roads, though.

text.Generic Argonian Male: If you're all alone in the woods and you see a troll coming, you run. Problem solved. Next question?

text.Generic Argonian Female: If you're all alone in the woods and you see a troll coming, you run. Problem solved. Next question?

text.Generic Argonian Male: Fighting's easy. Just lead them out on the water and shoot them full of holes. If you've got a bow, of course, and can walk on water.

text.Generic Argonian Female: Fighting's easy. Just lead them out on the water and shoot them full of holes. If you've got a bow, of course, and can walk on water.

text.Generic Argonian Male: The Arena's faked. You think those guys are getting killed? Really? It's just berry syrup and ham-acting.

text.Generic Argonian Female: The Arena's faked. You think those guys are getting killed? Really? It's just berry syrup and ham-acting.

text.Generic Argonian Male: Have you ever met anyone who got rich betting on the Arena? Didn't think so.

text.Generic Argonian Female: Have you ever met anyone who got rich betting on the Arena? Didn't think so.

text.Generic Argonian Male: The Council runs the Arena to amuse the masses, and it pays for itself, with all the fools who lose their shirts gambling.

text.Generic Argonian Female: The Council runs the Arena to amuse the masses, and it pays for itself, with all the fools who lose their shirts gambling.

text.Generic Argonian Male: If you're on a road, you can usually outrun anything. If you're in good shape, and not wearing a tin suit.

text.Generic Argonian Female: If you're on a road, you can usually outrun anything. If you're in good shape, and not wearing a tin suit.

text.Generic Argonian Male: Orcs don't ride horses. They eat horses. And sometimes I think they're the smart ones. Wait, maybe it's Dunmer who eat horses.

text.Generic Argonian Female: Orcs don't ride horses. They eat horses. And sometimes I think they're the smart ones. Wait, maybe it's Dunmer who eat horses.

text.Generic Argonian Male: Take Cheydinhal, for example. Pretty little town. But the Count's a Dark Elf, and it's crawling with Orc thugs and gangsters.

text.Generic Argonian Female: Take Cheydinhal, for example. Pretty little town. But the Count's a Dark Elf, and it's crawling with Orc thugs and gangsters.

text.Generic Argonian Male: The lands surrounding Lake Rumare are studded with small settlements, farms, and woodland game reserves.

text.Generic Argonian Female: The lands surrounding Lake Rumare are studded with small settlements, farms, and woodland game reserves.

text.Generic Argonian Male: The Nibenay Basin grades from rolling farmlands by the river east to the rugged uplands of the Valus Mountains.

text.Generic Argonian Female: The Nibenay Basin grades from rolling farmlands by the river east to the rugged uplands of the Valus Mountains.

text.Generic Argonian Male: On Cyrodiil's northern border is the sparsely populated mountain wilderness called the Valus Mountains.

text.Generic Argonian Female: On Cyrodiil's northern border is the sparsely populated mountain wilderness called the Valus Mountains.

text.Generic Argonian Male: You can't be too careful out in the wilderness. Almost any creature you find is liable to give you a disease.

text.Generic Argonian Female: You can't be too careful out in the wilderness. Almost any creature you find is liable to give you a disease.

text.Generic Argonian Male: Watch yourself around goblins. Some of the nastier ones will toss spells at you.

text.Generic Argonian Female: Watch yourself around goblins. Some of the nastier ones will toss spells at you.

text.Generic Argonian Male: Imps. I hate 'em. Little buggers flitting around, tossing fireballs at you!

text.Generic Argonian Female: Imps. I hate 'em. Little buggers flitting around, tossing fireballs at you!

text.Generic Argonian Male: I saw a wraith once. It threw a curse on me I'll never forget.

text.Generic Argonian Female: I saw a wraith once. It threw a curse on me I'll never forget.

text.Generic Argonian Male: Have you seen a land dreugh? We call them "Billies." Don't know why. Steer clear of them, though.

text.Generic Argonian Female: Have you seen a land dreugh? We call them "Billies." Don't know why. Steer clear of them, though.

text.Generic Argonian Male: I ran across a ghost once. Seemed to suck the energy right out of me.

text.Generic Argonian Female: I ran across a ghost once. Seemed to suck the energy right out of me.

text.Generic Argonian Male: Watch for minotaurs in the forests. Aggressive beasts. They'll tear right through your armor, too.

text.Generic Argonian Female: Watch for minotaurs in the forests. Aggressive beasts. They'll tear right through your armor, too.

text.Generic Argonian Male: Mudcrabs. What's the point? Annoying buggers, though the meat isn't bad.

text.Generic Argonian Female: Mudcrabs. What's the point? Annoying buggers, though the meat isn't bad.

text.Generic Argonian Male: Only thing worse than an ogre is two ogres. Tough bastards, and spells seem to bounce right off of 'em.

text.Generic Argonian Female: Only thing worse than an ogre is two ogres. Tough bastards, and spells seem to bounce right off of 'em.

text.Generic Argonian Male: Is there anywhere in Tamriel you can avoid rats? Disease spreading little nuisances.

text.Generic Argonian Female: Is there anywhere in Tamriel you can avoid rats? Disease spreading little nuisances.

text.Generic Argonian Male: Best way to take out a skeleton is with a big weapon. Forget spells. Just smack them and watch the bones fly!

text.Generic Argonian Female: Best way to take out a skeleton is with a big weapon. Forget spells. Just smack them and watch the bones fly!

text.Generic Argonian Male: I might swim more if it weren't for the slaughterfish. Sharp teeth, and some carry disease.

text.Generic Argonian Female: I might swim more if it weren't for the slaughterfish. Sharp teeth, and some carry disease.

text.Generic Argonian Male: Spriggans. "Nature's guardians" my foot! Mean things. They'll curse you, or they might call a bear to tear you apart.

text.Generic Argonian Female: Spriggans. "Nature's guardians" my foot! Mean things. They'll curse you, or they might call a bear to tear you apart.

text.Generic Argonian Male: All that stuff about having to set trolls on fire is a bunch of hooey. They don't like fire, but a good sword will cut them up fine.

text.Generic Argonian Female: All that stuff about having to set trolls on fire is a bunch of hooey. They don't like fire, but a good sword will cut them up fine.

text.Generic Argonian Male: I don't even know what a will-o-the-wisp is, much less how to kill one. I think they're just swamp gas, myself.

text.Generic Argonian Female: I don't even know what a will-o-the-wisp is, much less how to kill one. I think they're just swamp gas, myself.

text.Generic Argonian Male: I don't like to think about zombies. Missing arms, legs, heads. They smell awful, and they're hard to kill.

text.Generic Argonian Female: I don't like to think about zombies. Missing arms, legs, heads. They smell awful, and they're hard to kill.

text.Generic Argonian Male: Try combining aloe vera leaves with some venison. It's said to have some restorative properties.

text.Generic Argonian Female: Try combining aloe vera leaves with some venison. It's said to have some restorative properties.

text.Generic Argonian Male: You can find Cairn Bolete growing in caves. They're said to mark the place someone has died.

text.Generic Argonian Female: You can find Cairn Bolete growing in caves. They're said to mark the place someone has died.

text.Generic Argonian Male: It's said that eating taproot can bring you good luck.

text.Generic Argonian Female: It's said that eating taproot can bring you good luck.

text.Generic Argonian Male: Make sure not to eat nightshade. It's very poisonous.

text.Generic Argonian Female: Make sure not to eat nightshade. It's very poisonous.

text.SEBigHead: A new face in the Isles. Brings the Fork, perhaps?

text.SERavenBiter: A new visitor to our home. How wonderful. Better stay away from my wife....

text.SESheerMeedish: Someone new in the Isles? Don't care. Plenty to drink for everyone.

text.SEWideEye: Another of my brood finally returns to the Isles. Oh, I wonder what this one will be like!

text.SEBigHead: The Gatekeeper is no more. The Fork is missing. These are difficult times.

text.SERavenBiter: I can't believe the Gatekeeper is gone. He kept out all those other men.

text.SESheerMeedish: The Gatekeeper dead. Let's drink to the Gatekeeper!

text.SEWideEye: I heard the Gatekeeper was killed. I do hope one of my hatchlings wasn't responsible. That'd be ever so embarrassing.

text.SEBigHead: The Resonator of Judgment sings again! Singing, singing!

text.SERavenBiter: Let the Resonator draw the adventurers. Better it, than my dear Sheer-Meedish.

text.SESheerMeedish: Again the Resonator draws men near. Screw 'em! I drink to their health. Healths. Whatever.

text.SEWideEye: The Resonator is working again, I understand. I do hope it doesn't confuse any of my brood, returning to me after all these years.

text.SEBigHead: Thadon with his Chalice. No Fork for Big Head. Songs of sadness.

text.SERavenBiter: Thadon got his Chalice back. I heard he uses it around women. Better steer clear of mine.

text.SESheerMeedish: A Chalice for Thadon! I like chalices. And mugs. And steins. Cups are good, too.

text.SEWideEye: Master Thadon has his Chalice again. Happy days for us all.

text.SEBigHead: Conspiracy in the House of Dementia. Sad, sad songs. Songs of missing things.

text.SERavenBiter: More conspiracy in the House of Dementia. People are always sneaking around there....

text.SESheerMeedish: Syl had folks tortured again. So what? Real torture is my mug being empty.

text.SEWideEye: The court of Dementia is in disarray once more. Good that Thadon is such a better ruler than Syl.

text.SEBigHead: The Torch relit! It sings of things returned!

text.SERavenBiter: The Torch burns brightly again. Like my love for dear Sheer-Meedish.

text.SESheerMeedish: Let's celebrate the relighting of the Torch! Drinks for everyone!

text.SEWideEye: The Great Torch burns once more! This is good news for Thadon, I hope.

text.SEBigHead: Dementia has a new ruler! Perhaps a new fork for Big Head as well!

text.SERavenBiter: Syl has been replaced. I should tell Sheer-Meedish.

text.SESheerMeedish: Cheers to the new ruler of Dementia! Drinks all around!

text.SEWideEye: I tell you, we can't expect much from people who have to murder each other to get into power. Not very civilized, is it?

text.SEBigHead: Mania has a new ruler! Perhaps Big Head will hear songs of good fortune as well.

text.SERavenBiter: Thadon is dead, and a new ruler is in his place. Sheer-Meedish must be excited.

text.SESheerMeedish: Thadon is dead. I drink to his health. Or... whatever.

text.SEBigHead: Passwall attacked by Order. In all the destruction, no sign of the Fork.

text.SERavenBiter: I heard the Fringe was under attack. Sheer-Meedish is probably worried. I should talk to her.

text.SESheerMeedish: I heard Passwall has been destroyed. Damn shame. Used to drink with some of those folks.

text.SEWideEye: The Fringe has been laid to waste! I do hope none of my poor children were caught up in it.

text.SEBigHead: Gatekeeper at the Gates! Singing songs of gatekeeping!

text.SERavenBiter: The Gatekeeper walks again. He'll help keep Sheer-Meedish safe.

text.SESheerMeedish: Let's drink to the health of the new Gatekeeper!

text.SEWideEye: I should speak to someone about the new Gatekeeper. Don't want him killing any of my little ones trying to return to me.

text.SEBigHead: Armies of Our Lord are singing again! Bells ringing! Singing! Singing!

text.SERavenBiter: Sheogorath's armies again can protect sweet Sheer-Meedish.

text.SESheerMeedish: Our Lord's armies are at full strength. A toast to Our Lord!

text.SEWideEye: I can rest easier now, knowing that my children are all better protected.

text.SEBigHead: Where is Our Lord? Does he go to get the Fork?

text.SERavenBiter: Where has Sheogorath gone? Does he not realize the danger Sheer-Meedish is in?

text.SESheerMeedish: Sheogorath is missing. A drink in his order is in honor. Honor is in order. Whatever.

text.SEWideEye: I've tried to tell all my children to flee the Realm while they still can, but none listen to me!

text.SEBigHead: Order is defeated! Triumph for us all! Songs of gladness!

text.SERavenBiter: Order is defeated, and Sheer-Meedish is safe. Praise Sheogorath!

text.SESheerMeedish: A toast to Sheogorath! Order is no more.

text.SEWideEye: The Realm is a safe haven for all my hatchlings once more. If only I could get them to appreciate me.

text.SEBeelei: There's someone new in the Shivering Isles. One more person to worry about.

text.SERunsInCircles: Have you met the newcomer, yet? Rich, maybe? Kindhearted, or just another skinflint?

text.SETallTreesFalling: Who cares if a new adventurer will be in our Realm soon, he wouldn't wish to hear what I have to say anyway.

text.SEBeelei: The Gatekeeper's been killed. Now we're even more exposed to attack.

text.SERunsInCircles: Hey, did you hear the Gatekeeper is dead? That's valuable information, don't you think? Worth a few coins?

text.SETallTreesFalling: The mighty Gatekeeper has fallen. Fallen like my heart on a cold winter's day.

text.SEBeelei: I wish we had a Resonator of something-or-other. We're certainly not safe as it is.

text.SERunsInCircles: This Resonator thing-a-ma-jig. I don't get it. What's it for, anyway?

text.SETallTreesFalling: Just when I look forward to company, they activate the Resonator. Tall-Trees-Falling is so alone.

text.SEBeelei: Will Thadon's Chalice make Deepwallow any safer for me? No? Then I don't care.

text.SERunsInCircles: Here's one you haven't heard, I bet. The Duke's got his Chalice back. Hmm? See what I mean? Now, what can you do for me?

text.SETallTreesFalling: Thadon is in high spirits now? I'm glad someone is.

text.SEBeelei: Another round of torture in Crucible? At least if you're in a cell, no one can sneak up on you.

text.SERunsInCircles: This'd be a good time to have a friend with an ear to the ground, what with all the crazy goings-ons in Crucible, you know what I mean?

text.SETallTreesFalling: Hearing rumors of Syl's madness makes me glad I live outside the walls of New Sheoth.

text.SEBeelei: Someone relit the torch of Arden-Sul. Maybe they'll come here next and save us.

text.SERunsInCircles: The Great Torch is burning again! This calls for a celebration! You can spot me, right? Just a few gold?

text.SETallTreesFalling: The Great Torch burns once more -- a beacon of comfort that only serves to mock my existence.

text.SEBeelei: Power changes hands in Crucible, which means even less stability for the Realm. Just what we needed.

text.SERunsInCircles: I know we're not part of Dementia, but I think their new Duke still deserves a toast, don't you? You're buying, right?

text.SETallTreesFalling: Like the leaves of a tree, Syl has fallen from Sheogorath's grace and no longer rules Dementia.

text.SEBeelei: A new ruler of Mania. It doesn't sound good to me.

text.SERunsInCircles: Not every day we get a new Duke! Let's celebrate, you and me! Whaddya say you buy the first round?

text.SETallTreesFalling: Like the leaves of a tree, Thadon has fallen from Sheogorath's grace and no longer rules Mania.

text.SEBeelei: I've always known we're not truly safe in the Isles. Perhaps now more people will listen.

text.SERunsInCircles: The Fringe was destroyed! Did you hear? Gone. Everything turned to dust! You don't think that could happen here, do you?

text.SETallTreesFalling: The day has finally arrived, a day of doom and despair. Whatever shall we do?

text.SEBeelei: The Gatekeeper walks once more, but what good does that do me? Who knows what's already inside the Realm.

text.SERunsInCircles: What do you say we drink a toast to the new Gatekeeper together? Hey, could you spot me, just this once?

text.SETallTreesFalling: Why build the Gatekeeper again, if he will one day fall? Seems so sad and pointless.

text.SEBeelei: What do I care of armies that I never see? They don't ever set foot here, do they? We have to protect ourselves.

text.SERunsInCircles: They SAY the armies have been restored. But you think that's the whole story? Not by half, just you wait and see.

text.SETallTreesFalling: Armies can only mean one thing... more sorrow and more death.

text.SEBeelei: The whole Realm is at risk. Finally everyone can understand what it's like living under a blanket of fear.

text.SERunsInCircles: Sheogorath gone. The Duke gone. This whole thing is making me really, really nervous. I need to calm down.

text.SETallTreesFalling: Oh! Our Lord has abandoned us! What will be our fate?

text.SEBeelei: The world didn't end. Today, at least. That doesn't mean we're safe tomorrow. Doesn't really mean we're safe now, either.

text.SERunsInCircles: Victory calls for celebration, don't you think? I wish I had the coin to drink a toast to Sheogorath.

text.SETallTreesFalling: What's the point in being happy that the Greymarch has ended? Tomorrow something new will arise to destroy us.

text.Generic Breton Male: You're talking to me, and I don't like you. Goodbye.

text.Generic Breton Female: You're talking to me, and I don't like you. Goodbye.

text.Generic Breton Male: I see no reason to talk to you.

text.Generic Breton Female: I see no reason to talk to you.

text.Generic Breton Male: I don't like you and don't want to talk to you.

text.Generic Breton Female: I don't like you and don't want to talk to you.

text.Generic Breton Male: I'm not listening to you. It's because I don't like you.

text.Generic Breton Female: I'm not listening to you. It's because I don't like you.

text.Generic Breton Male: You're still speaking. Stop.

text.Generic Breton Female: You're still speaking. Stop.

text.Generic Breton Male: At least now we have a name to put to our enemy. Mankar Camoran and the Mythic Dawn will pay for their foul crimes.

text.Caroline: At least now we have a name to put to our enemy. Mankar Camoran and the Mythic Dawn will pay for their foul crimes.

text.Generic Breton Male: The Mythic Dawn will never take Cloud Ruler Temple. Not while any Blade still draws breath.

text.Caroline: The Mythic Dawn will never take Cloud Ruler Temple. Not while any Blade still draws breath.

text.Generic Breton Male: The noose around Bruma is tightening. Now that the Mythic Dawn has learned Martin's location, we have to be prepared for the worst.

text.Caroline: The noose around Bruma is tightening. Now that the Mythic Dawn has learned Martin's location, we have to be prepared for the worst.

text.Generic Breton Male: The Battle of Bruma was a great victory! The Mythic Dawn have learned that we are not defenseless.

text.Caroline: The Battle of Bruma was a great victory! The Mythic Dawn have learned that we are not defenseless.

text.Generic Breton Male: Martin Septim will soon claim his rightful place at the head of the Empire, and the Blades will stand beside him.

text.Caroline: Martin Septim will soon claim his rightful place at the head of the Empire, and the Blades will stand beside him.

text.Generic Breton Male: The Emperor's death was a harsh lesson for all of us. We failed in our duty to the Dragonborn. It must not happen again.

text.Caroline: The Emperor's death was a harsh lesson for all of us. We failed in our duty to the Dragonborn. It must not happen again.

text.Generic Breton Male: Martin showed himself a true son of the Dragon Blood. But where does that leave us, with no Emperor to serve?

text.Caroline: Martin showed himself a true son of the Dragon Blood. But where does that leave us, with no Emperor to serve?

text.Generic Breton Male: With no Emperor to serve, the Blades now return to our ancient role. We will bide our time until the next Dragonborn arises.

text.Caroline: With no Emperor to serve, the Blades now return to our ancient role. We will bide our time until the next Dragonborn arises.

text.ChristopheMarane: Everyone's talking about the assassination, of course. Here. Take my copy of the new Black Horse Courier. Go ahead. Keep it.

text.Generic Breton Female: Everyone's talking about the assassination, of course. Here. Take my copy of the new Black Horse Courier. Go ahead. Keep it.

text.Generic Breton Male: I'm glad that the Oblivion Crisis is over, of course, but I can't help wondering... what happens to the Empire now?

text.Generic Breton Female: I'm glad that the Oblivion Crisis is over, of course, but I can't help wondering... what happens to the Empire now?

text.Generic Breton Male: The Fighters Guild is recruiting again. Not a bad way to make some money, if you've got the stones for it.

text.Generic Breton Female: The Fighters Guild is recruiting again. Not a bad way to make some money, if you've got the stones for it.

text.Generic Breton Male: Anyone looking for work should consider the Fighters Guild. I hear they're always looking for recruits.

text.Generic Breton Female: Anyone looking for work should consider the Fighters Guild. I hear they're always looking for recruits.

text.Generic Breton Male: I understand the Fighters Guild is hiring new members. Not bad work for some folks.

text.Generic Breton Female: I understand the Fighters Guild is hiring new members. Not bad work for some folks.

text.Generic Breton Male: Mannimarco is no more! The guild is saved, and we have a new Arch-Mage to lead us.

text.Generic Breton Female: I can't believe Arch-Mage Traven sacrificed himself to save us all. How noble of him.

text.Generic Breton Male: I don't know what it was, but something important was taken away from Mannimarco. Maybe there is a chance he can be defeated.
Traven might get us through this yet. I hear that the Necromancers were handed a significant defeat at Silorn.
The Council has turned on Traven. Things couldn't possibly get any worse for the guild.
Mannimarco himself is in Cyrodiil, hunting us down. None of us are safe!
Without the Council of Mages to guide us, how will we stand up to the King of Worms?
The Council of Mages has been dissolved. Arch-Mage Traven has been deserted. He's all we have left.
Necromancers have attacked our very homes. What could be next?

text.Generic Breton Female: The Bruma guild hall has been decimated. Our hall could be next!
I've heard rumors about the Council of Mages consorting with outside sources. Why are outsiders interfering with our guild?
The Council of Mages has this Necromancer situation under control. They must, or else we'd know about it, right?

text.Generic Breton Male: Something has gone seriously wrong at the Arcane University. I heard that a high-ranking member was killed in some sort of ambush.

text.Generic Breton Female: I think the rumors about Necromancers are completely untrue. I've heard some crazy things, and I don't believe any of them.

text.Generic Breton Male: The Council seems very interested in this new group of Necromancers that has sprung up. I wonder how things will play out.
Have you heard anything more about what the Council knows about these Necromancers? Something's not right.

text.Generic Breton Female: It's good to know that valuable research is still going on, even though things seem to be a bit more tense lately.

text.Generic Breton Male: Someone finally solved the problems with research at Vahtacen. You'd think the Council would know more about the Ayleids by now.

text.Generic Breton Female: It sounds like the Council of Mages has been holding extra meetings recently. I'm not sure what that means.

text.Generic Breton Male: I've heard rumors that the Council of Mages is taking advice from outsiders. I'm not sure how I feel about that.
Arch-Mage Traven was right to ban Necromancy from the guild. Look at what they've done; they've gone and killed several of us!

text.Generic Breton Female: The Mages Guild has been attacked by Necromancers. This proves they can't be trusted!

text.Generic Breton Male: I understand that Dagail is in much better control of her faculties now that Kalthar's plot has been exposed.
Kalthar tried to ruin the Leyawiin guild. Just goes to show you can't trust a Necromancer, even if he claims to be "reformed."

text.Generic Breton Female: Did you hear that someone played yet another prank on Jeanne Frasoric in Bruma? I don't know how she keeps falling for these things.

text.Generic Breton Male: It sounds like there are an awful lot of problems at the Bruma guild hall. Jeanne does a poor job of running that place.

text.Generic Breton Female: The Chorrol guild hall had an unpleasant visit recently, from someone who had a grudge against Teekeeus.

text.Generic Breton Male: I hear a new Associate came to Teekeeus's aid recently. Something about an old enemy of his storming into town.
