The roads near Anvil are safer now, thanks to Carahil and her guild hall. She's an example for us all.

text.Generic Breton Female: The Anvil guild has made quite a name for itself under Carahil. Did you hear about the recent murderer they caught?
Kud-Ei will do anything to help her girls out. She recently got Ardaline out of a bind, and I hear it wasn't completely within guild rules.

text.Generic Breton Male: Kud-Ei runs a tight ship in Bruma. She may not always play by the rules, but I wouldn't want her on my bad side.
I can't believe a Mages Guild associate was found dead in Cheydinhal. What kind of place are they running there?

text.Generic Breton Female: Did you hear that Falcar left the guild? I think Deetsan is in charge in Cheydinhal now.
I heard that one of the Skingrad mages was assaulted, but I don't know the details.

text.Generic Breton Male: Sounds like the Skingrad branch of the guild can't even keep track of its members. How appalling.
Soris Arenim sure seems upset. I think he lost something important.

text.Generic Breton Female: Soris Arenim sure seems upset. I think he lost something important.

text.Generic Breton Male: Things in the guild have been different since Traven was named Arch-Mage. They're more structured, but everyone seems tense.

text.Generic Breton Female: Things in the guild have been different since Traven was named Arch-Mage. They're more structured, but everyone seems tense.

text.Generic Breton Male: Half of the Council of Mages resigned when Traven took over the position of Arch-Mage.

text.Generic Breton Female: Half of the Council of Mages resigned when Traven took over the position of Arch-Mage.

text.Generic Breton Male: Arch-Mage Traven is the first to take such a hard stance on Necromancy. It upset more than a few people.

text.Generic Breton Female: Arch-Mage Traven is the first to take such a hard stance on Necromancy. It upset more than a few people.

text.Generic Breton Male: The Mages Guild runs more or less like it always did, but we lost quite a few members when the practice of Necromancy was banned.

text.Generic Breton Female: The Mages Guild runs more or less like it always did, but we lost quite a few members when the practice of Necromancy was banned.

text.Generic Breton Male: Necromancy may be legal in Cyrodiil, but few will openly admit to practicing it now that the Mages Guild has banned it.

text.Generic Breton Female: Necromancy may be legal in Cyrodiil, but few will openly admit to practicing it now that the Mages Guild has banned it.

text.Generic Breton Male: Some say that Traven is mis-using the power of the Arch-Mage's position to further his personal agendas.

text.Generic Breton Female: Some say that Traven is mis-using the power of the Arch-Mage's position to further his personal agendas.

text.Generic Breton Male: I don't know what Arch-Mage Traven has against Necromancy, but the first thing he did after taking over the Mages Guild was to ban its practice.

text.Generic Breton Female: I don't know what Arch-Mage Traven has against Necromancy, but the first thing he did after taking over the Mages Guild was to ban its practice.

text.Generic Breton Male: Not only has Necromancy been banned from practice in the Mages Guild, but the Guild won't deal with anyone who openly uses it.

text.Generic Breton Female: Not only has Necromancy been banned from practice in the Mages Guild, but the Guild won't deal with anyone who openly uses it.

text.Generic Breton Male: The Mages Guild has made more than a few enemies since Necromancy was banned.

text.Generic Breton Female: The Mages Guild has made more than a few enemies since Necromancy was banned.

text.Generic Breton Male: I saw that Earana woman hanging around the Mages Guild again.
I saw that Erthor is back in town again.

text.Generic Breton Female: I hear one of the guild mages has gone missing again.

text.Generic Breton Male: It seems quieter than usual at the Mages Guild.
I saw Earana leaving town. She looked very excited.

text.Generic Breton Female: Things at the Mages Guild seem tense. That Falcar fellow sure keeps a tight rein on things.

text.Generic Breton Male: Falcar at the Mages Guild seems to be angry all the time. I avoid him when I can.
I haven't seen Vidkun around town lately. I guess they're keeping him pretty busy at the Mages Guild.

text.Generic Breton Female: I haven't seen Vidkun around town lately. I guess they're keeping him pretty busy at the Mages Guild.

text.Generic Breton Male: Varon Vamori seems very glum lately. I guess things aren't going well with Ardaline.
Kud-Ei seems upset about something lately. I'd stay away from the Mages Guild if I were you.

text.Generic Breton Female: Kud-Ei seems upset about something lately. I'd stay away from the Mages Guild if I were you.
Those new fellows here in town are making me nervous. Walking around with those big weapons; I hope they leave soon.

text.Generic Breton Male: I heard someone broke into the Mages Guild.

text.Generic Breton Female: I heard someone broke into the Mages Guild.

text.Generic Breton Male: If the Council really did split up, the guild is done for. This is serious.

text.Generic Breton Female: If the Council really did split up, the guild is done for. This is serious.

text.Generic Breton Male: The Mages Guild seems more disorganized than usual lately.

text.Courier3: The Mages Guild seems more disorganized than usual lately.

text.Generic Breton Male: Andel Indarys may or may not have killed his wife, and it may or may not have been an accident. And I doubt we'll ever know for sure.
How did a Dark Elf become Count Cheydinhal? King Helseth and Barenziah have considerable influence, and Helseth and Indarys are cronies. Get it?
Andel Indarys is an intemperate, bibulous philanderer. And a Dark Elf. Other than that, he is perfectly suited to be a count.
Millona Umbranox is better off without that irresponsible husband of hers. The most honorable thing he ever did was to disappear and leave her alone.
Millona Umbranox, Arriana Valga, and Narina Carvain seem to rule their counties perfectly well without male assistance.
I've never heard the Countess mention her husband. I believe it is something of a sore point with Lady Millona.
I believe the rugged climate of Bruma suits Narina Carvain. She's tough and cold, but you always know what to expect from her.
No wonder Narina Carvain is so cranky. If you had to live year-round in a cold, drafty, soot-stained castle like Bruma, you'd be cranky, too.
With Regulus Terentius for a father, what do you expect from Gellius? The acorn never falls too far from the tree.
It is fashionable to make fun of Bravil and Regulus Terentius. Personally, I think it is poor sport to mock the poor and disadvantaged.
Alessia Caro visits her mother in Chorrol regularly. A dutiful daughter... and a dutiful wife, I hear.
There's been trouble with smugglers and Khajiit bandits in the Trans-Niben, but Marius Caro is taking steps to deal with the problem.
The Count of Skingrad and I are not social intimates. In fact, I don't believe Janus Hassildor has any social intimates.
It's curious. Skingrad's people scarcely ever set eyes on the Count, but he's apparently loved and respected by all his subjects.
A master sorcerer like Janus Hassildor inevitably outlives all his peers. It must be a lonely existence.
It is pleasant, and a bit melancholy, to walk among the graves in Green Emperor Way and contemplate the dead who precede us.
I admit to sharing the common enthusiasm for the Arena. It is barbaric, but the stakes of life or death make the drama irresistably compelling.
They say Alinor on Summerset Isle is more beautiful. I've never been. For the present, I must count the Imperial City the most glorious in Tamriel.
Legion duty here in Cyrodiil is usually a dull affair. In the East, though, things are a bit more challenging, and one can make a name for oneself.
The legions patrol the roads, and they've always been sufficient. I can't imagine we'll ever be at war with the provinces... not in my lifetime.
I've not always been happy with the standards of conduct in the Mages Guild, but Hannibal Traven's reforms are quite encouraging.
I'm not sure the Dark Brotherhood is any more serious a problem than beggary and petty thievery. And it's certainly a discreet and secret problem.
The people have a simple faith in the Nine, and the clerics do their part to heal and comfort them in adversity.
I've sometimes thought I'd like to make a pilgrimage to the wayshrines, but my duties prevent me from such extensive and dangerous travel.
The doomstones are a mystery. Are they traces of the Mythic Times? Or creations of ancient beastfolk or lost races of mer or men?
I have not read the works of Mrs. Ottus. I'm told some find her guide books useful, though she apparently has strong opinions on some matters.
The Elder Council and the bureaucracy have managed the Empire's affairs for decades. The Emperor rules, but the Council handles all the details.
What can be said about taxes? They're high, but we must pay. At least they are administered efficiently, and the shrinkage is within decent limits.
It is not always an easy life we lead, but the people must be served.
What we do is perfectly legal. Others have no right to interfere.

text.Generic Breton Female: We don't welcome visitors, but we don't murder them either.

text.VicenteValtieri: The Count of Skingrad is not all he seems. Let's just say I'm not the only one who enjoys his evenings...

text.AntoinettaMarie: Don't tell anyone else, but some day I'm going to have Ocheeva's position. Just you wait and see. Lucien Lachance knows real talent when he sees it.

text.Dark19Murderer2: I... I heard what they did to Lucien Lachance... Is it true that Arquen feasted on his entrails?

text.Generic Breton Male: They say that when you murder someone, the Dark Brotherhood comes to you in your sleep. It's how they recruit new members.

text.Generic Breton Female: They say that when you murder someone, the Dark Brotherhood comes to you in your sleep. It's how they recruit new members.

text.Generic Breton Male: Knights-Errant? That's just a poor knight without a castle. But I hear they got a nice lodge right on the banks of the Niben.

text.Courier3: Knights-Errant? That's just a poor knight without a castle. But I hear they got a nice lodge right on the banks of the Niben.

text.Generic Breton Male: I hear the Count's got someone to sort out that business with Mazoga the so-called knight.
Have you seen Valus Odiil recently? Spends all day in the tavern since his boys left.

text.Generic Breton Female: Have you seen Valus Odiil recently? Spends all day in the tavern since his boys left.

text.Generic Breton Male: I saw Valus Odiil at the Grey Mare again today. Hasn't been the same since his boys took off.

text.Generic Breton Female: I saw Valus Odiil at the Grey Mare again today. Hasn't been the same since his boys took off.

text.Generic Breton Male: I heard that Velwyn Benirus was killed. The Manor claims another victim.

text.Generic Breton Female: I heard that Velwyn Benirus was killed. The Manor claims another victim.

text.Generic Breton Male: The new owner sure has turned Benirus Manor around. It's now a welcome addition to our city.

text.Generic Breton Female: The new owner sure has turned Benirus Manor around. It's now a welcome addition to our city.

text.Generic Breton Male: I have it on good authority that the city watch sent someone to stop that gang of women from robbing the town's men. Good show I say!

text.Generic Breton Female: I have it on good authority that the city watch sent someone to stop that gang of women from robbing the town's men. Good show I say!

text.Generic Breton Male: Kud-Ei seems to be in good spirits again after Henantier's return. I heard she enlisted a stranger's help in the search. Good show I say!

text.Generic Breton Female: Kud-Ei seems to be in good spirits again after Henantier's return. I heard she enlisted a stranger's help in the search. Good show I say!

text.Generic Breton Male: Henantier was slain in his sleep. How awful. They should find the one who did it and send him straight to prison.

text.Generic Breton Female: Henantier was slain in his sleep. How awful. They should find the one who did it and send him straight to prison.

text.Generic Breton Male: I have it on good account that the Forlorn Watchman is gone for good. The stories about his fate were true, but now the curse has been broken.

text.Generic Breton Female: I have it on good account that the Forlorn Watchman is gone for good. The stories about his fate were true, but now the curse has been broken.

text.Generic Breton Male: Well, despite everything, Aleron Loche turned up dead. That's what you get when you deal with gamblers and usurers.

text.Generic Breton Female: Well, despite everything, Aleron Loche turned up dead. That's what you get when you deal with gamblers and usurers.

text.Generic Breton Male: Arnora was killed. Such a shame. I wonder if Jorundr had something to do with it? I wouldn't put it past him.

text.Generic Breton Female: Arnora was killed. Such a shame. I wonder if Jorundr had something to do with it? I wouldn't put it past him.

text.Generic Breton Male: I overheard that the vampire hunter who was in town was a fake. It was apparently a ruse to get his hands on Bradon's key to a treasure chest.

text.Generic Breton Female: I overheard that the vampire hunter who was in town was a fake. It was apparently a ruse to get his hands on Bradon's key to a treasure chest.

text.Generic Breton Male: The Honorblade has been returned to the Castle after all these years! This is certainly a good omen.

text.Generic Breton Female: The Honorblade has been returned to the Castle after all these years! This is certainly a good omen.

text.Generic Breton Male: The Countess still seems quite sad. I hear someone tried to find the item stolen from the castle, but they had no luck. Oh well.

text.Generic Breton Female: The Countess still seems quite sad. I hear someone tried to find the item stolen from the castle, but they had no luck. Oh well.

text.Generic Breton Male: The Countess seems much happier now that the item that was stolen from her was returned.

text.Generic Breton Female: The Countess seems much happier now that the item that was stolen from her was returned.

text.Generic Breton Male: I saw Reynald Jemane's brother earlier. Can't believe they didn't even know about each other.

text.Generic Breton Female: I saw Reynald Jemane's brother earlier. Can't believe they didn't even know about each other.

text.Generic Breton Male: Reynald Jemane has a terrible memory. We've met many times, but when I saw him in Cheydinhal, he walked right past me like we were strangers.

text.Generic Breton Female: Reynald Jemane has a terrible memory. We've met many times, but when I saw him in Cheydinhal, he walked right past me like we were strangers.

text.Generic Breton Male: I was in Cheydinhal last week, and I'm sure I saw Reynald Jemane. He acted like he didn't know me, though.

text.Generic Breton Female: I was in Cheydinhal last week, and I'm sure I saw Reynald Jemane. He acted like he didn't know me, though.

text.Generic Breton Male: You hear any word about Kud-Ei's friend? She's offering a generous reward, so hopefully someone will show up and lend a hand.

text.Generic Breton Female: You hear any word about Kud-Ei's friend? She's offering a generous reward, so hopefully someone will show up and lend a hand.

text.Generic Breton Male: I saw Kud-Ei moping around outside the Mages Guild yesterday. In fact, I could swear she was crying. I hope she finds her missing friend.

text.Generic Breton Female: I saw Kud-Ei moping around outside the Mages Guild yesterday. In fact, I could swear she was crying. I hope she finds her missing friend.

text.Generic Breton Male: There's some strange Dark Elf in town, asking about Reynald Jemane and his brother.

text.Generic Breton Female: There's some strange Dark Elf in town, asking about Reynald Jemane and his brother.

text.Generic Breton Male: I've sighted the Forlorn Watchman again. Every time I see that ghost, it gives me the creeps.

text.Generic Breton Female: I've sighted the Forlorn Watchman again. Every time I see that ghost, it gives me the creeps.

text.Generic Breton Male: Have you heard about that ghost of the old man that looks out into Niben Bay each night? They're calling him the Forlorn Watchman... spooky.

text.Generic Breton Female: Have you heard about that ghost of the old man that looks out into Niben Bay each night? They're calling him the Forlorn Watchman... spooky.

text.Generic Breton Male: I can't believe that the Countess is more obsessed with that painting than the Oblivion Gate threatening the city!

text.Generic Breton Female: I can't believe that the Countess is more obsessed with that painting than the Oblivion Gate threatening the city!

text.Generic Breton Male: I heard that the Countess is quite upset lately. Apparently someone stole something very personal to her.

text.Generic Breton Female: I heard that the Countess is quite upset lately. Apparently someone stole something very personal to her.

text.Generic Breton Male: Have you noticed all the city guards are roaming around the city as if looking for someone? I wonder what that's all about.

text.Generic Breton Female: Have you noticed all the city guards are roaming around the city as if looking for someone? I wonder what that's all about.

text.Generic Breton Male: Did you hear about Bradon Lirrian? A vampire hunter named Raynil Dralas made his way into town, snuck into his house and killed him.

text.Generic Breton Female: Did you hear about Bradon Lirrian? A vampire hunter named Raynil Dralas made his way into town, snuck into his house and killed him.

text.Generic Breton Male: I was at Olav's earlier and I ran into this Dunmer named Raynil Dralas. After a round or two, he told me he was an honest-to-goodness vampire hunter!

text.Generic Breton Female: I was at Olav's earlier and I ran into this Dunmer named Raynil Dralas. After a round or two, he told me he was an honest-to-goodness vampire hunter!

text.Generic Breton Male: Don't know if this is true, but I heard a gang of all female thieves is preying on the married menfolk of the town.

text.Generic Breton Female: Don't know if this is true, but I heard a gang of all female thieves is preying on the married menfolk of the town.

text.Generic Breton Male: You hear about Gogan? A gang of thieves is running a scam in town, and he fell for it! Hahaha... what an idiot!

text.Generic Breton Female: You hear about Gogan? A gang of thieves is running a scam in town, and he fell for it! Hahaha... what an idiot!

text.Generic Breton Male: You hear about Jorundr? He was caught stealing gold, and now he's in jail! I bet Arnora's beside herself with grief.

text.Generic Breton Female: You hear about Jorundr? He was caught stealing gold, and now he's in jail! I bet Arnora's beside herself with grief.

text.Generic Breton Male: Poor Arnora. Seems her boyfriend, Jorundr, has stolen some gold from her and left her penniless. Now he's in jail, and she's destitute.

text.Generic Breton Female: Poor Arnora. Seems her boyfriend, Jorundr, has stolen some gold from her and left her penniless. Now he's in jail, and she's destitute.

text.Generic Breton Male: So, thanks to some hired help, the Jemanes recovered Weatherleah. Good thing... I never liked having ogres so close to Chorrol.

text.Generic Breton Female: So, thanks to some hired help, the Jemanes recovered Weatherleah. Good thing... I never liked having ogres so close to Chorrol.

text.Generic Breton Male: I overheard a guard mention the Countess is looking for a piece to add to her collection of Akaviri artifacts. Our taxpayer's drakes at work...

text.Generic Breton Female: I overheard a guard mention the Countess is looking for a piece to add to her collection of Akaviri artifacts. Our taxpayer's drakes at work...

text.Generic Breton Male: I overheard someone say that Aleron Loche is missing. I don't know what happened to him. His wife, Ursanne, is beside herself with grief.

text.Generic Breton Female: I overheard someone say that Aleron Loche is missing. I don't know what happened to him. His wife, Ursanne, is beside herself with grief.

text.Generic Breton Male: I swear that when I passed by Benirus Manor last night, I heard someone scream from inside. Velwyn Benirus will never sell that deathtrap!

text.Generic Breton Female: I swear that when I passed by Benirus Manor last night, I heard someone scream from inside. Velwyn Benirus will never sell that deathtrap!

text.Generic Breton Male: I heard that Velwyn Benirus is trying to sell off Benirus Manor. Hopefully the new owners will clean that eyesore up.

text.Generic Breton Female: I heard that Velwyn Benirus is trying to sell off Benirus Manor. Hopefully the new owners will clean that eyesore up.

text.Generic Breton Male: I think Glarthir is having one of his bad spells lately, have you noticed?

text.Generic Breton Female: I think Glarthir is having one of his bad spells lately, have you noticed?

text.Generic Breton Male: Did you hear about Glarthir going crazy and attacking people with an axe?

text.Generic Breton Female: Did you hear about Glarthir going crazy and attacking people with an axe?

text.Generic Breton Male: Did you hear about Glarthir? Thank the Nine that the guard stopped him before he killed someone!

text.Generic Breton Female: Did you hear about Glarthir? Thank the Nine that the guard stopped him before he killed someone!

text.Generic Breton Male: Did you hear that Dar-Ma has disappeared?

text.Generic Breton Female: Did you hear that Dar-Ma has disappeared?

text.Generic Breton Male: Did you hear the bad news?  Dar-Ma's daughter was killed by some strange cultists down in Hackdirt. Terrible, terrible times we live in.

text.Generic Breton Female: Did you hear the bad news?  Dar-Ma's daughter was killed by some strange cultists down in Hackdirt. Terrible, terrible times we live in.

text.Generic Breton Male: Did you hear that Dar-Ma came back, safe and sound?  You know, Seed-Neeus's daughter, the Argonians.

text.Generic Breton Female: Did you hear that Dar-Ma came back, safe and sound?  You know, Seed-Neeus's daughter, the Argonians.

text.DarkPrisonGuard06: It's true what everyone's saying -- Kvatch is lost. The Daedra, they swarmed in.... The Town Guard never had a chance.
The Kvatch Oblivion Gate has been closed! Don't you understand what that means? We can beat the bastards!
The Mythic Dawn murdered the Emperor and led those damn Daedra right into the heart of the Empire! They'll pay for their treachery!
Kvatch? Kvatch was just the beginning! Those damned Gates have opened up everywhere! Cheydinhal, Chorrol, Leyawiin -- no city is safe.
If you've got to travel, by the Nine Divines, stay on the roads! The wilderness just isn't safe anymore. We've had sightings, you see. The Daedra...

text.Generic Breton Male: We're all talking about the emperor's murder. We have no emperor. And no heir. That's never happened before. I suppose we should all be worried.

text.Generic Breton Female: We're all talking about the emperor's murder. We have no emperor. And no heir. That's never happened before. I suppose we should all be worried.

text.PriorMaborel: People are subdued. Troubled. A crisis like this tests the people's faith.

text.Generic Breton Female: People are subdued. Troubled. A crisis like this tests the people's faith.
I think we're in for some hard times. The death of Uriel Septim and his heirs changes everything.

text.Generic Breton Male: The Emperor and his three sons, dead, right under the noses of the Imperial Guard. It's a disgrace.
Have you heard about Kvatch? They say that daedra came from Oblivion and burned the whole city to the ground!

text.Generic Breton Female: Everyone's saying there's trouble in Kvatch. The whole town destroyed. Only a few survivors.

text.Generic Breton Male: Do you think what happened to Kvatch could happen here?
I heard that the Kvatch Guard is driving back the daedra! Maybe there's hope after all.

text.Generic Breton Female: I heard that the Kvatch Guard is driving back the daedra! Maybe there's hope after all.
Everybody's talking about the Hero of Kvatch! They say he actually went into an Oblivion Gate and destroyed it.

text.Generic Breton Male: Everybody's talking about the Hero of Kvatch! They say she actually went into an Oblivion Gate and destroyed it.
Hey, you're the one they call the Hero of Kvatch, aren't you? The one that closed the Oblivion Gate and saved the city?

text.Generic Breton Female: Hey, you're the one they call the Hero of Kvatch, aren't you? The one that closed the Oblivion Gate and saved the city?

text.Generic Breton Male: Good news from Kvatch for a change. The last of the daedra have been driven out.

text.Generic Breton Female: Good news from Kvatch for a change. The last of the daedra have been driven out.

text.Generic Breton Male: Do you believe any of that talk about more Oblivion Gates opening all over the place?

text.Generic Breton Female: I've been hearing disturbing tales about Oblivion Gates opening all across Cyrodiil. I hope it's just wild talk.

text.Generic Breton Male: They say that Oblivion Gates have opened outside cities all across Tamriel! Gods preserve us!

text.Generic Breton Female: With those Oblivion Gates opening everywhere, it's only a matter of time before another city goes the way of Kvatch.
Did you hear? The lost heir of Uriel Septim rallied the Guard and smashed a horde of daedra outside Bruma!

text.Generic Breton Male: They say a lost son of Uriel Septim has reappeared in Bruma. Troops are flocking to his banner from all over Cyrodiil!
I heard that some cult called the Mythic Dawn is behind the Emperor's assassination.

text.Generic Breton Female: They're saying some cult murdered the Emperor and are opening the Oblivion Gates. Do you think any of it's true?

text.Generic Breton Male: Thank Akatosh the Oblivion Crisis is over! Although with no Emperor and no heir, I wonder what will happen to the Empire?
I plan to visit the Imperial City soon to pay my respects at the Temple of the One. They say the Dragon Statue is 100 feet high!

text.Generic Breton Female: I'm sure the Elder Council will find some way to hold the Empire together. At least the Oblivion invasion is over!
I heard that some of the provinces were talking about seceding from the Empire. Probably just talk though. Everything's a bit unsettled now.

text.Generic Breton Male: Most people consider Martin's... transformation... a religious or political event, but what interests me is its metaphysical implications.

text.Generic Breton Female: Most people consider Martin's... transformation... a religious or political event, but what interests me is its metaphysical implications.

text.PriorMaborel: I wish I had witnessed the avatar of divine Akatosh myself. Imagine! Upon the very altar of the Temple of the One!

text.Generic Breton Female: I wish I had witnessed the avatar of divine Akatosh myself. Imagine! Upon the very altar of the Temple of the One!
I confess, I didn't think we had a chance against the daedra. But Martin proved himself a true heir of Talos on that day.

text.Generic Breton Male: To think that Bruma was where Martin Septim chose to reveal himself as the true heir to the throne for the first time!

text.Generic Breton Female: I hear that Earil is fed up with Brithaur's antics. He really wants something done about it.
Scalons carry diseases. Lots of them.
Don't run into the water to escape a Scalon. They'll follow you.

text.SEAmiableFanriene: Have to watch for those Scalons. I hear they carry disease.
If you see a Gnarl, be careful what spells you use on them.

text.Generic Breton Female: I've heard that Gnarl get stronger when hit by some spells.
The Gnarl are strange creatures. Hit them with a fireball, and they get stronger, but they hate other elements even more.

text.SEAmiableFanriene: Those Shambles are dangerous. Make sure to stand back if you kill one.

text.Generic Breton Female: Don't bother using a frost spell on a Shambles.
If you see a Shambles dying, stand back. They'll take you with them.

text.SEAmiableFanriene: Flesh Atronachs are dangerous. Some are smart enough to heal themselves when they're hurt.

text.Generic Breton Female: Sometimes, a sharp blade is the best way to kill a Flesh Atronach.
If you have to fight a Flesh Atronach, a good shock spell is the way to go.

text.SEAmiableFanriene: The poison of the Elytra can be debilitating.

text.Generic Breton Female: The Elytra have wondrous poisons that can drain the very life from you.
Watch for the Elytra's stingers; their poison can be deadly. They don't like magic much, though.

text.SEAmiableFanriene: The Hunger is one of Lord Sheogorath's favorite pets.

text.Generic Breton Female: Only the Demented can truly appreciate the Hunger.
Like most lesser Daedra, the Hunger has a weakness to shock spells.

text.SEAmiableFanriene: Some say the Grummites are the original inhabitants of the Shivering Isles.

text.Generic Breton Female: Who do the Grummites worship? Some say Sheogorath, but I'm not sure.
Try not to fight a Grummite in the water. Or in the rain. They seem to like that.

text.SEAmiableFanriene: The Baliwog is a dangerous little creature. Some say they grow up to be Scalons.

text.Generic Breton Female: The Baliwog are known to carry Swamp Fever.
The Baliwog will return to the water to heal.

text.SEAmiableFanriene: I've heard that Skinned Hounds don't like fire.

text.Generic Breton Female: Don't waste your wonderful poisons on Skinned Hounds. They seem to like them.
Best way to kill a Skinned Hound is with a fireball, or a good weapon.

text.SEAmiableFanriene: Heretics are misguided worshippers of Arden-Sul.

text.Generic Breton Female: I hear the Heretics in the lands of Mania summon Hungers to fight by their sides.
If you want to get close to the Heretics, try putting on their robes.

text.SEAmiableFanriene: The Zealots in the lands of Dementia believe they worship Arden-Sul. Poor, deluded souls.

text.Generic Breton Female: Zealots have dedicated themselves to the worship of Arden-Sul.
If you want to sneak up on one of those Zealots, wear one of their robes. Fools them every time.

text.SEAmiableFanriene: I understand there's been strange activity near the obelisks around the Isles.

text.Generic Breton Female: Stay away from the obelisks! Strange things have appeared near them.
The crystal obelisks that dot the Isles have recently started behaving strangely.

text.SEAmiableFanriene: Knights of Order have appeared in the Isles. I hear they come from the obelisks.

text.Generic Breton Female: Knights of Order have come to destroy the Realm!
I understand that the Hearts of Order you find on the Knights can be used to unlock special chests.

text.SEAmiableFanriene: Raven-Biter runs the Choosy Beggar. Not a bad place.

text.Generic Breton Female: You can stay at the Choosy Beggar in Bliss, but I wouldn't.

text.SEAmiableFanriene: Tilse Areleth has quite a collection of things for sale at Common Treasures.

text.Generic Breton Female: Common Treasures is full of junk. That's all Tilse Areleth collects.

text.SEAmiableFanriene: The best armor in the city is at The Missing Pauldron.

text.Generic Breton Female: I'm not about to go to the Missing Pauldron, even if they do sell armor. I'll stay in Crucible, thank you.

text.SEAmiableFanriene: Books of Bliss has quite a selection.

text.Generic Breton Female: Sontaire may sell a lot of books, but that's not why the men visit her.

text.SEAmiableFanriene: Cutter sells weapons in Crucible, but you won't catch me going there.

text.Generic Breton Female: I'd buy my weapons at Cutter's. She has... a way with blades.

text.SEAmiableFanriene: That Museum of Oddities is a joke, although I hear Una Armina will pay for certain items.

text.Generic Breton Female: You should stop by the Museum of Oddities. I understand Una is always looking for more items to display.

text.SEAmiableFanriene: I'd research my own spells before I'd buy them from Earil's Mysteries.

text.Generic Breton Female: Earil's Mysteries sells a number of unique spells. Doesn't sell any mysteries, though.

text.SEAmiableFanriene: Things Found? More like Things Found in the Trash.

text.Generic Breton Female: You can find some good deals at Things Found. Ahjazda has an interesting collection.

text.SEAmiableFanriene: I wouldn't be caught dead at Sickly Bernice's... though I imagine her customers might.

text.Generic Breton Female: Sickly Bernice's isn't a bad place. Just make sure to wash your hands.

text.SEAmiableFanriene: Dumag gro-Bonk at The Missing Pauldron is collecting that Amber you find in the root tunnels.

text.Generic Breton Female: I hear Cutter collects the Madness Ore to turn into armor.
There are smiths in New Sheoth that collect Amber and Madness Ore.

text.SEAmiableFanriene: I've heard ghosts haunt the ruined city of Vitharn.

text.Generic Breton Female: Stay away from Vitharn. It's said the dead walk there.
Take care venturing into the ruined city of Vitharn.

text.SEAmiableFanriene: I understand there's a Knight of the Thorn in Hale.

text.Generic Breton Female: Pyke, the Knight of the Thorn, lives in Hale.
If you visit Hale, you may see Pyke, a Knight of the Thorn.

text.SEAmiableFanriene: The merchants in Crucible are getting tired of Brithaur stealing from them.

text.Generic Breton Female: Everyone is tired of Brithaur's antics.
I understand the merchants of Crucible are having problems with Brithaur.

text.SEAmiableFanriene: I understand Hirrus Clutumnus is begging for people to kill him.

text.Generic Breton Female: Someone should put Hirrus Clutumnus out of his misery.
In Crucible, a man named Hirrus Clutumnus has been trying to convince people to kill him.

text.SEAmiableFanriene: I've heard there's someone in Highcross trying to catalogue every living thing in the Isles.

text.Generic Breton Female: Mirili Ulven in Highcross thinks she can catalogue every creature in the Isles.
If you visit Highcross, speak with Mirili Ulven. She needs help with her project.

text.SEAmiableFanriene: I don't visit the Museum of Oddities, but Una Armina is always looking for new items to display.

text.Generic Breton Female: If you find something unique, it's worth checking with Una Armina.

text.SEAmiableFanriene: Cindanwe runs a tight ship in Fellmoor.

text.Generic Breton Female: The workers in Fellmoor aren't too happy with Cindanwe.
Fellmoor must be a terrible place to live.
That Amiable Fanriene is afraid of his own shadow.
There's a man in Bliss who believes his own house will collapse around him.

text.SEAmiableFanriene: Sickly Bernice is convinced she's dying. No wonder no one wants to eat at her Taphouse.

text.Generic Breton Female: Sickly Bernice is always looking for a miracle cure.
Sickly Bernice in Crucible believes she is dying.

text.SEAmiableFanriene: I heard Tove the Unrestful is building something again.

text.Generic Breton Female: Tove the Unrestful in Bliss is collecting useless items to build something.
Tove the Unrestful in Bliss is collecting items to build something.

text.SEAmiableFanriene: Ushnar in Crucible is afraid of cats. Cats!

text.Generic Breton Female: Ushnar is deathly afraid of cats. He makes sure to keep dogs around because of it.
There's an orc in Crucible who is deathly afraid of cats.

text.SEAmiableFanriene: Ahjazda in Crucible believes the world is ending.

text.Generic Breton Female: Ahjazda thinks the world is ending tomorrow. She's been saving magic items just in case.
There is a Khajiit in Crucible who believes the world is about to end.

text.SEAmiableFanriene: Poor Big Head will never find the Fork of Horripilation.

text.Generic Breton Female: That fool Big Head is always looking for the Fork of Horripilation.
The Argonian Big Head is always searching for the Fork of Horripilation.

text.SEAmiableFanriene: Every resident of Split has a double living in the town.

text.Generic Breton Female: Every person in Split has been divided into their Manic and Demented halves.
There are two of everything in Split. Even the residents.

text.Generic Breton Male: The Gray Fox sounds like a dangerous thief.

text.Generic Breton Female: The Gray Fox sounds like a dangerous thief.

text.Generic Breton Male: Amantius Allectus was killed during a burglary. They say the house was ransacked.

text.Generic Breton Female: Amantius Allectus was killed during a burglary. They say the house was ransacked.

text.Generic Breton Male: Captain Lex blames the Gray Fox for stealing the tax collection. He wants a bounty put on the Gray Fox, but the Legion Commander has refused.

text.Generic Breton Female: Captain Lex blames the Gray Fox for stealing the tax collection. He wants a bounty put on the Gray Fox, but the Legion Commander has refused.

text.Generic Breton Male: I heard that thieves broke into the Arcane University, the Imperial Legion Compound, and the Temple, all on the same night!

text.Generic Breton Female: I heard that thieves broke into the Arcane University, the Imperial Legion Compound, and the Temple, all on the same night!

text.Generic Breton Male: Someone told me that Hieronymus Lex is gone. Reassigned to Anvil. That can't be true!

text.Generic Breton Female: Someone told me that Hieronymus Lex is gone. Reassigned to Anvil. That can't be true!

text.Generic Breton Male: Lady Umbranox has hired a new Captain of the guard.

text.Generic Breton Female: Lady Umbranox has hired a new Captain of the guard.

text.Generic Breton Male: Did you hear what happened? Someone robbed the wizard's tower. Fathis Aren got what he deserved, if you ask me.

text.Generic Breton Female: Did you hear what happened? Someone robbed the wizard's tower. Fathis Aren got what he deserved, if you ask me.

text.Generic Breton Male: Did you hear that the Earl of Imbel's house was robbed?

text.Generic Breton Female: Did you hear that the Earl of Imbel's house was robbed?

text.Generic Breton Male: Can you believe that a thief broke into the Imperial Palace itself!

text.Generic Breton Female: Can you believe that a thief broke into the Imperial Palace itself!

text.Generic Breton Male: There are rumors that there is a new Gray Fox. Nobody knows what happened to the old one.

text.Generic Breton Female: There are rumors that there is a new Gray Fox. Nobody knows what happened to the old one.

text.Generic Breton Male: Count Umbranox has returned! After eleven years, he just walked back into Anvil.

text.Generic Breton Female: Count Umbranox has returned! After eleven years, he just walked back into Anvil.

text.Generic Breton Male: I saw Ugak gra-Mogakh earlier. At least, I think it was her. Perhaps it was her sister.

text.Generic Breton Female: I saw Ugak gra-Mogakh earlier. At least, I think it was her. Perhaps it was her sister.

text.Generic Breton Male: The West Weald is a good place. Erina Jeranus isn't the friendliest person in the world, but not a bad sort when you get to know her.

text.Generic Breton Female: The West Weald is a good place. Erina Jeranus isn't the friendliest person in the world, but not a bad sort when you get to know her.

text.Generic Breton Male: I've bought a good number of things at Colovian Traders. And Gunder is a friendly sort.

text.Generic Breton Female: I've bought a good number of things at Colovian Traders. And Gunder is a friendly sort.

text.Generic Breton Male: Hammer and Tongs is a good place to get your armor repaired. Just don't go early in the morning. Agnete usually isn't feeling so well then.

text.Generic Breton Female: Hammer and Tongs is a good place to get your armor repaired. Just don't go early in the morning. Agnete usually isn't feeling so well then.

text.Generic Breton Male: I went to the chapel yesterday, but Valandrus was the only one there. I figured I'd come back another time.

text.Generic Breton Female: I went to the chapel yesterday, but Valandrus was the only one there. I figured I'd come back another time.

text.Generic Breton Male: That Danus Artellian is a little too full of himself. Sure, he's a Captain of the Guard, but I'm not impressed.

text.Generic Breton Female: That Danus Artellian is a little too full of himself. Sure, he's a Captain of the Guard, but I'm not impressed.

text.Generic Breton Male: Fadus Calidius sure can use a shield. I've never seen him take a hit!

text.Generic Breton Female: Fadus Calidius sure can use a shield. I've never seen him take a hit!

text.Generic Breton Male: If you're looking to learn a bit about Conjuration, Sulinus Vassinus is a good person to talk to.

text.Generic Breton Female: If you're looking to learn a bit about Conjuration, Sulinus Vassinus is a good person to talk to.

text.Generic Breton Male: Vigge the Cautious is responsible for enchanted item recharge at the Mages Guild. Good thing he's cautious. I'd hate to have something go wrong.

text.Generic Breton Female: Vigge the Cautious is responsible for enchanted item recharge at the Mages Guild. Good thing he's cautious. I'd hate to have something go wrong.

text.Generic Breton Male: I've heard that someone has it out for Toutius Sextius. Who'd want to hurt him?

text.Generic Breton Female: I've heard that someone has it out for Toutius Sextius. Who'd want to hurt him?

text.Generic Breton Male: I'll buy sweetrolls from Salmo the Baker any day. Once, I was carrying a sweetroll when three thugs attacked me. So, I took the sweetroll....

text.Generic Breton Female: I'll buy sweetrolls from Salmo the Baker any day. Once, I was carrying a sweetroll when three thugs attacked me. So, I took the sweetroll....

text.Generic Breton Male: I learned quite a bit about how to use a shield from Ambrose Canne. Cost me a bit, but it was worth it.

text.Generic Breton Female: I learned quite a bit about how to use a shield from Ambrose Canne. Cost me a bit, but it was worth it.

text.Generic Breton Male: Uuras the Shepherd sure takes care of his sheep. And, boy, does he like cheese! I mean, he really likes cheese.

text.Generic Breton Female: Uuras the Shepherd sure takes care of his sheep. And, boy, does he like cheese! I mean, he really likes cheese.

text.Generic Breton Male: Not only does Shameer make a good wine at the Tamika Vineyards, but he's really good with his bow, too. I heard he'll train you, for a fee.

text.Generic Breton Female: Not only does Shameer make a good wine at the Tamika Vineyards, but he's really good with his bow, too. I heard he'll train you, for a fee.

text.Generic Breton Male: Something is just a bit off about Glarthir. Someone needs to keep an eye on him.

text.Generic Breton Female: Something is just a bit off about Glarthir. Someone needs to keep an eye on him.

text.Generic Breton Male: Rohssan is a talented smith. One of the best around, if you ask me.

text.Generic Breton Female: Rohssan is a talented smith. One of the best around, if you ask me.

text.Generic Breton Male: If I had a question about heavy armor, I'd probably ask Varnado at The Best Defense.

text.Generic Breton Female: If I had a question about heavy armor, I'd probably ask Varnado at The Best Defense.

text.Generic Breton Male: Irene Metrick moves with such grace. I wonder what it is she does.

text.Generic Breton Female: Irene Metrick moves with such grace. I wonder what it is she does.

text.Generic Breton Male: There's something strange about Ida Vlinorman. I heard she was climbing up the chapel, just so she could jump off.

text.Generic Breton Female: There's something strange about Ida Vlinorman. I heard she was climbing up the chapel, just so she could jump off.

text.Generic Breton Male: The Tiber Septim Hotel is a nice place. It's not cheap, though.

text.Generic Breton Female: The Tiber Septim Hotel is a nice place. It's not cheap, though.

text.Generic Breton Male: If you're looking for books, First Edition is the only place in the city to find them.

text.Generic Breton Female: If you're looking for books, First Edition is the only place in the city to find them.

text.Generic Breton Male: I understand money is tight, but buying discount spells seems like a bad idea.

text.Generic Breton Female: I understand money is tight, but buying discount spells seems like a bad idea.

text.Generic Breton Male: The Feed Bag isn't fancy, but it fills you up.

text.Generic Breton Female: The Feed Bag isn't fancy, but it fills you up.

text.Generic Breton Male: I shopped at Three Brothers a couple of days ago. Not sure which one I talked to, though.

text.Generic Breton Female: I shopped at Three Brothers a couple of days ago. Not sure which one I talked to, though.

text.Generic Breton Male: Claudette Perrick runs a fine alchemy shop. You should check out The Gilded Carafe.

text.Generic Breton Female: Claudette Perrick runs a fine alchemy shop. You should check out The Gilded Carafe.

text.Generic Breton Male: Good thing we have the Black Horse Courier. I don't know how we'd get our news without it.

text.Generic Breton Female: Good thing we have the Black Horse Courier. I don't know how we'd get our news without it.

text.Generic Breton Male: Dervera Romalen is sure proud of the Newlands lodge. I think she's especially happy that the Red Queen drinks there.

text.Generic Breton Female: Dervera Romalen is sure proud of the Newlands lodge. I think she's especially happy that the Red Queen drinks there.

text.Generic Breton Male: I've heard that Hil the Tall knows a lot about Alteration, how to cast shields and that sort of thing.

text.Generic Breton Female: I've heard that Hil the Tall knows a lot about Alteration, how to cast shields and that sort of thing.

text.Generic Breton Male: I hope Ohtesse is taking care of herself. She's a gifted healer, and she spends all her time helping others.

text.Generic Breton Female: I hope Ohtesse is taking care of herself. She's a gifted healer, and she spends all her time helping others.

text.Generic Breton Male: I spoke with Deetsan at the Mages Guild recently. I've never seen someone so happy about being in the guild.

text.Generic Breton Female: I spoke with Deetsan at the Mages Guild recently. I've never seen someone so happy about being in the guild.

text.Generic Breton Male: Olav's Tap and Tack is a good, inexpensive place for travelers.

text.Generic Breton Female: Olav's Tap and Tack is a good, inexpensive place for travelers.

text.Generic Breton Male: Someone needs to get Skjorta under control. You'd think Olfand would be the one to do it.

text.Generic Breton Female: Someone needs to get Skjorta under control. You'd think Olfand would be the one to do it.

text.Generic Breton Male: I've heard that Arentus Falvius at the chapel can conjure up creatures.

text.Generic Breton Female: I've heard that Arentus Falvius at the chapel can conjure up creatures.

text.Generic Breton Male: I understand Bumph gra-Gash trains other Fighters Guild members on the proper use of heavy armors.

text.Generic Breton Female: I understand Bumph gra-Gash trains other Fighters Guild members on the proper use of heavy armors.

text.Generic Breton Male: I've heard that Jantus Brolus is skilled with both magic and steel.

text.Generic Breton Female: I've heard that Jantus Brolus is skilled with both magic and steel.

text.Generic Breton Male: I think all Bogrum gro-Galash cares about is the Lonely Suitor Lodge. He really puts everything into it.

text.Generic Breton Female: I think all Bogrum gro-Galash cares about is the Lonely Suitor Lodge. He really puts everything into it.

text.Generic Breton Male: It's always a pleasure to hear Uravasa Othrelas speak at chapel. She has a real way with words.

text.Generic Breton Female: It's always a pleasure to hear Uravasa Othrelas speak at chapel. She has a real way with words.

text.Generic Breton Male: Nahsi at the Fighters Guild seems very at peace with himself. He says that's what allows him to be such an amazing martial artist.

text.Generic Breton Female: Nahsi at the Fighters Guild seems very at peace with himself. He says that's what allows him to be such an amazing martial artist.

text.Generic Breton Male: Mages Guild members have said that Kud-Ei is an excellent teacher, as well as a very loyal guildmember.

text.Generic Breton Female: Mages Guild members have said that Kud-Ei is an excellent teacher, as well as a very loyal guildmember.

text.Generic Breton Male: That Delphine Jend seems dangerous to me. She's very skilled, but I think she's reckless.

text.Generic Breton Female: That Delphine Jend seems dangerous to me. She's very skilled, but I think she's reckless.

text.Generic Breton Male: Keep your eyes on City-Swimmer. I don't know where she goes when she's not in the canals.

text.Generic Breton Female: Keep your eyes on City-Swimmer. I don't know where she goes when she's not in the canals.

text.Generic Breton Male: Witseidutsei runs a clean establishment. She really hates it when people mess up her place.

text.Courier3: Witseidutsei runs a clean establishment. She really hates it when people mess up her place.

text.Generic Breton Male: Bugok gro-Bol always seems ready for a fight. Seems odd for a bookseller.

text.Courier3: Bugok gro-Bol always seems ready for a fight. Seems odd for a bookseller.

text.Generic Breton Male: Sherina is good with a blade. She knows it, too.

text.Courier3: Sherina is good with a blade. She knows it, too.

text.Generic Breton Male: When S'drassa isn't teaching alchemy, he spends all of his time researching a cure for skooma addiction.

text.Courier3: When S'drassa isn't teaching alchemy, he spends all of his time researching a cure for skooma addiction.

text.Generic Breton Male: Maenlorn and his brother run a nice establishment at the Flowing Bowl.

text.Generic Breton Female: Maenlorn and his brother run a nice establishment at the Flowing Bowl.

text.Generic Breton Male: I feel sorry for Norbert Lelles. He's a good man, but he gets taken in so easily.

text.Generic Breton Female: I feel sorry for Norbert Lelles. He's a good man, but he gets taken in so easily.

text.Generic Breton Male: Rufrius Vinicius is good with his fists. I've seen him in action, and it's impressive.

text.Generic Breton Female: Rufrius Vinicius is good with his fists. I've seen him in action, and it's impressive.

text.Generic Breton Male: Huurwen was sparring with some other Fighters Guild members recently. I don't think any of them could get a hit through her shield.

text.Generic Breton Female: Huurwen was sparring with some other Fighters Guild members recently. I don't think any of them could get a hit through her shield.

text.Generic Breton Male: Marc Gulitte knows more about how to cast a fireball than anyone in Anvil. I try to stay on his good side.

text.Generic Breton Female: Marc Gulitte knows more about how to cast a fireball than anyone in Anvil. I try to stay on his good side.

text.Generic Breton Male: Hauls-Ropes-Faster can run faster than anyone I've ever seen. Of course, he can't often walk a straight line.

text.Generic Breton Female: Hauls-Ropes-Faster can run faster than anyone I've ever seen. Of course, he can't often walk a straight line.

text.Generic Breton Male: Arvena Thelas is an odd one. I've heard some strange noises coming from her basement.

text.Generic Breton Female: Arvena Thelas is an odd one. I've heard some strange noises coming from her basement.

text.AlbericLitte: Good thing I joined the Mages Guild when I did. There's nothing better than enchanting your own clothes.

text.Generic Breton Male: I'm thinking of heading over to Renoit's to buy some books. There's quite a selection.

text.Generic Breton Female: I'm thinking of heading over to Renoit's to buy some books. There's quite a selection.

text.Generic Breton Male: The Oak and Crosier is a nice place, but that Talasma seems rather stuck-up to me.

text.Generic Breton Female: The Oak and Crosier is a nice place, but that Talasma seems rather stuck-up to me.

text.Generic Breton Male: I could be wrong, but it seems to me there's something shady going on at the Oak and Crosier.

text.Generic Breton Female: I could be wrong, but it seems to me there's something shady going on at the Oak and Crosier.

text.Generic Breton Male: The Fighters Guild is a good place to go if you need weapons training.

text.Generic Breton Female: The Fighters Guild is a good place to go if you need weapons training.

text.Generic Breton Male: I saw Rimalus Bruiant walking his dogs today. And yesterday. And the day before. I swear that's all he does.

text.Generic Breton Female: I saw Rimalus Bruiant walking his dogs today. And yesterday. And the day before. I swear that's all he does.

text.Generic Breton Male: I don't understand what Glistel is doing with Malintus Ancrus. I mean, have you seen her? And have you seen him? I just don't get it.

text.Generic Breton Female: I don't understand what Glistel is doing with Malintus Ancrus. I mean, have you seen her? And have you seen him? I just don't get it.

text.Generic Breton Male: Hard to complain about living in Chorrol. We've got everything you need.

text.Generic Breton Female: Hard to complain about living in Chorrol. We've got everything you need.

text.Generic Breton Male: Lots of dogs in this town. Lots of sheep, too. Of course, I prefer the taste of sheep.

text.Generic Breton Female: Lots of dogs in this town. Lots of sheep, too. Of course, I prefer the taste of sheep.

text.Generic Breton Male: It's good to know we've got such a strong Fighters Guild presence here in town.

text.Generic Breton Female: It's good to know we've got such a strong Fighters Guild presence here in town.

text.Generic Breton Male: Ancient Wayshrines of the Nine are scattered through the wilderness. The righteous who pray there receive powerful divine blessings.

text.Generic Breton Female: Ancient Wayshrines of the Nine are scattered through the wilderness. The righteous who pray there receive powerful divine blessings.

text.Generic Breton Male: If you've done good deeds, the Nine will bless you and cure diseases when you visit their wayshrines.

text.Generic Breton Female: If you've done good deeds, the Nine will bless you and cure diseases when you visit their wayshrines.

text.Generic Breton Male: Wayshrines of the Nine in the wilderness confer blessings on the righteous and faithful.

text.Generic Breton Female: Wayshrines of the Nine in the wilderness confer blessings on the righteous and faithful.

text.Generic Breton Male: Those famous for good deeds may receive Blessings of Intelligence and Magicka when they visit Wayshrines of Julianos.

text.Generic Breton Female: Those famous for good deeds may receive Blessings of Intelligence and Magicka when they visit Wayshrines of Julianos.

text.Generic Breton Male: Virtuous visitors to Wayshrines of Kynareth may receive Blessings of Agility.

text.Generic Breton Female: Virtuous visitors to Wayshrines of Kynareth may receive Blessings of Agility.

text.Generic Breton Male: When you visit a Wayshrine of Zenithar, and you've lived a good life by the Nine, you may receive a Blessing of Luck.

text.Generic Breton Female: When you visit a Wayshrine of Zenithar, and you've lived a good life by the Nine, you may receive a Blessing of Luck.

text.Generic Breton Male: Those who live by the Commands of the Nine receive Blessings of Strength when they visit Wayshrines of Tiber Septim.

text.Generic Breton Female: Those who live by the Commands of the Nine receive Blessings of Strength when they visit Wayshrines of Tiber Septim.

text.Generic Breton Male: A good man who honors the Nine may visit the Wayshrines of Akatosh for Blessings of Speed and Magicka.

text.Generic Breton Female: A good man who honors the Nine may visit the Wayshrines of Akatosh for Blessings of Speed and Magicka.

text.Generic Breton Male: If you've been good, Wayshrines of Dibella may bless your Personality.

text.Generic Breton Female: If you've been good, Wayshrines of Dibella may bless your Personality.

text.Generic Breton Male: Wayshrines of Arkay confer Blessings of Health on those who've pleased the Nine by righteous acts.

text.Generic Breton Female: Wayshrines of Arkay confer Blessings of Health on those who've pleased the Nine by righteous acts.

text.Generic Breton Male: Please the Nine with good works, and visit Wayshrines of Stendarr for Blessings of Endurance.

text.Generic Breton Female: Please the Nine with good works, and visit Wayshrines of Stendarr for Blessings of Endurance.

text.Generic Breton Male: You've seen wayshrines in the wilderness? Those who've pleased the Nine may receive Blessings of Willpower at the Wayshrines of Mara.

text.Generic Breton Female: You've seen wayshrines in the wilderness? Those who've pleased the Nine may receive Blessings of Willpower at the Wayshrines of Mara.

text.Generic Breton Male: The Heartlands and Nibenean Valley are the agricultural breadbaskets of Cyrodiil.

text.Generic Breton Female: The Heartlands and Nibenean Valley are the agricultural breadbaskets of Cyrodiil.

text.Generic Breton Male: Where does our food come from? The Heartlands. And the Nibenean Valley. And Skingrad? Great wines, cheeses, and tomatoes.

text.Generic Breton Female: Where does our food come from? The Heartlands. And the Nibenean Valley. And Skingrad? Great wines, cheeses, and tomatoes.

text.Generic Breton Male: The lowlands of the Great Forest rise to the upland plateau of the Colovian West.

text.Generic Breton Female: The lowlands of the Great Forest rise to the upland plateau of the Colovian West.

text.Generic Breton Male: The Great Forest was cleared for agriculture around Lake Rumare, but it's mostly wilderness outside of that.

text.Generic Breton Female: The Great Forest was cleared for agriculture around Lake Rumare, but it's mostly wilderness outside of that.

text.Generic Breton Male: The Colovian Highlands are barren wastelands along the border with Hammerfell.

text.Generic Breton Female: The Colovian Highlands are barren wastelands along the border with Hammerfell.

text.Generic Breton Male: The Colovian Highlands? Near the Hammerfell border? No one lives there. That's barren wastelands.

text.Generic Breton Female: The Colovian Highlands? Near the Hammerfell border? No one lives there. That's barren wastelands.

text.Generic Breton Male: High mountain ranges rise to the borders in the north and east, and marshes and rainforests extend to the southeast borders.

text.Generic Breton Female: High mountain ranges rise to the borders in the north and east, and marshes and rainforests extend to the southeast borders.

text.Generic Breton Male: It's our natural barriers that keep us safe, mostly. Mountain borders north and east, open sea to the west, and bogs and rainforest to south.

text.Generic Breton Female: It's our natural barriers that keep us safe, mostly. Mountain borders north and east, open sea to the west, and bogs and rainforest to south.

text.Generic Breton Male: Cyrodiil is surrounded to the north and east by the lofty Jerall and Valus mountain ranges.

text.Generic Breton Female: Cyrodiil is surrounded to the north and east by the lofty Jerall and Valus mountain ranges.

text.Generic Breton Male: No one wants to live in the Jerall Mountains. Well, maybe in Bruma, but they're like Nords. They don't feel the cold.

text.Generic Breton Female: No one wants to live in the Jerall Mountains. Well, maybe in Bruma, but they're like Nords. They don't feel the cold.

text.Generic Breton Male: Western Cyrodiil is called 'Colovia,' and includes the Gold Coast, West Weald, and Colovian Highlands regions.

text.Generic Breton Female: Western Cyrodiil is called 'Colovia,' and includes the Gold Coast, West Weald, and Colovian Highlands regions.

text.Generic Breton Male: In the west, in Old Colovia, that's where men are men. That's the Gold Coast, West Weald, and Colovian Highlands.

text.Generic Breton Female: In the west, in Old Colovia, that's where men are men. That's the Gold Coast, West Weald, and Colovian Highlands.

text.Generic Breton Male: Nibenay is a region of mixed farmland, parkland, and forest.

text.Generic Breton Female: Nibenay is a region of mixed farmland, parkland, and forest.

text.Generic Breton Male: With all the farms in Nibenay, there's still plenty of forest and wilderness open for settlement.

text.Generic Breton Female: With all the farms in Nibenay, there's still plenty of forest and wilderness open for settlement.

text.Generic Breton Male: Nibenay is bordered on north and east by rugged mountains and to the south by marshes and rainforest.

text.Generic Breton Female: Nibenay is bordered on north and east by rugged mountains and to the south by marshes and rainforest.

text.Generic Breton Male: The people of Nibenay consider themselves to be more civilized and sophisticated than Colovians.

text.Generic Breton Female: The people of Nibenay consider themselves to be more civilized and sophisticated than Colovians.

text.Generic Breton Male: I'm not saying Colovians are dumb. They're just hard-headed.

text.Generic Breton Female: I'm not saying Colovians are dumb. They're just hard-headed.

text.Generic Breton Male: The Nibeneans think they're slick. 'Slippery' is more like it.

text.Generic Breton Female: The Nibeneans think they're slick. 'Slippery' is more like it.

text.Generic Breton Male: Colovia is a land of rugged wastes and highland forests.

text.Generic Breton Female: Colovia is a land of rugged wastes and highland forests.

text.Generic Breton Male: Colovia is dotted with isolated farms and settlements, with most of the population in the coastal margin.

text.Generic Breton Female: Colovia is dotted with isolated farms and settlements, with most of the population in the coastal margin.

text.Generic Breton Male: The Colovians are proud of their reputation for being independent, rough, and rebellious.

text.Generic Breton Female: The Colovians are proud of their reputation for being independent, rough, and rebellious.

text.Generic Breton Male: The Imperial City is located on a large island surrounded by Lake Rumare.

text.Generic Breton Female: The Imperial City is located on a large island surrounded by Lake Rumare.

text.Generic Breton Male: The Imperial City is densely urbanized, with a few large parks and waterside dock areas.

text.Generic Breton Female: The Imperial City is densely urbanized, with a few large parks and waterside dock areas.

text.Generic Breton Male: The Imperial City itself is a walled city, with separate inner walls protecting the Imperial palace.

text.Generic Breton Female: The Imperial City itself is a walled city, with separate inner walls protecting the Imperial palace.

text.Generic Breton Male: The prettiest town in Cyrodiil? Don't know, but the ugliest is Bravil. Shabby, tumbledown shacks. They're big shacks, though.

text.Generic Breton Female: The prettiest town in Cyrodiil? Don't know, but the ugliest is Bravil. Shabby, tumbledown shacks. They're big shacks, though.

text.Generic Breton Male: Where to buy weapons? Where to buy anything, if you can afford to travel, is the Market District in the Imperial City.

text.Generic Breton Female: Where to buy weapons? Where to buy anything, if you can afford to travel, is the Market District in the Imperial City.

text.Generic Breton Male: My favorite town? Anvil. Lovely old stone buildings, and the harbor at sunset is beautiful.

text.Generic Breton Female: My favorite town? Anvil. Lovely old stone buildings, and the harbor at sunset is beautiful.

text.Generic Breton Male: Ayleid ruins? The big thing is to watch out for the traps. Thousands of years old, and still working. Amazing.

text.Generic Breton Female: Ayleid ruins? The big thing is to watch out for the traps. Thousands of years old, and still working. Amazing.

text.Generic Breton Male: I've seen plenty of Ayleid ruins. You'd think they'd be picked clean after 2000 years, but, no, there's still great treasures there.

text.Generic Breton Female: I've seen plenty of Ayleid ruins. You'd think they'd be picked clean after 2000 years, but, no, there's still great treasures there.

text.Generic Breton Male: It's still pretty wild east of the Niben. Few people, except for bandits, but at least it hasn't been picked clean by treasure-hunters.

text.Generic Breton Female: It's still pretty wild east of the Niben. Few people, except for bandits, but at least it hasn't been picked clean by treasure-hunters.

text.Generic Breton Male: Nobody goes into the mountains but hunters and thieves on the lam. Food and shelter is hard to come by.

text.Generic Breton Female: Nobody goes into the mountains but hunters and thieves on the lam. Food and shelter is hard to come by.

text.Generic Breton Male: Blackwood isn't so bad, once you get used to the flies. And being lost all the time. And the zombies and will-o-the-wisps.

text.Generic Breton Female: Blackwood isn't so bad, once you get used to the flies. And being lost all the time. And the zombies and will-o-the-wisps.

text.Generic Breton Male: There's islands in Niben Bay no one has visited in a hundred years. No telling what you'll find.

text.Generic Breton Female: There's islands in Niben Bay no one has visited in a hundred years. No telling what you'll find.

text.Generic Breton Male: Well, it's no problem traveling from the Imperial City to Leyawiin... if you're a wizard and can walk on water. I'd stay off the roads, though.

text.Generic Breton Female: Well, it's no problem traveling from the Imperial City to Leyawiin... if you're a wizard and can walk on water. I'd stay off the roads, though.

text.Generic Breton Male: If you're all alone in the woods and you see a troll coming, you run. Problem solved. Next question?

text.Generic Breton Female: If you're all alone in the woods and you see a troll coming, you run. Problem solved. Next question?

text.Generic Breton Male: Fighting's easy. Just lead them out on the water and shoot them full of holes. If you've got a bow, of course, and can walk on water.

text.Generic Breton Female: Fighting's easy. Just lead them out on the water and shoot them full of holes. If you've got a bow, of course, and can walk on water.

text.Generic Breton Male: The Arena's faked. You think those guys are getting killed? Really? It's just berry syrup and ham-acting.

text.Generic Breton Female: The Arena's faked. You think those guys are getting killed? Really? It's just berry syrup and ham-acting.

text.Generic Breton Male: Have you ever met anyone who got rich betting on the Arena? Didn't think so.

text.Generic Breton Female: Have you ever met anyone who got rich betting on the Arena? Didn't think so.

text.Generic Breton Male: The Council runs the Arena to amuse the masses, and it pays for itself, with all the fools who lose their shirts gambling.

text.Generic Breton Female: The Council runs the Arena to amuse the masses, and it pays for itself, with all the fools who lose their shirts gambling.

text.Generic Breton Male: If you're on a road, you can usually outrun anything. If you're in good shape, and not wearing a tin suit.

text.Generic Breton Female: If you're on a road, you can usually outrun anything. If you're in good shape, and not wearing a tin suit.

text.Generic Breton Male: Orcs don't ride horses. They eat horses. And sometimes I think they're the smart ones. Wait, maybe it's Dunmer who eat horses.

text.Generic Breton Female: Orcs don't ride horses. They eat horses. And sometimes I think they're the smart ones. Wait, maybe it's Dunmer who eat horses.

text.Generic Breton Male: Take Cheydinhal, for example. Pretty little town. But the Count's a Dark Elf, and it's crawling with Orc thugs and gangsters.

text.Generic Breton Female: Take Cheydinhal, for example. Pretty little town. But the Count's a Dark Elf, and it's crawling with Orc thugs and gangsters.

text.Generic Breton Male: The lands surrounding Lake Rumare are studded with small settlements, farms, and woodland game reserves.

text.Generic Breton Female: The lands surrounding Lake Rumare are studded with small settlements, farms, and woodland game reserves.

text.Generic Breton Male: The Nibenay Basin grades from rolling farmlands by the river east to the rugged uplands of the Valus Mountains.

text.Generic Breton Female: The Nibenay Basin grades from rolling farmlands by the river east to the rugged uplands of the Valus Mountains.

text.Generic Breton Male: On Cyrodiil's northern border is the sparsely populated mountain wilderness called the Valus Mountains.

text.Generic Breton Female: On Cyrodiil's northern border is the sparsely populated mountain wilderness called the Valus Mountains.

text.Generic Breton Male: You can't be too careful out in the wilderness. Almost any creature you find is liable to give you a disease.

text.Generic Breton Female: You can't be too careful out in the wilderness. Almost any creature you find is liable to give you a disease.

text.Generic Breton Male: Watch yourself around goblins. Some of the nastier ones will toss spells at you.

text.Generic Breton Female: Watch yourself around goblins. Some of the nastier ones will toss spells at you.

text.Generic Breton Male: Imps. I hate 'em. Little buggers flitting around, tossing fireballs at you!

text.Generic Breton Female: Imps. I hate 'em. Little buggers flitting around, tossing fireballs at you!

text.Generic Breton Male: I saw a wraith once. It threw a curse on me I'll never forget.

text.Generic Breton Female: I saw a wraith once. It threw a curse on me I'll never forget.

text.Generic Breton Male: Have you seen a land dreugh? We call them "Billies." Don't know why. Steer clear of them, though.

text.Generic Breton Female: Have you seen a land dreugh? We call them "Billies." Don't know why. Steer clear of them, though.

text.Generic Breton Male: I ran across a ghost once. Seemed to suck the energy right out of me.

text.Generic Breton Female: I ran across a ghost once. Seemed to suck the energy right out of me.

text.Generic Breton Male: Watch for minotaurs in the forests. Aggressive beasts. They'll tear right through your armor, too.

text.Generic Breton Female: Watch for minotaurs in the forests. Aggressive beasts. They'll tear right through your armor, too.

text.Generic Breton Male: Mudcrabs. What's the point? Annoying buggers, though the meat isn't bad.

text.Generic Breton Female: Mudcrabs. What's the point? Annoying buggers, though the meat isn't bad.

text.Generic Breton Male: Only thing worse than an ogre is two ogres. Tough bastards, and spells seem to bounce right off of 'em.

text.Generic Breton Female: Only thing worse than an ogre is two ogres. Tough bastards, and spells seem to bounce right off of 'em.

text.Generic Breton Male: Is there anywhere in Tamriel you can avoid rats? Disease spreading little nuisances.

text.Generic Breton Female: Is there anywhere in Tamriel you can avoid rats? Disease spreading little nuisances.

text.Generic Breton Male: Best way to take out a skeleton is with a big weapon. Forget spells. Just smack them and watch the bones fly!

text.Generic Breton Female: Best way to take out a skeleton is with a big weapon. Forget spells. Just smack them and watch the bones fly!

text.Generic Breton Male: I might swim more if it weren't for the slaughterfish. Sharp teeth, and some carry disease.

text.Generic Breton Female: I might swim more if it weren't for the slaughterfish. Sharp teeth, and some carry disease.

text.Generic Breton Male: Spriggans. "Nature's guardians" my foot! Mean things. They'll curse you, or they might call a bear to tear you apart.

text.Generic Breton Female: Spriggans. "Nature's guardians" my foot! Mean things. They'll curse you, or they might call a bear to tear you apart.

text.Generic Breton Male: All that stuff about having to set trolls on fire is a bunch of hooey. They don't like fire, but a good sword will cut them up fine.

text.Generic Breton Female: All that stuff about having to set trolls on fire is a bunch of hooey. They don't like fire, but a good sword will cut them up fine.

text.Generic Breton Male: I don't even know what a will-o-the-wisp is, much less how to kill one. I think they're just swamp gas, myself.

text.Generic Breton Female: I don't even know what a will-o-the-wisp is, much less how to kill one. I think they're just swamp gas, myself.

text.Generic Breton Male: I don't like to think about zombies. Missing arms, legs, heads. They smell awful, and they're hard to kill.

text.Generic Breton Female: I don't like to think about zombies. Missing arms, legs, heads. They smell awful, and they're hard to kill.

text.Generic Breton Male: Try combining aloe vera leaves with some venison. It's said to have some restorative properties.

text.Generic Breton Female: Try combining aloe vera leaves with some venison. It's said to have some restorative properties.

text.Generic Breton Male: You can find Cairn Bolete growing in caves. They're said to mark the place someone has died.

text.Generic Breton Female: You can find Cairn Bolete growing in caves. They're said to mark the place someone has died.

text.Generic Breton Male: It's said that eating taproot can bring you good luck.

text.Generic Breton Female: It's said that eating taproot can bring you good luck.

text.Generic Breton Male: Make sure not to eat nightshade. It's very poisonous.

text.Generic Breton Female: Make sure not to eat nightshade. It's very poisonous.

text.SEAmiableFanriene: I hear there's someone new in the Isles... they should have stayed away. This whole place is coming down on our heads!
The Gatekeeper's dead? Probably got killed by the Gates of Madness falling down on his head.
I heard there's an ancient ruin that lures adventurers into it, then it kills them. It's old, so those walls can't be safe.
Thadon is not so moody lately. Do you think that wall is about to fall on me? It seems awfully unstable.
Syl's torturing people again? I'd hate to be locked up in a tiny cell. That'd be torture enough.
That giant torch is on fire now. Great. The thing's likely to fall over and land on somebody. Me, probably. It's not safe walking around anymore.
Maybe the ruler of Mania will fix all these walls that threaten to fall on top of us all the time.
Maybe the ruler of Dementia will fix all these walls that threaten to fall on top of us all the time.
See, I told you! These buildings just aren't safe. A huge Obelisk fell over and destroyed Passwall.
Heard there's a new Gatekeeper. Spends all day by that huge wall. It's bound to fall in on him.
Lord Sheogorath's armies are back! Maybe they'll fix some of these buildings so they don't collapse on people.
Even Sheogorath knows it's not safe here. Probably afraid of the buildings falling in on him.
The Greymarch is over. Sheogorath has defeated Jyggalag! The whole world almost collapsed on us! But it didn't!

text.SEAnyaHerrick: Someone new in the Isles? Oh no, I don't want that. Perhaps Syl will put a stop to it.

text.SESicklyBernice: Someone different come to the Isles? Don't like to think what kind of diseases came along.

text.SEAnyaHerrick: The Gatekeeper, dead! This could be the end for all of us!

text.SESicklyBernice: The Gatekeeper has died. Wonder what got him. Collywobbles? Greenspore?

text.SEAnyaHerrick: Hearing that the Resonator works again almost makes up for losing the Gatekeeper. We're still not safe, though.

text.SESicklyBernice: The Resonator is active once again? Perhaps it will draw the disease from my body.

text.SEAnyaHerrick: If Thadon has his Chalice back, maybe that will smooth things over between the two Houses.

text.SESicklyBernice: How can Thadon drink from that Chalice? Who knows what germs are on it?

text.SEAnyaHerrick: I don't know what happened. I didn't do anything to Syl, so why was I punished?

text.SESicklyBernice: I heard something strange happened in the House of Dementia. Probably disease-related.

text.SEAnyaHerrick: The Great Torch is lit once more. Maybe we might be safe here after all.

text.SESicklyBernice: The Great Torch burns once more. Perhaps there's hope for all. Except me. Can't shake this cold....

text.SEAnyaHerrick: Crucible has a new ruler. Perhaps I can continue to find shelter in the House of Dementia, else what will I do?

text.SESicklyBernice: Syl is gone, and a new ruler presides over the House of Dementia. Perhaps they can cure my malady.

text.SEAnyaHerrick: Thank Sheogorath it was Thadon who was killed, not Syl.

text.SESicklyBernice: Thadon has passed the mantle. I heard he was in bad health, anyway, and I know how that is.

text.SEAnyaHerrick: The Fringe gone. We're next. I'm sure of it.

text.SESicklyBernice: Order has attacked Passwall. Probably brought horrible disease with them, as well.

text.SEAnyaHerrick: The Gatekeeper has been rebuilt, which means the Realm is a little safer for now.

text.SESicklyBernice: A new Gatekeeper protects the Fringe. But he does nothing to stop the spread of disease.

text.SEAnyaHerrick: The realm has regained an army. Let's hope it can protect us.

text.SESicklyBernice: The Daedric armies are whole again. If only I could live to see them in battle. The chills are getting worse, though.

text.SEAnyaHerrick: Maybe there really is no place left to hide. We are truly doomed if the attempts to find Him fail.

text.SESicklyBernice: Sheogorath gone, and me not far behind. I think this cold will finally be the death of me.

text.SEAnyaHerrick: The Greymarch is over. At least I'll be able to sleep a little safer now.

text.SESicklyBernice: Order is defeated! I think I actually feel a little better. No... I don't.

text.SENanetteDon: The Gatekeeper should take care of anyone who doesn't belong.

text.SEZoeMalene: I don't have time to deal with adventurers entering the Isles, I have a painting to finish!

text.SENanetteDon: The Gatekeeper's dead. I hope I get to help rebuild a new one.

text.SEZoeMalene: Perhaps I should dedicate a portrait to the Gatekeeper in honor of his death.

text.SENanetteDon: It's good that Resonator of Judgment is working again, what with the Gatekeeper dead and everything. Did you hear that noise?

text.SEZoeMalene: I began a painting of the Resonator of Judgment many years ago. I wonder if I ever finished it?

text.SENanetteDon: Thadon is addicted to Felldew. I stay away from drugs. A sorceress needs a clear mind. Hey, do you hear those dogs barking? They're so loud!

text.SEZoeMalene: Thadon's new mood after recovering his Chalice is quite nice.

text.SENanetteDon: Syl likes torturing people. She's got nothing on the methods of Sorceress Verenim, though. She's a genius with pain.

text.SEZoeMalene: I don't have time to deal with Syl and her paranoid ways.

text.SENanetteDon: The Great Torch is lit in the city. Do you hear it? I do.

text.SEZoeMalene: The Great Torch burns with such vibrant color. I should try and incorporate the hues in my next work.

text.SENanetteDon: I heard there's a new ruler in Crucible. Of course, I hear lots of things. Like that! Did you hear that?

text.SEZoeMalene: The Duchess of Dementia has been assassinated? Well, no need to finish her portrait then.

text.SENanetteDon: I heard there's a new ruler in Bliss. Of course, I hear lots of things. Like that! Did you hear that?

text.SEZoeMalene: The Duke of Mania has been assassinated? Well, no need to finish his portrait, then....

text.SENanetteDon: If the old Gatekeeper were still around, those Knights wouldn't have caused such trouble.

text.SEZoeMalene: I must make my way to The Fringe and capture its destruction on canvas. We can't let history be forgotten.
