text.SENanetteDon: I wish I'd been able to help construct the new Gatekeeper.

text.SEZoeMalene: The Gatekeeper's return can only mean one thing... time to begin a new painting of him.

text.SENanetteDon: Armies with steel are good, but armies can be destroyed. Magic is better. Magic can bring armies back to life.

text.SEZoeMalene: Now there's an army to protect us? Ugh, and I almost had begun to paint "The Gatekeeper in Repose." Oh well, time to start again.

text.SENanetteDon: Where has our Lord gone? I hope He returns soon.

text.SEZoeMalene: Sheogorath has disappeared! How can I be expected to paint at a time like this?

text.SENanetteDon: Jyggalag's forces have been defeated. Perhaps Order is simply an inferior element.

text.SEZoeMalene: Finally, some peace and quiet around here... now I can get some serious work done.

text.Generic DarkElf Male: You're talking to me, and I don't like you. Goodbye.

text.Generic DarkElf Female: You're talking to me, and I don't like you. Goodbye.

text.Generic DarkElf Male: I see no reason to talk to you.

text.Generic DarkElf Female: I see no reason to talk to you.

text.Generic DarkElf Male: I don't like you and don't want to talk to you.

text.Generic DarkElf Female: I don't like you and don't want to talk to you.

text.Generic DarkElf Male: I'm not listening to you. It's because I don't like you.

text.Generic DarkElf Female: I'm not listening to you. It's because I don't like you.

text.Generic DarkElf Male: You're still speaking. Stop.

text.Generic DarkElf Female: You're still speaking. Stop.

text.DelosFandas: Everyone's talking about the assassination, of course. Here. Take my copy of the new Black Horse Courier. Go ahead. Keep it.

text.Generic DarkElf Female: Everyone's talking about the assassination, of course. Here. Take my copy of the new Black Horse Courier. Go ahead. Keep it.

text.Generic DarkElf Male: Everyone wants to know what really happened in the Temple. What happened to Martin? Was the fiery dragon really Akatosh?

text.Generic DarkElf Female: Everyone wants to know what really happened in the Temple. What happened to Martin? Was the fiery dragon really Akatosh?

text.Generic DarkElf Male: The Fighters Guild is recruiting again. Not a bad way to make some money, if you've got the stones for it.

text.Generic DarkElf Female: The Fighters Guild is recruiting again. Not a bad way to make some money, if you've got the stones for it.

text.Generic DarkElf Male: Anyone looking for work should consider the Fighters Guild. I hear they're always looking for recruits.

text.Generic DarkElf Female: Anyone looking for work should consider the Fighters Guild. I hear they're always looking for recruits.

text.Generic DarkElf Male: I understand the Fighters Guild is hiring new members. Not bad work for some folks.

text.Generic DarkElf Female: I understand the Fighters Guild is hiring new members. Not bad work for some folks.

text.Generic DarkElf Male: Mannimarco is no more! The guild is saved, and we have a new Arch-Mage to lead us.

text.AlvesUvenim: I can't believe Arch-Mage Traven sacrificed himself to save us all. How noble of him.

text.Generic DarkElf Male: I don't know what it was, but something important was taken away from Mannimarco. Maybe there is a chance he can be defeated.
Traven might get us through this yet. I hear that the Necromancers were handed a significant defeat at Silorn.
The Council has turned on Traven. Things couldn't possibly get any worse for the guild.
Mannimarco himself is in Cyrodiil, hunting us down. None of us are safe!
Without the Council of Mages to guide us, how will we stand up to the King of Worms?
The Council of Mages has been dissolved. Arch-Mage Traven has been deserted. He's all we have left.
Necromancers have attacked our very homes. What could be next?

text.AlvesUvenim: The Bruma guild hall has been decimated. Our hall could be next!
I've heard rumors about the Council of Mages consorting with outside sources. Why are outsiders interfering with our guild?
The Council of Mages has this Necromancer situation under control. They must, or else we'd know about it, right?

text.Generic DarkElf Male: Something has gone seriously wrong at the Arcane University. I heard that a high-ranking member was killed in some sort of ambush.

text.AlvesUvenim: I think the rumors about Necromancers are completely untrue. I've heard some crazy things, and I don't believe any of them.

text.Generic DarkElf Male: The Council seems very interested in this new group of Necromancers that has sprung up. I wonder how things will play out.
Have you heard anything more about what the Council knows about these Necromancers? Something's not right.

text.AlvesUvenim: It's good to know that valuable research is still going on, even though things seem to be a bit more tense lately.

text.Generic DarkElf Male: Someone finally solved the problems with research at Vahtacen. You'd think the Council would know more about the Ayleids by now.

text.AlvesUvenim: It sounds like the Council of Mages has been holding extra meetings recently. I'm not sure what that means.

text.Generic DarkElf Male: I've heard rumors that the Council of Mages is taking advice from outsiders. I'm not sure how I feel about that.
Arch-Mage Traven was right to ban Necromancy from the guild. Look at what they've done; they've gone and killed several of us!

text.AlvesUvenim: The Mages Guild has been attacked by Necromancers. This proves they can't be trusted!

text.Generic DarkElf Male: I understand that Dagail is in much better control of her faculties now that Kalthar's plot has been exposed.
Kalthar tried to ruin the Leyawiin guild. Just goes to show you can't trust a Necromancer, even if he claims to be "reformed."

text.Generic DarkElf Female: Did you hear that someone played yet another prank on Jeanne Frasoric in Bruma? I don't know how she keeps falling for these things.

text.Generic DarkElf Male: It sounds like there are an awful lot of problems at the Bruma guild hall. Jeanne does a poor job of running that place.

text.Generic DarkElf Female: The Chorrol guild hall had an unpleasant visit recently, from someone who had a grudge against Teekeeus.

text.Generic DarkElf Male: I hear a new Associate came to Teekeeus's aid recently. Something about an old enemy of his storming into town.
The roads near Anvil are safer now, thanks to Carahil and her guild hall. She's an example for us all.

text.Generic DarkElf Female: The Anvil guild has made quite a name for itself under Carahil. Did you hear about the recent murderer they caught?
Kud-Ei will do anything to help her girls out. She recently got Ardaline out of a bind, and I hear it wasn't completely within guild rules.

text.Generic DarkElf Male: Kud-Ei runs a tight ship in Bruma. She may not always play by the rules, but I wouldn't want her on my bad side.
I can't believe a Mages Guild associate was found dead in Cheydinhal. What kind of place are they running there?

text.Generic DarkElf Female: Did you hear that Falcar left the guild? I think Deetsan is in charge in Cheydinhal now.
I heard that one of the Skingrad mages was assaulted, but I don't know the details.

text.Generic DarkElf Male: Sounds like the Skingrad branch of the guild can't even keep track of its members. How appalling.
I heard that Soris Arenim made himself quite a bit of money recently. He seems very happy about it.

text.Generic DarkElf Female: I heard that Soris Arenim made himself quite a bit of money recently. He seems very happy about it.

text.Generic DarkElf Male: There was some kind of fight at the Mages Guild. I heard that Falcar disappeared, as well.

text.Generic DarkElf Female: There was some kind of fight at the Mages Guild. I heard that Falcar disappeared, as well.

text.Generic DarkElf Male: Things in the guild have been different since Traven was named Arch-Mage. They're more structured, but everyone seems tense.

text.Generic DarkElf Female: Things in the guild have been different since Traven was named Arch-Mage. They're more structured, but everyone seems tense.

text.Generic DarkElf Male: Half of the Council of Mages resigned when Traven took over the position of Arch-Mage.

text.Generic DarkElf Female: Half of the Council of Mages resigned when Traven took over the position of Arch-Mage.

text.Generic DarkElf Male: Arch-Mage Traven is the first to take such a hard stance on Necromancy. It upset more than a few people.

text.Generic DarkElf Female: Arch-Mage Traven is the first to take such a hard stance on Necromancy. It upset more than a few people.

text.Generic DarkElf Male: The Mages Guild runs more or less like it always did, but we lost quite a few members when the practice of Necromancy was banned.

text.Generic DarkElf Female: The Mages Guild runs more or less like it always did, but we lost quite a few members when the practice of Necromancy was banned.

text.Generic DarkElf Male: Necromancy may be legal in Cyrodiil, but few will openly admit to practicing it now that the Mages Guild has banned it.

text.Generic DarkElf Female: Necromancy may be legal in Cyrodiil, but few will openly admit to practicing it now that the Mages Guild has banned it.

text.Generic DarkElf Male: Some say that Traven is mis-using the power of the Arch-Mage's position to further his personal agendas.

text.Generic DarkElf Female: Some say that Traven is mis-using the power of the Arch-Mage's position to further his personal agendas.

text.Generic DarkElf Male: I don't know what Arch-Mage Traven has against Necromancy, but the first thing he did after taking over the Mages Guild was to ban its practice.

text.Generic DarkElf Female: I don't know what Arch-Mage Traven has against Necromancy, but the first thing he did after taking over the Mages Guild was to ban its practice.

text.Generic DarkElf Male: Not only has Necromancy been banned from practice in the Mages Guild, but the Guild won't deal with anyone who openly uses it.

text.Generic DarkElf Female: Not only has Necromancy been banned from practice in the Mages Guild, but the Guild won't deal with anyone who openly uses it.

text.Generic DarkElf Male: The Mages Guild has made more than a few enemies since Necromancy was banned.

text.Generic DarkElf Female: The Mages Guild has made more than a few enemies since Necromancy was banned.

text.Generic DarkElf Male: I saw that Earana woman hanging around the Mages Guild again.
I saw that Erthor is back in town again.

text.Generic DarkElf Female: I hear one of the guild mages has gone missing again.

text.Generic DarkElf Male: It seems quieter than usual at the Mages Guild.
I saw Earana leaving town. She looked very excited.

text.Generic DarkElf Female: Things at the Mages Guild seem tense. That Falcar fellow sure keeps a tight rein on things.

text.Generic DarkElf Male: Falcar at the Mages Guild seems to be angry all the time. I avoid him when I can.
I haven't seen Vidkun around town lately. I guess they're keeping him pretty busy at the Mages Guild.

text.Generic DarkElf Female: I haven't seen Vidkun around town lately. I guess they're keeping him pretty busy at the Mages Guild.

text.Generic DarkElf Male: Varon Vamori seems very glum lately. I guess things aren't going well with Ardaline.
Kud-Ei seems upset about something lately. I'd stay away from the Mages Guild if I were you.

text.Generic DarkElf Female: Kud-Ei seems upset about something lately. I'd stay away from the Mages Guild if I were you.
Those new fellows here in town are making me nervous. Walking around with those big weapons; I hope they leave soon.

text.Generic DarkElf Male: I heard someone broke into the Mages Guild.

text.Generic DarkElf Female: I heard someone broke into the Mages Guild.

text.Generic DarkElf Male: If the Council really did split up, the guild is done for. This is serious.

text.Generic DarkElf Female: If the Council really did split up, the guild is done for. This is serious.

text.Generic DarkElf Male: The Mages Guild seems more disorganized than usual lately.

text.DraloraAthram: The Mages Guild seems more disorganized than usual lately.

text.AndelIndarys: Millona Umbranox is better off without that irresponsible husband of hers. The most honorable thing he ever did was to disappear and leave her alone.
Millona Umbranox, Arriana Valga, and Narina Carvain seem to rule their counties perfectly well without male assistance.
I've never heard the Countess mention her husband. I believe it is something of a sore point with Lady Millona.
I believe the rugged climate of Bruma suits Narina Carvain. She's tough and cold, but you always know what to expect from her.
No wonder Narina Carvain is so cranky. If you had to live year-round in a cold, drafty, soot-stained castle like Bruma, you'd be cranky, too.
With Regulus Terentius for a father, what do you expect from Gellius? The acorn never falls too far from the tree.
It is fashionable to make fun of Bravil and Regulus Terentius. Personally, I think it is poor sport to mock the poor and disadvantaged.
Alessia Caro visits her mother in Chorrol regularly. A dutiful daughter... and a dutiful wife, I hear.
There's been trouble with smugglers and Khajiit bandits in the Trans-Niben, but Marius Caro is taking steps to deal with the problem.
The Count of Skingrad and I are not social intimates. In fact, I don't believe Janus Hassildor has any social intimates.
It's curious. Skingrad's people scarcely ever set eyes on the Count, but he's apparently loved and respected by all his subjects.
A master sorcerer like Janus Hassildor inevitably outlives all his peers. It must be a lonely existence.
It is pleasant, and a bit melancholy, to walk among the graves in Green Emperor Way and contemplate the dead who precede us.
I admit to sharing the common enthusiasm for the Arena. It is barbaric, but the stakes of life or death make the drama irresistably compelling.
They say Alinor on Summerset Isle is more beautiful. I've never been. For the present, I must count the Imperial City the most glorious in Tamriel.
Legion duty here in Cyrodiil is usually a dull affair. In the East, though, things are a bit more challenging, and one can make a name for oneself.
The legions patrol the roads, and they've always been sufficient. I can't imagine we'll ever be at war with the provinces... not in my lifetime.
I've not always been happy with the standards of conduct in the Mages Guild, but Hannibal Traven's reforms are quite encouraging.
I'm not sure the Dark Brotherhood is any more serious a problem than beggary and petty thievery. And it's certainly a discreet and secret problem.
The people have a simple faith in the Nine, and the clerics do their part to heal and comfort them in adversity.
I've sometimes thought I'd like to make a pilgrimage to the wayshrines, but my duties prevent me from such extensive and dangerous travel.
The doomstones are a mystery. Are they traces of the Mythic Times? Or creations of ancient beastfolk or lost races of mer or men?
I have not read the works of Mrs. Ottus. I'm told some find her guide books useful, though she apparently has strong opinions on some matters.
The Elder Council and the bureaucracy have managed the Empire's affairs for decades. The Emperor rules, but the Council handles all the details.
What can be said about taxes? They're high, but we must pay. At least they are administered efficiently, and the shrinkage is within decent limits.
It is not always an easy life we lead, but the people must be served.

text.Generic DarkElf Female: You better have the right offering, or you're wasting your time here.

text.Generic DarkElf Male: The Nine Divines are boring. Daedra? They're never boring.
They say that when you murder someone, the Dark Brotherhood comes to you in your sleep. It's how they recruit new members.

text.Generic DarkElf Female: They say that when you murder someone, the Dark Brotherhood comes to you in your sleep. It's how they recruit new members.

text.Generic DarkElf Male: Count Leyawiin placed a bounty on the heads of the surviving Black Bow Bandits.

text.Generic DarkElf Female: Count Leyawiin placed a bounty on the heads of the surviving Black Bow Bandits.

text.Generic DarkElf Male: I hear the Count's got someone to sort out that business with Mazoga the so-called knight.
Poor Tivela. I hear she is turning Cheydinhal inside out looking for her husband, Rythe. I hope nothing bad has happened to him.

text.Generic DarkElf Female: Poor Tivela. I hear she is turning Cheydinhal inside out looking for her husband, Rythe. I hope nothing bad has happened to him.

text.Generic DarkElf Male: Have you seen Valus Odiil recently? Spends all day in the tavern since his boys left.

text.Generic DarkElf Female: Have you seen Valus Odiil recently? Spends all day in the tavern since his boys left.

text.Generic DarkElf Male: I saw Valus Odiil at the Grey Mare again today. Hasn't been the same since his boys took off.

text.Generic DarkElf Female: I saw Valus Odiil at the Grey Mare again today. Hasn't been the same since his boys took off.

text.Generic DarkElf Male: Kud-Ei seems to be in good spirits again after Henantier's return. I heard she enlisted a stranger's help in the search. Good show I say!

text.Generic DarkElf Female: Kud-Ei seems to be in good spirits again after Henantier's return. I heard she enlisted a stranger's help in the search. Good show I say!

text.Generic DarkElf Male: Henantier was slain in his sleep. How awful. They should find the one who did it and send him straight to prison.

text.Generic DarkElf Female: Henantier was slain in his sleep. How awful. They should find the one who did it and send him straight to prison.

text.Generic DarkElf Male: I have it on good account that the Forlorn Watchman is gone for good. The stories about his fate were true, but now the curse has been broken.

text.Generic DarkElf Female: I have it on good account that the Forlorn Watchman is gone for good. The stories about his fate were true, but now the curse has been broken.

text.Generic DarkElf Male: Well, despite everything, Aleron Loche turned up dead. That's what you get when you deal with gamblers and usurers.

text.Generic DarkElf Female: Well, despite everything, Aleron Loche turned up dead. That's what you get when you deal with gamblers and usurers.

text.Generic DarkElf Male: So, the mighty Ulrich Leland has fallen. Apparently Llevana Nedaren snapped and killed him. Good riddance I say.

text.Generic DarkElf Female: So, the mighty Ulrich Leland has fallen. Apparently Llevana Nedaren snapped and killed him. Good riddance I say.

text.Generic DarkElf Male: Did you hear the news? Ulrich Leland was thrown in the dungeons for stealing money from the city coffers. Haha! Justice for the little guy!

text.Generic DarkElf Female: Did you hear the news? Ulrich Leland was thrown in the dungeons for stealing money from the city coffers. Haha! Justice for the little guy!

text.Generic DarkElf Male: Thank goodness the gate is gone. I couldn't get a good night's sleep knowing it was out there!

text.Generic DarkElf Female: Thank goodness the gate is gone. I couldn't get a good night's sleep knowing it was out there!

text.Generic DarkElf Male: Rythe Lythandas seems to be back in town. Wonder where he was off to?

text.Generic DarkElf Female: Rythe Lythandas seems to be back in town. Wonder where he was off to?

text.Generic DarkElf Male: The Honorblade has been returned to the Castle after all these years! This is certainly a good omen.

text.Generic DarkElf Female: The Honorblade has been returned to the Castle after all these years! This is certainly a good omen.

text.Generic DarkElf Male: The Countess still seems quite sad. I hear someone tried to find the item stolen from the castle, but they had no luck. Oh well.

text.Generic DarkElf Female: The Countess still seems quite sad. I hear someone tried to find the item stolen from the castle, but they had no luck. Oh well.

text.Generic DarkElf Male: The Countess seems much happier now that the item that was stolen from her was returned.

text.Generic DarkElf Female: The Countess seems much happier now that the item that was stolen from her was returned.

text.Generic DarkElf Male: I saw Reynald Jemane's brother earlier. Can't believe they didn't even know about each other.

text.Generic DarkElf Female: I saw Reynald Jemane's brother earlier. Can't believe they didn't even know about each other.

text.Generic DarkElf Male: Reynald Jemane has a terrible memory. We've met many times, but when I saw him in Cheydinhal, he walked right past me like we were strangers.

text.Generic DarkElf Female: Reynald Jemane has a terrible memory. We've met many times, but when I saw him in Cheydinhal, he walked right past me like we were strangers.

text.Generic DarkElf Male: I was in Cheydinhal last week, and I'm sure I saw Reynald Jemane. He acted like he didn't know me, though.

text.Generic DarkElf Female: I was in Cheydinhal last week, and I'm sure I saw Reynald Jemane. He acted like he didn't know me, though.

text.Generic DarkElf Male: You hear any word about Kud-Ei's friend? She's offering a generous reward, so hopefully someone will show up and lend a hand.

text.Generic DarkElf Female: You hear any word about Kud-Ei's friend? She's offering a generous reward, so hopefully someone will show up and lend a hand.

text.Generic DarkElf Male: I saw Kud-Ei moping around outside the Mages Guild yesterday. In fact, I could swear she was crying. I hope she finds her missing friend.

text.Generic DarkElf Female: I saw Kud-Ei moping around outside the Mages Guild yesterday. In fact, I could swear she was crying. I hope she finds her missing friend.

text.Generic DarkElf Male: There's some strange Dark Elf in town, asking about Reynald Jemane and his brother.

text.Generic DarkElf Female: There's some strange Dark Elf in town, asking about Reynald Jemane and his brother.

text.Generic DarkElf Male: I've sighted the Forlorn Watchman again. Every time I see that ghost, it gives me the creeps.

text.Generic DarkElf Female: I've sighted the Forlorn Watchman again. Every time I see that ghost, it gives me the creeps.

text.Generic DarkElf Male: Have you heard about that ghost of the old man that looks out into Niben Bay each night? They're calling him the Forlorn Watchman... spooky.

text.Generic DarkElf Female: Have you heard about that ghost of the old man that looks out into Niben Bay each night? They're calling him the Forlorn Watchman... spooky.

text.Generic DarkElf Male: I can't believe that the Countess is more obsessed with that painting than the Oblivion Gate threatening the city!

text.Generic DarkElf Female: I can't believe that the Countess is more obsessed with that painting than the Oblivion Gate threatening the city!

text.Generic DarkElf Male: I heard that the Countess is quite upset lately. Apparently someone stole something very personal to her.

text.Generic DarkElf Female: I heard that the Countess is quite upset lately. Apparently someone stole something very personal to her.

text.Generic DarkElf Male: They charged me 5 gold for littering! Littering!! I barely make that in a year! These fines are ridiculous!

text.Generic DarkElf Female: They charged me 5 gold for littering! Littering!! I barely make that in a year! These fines are ridiculous!

text.Generic DarkElf Male: I can't believe the ridiculous new fines the guards are imposing. Ever since Ulrich took over as Captain of the Guard, this place is going downhill.

text.Generic DarkElf Female: I can't believe the ridiculous new fines the guards are imposing. Ever since Ulrich took over as Captain of the Guard, this place is going downhill.

text.Generic DarkElf Male: So, thanks to some hired help, the Jemanes recovered Weatherleah. Good thing... I never liked having ogres so close to Chorrol.

text.Generic DarkElf Female: So, thanks to some hired help, the Jemanes recovered Weatherleah. Good thing... I never liked having ogres so close to Chorrol.

text.Generic DarkElf Male: I'd stay inside the city walls if I were you, there's no telling what's going to come out of that gate.

text.Generic DarkElf Female: I'd stay inside the city walls if I were you, there's no telling what's going to come out of that gate.

text.Generic DarkElf Male: Ever since that gate appeared, the city guards have been on alert. I hope they can protect us.

text.Generic DarkElf Female: Ever since that gate appeared, the city guards have been on alert. I hope they can protect us.

text.Generic DarkElf Male: I overheard someone say that Aleron Loche is missing. I don't know what happened to him. His wife, Ursanne, is beside herself with grief.

text.Generic DarkElf Female: I overheard someone say that Aleron Loche is missing. I don't know what happened to him. His wife, Ursanne, is beside herself with grief.

text.Generic DarkElf Male: Did you hear that Dar-Ma has disappeared?

text.Generic DarkElf Female: Did you hear that Dar-Ma has disappeared?

text.Generic DarkElf Male: Did you hear the bad news?  Dar-Ma's daughter was killed by some strange cultists down in Hackdirt. Terrible, terrible times we live in.

text.Generic DarkElf Female: Did you hear the bad news?  Dar-Ma's daughter was killed by some strange cultists down in Hackdirt. Terrible, terrible times we live in.

text.Generic DarkElf Male: Did you hear that Dar-Ma came back, safe and sound?  You know, Seed-Neeus's daughter, the Argonians.

text.Generic DarkElf Female: Did you hear that Dar-Ma came back, safe and sound?  You know, Seed-Neeus's daughter, the Argonians.

text.Generic DarkElf Male: We're all talking about the emperor's murder. We have no emperor. And no heir. That's never happened before. I suppose we should all be worried.

text.Generic DarkElf Female: We're all talking about the emperor's murder. We have no emperor. And no heir. That's never happened before. I suppose we should all be worried.

text.Generic DarkElf Male: People are subdued. Troubled. A crisis like this tests the people's faith.

text.UravasaOthrelas: People are subdued. Troubled. A crisis like this tests the people's faith.

text.Generic DarkElf Female: I think we're in for some hard times. The death of Uriel Septim and his heirs changes everything.

text.Generic DarkElf Male: The Emperor and his three sons, dead, right under the noses of the Imperial Guard. It's a disgrace.
Have you heard about Kvatch? They say that daedra came from Oblivion and burned the whole city to the ground!

text.Generic DarkElf Female: Everyone's saying there's trouble in Kvatch. The whole town destroyed. Only a few survivors.

text.Generic DarkElf Male: Do you think what happened to Kvatch could happen here?
I heard that the Kvatch Guard is driving back the daedra! Maybe there's hope after all.

text.Generic DarkElf Female: I heard that the Kvatch Guard is driving back the daedra! Maybe there's hope after all.
Everybody's talking about the Hero of Kvatch! They say he actually went into an Oblivion Gate and destroyed it.

text.Generic DarkElf Male: Everybody's talking about the Hero of Kvatch! They say she actually went into an Oblivion Gate and destroyed it.
Hey, you're the one they call the Hero of Kvatch, aren't you? The one that closed the Oblivion Gate and saved the city?

text.Generic DarkElf Female: Hey, you're the one they call the Hero of Kvatch, aren't you? The one that closed the Oblivion Gate and saved the city?

text.Generic DarkElf Male: Good news from Kvatch for a change. The last of the daedra have been driven out.

text.Generic DarkElf Female: Good news from Kvatch for a change. The last of the daedra have been driven out.

text.Generic DarkElf Male: Do you believe any of that talk about more Oblivion Gates opening all over the place?

text.Generic DarkElf Female: I've been hearing disturbing tales about Oblivion Gates opening all across Cyrodiil. I hope it's just wild talk.

text.Generic DarkElf Male: They say that Oblivion Gates have opened outside cities all across Tamriel! Gods preserve us!

text.Generic DarkElf Female: With those Oblivion Gates opening everywhere, it's only a matter of time before another city goes the way of Kvatch.
Did you hear? The lost heir of Uriel Septim rallied the Guard and smashed a horde of daedra outside Bruma!

text.Generic DarkElf Male: They say a lost son of Uriel Septim has reappeared in Bruma. Troops are flocking to his banner from all over Cyrodiil!
I heard that some cult called the Mythic Dawn is behind the Emperor's assassination.

text.Generic DarkElf Female: They're saying some cult murdered the Emperor and are opening the Oblivion Gates. Do you think any of it's true?

text.Generic DarkElf Male: Thank Akatosh the Oblivion Crisis is over! Although with no Emperor and no heir, I wonder what will happen to the Empire?
I plan to visit the Imperial City soon to pay my respects at the Temple of the One. They say the Dragon Statue is 100 feet high!

text.Generic DarkElf Female: I'm sure the Elder Council will find some way to hold the Empire together. At least the Oblivion invasion is over!
I heard that some of the provinces were talking about seceding from the Empire. Probably just talk though. Everything's a bit unsettled now.

text.Generic DarkElf Male: Most people consider Martin's... transformation... a religious or political event, but what interests me is its metaphysical implications.

text.Generic DarkElf Female: Most people consider Martin's... transformation... a religious or political event, but what interests me is its metaphysical implications.

text.Generic DarkElf Male: I wish I had witnessed the avatar of divine Akatosh myself. Imagine! Upon the very altar of the Temple of the One!

text.UravasaOthrelas: I wish I had witnessed the avatar of divine Akatosh myself. Imagine! Upon the very altar of the Temple of the One!

text.AlvalUvani: To think that Bruma was where Martin Septim chose to reveal himself as the true heir to the throne for the first time!

text.Generic DarkElf Male: Don't run into the water to escape a Scalon. They'll follow you.

text.Generic DarkElf Female: Don't run into the water to escape a Scalon. They'll follow you.

text.SERendilDrarara: Have to watch for those Scalons. I hear they carry disease.

text.SETilseAreleth: Have to watch for those Scalons. I hear they carry disease.

text.SERendilDrarara: If you see a Gnarl, be careful what spells you use on them.

text.SETilseAreleth: If you see a Gnarl, be careful what spells you use on them.

text.Generic DarkElf Male: The Gnarl are strange creatures. Hit them with a fireball, and they get stronger, but they hate other elements even more.

text.Generic DarkElf Female: The Gnarl are strange creatures. Hit them with a fireball, and they get stronger, but they hate other elements even more.

text.SERendilDrarara: Those Shambles are dangerous. Make sure to stand back if you kill one.

text.SETilseAreleth: Those Shambles are dangerous. Make sure to stand back if you kill one.

text.Generic DarkElf Male: If you see a Shambles dying, stand back. They'll take you with them.

text.Generic DarkElf Female: If you see a Shambles dying, stand back. They'll take you with them.

text.SERendilDrarara: Flesh Atronachs are dangerous. Some are smart enough to heal themselves when they're hurt.

text.SETilseAreleth: Flesh Atronachs are dangerous. Some are smart enough to heal themselves when they're hurt.

text.Generic DarkElf Male: If you have to fight a Flesh Atronach, a good shock spell is the way to go.

text.Generic DarkElf Female: If you have to fight a Flesh Atronach, a good shock spell is the way to go.

text.SERendilDrarara: The poison of the Elytra can be debilitating.

text.SETilseAreleth: The poison of the Elytra can be debilitating.

text.Generic DarkElf Male: Watch for the Elytra's stingers; their poison can be deadly. They don't like magic much, though.

text.Generic DarkElf Female: Watch for the Elytra's stingers; their poison can be deadly. They don't like magic much, though.

text.SERendilDrarara: The Hunger is one of Lord Sheogorath's favorite pets.

text.SETilseAreleth: The Hunger is one of Lord Sheogorath's favorite pets.

text.Generic DarkElf Male: Like most lesser Daedra, the Hunger has a weakness to shock spells.

text.Generic DarkElf Female: Like most lesser Daedra, the Hunger has a weakness to shock spells.

text.SERendilDrarara: Some say the Grummites are the original inhabitants of the Shivering Isles.

text.SETilseAreleth: Some say the Grummites are the original inhabitants of the Shivering Isles.

text.Generic DarkElf Male: Try not to fight a Grummite in the water. Or in the rain. They seem to like that.

text.Generic DarkElf Female: Try not to fight a Grummite in the water. Or in the rain. They seem to like that.

text.SERendilDrarara: The Baliwog is a dangerous little creature. Some say they grow up to be Scalons.

text.SETilseAreleth: The Baliwog is a dangerous little creature. Some say they grow up to be Scalons.

text.Generic DarkElf Male: The Baliwog will return to the water to heal.

text.Generic DarkElf Female: The Baliwog will return to the water to heal.

text.SERendilDrarara: I've heard that Skinned Hounds don't like fire.

text.SETilseAreleth: I've heard that Skinned Hounds don't like fire.

text.Generic DarkElf Male: Best way to kill a Skinned Hound is with a fireball, or a good weapon.

text.Generic DarkElf Female: Best way to kill a Skinned Hound is with a fireball, or a good weapon.

text.SERendilDrarara: Heretics are misguided worshippers of Arden-Sul.

text.SETilseAreleth: Heretics are misguided worshippers of Arden-Sul.

text.Generic DarkElf Male: If you want to get close to the Heretics, try putting on their robes.

text.Generic DarkElf Female: If you want to get close to the Heretics, try putting on their robes.

text.SERendilDrarara: The Zealots in the lands of Dementia believe they worship Arden-Sul. Poor, deluded souls.

text.SETilseAreleth: The Zealots in the lands of Dementia believe they worship Arden-Sul. Poor, deluded souls.

text.Generic DarkElf Male: If you want to sneak up on one of those Zealots, wear one of their robes. Fools them every time.

text.Generic DarkElf Female: If you want to sneak up on one of those Zealots, wear one of their robes. Fools them every time.

text.SERendilDrarara: I understand there's been strange activity near the obelisks around the Isles.

text.SETilseAreleth: I understand there's been strange activity near the obelisks around the Isles.

text.Generic DarkElf Male: The crystal obelisks that dot the Isles have recently started behaving strangely.

text.Generic DarkElf Female: The crystal obelisks that dot the Isles have recently started behaving strangely.

text.SERendilDrarara: Knights of Order have appeared in the Isles. I hear they come from the obelisks.

text.SETilseAreleth: Knights of Order have appeared in the Isles. I hear they come from the obelisks.

text.Generic DarkElf Male: I understand that the Hearts of Order you find on the Knights can be used to unlock special chests.

text.Generic DarkElf Female: I understand that the Hearts of Order you find on the Knights can be used to unlock special chests.

text.SERendilDrarara: Raven-Biter runs the Choosy Beggar. Not a bad place.

text.SETilseAreleth: Raven-Biter runs the Choosy Beggar. Not a bad place.

text.SERendilDrarara: Tilse Areleth has quite a collection of things for sale at Common Treasures.
The best armor in the city is at The Missing Pauldron.

text.SETilseAreleth: The best armor in the city is at The Missing Pauldron.

text.SERendilDrarara: Books of Bliss has quite a selection.

text.SETilseAreleth: Books of Bliss has quite a selection.

text.SERendilDrarara: Cutter sells weapons in Crucible, but you won't catch me going there.

text.SETilseAreleth: Cutter sells weapons in Crucible, but you won't catch me going there.

text.SERendilDrarara: That Museum of Oddities is a joke, although I hear Una Armina will pay for certain items.

text.SETilseAreleth: That Museum of Oddities is a joke, although I hear Una Armina will pay for certain items.

text.SERendilDrarara: I'd research my own spells before I'd buy them from Earil's Mysteries.

text.SETilseAreleth: I'd research my own spells before I'd buy them from Earil's Mysteries.

text.SERendilDrarara: Things Found? More like Things Found in the Trash.

text.SETilseAreleth: Things Found? More like Things Found in the Trash.

text.SERendilDrarara: I wouldn't be caught dead at Sickly Bernice's... though I imagine her customers might.

text.SETilseAreleth: I wouldn't be caught dead at Sickly Bernice's... though I imagine her customers might.

text.SERendilDrarara: Dumag gro-Bonk at The Missing Pauldron is collecting that Amber you find in the root tunnels.

text.SETilseAreleth: Dumag gro-Bonk at The Missing Pauldron is collecting that Amber you find in the root tunnels.

text.Generic DarkElf Male: There are smiths in New Sheoth that collect Amber and Madness Ore.

text.Generic DarkElf Female: There are smiths in New Sheoth that collect Amber and Madness Ore.

text.SERendilDrarara: I've heard ghosts haunt the ruined city of Vitharn.

text.SETilseAreleth: I've heard ghosts haunt the ruined city of Vitharn.

text.Generic DarkElf Male: Take care venturing into the ruined city of Vitharn.

text.Generic DarkElf Female: Take care venturing into the ruined city of Vitharn.

text.SERendilDrarara: I understand there's a Knight of the Thorn in Hale.

text.SETilseAreleth: I understand there's a Knight of the Thorn in Hale.

text.Generic DarkElf Male: If you visit Hale, you may see Pyke, a Knight of the Thorn.

text.Generic DarkElf Female: If you visit Hale, you may see Pyke, a Knight of the Thorn.

text.SERendilDrarara: The merchants in Crucible are getting tired of Brithaur stealing from them.

text.SETilseAreleth: The merchants in Crucible are getting tired of Brithaur stealing from them.

text.Generic DarkElf Male: I understand the merchants of Crucible are having problems with Brithaur.

text.Generic DarkElf Female: I understand the merchants of Crucible are having problems with Brithaur.

text.SERendilDrarara: I understand Hirrus Clutumnus is begging for people to kill him.

text.SETilseAreleth: I understand Hirrus Clutumnus is begging for people to kill him.

text.Generic DarkElf Male: In Crucible, a man named Hirrus Clutumnus has been trying to convince people to kill him.

text.Generic DarkElf Female: In Crucible, a man named Hirrus Clutumnus has been trying to convince people to kill him.

text.SERendilDrarara: I've heard there's someone in Highcross trying to catalogue every living thing in the Isles.

text.SETilseAreleth: I've heard there's someone in Highcross trying to catalogue every living thing in the Isles.

text.Generic DarkElf Male: If you visit Highcross, speak with Mirili Ulven. She needs help with her project.

text.SERelmynaVerenim: If you visit Highcross, speak with Mirili Ulven. She needs help with her project.

text.SERendilDrarara: I don't visit the Museum of Oddities, but Una Armina is always looking for new items to display.

text.SETilseAreleth: I don't visit the Museum of Oddities, but Una Armina is always looking for new items to display.

text.SERendilDrarara: Cindanwe runs a tight ship in Fellmoor.

text.SETilseAreleth: Cindanwe runs a tight ship in Fellmoor.

text.Generic DarkElf Male: Fellmoor must be a terrible place to live.

text.Generic DarkElf Female: Fellmoor must be a terrible place to live.

text.SERendilDrarara: Amiable Fanriene thinks his house is going to fall in on him.

text.SETilseAreleth: Amiable Fanriene thinks his house is going to fall in on him.

text.Generic DarkElf Male: There's a man in Bliss who believes his own house will collapse around him.

text.Generic DarkElf Female: There's a man in Bliss who believes his own house will collapse around him.

text.SERendilDrarara: Sickly Bernice is convinced she's dying. No wonder no one wants to eat at her Taphouse.

text.SETilseAreleth: Sickly Bernice is convinced she's dying. No wonder no one wants to eat at her Taphouse.

text.Generic DarkElf Male: Sickly Bernice in Crucible believes she is dying.

text.Generic DarkElf Female: Sickly Bernice in Crucible believes she is dying.

text.SERendilDrarara: I heard Tove the Unrestful is building something again.

text.SETilseAreleth: I heard Tove the Unrestful is building something again.

text.Generic DarkElf Male: Tove the Unrestful in Bliss is collecting items to build something.

text.Generic DarkElf Female: Tove the Unrestful in Bliss is collecting items to build something.

text.SERendilDrarara: Ushnar in Crucible is afraid of cats. Cats!

text.SETilseAreleth: Ushnar in Crucible is afraid of cats. Cats!

text.Generic DarkElf Male: There's an orc in Crucible who is deathly afraid of cats.

text.Generic DarkElf Female: There's an orc in Crucible who is deathly afraid of cats.

text.SERendilDrarara: Ahjazda in Crucible believes the world is ending.

text.SETilseAreleth: Ahjazda in Crucible believes the world is ending.

text.Generic DarkElf Male: There is a Khajiit in Crucible who believes the world is about to end.

text.Generic DarkElf Female: There is a Khajiit in Crucible who believes the world is about to end.

text.SERendilDrarara: Poor Big Head will never find the Fork of Horripilation.

text.SETilseAreleth: Poor Big Head will never find the Fork of Horripilation.

text.Generic DarkElf Male: The Argonian Big Head is always searching for the Fork of Horripilation.

text.Generic DarkElf Female: The Argonian Big Head is always searching for the Fork of Horripilation.

text.SERendilDrarara: Every resident of Split has a double living in the town.

text.SETilseAreleth: Every resident of Split has a double living in the town.

text.Generic DarkElf Male: There are two of everything in Split. Even the residents.

text.Generic DarkElf Female: There are two of everything in Split. Even the residents.

text.Generic DarkElf Male: Those wanted posters of the Gray Fox are everywhere.

text.Generic DarkElf Female: Those wanted posters of the Gray Fox are everywhere.

text.Generic DarkElf Male: Did you hear that someone broke into an Imperial Legion post and stole the taxes they collected from the Waterfront?

text.Generic DarkElf Female: Did you hear that someone broke into an Imperial Legion post and stole the taxes they collected from the Waterfront?

text.Generic DarkElf Male: Captain Lex blames the Gray Fox for stealing the tax collection. He wants a bounty put on the Gray Fox, but the Legion Commander has refused.

text.Generic DarkElf Female: Captain Lex blames the Gray Fox for stealing the tax collection. He wants a bounty put on the Gray Fox, but the Legion Commander has refused.

text.Generic DarkElf Male: Have you heard? Someone desecrated the tomb of Llathasa. No wonder her ghost haunts that place.

text.Generic DarkElf Female: Have you heard? Someone desecrated the tomb of Llathasa. No wonder her ghost haunts that place.

text.Generic DarkElf Male: One of the castle staff was murdered trying to stop a thief.

text.Generic DarkElf Female: One of the castle staff was murdered trying to stop a thief.

text.Generic DarkElf Male: I heard that thieves broke into the Arcane University, the Imperial Legion Compound, and the Temple, all on the same night!

text.Generic DarkElf Female: I heard that thieves broke into the Arcane University, the Imperial Legion Compound, and the Temple, all on the same night!

text.Generic DarkElf Male: Someone told me that Hieronymus Lex is gone. Reassigned to Anvil. That can't be true!

text.Generic DarkElf Female: Someone told me that Hieronymus Lex is gone. Reassigned to Anvil. That can't be true!

text.Generic DarkElf Male: Is there a new Captain of the guard? I thought I saw him walking the rounds.

text.Generic DarkElf Female: Is there a new Captain of the guard? I thought I saw him walking the rounds.

text.Generic DarkElf Male: I heard that someone broke into the wizard's tower. What kind of a fool would take on Fathis Aren?

text.Generic DarkElf Female: I heard that someone broke into the wizard's tower. What kind of a fool would take on Fathis Aren?

text.Generic DarkElf Male: The Earl of Imbel was attacked and killed in his own home. I heard the body burned in the sunlight.

text.Generic DarkElf Female: The Earl of Imbel was attacked and killed in his own home. I heard the body burned in the sunlight.

text.Generic DarkElf Male: They say a thief actually stole one of the Elder Scrolls from the Imperial Library. Who would have thought it was even possible?

text.Generic DarkElf Female: They say a thief actually stole one of the Elder Scrolls from the Imperial Library. Who would have thought it was even possible?

text.Generic DarkElf Male: I saw Ugak gra-Mogakh earlier. At least, I think it was her. Perhaps it was her sister.

text.Generic DarkElf Female: I saw Ugak gra-Mogakh earlier. At least, I think it was her. Perhaps it was her sister.

text.Generic DarkElf Male: Mog gra-Mogakh runs a fine establishment at the Two Sisters Lodge. And her sister has some quality horses.

text.Generic DarkElf Female: Mog gra-Mogakh runs a fine establishment at the Two Sisters Lodge. And her sister has some quality horses.

text.Generic DarkElf Male: Maybe it's just me, but I find Falanu Hlaalu really odd. And I've seen him hanging around the graveyard with a strange smile on his face.

text.UndenaOrethi: Maybe it's just me, but I find Falanu Hlaalu really odd. And I've seen him hanging around the graveyard with a strange smile on his face.

text.Generic DarkElf Male: I don't know if Tumindil ever leaves the chapel. That man works day and night to take care of all of us.

text.Generic DarkElf Female: I don't know if Tumindil ever leaves the chapel. That man works day and night to take care of all of us.

text.Generic DarkElf Male: I suppose Count Hassildor keeps Skingrad running smoothly, but you hardly ever see the man.

text.Generic DarkElf Female: I suppose Count Hassildor keeps Skingrad running smoothly, but you hardly ever see the man.

text.Generic DarkElf Male: I hope nobody tries to get away with anything when Captain Dion is around. He's a tough customer.

text.Generic DarkElf Female: I hope nobody tries to get away with anything when Captain Dion is around. He's a tough customer.

text.Generic DarkElf Male: I heard Ah-Mahlz was out hunting goblins again. Good. They're vermin.

text.Generic DarkElf Female: I heard Ah-Mahlz was out hunting goblins again. Good. They're vermin.

text.Generic DarkElf Male: Parwen has really got a thing for goblins. I think she and Ah-Malz keep a running tally of who has killed more.

text.Generic DarkElf Female: Parwen has really got a thing for goblins. I think she and Ah-Malz keep a running tally of who has killed more.

text.Generic DarkElf Male: If you don't know much about Mysticism, Druja is a good person to talk to. She's at the Mages Guild.

text.Generic DarkElf Female: If you don't know much about Mysticism, Druja is a good person to talk to. She's at the Mages Guild.

text.Generic DarkElf Male: I smelled a strange odor coming from the Mages Guild yesterday. Erthor must have been doing another experiment.

text.Generic DarkElf Female: I smelled a strange odor coming from the Mages Guild yesterday. Erthor must have been doing another experiment.

text.Generic DarkElf Male: I love walking by Salmo's place. The smell of her bread baking is amazing.

text.Generic DarkElf Female: I love walking by Salmo's place. The smell of her bread baking is amazing.

text.Generic DarkElf Male: You know, if you need to get better at archery, you should talk to Reman Broder. He's quite a good shot.

text.Generic DarkElf Female: You know, if you need to get better at archery, you should talk to Reman Broder. He's quite a good shot.

text.Generic DarkElf Male: Bernadette Peneles works over at the Tamika Winery. They make a quality wine there.

text.Generic DarkElf Female: Bernadette Peneles works over at the Tamika Winery. They make a quality wine there.

text.Generic DarkElf Male: I bought some wine from Davide Surilie. Excellent body. He's a fine vintner.

text.Generic DarkElf Female: I bought some wine from Davide Surilie. Excellent body. He's a fine vintner.

text.Generic DarkElf Male: Tamika makes some truly fine wines at her winery. I think they're every bit as good as the Surilie Brothers wines.

text.Generic DarkElf Female: Tamika makes some truly fine wines at her winery. I think they're every bit as good as the Surilie Brothers wines.

text.Generic DarkElf Male: I don't know that anyone in Cyrodiil drives a harder bargain than Palonirya at Divine Elegance.

text.Generic DarkElf Female: I don't know that anyone in Cyrodiil drives a harder bargain than Palonirya at Divine Elegance.

text.Generic DarkElf Male: The King and Queen Tavern isn't a bad place to stay if you're visiting the city.

text.Generic DarkElf Female: The King and Queen Tavern isn't a bad place to stay if you're visiting the city.

text.Generic DarkElf Male: I understand old Dovyn Aren can still teach a bit about Alteration.

text.Generic DarkElf Female: I understand old Dovyn Aren can still teach a bit about Alteration.

text.Generic DarkElf Male: Othrelos is a sneaky one. Kind of makes you wonder what he's up to.

text.Generic DarkElf Female: Othrelos is a sneaky one. Kind of makes you wonder what he's up to.

text.Generic DarkElf Male: Samuel Bantien used to be a wild one. They say he used to be quite the "locksmith."

text.Generic DarkElf Female: Samuel Bantien used to be a wild one. They say he used to be quite the "locksmith."

text.Generic DarkElf Male: A lot of mages swear by Rindir's Staffs.

text.Generic DarkElf Female: A lot of mages swear by Rindir's Staffs.

text.Generic DarkElf Male: If you need to get rid of something quickly, check out the Copious Coinpurse.

text.Generic DarkElf Female: If you need to get rid of something quickly, check out the Copious Coinpurse.

text.Generic DarkElf Male: I needed some cash, so I went to see Jensine.

text.Generic DarkElf Female: I needed some cash, so I went to see Jensine.

text.Generic DarkElf Male: Calindil runs a nice place at the Mystic Emporium.

text.Generic DarkElf Female: Calindil runs a nice place at the Mystic Emporium.

text.Generic DarkElf Male: If you need light armor, talk to Maro Rufus at The Best Defense.

text.Generic DarkElf Female: If you need light armor, talk to Maro Rufus at The Best Defense.

text.Generic DarkElf Male: Vinivia Melissaeia takes all the merchant complaints in the city.

text.Generic DarkElf Female: Vinivia Melissaeia takes all the merchant complaints in the city.

text.Generic DarkElf Male: There are some quality books at Mach-Na's. Just don't catch him when he's in a bad mood.

text.Generic DarkElf Female: There are some quality books at Mach-Na's. Just don't catch him when he's in a bad mood.

text.Generic DarkElf Male: Gruiand Garrana can talk her way out of anything. Of course, all she usually talks about is herself.

text.Generic DarkElf Female: Gruiand Garrana can talk her way out of anything. Of course, all she usually talks about is herself.

text.Generic DarkElf Male: Naspia Cosma is really skilled with her blade. It's a shame she doesn't compete in the Arena.

text.Generic DarkElf Female: Naspia Cosma is really skilled with her blade. It's a shame she doesn't compete in the Arena.

text.Generic DarkElf Male: Ganredhel sure does have a knack for training dogs. I've heard that she will train people as well, for a price.

text.Generic DarkElf Female: Ganredhel sure does have a knack for training dogs. I've heard that she will train people as well, for a price.

text.AlvalUvani: Jerall View is a nice place for visitors to stay. Hafid makes everyone feel welcome.
Poor Olfand. I don't know how he manages to live with Skjorta.
I've heard Right-Wind is good with a blade. No wonder he's in the Fighters Guild.
Don't get on J'skar's bad side. You'll likely get a fireball in your face for your troubles.
Rumor has it that Edla Dark-Heart left Skyrim with the law right behind her.

text.Generic DarkElf Male: I don't think that Gilgondrin really wants to run Silverhome-on-the-Water. He never seems happy when he's there.

text.Generic DarkElf Female: I don't think that Gilgondrin really wants to run Silverhome-on-the-Water. He never seems happy when he's there.

text.Generic DarkElf Male: I'm glad Marz lives here in Bravil. She's an excellent healer.

text.Generic DarkElf Female: I'm glad Marz lives here in Bravil. She's an excellent healer.

text.Generic DarkElf Male: I understand Tadrose Helas has more jobs than she knows what to do with. She's very eager to help out her guild.

text.UravasaOthrelas: I understand Tadrose Helas has more jobs than she knows what to do with. She's very eager to help out her guild.

text.Generic DarkElf Male: Seems to me that Ardaline has an admirer in Varon Vamori.

text.Generic DarkElf Female: Seems to me that Ardaline has an admirer in Varon Vamori.

text.Generic DarkElf Male: Varon Vamori really has a silver tongue.

text.Generic DarkElf Female: Varon Vamori really has a silver tongue.

text.Generic DarkElf Male: She doesn't leave home much, but apparently Luciana Galena has a lot of experience fighting in light armor.

text.Generic DarkElf Female: She doesn't leave home much, but apparently Luciana Galena has a lot of experience fighting in light armor.

text.Generic DarkElf Male: The Three Sisters Inn is a nice place, but that Shuravi sure is grumpy. I don't think she likes anyone.

text.Generic DarkElf Female: The Three Sisters Inn is a nice place, but that Shuravi sure is grumpy. I don't think she likes anyone.

text.Generic DarkElf Male: The Dividing Line is a good place to buy a sharp blade. Of course, you're likely to hear some of Tun-Zeeus' stories if you hang around.

text.Generic DarkElf Female: The Dividing Line is a good place to buy a sharp blade. Of course, you're likely to hear some of Tun-Zeeus' stories if you hang around.

text.Generic DarkElf Male: I've heard that Dagail knows a lot about Mysticism. And sheep.

text.Generic DarkElf Female: I've heard that Dagail knows a lot about Mysticism. And sheep.

text.Generic DarkElf Male: Have you spoken to Wilbur at the Count's Arms? He knows a lot about fine wines.

text.Generic DarkElf Female: Have you spoken to Wilbur at the Count's Arms? He knows a lot about fine wines.

text.Generic DarkElf Male: I've heard Azzan can sign you up for the Fighters Guild. That's someone I wouldn't mind working for.

text.ArvenaThelas: I've heard Azzan can sign you up for the Fighters Guild. That's someone I wouldn't mind working for.

text.Generic DarkElf Male: I understand that Vigdis at the Fighters Guild has some skill with blunt weapons. He's been training other Fighters Guild members.

text.ArvenaThelas: I understand that Vigdis at the Fighters Guild has some skill with blunt weapons. He's been training other Fighters Guild members.

text.Generic DarkElf Male: I understand Carahil knows more about Illusion than any other mage in Anvil. Of course, she only shares that knowledge with the Mages Guild.

text.Generic DarkElf Female: I understand Carahil knows more about Illusion than any other mage in Anvil. Of course, she only shares that knowledge with the Mages Guild.

text.Generic DarkElf Male: Mirabelle Monet is quite a woman. Ask any of the sailors down at the Fo'c's'le.

text.Generic DarkElf Female: Mirabelle Monet is quite a woman. Ask any of the sailors down at the Fo'c's'le.

text.Generic DarkElf Male: The shipmaster, Heinrich Oaken-Hull, has a wood elf for a wife. I'd rather sleep with my horse.

text.Generic DarkElf Female: The shipmaster, Heinrich Oaken-Hull, has a wood elf for a wife. I'd rather sleep with my horse.

text.Generic DarkElf Male: I've never read any of Quill-Weave's writings. I've heard they're fairly good, though.

text.Generic DarkElf Female: I've never read any of Quill-Weave's writings. I've heard they're fairly good, though.

text.ModrynOreyn: It's good to be a Fighters Guild member, don't you think?

text.Generic DarkElf Male: I found some good pauldrons at the armorer.

text.Generic DarkElf Female: I found some good pauldrons at the armorer.

text.Generic DarkElf Male: The Grey Mare isn't a bad place to stay, especially if you're low on Septims.

text.Generic DarkElf Female: The Grey Mare isn't a bad place to stay, especially if you're low on Septims.

text.Generic DarkElf Male: Been to Fire and Steel recently? Rasheda has some nice new swords in there. And she's a friendly one, she is.

text.Generic DarkElf Female: Been to Fire and Steel recently? Rasheda has some nice new swords in there. And she's a friendly one, she is.

text.Generic DarkElf Male: I'd like to learn more about spellcasting. Might have to head over to the Mages Guild and see if they're accepting new members.

text.Generic DarkElf Female: I'd like to learn more about spellcasting. Might have to head over to the Mages Guild and see if they're accepting new members.

text.Generic DarkElf Male: I'm not so sure about that Eugal Belette. An odd fellow, and people have said there are strange noises coming from his house at all hours.

text.Generic DarkElf Female: I'm not so sure about that Eugal Belette. An odd fellow, and people have said there are strange noises coming from his house at all hours.

text.Generic DarkElf Male: I can't believe that Glistel would live with that Malintus Ancrus. Shameful, and her being such a lovely girl.

text.Nardhil: I can't believe that Glistel would live with that Malintus Ancrus. Shameful, and her being such a lovely girl.

text.Generic DarkElf Male: Sometimes I just go look at the Great Oak. Magnificent, don't you think?

text.Generic DarkElf Female: Sometimes I just go look at the Great Oak. Magnificent, don't you think?

text.Generic DarkElf Male: I lived in the Imperial City for a while, but city life just isn't for me. I'm much happier in Chorrol.

text.Generic DarkElf Female: I lived in the Imperial City for a while, but city life just isn't for me. I'm much happier in Chorrol.

text.Generic DarkElf Male: Don't get too many folks passing through here these days.

text.Generic DarkElf Female: Don't get too many folks passing through here these days.

text.Generic DarkElf Male: Ancient Wayshrines of the Nine are scattered through the wilderness. The righteous who pray there receive powerful divine blessings.

text.Generic DarkElf Female: Ancient Wayshrines of the Nine are scattered through the wilderness. The righteous who pray there receive powerful divine blessings.

text.Generic DarkElf Male: If you've done good deeds, the Nine will bless you and cure diseases when you visit their wayshrines.

text.Generic DarkElf Female: If you've done good deeds, the Nine will bless you and cure diseases when you visit their wayshrines.

text.Generic DarkElf Male: Wayshrines of the Nine in the wilderness confer blessings on the righteous and faithful.

text.Generic DarkElf Female: Wayshrines of the Nine in the wilderness confer blessings on the righteous and faithful.

text.Generic DarkElf Male: Those famous for good deeds may receive Blessings of Intelligence and Magicka when they visit Wayshrines of Julianos.

text.Generic DarkElf Female: Those famous for good deeds may receive Blessings of Intelligence and Magicka when they visit Wayshrines of Julianos.

text.Generic DarkElf Male: Virtuous visitors to Wayshrines of Kynareth may receive Blessings of Agility.

text.Generic DarkElf Female: Virtuous visitors to Wayshrines of Kynareth may receive Blessings of Agility.

text.Generic DarkElf Male: When you visit a Wayshrine of Zenithar, and you've lived a good life by the Nine, you may receive a Blessing of Luck.

text.Generic DarkElf Female: When you visit a Wayshrine of Zenithar, and you've lived a good life by the Nine, you may receive a Blessing of Luck.

text.Generic DarkElf Male: Those who live by the Commands of the Nine receive Blessings of Strength when they visit Wayshrines of Tiber Septim.

text.Generic DarkElf Female: Those who live by the Commands of the Nine receive Blessings of Strength when they visit Wayshrines of Tiber Septim.

text.Generic DarkElf Male: A good man who honors the Nine may visit the Wayshrines of Akatosh for Blessings of Speed and Magicka.

text.Generic DarkElf Female: A good man who honors the Nine may visit the Wayshrines of Akatosh for Blessings of Speed and Magicka.

text.Generic DarkElf Male: If you've been good, Wayshrines of Dibella may bless your Personality.

text.Generic DarkElf Female: If you've been good, Wayshrines of Dibella may bless your Personality.

text.Generic DarkElf Male: Wayshrines of Arkay confer Blessings of Health on those who've pleased the Nine by righteous acts.

text.Generic DarkElf Female: Wayshrines of Arkay confer Blessings of Health on those who've pleased the Nine by righteous acts.

text.Generic DarkElf Male: Please the Nine with good works, and visit Wayshrines of Stendarr for Blessings of Endurance.

text.Generic DarkElf Female: Please the Nine with good works, and visit Wayshrines of Stendarr for Blessings of Endurance.

text.Generic DarkElf Male: You've seen wayshrines in the wilderness? Those who've pleased the Nine may receive Blessings of Willpower at the Wayshrines of Mara.

text.Generic DarkElf Female: You've seen wayshrines in the wilderness? Those who've pleased the Nine may receive Blessings of Willpower at the Wayshrines of Mara.

text.Generic DarkElf Male: The Heartlands and Nibenean Valley are the agricultural breadbaskets of Cyrodiil.

text.Generic DarkElf Female: The Heartlands and Nibenean Valley are the agricultural breadbaskets of Cyrodiil.

text.Generic DarkElf Male: Where does our food come from? The Heartlands. And the Nibenean Valley. And Skingrad? Great wines, cheeses, and tomatoes.

text.Generic DarkElf Female: Where does our food come from? The Heartlands. And the Nibenean Valley. And Skingrad? Great wines, cheeses, and tomatoes.

text.Generic DarkElf Male: The lowlands of the Great Forest rise to the upland plateau of the Colovian West.

text.Generic DarkElf Female: The lowlands of the Great Forest rise to the upland plateau of the Colovian West.

text.Generic DarkElf Male: The Great Forest was cleared for agriculture around Lake Rumare, but it's mostly wilderness outside of that.

text.Generic DarkElf Female: The Great Forest was cleared for agriculture around Lake Rumare, but it's mostly wilderness outside of that.

text.Generic DarkElf Male: The Colovian Highlands are barren wastelands along the border with Hammerfell.

text.Generic DarkElf Female: The Colovian Highlands are barren wastelands along the border with Hammerfell.

text.Generic DarkElf Male: The Colovian Highlands? Near the Hammerfell border? No one lives there. That's barren wastelands.

text.Generic DarkElf Female: The Colovian Highlands? Near the Hammerfell border? No one lives there. That's barren wastelands.

text.Generic DarkElf Male: High mountain ranges rise to the borders in the north and east, and marshes and rainforests extend to the southeast borders.

text.Generic DarkElf Female: High mountain ranges rise to the borders in the north and east, and marshes and rainforests extend to the southeast borders.

text.Generic DarkElf Male: It's our natural barriers that keep us safe, mostly. Mountain borders north and east, open sea to the west, and bogs and rainforest to south.

text.Generic DarkElf Female: It's our natural barriers that keep us safe, mostly. Mountain borders north and east, open sea to the west, and bogs and rainforest to south.

text.Generic DarkElf Male: Cyrodiil is surrounded to the north and east by the lofty Jerall and Valus mountain ranges.

text.Generic DarkElf Female: Cyrodiil is surrounded to the north and east by the lofty Jerall and Valus mountain ranges.

text.Generic DarkElf Male: No one wants to live in the Jerall Mountains. Well, maybe in Bruma, but they're like Nords. They don't feel the cold.

text.Generic DarkElf Female: No one wants to live in the Jerall Mountains. Well, maybe in Bruma, but they're like Nords. They don't feel the cold.

text.Generic DarkElf Male: Western Cyrodiil is called 'Colovia,' and includes the Gold Coast, West Weald, and Colovian Highlands regions.

text.Generic DarkElf Female: Western Cyrodiil is called 'Colovia,' and includes the Gold Coast, West Weald, and Colovian Highlands regions.

text.Generic DarkElf Male: In the west, in Old Colovia, that's where men are men. That's the Gold Coast, West Weald, and Colovian Highlands.

text.Generic DarkElf Female: In the west, in Old Colovia, that's where men are men. That's the Gold Coast, West Weald, and Colovian Highlands.

text.Generic DarkElf Male: Nibenay is a region of mixed farmland, parkland, and forest.

text.Generic DarkElf Female: Nibenay is a region of mixed farmland, parkland, and forest.

text.Generic DarkElf Male: With all the farms in Nibenay, there's still plenty of forest and wilderness open for settlement.

text.Generic DarkElf Female: With all the farms in Nibenay, there's still plenty of forest and wilderness open for settlement.

text.Generic DarkElf Male: Nibenay is bordered on north and east by rugged mountains and to the south by marshes and rainforest.

text.Generic DarkElf Female: Nibenay is bordered on north and east by rugged mountains and to the south by marshes and rainforest.

text.Generic DarkElf Male: The people of Nibenay consider themselves to be more civilized and sophisticated than Colovians.

text.Generic DarkElf Female: The people of Nibenay consider themselves to be more civilized and sophisticated than Colovians.

text.Generic DarkElf Male: I'm not saying Colovians are dumb. They're just hard-headed.

text.Generic DarkElf Female: I'm not saying Colovians are dumb. They're just hard-headed.

text.Generic DarkElf Male: The Nibeneans think they're slick. 'Slippery' is more like it.

text.Generic DarkElf Female: The Nibeneans think they're slick. 'Slippery' is more like it.

text.Generic DarkElf Male: Colovia is a land of rugged wastes and highland forests.

text.Generic DarkElf Female: Colovia is a land of rugged wastes and highland forests.

text.Generic DarkElf Male: Colovia is dotted with isolated farms and settlements, with most of the population in the coastal margin.

text.Generic DarkElf Female: Colovia is dotted with isolated farms and settlements, with most of the population in the coastal margin.

text.Generic DarkElf Male: The Colovians are proud of their reputation for being independent, rough, and rebellious.

text.Generic DarkElf Female: The Colovians are proud of their reputation for being independent, rough, and rebellious.

text.Generic DarkElf Male: The Imperial City is located on a large island surrounded by Lake Rumare.

text.Generic DarkElf Female: The Imperial City is located on a large island surrounded by Lake Rumare.

text.Generic DarkElf Male: The Imperial City is densely urbanized, with a few large parks and waterside dock areas.

text.Generic DarkElf Female: The Imperial City is densely urbanized, with a few large parks and waterside dock areas.

text.Generic DarkElf Male: The Imperial City itself is a walled city, with separate inner walls protecting the Imperial palace.

text.Generic DarkElf Female: The Imperial City itself is a walled city, with separate inner walls protecting the Imperial palace.

text.Generic DarkElf Male: The prettiest town in Cyrodiil? Don't know, but the ugliest is Bravil. Shabby, tumbledown shacks. They're big shacks, though.

text.Generic DarkElf Female: The prettiest town in Cyrodiil? Don't know, but the ugliest is Bravil. Shabby, tumbledown shacks. They're big shacks, though.

text.Generic DarkElf Male: Where to buy weapons? Where to buy anything, if you can afford to travel, is the Market District in the Imperial City.

text.Generic DarkElf Female: Where to buy weapons? Where to buy anything, if you can afford to travel, is the Market District in the Imperial City.

text.Generic DarkElf Male: My favorite town? Anvil. Lovely old stone buildings, and the harbor at sunset is beautiful.

text.Generic DarkElf Female: My favorite town? Anvil. Lovely old stone buildings, and the harbor at sunset is beautiful.

text.Generic DarkElf Male: Ayleid ruins? The big thing is to watch out for the traps. Thousands of years old, and still working. Amazing.

text.Generic DarkElf Female: Ayleid ruins? The big thing is to watch out for the traps. Thousands of years old, and still working. Amazing.

text.Generic DarkElf Male: I've seen plenty of Ayleid ruins. You'd think they'd be picked clean after 2000 years, but, no, there's still great treasures there.

text.Generic DarkElf Female: I've seen plenty of Ayleid ruins. You'd think they'd be picked clean after 2000 years, but, no, there's still great treasures there.

text.Generic DarkElf Male: It's still pretty wild east of the Niben. Few people, except for bandits, but at least it hasn't been picked clean by treasure-hunters.

text.Generic DarkElf Female: It's still pretty wild east of the Niben. Few people, except for bandits, but at least it hasn't been picked clean by treasure-hunters.

text.Generic DarkElf Male: Nobody goes into the mountains but hunters and thieves on the lam. Food and shelter is hard to come by.

text.Generic DarkElf Female: Nobody goes into the mountains but hunters and thieves on the lam. Food and shelter is hard to come by.

text.Generic DarkElf Male: Blackwood isn't so bad, once you get used to the flies. And being lost all the time. And the zombies and will-o-the-wisps.

text.Generic DarkElf Female: Blackwood isn't so bad, once you get used to the flies. And being lost all the time. And the zombies and will-o-the-wisps.

text.Generic DarkElf Male: There's islands in Niben Bay no one has visited in a hundred years. No telling what you'll find.

text.Generic DarkElf Female: There's islands in Niben Bay no one has visited in a hundred years. No telling what you'll find.

text.Generic DarkElf Male: Well, it's no problem traveling from the Imperial City to Leyawiin... if you're a wizard and can walk on water. I'd stay off the roads, though.

text.Generic DarkElf Female: Well, it's no problem traveling from the Imperial City to Leyawiin... if you're a wizard and can walk on water. I'd stay off the roads, though.

text.Generic DarkElf Male: If you're all alone in the woods and you see a troll coming, you run. Problem solved. Next question?

text.Generic DarkElf Female: If you're all alone in the woods and you see a troll coming, you run. Problem solved. Next question?

text.Generic DarkElf Male: Fighting's easy. Just lead them out on the water and shoot them full of holes. If you've got a bow, of course, and can walk on water.

text.Generic DarkElf Female: Fighting's easy. Just lead them out on the water and shoot them full of holes. If you've got a bow, of course, and can walk on water.

text.Generic DarkElf Male: The Arena's faked. You think those guys are getting killed? Really? It's just berry syrup and ham-acting.

text.Generic DarkElf Female: The Arena's faked. You think those guys are getting killed? Really? It's just berry syrup and ham-acting.

text.Generic DarkElf Male: Have you ever met anyone who got rich betting on the Arena? Didn't think so.

text.Generic DarkElf Female: Have you ever met anyone who got rich betting on the Arena? Didn't think so.

text.Generic DarkElf Male: The Council runs the Arena to amuse the masses, and it pays for itself, with all the fools who lose their shirts gambling.

text.Generic DarkElf Female: The Council runs the Arena to amuse the masses, and it pays for itself, with all the fools who lose their shirts gambling.

text.Generic DarkElf Male: If you're on a road, you can usually outrun anything. If you're in good shape, and not wearing a tin suit.

text.Generic DarkElf Female: If you're on a road, you can usually outrun anything. If you're in good shape, and not wearing a tin suit.

text.Generic DarkElf Male: The lands surrounding Lake Rumare are studded with small settlements, farms, and woodland game reserves.

text.Generic DarkElf Female: The lands surrounding Lake Rumare are studded with small settlements, farms, and woodland game reserves.

text.Generic DarkElf Male: The Nibenay Basin grades from rolling farmlands by the river east to the rugged uplands of the Valus Mountains.

text.Generic DarkElf Female: The Nibenay Basin grades from rolling farmlands by the river east to the rugged uplands of the Valus Mountains.

text.Generic DarkElf Male: On Cyrodiil's northern border is the sparsely populated mountain wilderness called the Valus Mountains.

text.Generic DarkElf Female: On Cyrodiil's northern border is the sparsely populated mountain wilderness called the Valus Mountains.

text.Generic DarkElf Male: You can't be too careful out in the wilderness. Almost any creature you find is liable to give you a disease.

text.Generic DarkElf Female: You can't be too careful out in the wilderness. Almost any creature you find is liable to give you a disease.

text.Generic DarkElf Male: Watch yourself around goblins. Some of the nastier ones will toss spells at you.

text.Generic DarkElf Female: Watch yourself around goblins. Some of the nastier ones will toss spells at you.

text.Generic DarkElf Male: Imps. I hate 'em. Little buggers flitting around, tossing fireballs at you!

text.Generic DarkElf Female: Imps. I hate 'em. Little buggers flitting around, tossing fireballs at you!

text.Generic DarkElf Male: I saw a wraith once. It threw a curse on me I'll never forget.

text.Generic DarkElf Female: I saw a wraith once. It threw a curse on me I'll never forget.

text.Generic DarkElf Male: Have you seen a land dreugh? We call them "Billies." Don't know why. Steer clear of them, though.

text.Generic DarkElf Female: Have you seen a land dreugh? We call them "Billies." Don't know why. Steer clear of them, though.

text.Generic DarkElf Male: I ran across a ghost once. Seemed to suck the energy right out of me.

text.Generic DarkElf Female: I ran across a ghost once. Seemed to suck the energy right out of me.

text.Generic DarkElf Male: Watch for minotaurs in the forests. Aggressive beasts. They'll tear right through your armor, too.

text.Generic DarkElf Female: Watch for minotaurs in the forests. Aggressive beasts. They'll tear right through your armor, too.

text.Generic DarkElf Male: Mudcrabs. What's the point? Annoying buggers, though the meat isn't bad.

text.Generic DarkElf Female: Mudcrabs. What's the point? Annoying buggers, though the meat isn't bad.

text.Generic DarkElf Male: Only thing worse than an ogre is two ogres. Tough bastards, and spells seem to bounce right off of 'em.

text.Generic DarkElf Female: Only thing worse than an ogre is two ogres. Tough bastards, and spells seem to bounce right off of 'em.

text.Generic DarkElf Male: Is there anywhere in Tamriel you can avoid rats? Disease spreading little nuisances.

text.Generic DarkElf Female: Is there anywhere in Tamriel you can avoid rats? Disease spreading little nuisances.

text.Generic DarkElf Male: Best way to take out a skeleton is with a big weapon. Forget spells. Just smack them and watch the bones fly!

text.Generic DarkElf Female: Best way to take out a skeleton is with a big weapon. Forget spells. Just smack them and watch the bones fly!

text.Generic DarkElf Male: I might swim more if it weren't for the slaughterfish. Sharp teeth, and some carry disease.

text.Generic DarkElf Female: I might swim more if it weren't for the slaughterfish. Sharp teeth, and some carry disease.

text.Generic DarkElf Male: Spriggans. "Nature's guardians" my foot! Mean things. They'll curse you, or they might call a bear to tear you apart.

text.Generic DarkElf Female: Spriggans. "Nature's guardians" my foot! Mean things. They'll curse you, or they might call a bear to tear you apart.

text.Generic DarkElf Male: All that stuff about having to set trolls on fire is a bunch of hooey. They don't like fire, but a good sword will cut them up fine.

text.Generic DarkElf Female: All that stuff about having to set trolls on fire is a bunch of hooey. They don't like fire, but a good sword will cut them up fine.

text.Generic DarkElf Male: I don't even know what a will-o-the-wisp is, much less how to kill one. I think they're just swamp gas, myself.

text.Generic DarkElf Female: I don't even know what a will-o-the-wisp is, much less how to kill one. I think they're just swamp gas, myself.

text.Generic DarkElf Male: I don't like to think about zombies. Missing arms, legs, heads. They smell awful, and they're hard to kill.

text.Generic DarkElf Female: I don't like to think about zombies. Missing arms, legs, heads. They smell awful, and they're hard to kill.

text.Generic DarkElf Male: Try combining aloe vera leaves with some venison. It's said to have some restorative properties.

text.Generic DarkElf Female: Try combining aloe vera leaves with some venison. It's said to have some restorative properties.

text.Generic DarkElf Male: You can find Cairn Bolete growing in caves. They're said to mark the place someone has died.

text.Generic DarkElf Female: You can find Cairn Bolete growing in caves. They're said to mark the place someone has died.

text.Generic DarkElf Male: It's said that eating taproot can bring you good luck.

text.Generic DarkElf Female: It's said that eating taproot can bring you good luck.

text.Generic DarkElf Male: Make sure not to eat nightshade. It's very poisonous.

text.Generic DarkElf Female: Make sure not to eat nightshade. It's very poisonous.

text.SERendilDrarara: A new adventurer may set foot in the Shivering Isles, I hear. Perhaps I will bake him a fine treat in case our paths should cross.

text.SETilseAreleth: A stranger in the Isles is interesting news. Perhaps this stranger has interesting things...?

text.SERendilDrarara: So, this mystery adventurer has breached our defenses. I better prepare a special dish to commemorate this event.

text.SETilseAreleth: Sad about the Gatekeeper. I wonder if he had anything worth keeping?

text.SERendilDrarara: I feel safer now that the Resonator of Judgment has been restored. I was beginning to worry.

text.SETilseAreleth: The Resonator draws adventurers to it once again. I suppose they won't need their belongings.

text.SERendilDrarara: So, Thadon has the Chalice again? I wish I had time to loaf about and drink Felldew.

text.SETilseAreleth: Good that Thadon got his Chalice back. I'd hate if someone took mine. Or anything else, for that matter.

text.SERendilDrarara: I never understood Syl's methods. Wouldn't a nice talk and a basket of hot biscuits get her the information she needs?

text.SETilseAreleth: Another conspiracy in Crucible. That's fine. Just stay away from my things.

text.SERendilDrarara: Like the hearth in my kitchen, the Great Torch burns once more. This makes me as happy as a batch of sweetrolls.

text.SETilseAreleth: The Torch alight! There's hope for us all.

text.SERendilDrarara: I hadn't heard that Syl was replaced, I was too busy prefecting my latest culinary creation.

text.SETilseAreleth: Syl replaced. I wouldn't have guessed I'd see it.

text.SERendilDrarara: I hadn't heard that Thadon was replaced, I was too busy perfecting my latest culinary creation.

text.SETilseAreleth: Thadon is gone. I wonder if he left anything worth keeping...

text.SERendilDrarara: Oh, my word! The Fringe, gone? Luckily, Sheogorath will protect us. He always does.

text.SETilseAreleth: Passwall is in ruins. I should see what they left behind.

text.SERendilDrarara: So, the Gatekeeper is back at its post... good. Now we all may be able to get things done around here.

text.SETilseAreleth: The Gatekeeper has been reborn. I wonder if there are pieces left over....
