text.SERendilDrarara: Armies, war? Bah! When it comes to a man's heart, a basket of sweetrolls can be as effective as a sword.

text.SETilseAreleth: Sheogorath's armies have returned. They'll protect me while I protect my belongings.

text.SERendilDrarara: Sheogorath has vanished? I certainly hope it had nothing to do with the Greenmote Upsidedown Cake I sent to the Castle.

text.SETilseAreleth: Our Lord is missing? Perhaps I should get his things. To keep them safe.

text.SERendilDrarara: The day is ours! Come and celebrate, we will feast and dine until we can eat no more!

text.SETilseAreleth: Order is gone! They didn't leave anything interesting behind, though.

text.SEErverDevani: Whoever this new person in the Isles is, he'd better steer clear of Deepwallow.

text.SEFelasSarandas: A new person wandering around? Did anyone check to see if this person was diseased?

text.SEMiriliUlven: They say there's a newcomer about. I wonder where he's from?

text.SERelmynaVerenim: My child will smash to a bloody pulp any adventurer who tries to get into the realm.

text.SEErverDevani: You know who's responsible for killing the Gatekeeper, don't you? It's Them.

text.SEFelasSarandas: The Gatekeeper has been slain. I bet he died of a disease. I hope someone takes care of his corpse. Can you imagine how disgusting that will be?

text.SEMiriliUlven: I'll have to update my encyclopedia. I had an entire volume devoted to the Gatekeeper, and now he's dead.

text.SERelmynaVerenim: Someone killed my poor child! And my Lord cares little. So be it. Let the adventurers in. I don't care anymore.

text.SEErverDevani: Even if the Resonator of Judgment is working again, I bet it won't deter Them. I'm still not safe.

text.SEFelasSarandas: That Resonator is up and running again. It traps adventurers like the disease-infected rats that they are.

text.SEMiriliUlven: I suspect that the Resonator is affecting the migration patterns of baliwogs, but it's going to take years of study to be sure.

text.SERelmynaVerenim: Foolish adventurers are being pulled into the Resonator of Judgment.

text.SEErverDevani: Must be nice to be Duke of Mania, and have your biggest problem surround some missing cup.

text.SEFelasSarandas: Thadon better not drink out of that Chalice. Who knows how many people have used it while it was missing? Reusing cups is the best way to get sick.

text.SEMiriliUlven: Everyone's talking about Duke Thadon and his Chalice. How tedious. Don't people understand I have important work to finish?

text.SERelmynaVerenim: Thadon's a fool. Who cares about his precious Chalice?

text.SEErverDevani: If I thought I could make the trip safely, I'd go to Crucible and find out if the torture revealed anything about Them.

text.SEFelasSarandas: Syl has been known to round up people for "questioning" from time to time. Torture devices are known to spread disease.

text.SEMiriliUlven: The palace intrigues of the House of Dementia are of no interest to me.

text.SERelmynaVerenim: Syl enjoys having people tortured. She's a rank amateur. I could teach her a few things.

text.SEErverDevani: I heard someone relit the Torch at the Sacellum Arden-Sul. Good news, unless... what if someone is just trying to trick us?

text.SEFelasSarandas: That torch in New Sheoth is lit. Hopefully, that will burn off some of the airborne germs. It won't get all of them, though.

text.SEMiriliUlven: People are all excited about the Great Torch being relit. Personally, I don't pay any attention to politics.

text.SERelmynaVerenim: So, the Great Torch burns. I know something about burning. The human body makes a pretty good torch, especially the fattier parts.

text.SEErverDevani: So we have a new ruler of Dementia. How do I know this one isn't in league with Them?

text.SEFelasSarandas: Someone has replaced the Duchess!  I bet she got sick and died.

text.SEMiriliUlven: I understand Dementia has a new leader. Not my area of interest, honestly.

text.SERelmynaVerenim: A new Duke in Crucible? They're all just bags of meat to me.

text.SEErverDevani: Someone new on the throne of Mania? I hope it's not one of Them.

text.SEFelasSarandas: Someone has replaced the Duke. I bet he got sick and died.

text.SEMiriliUlven: I understand Mania has a new leader. Not my area of interest, honestly.

text.SERelmynaVerenim: Thadon's dead? They're all just bags of meat to me.

text.SEErverDevani: They're coming for me. Those Knights. I should have seen it coming.

text.SEFelasSarandas: Those strange Knights probably have diseases from wherever they came from. Best stay away from them.

text.SEMiriliUlven: All my work on the Fringe... wasted. I'll have to begin my research all over again.

text.SERelmynaVerenim: With the Gatekeeper gone, the Knights of Order have been causing trouble in the Fringe.

text.SEErverDevani: I hear there's a new Gatekeeper. What if They tamper with him, and send him after me?

text.SEFelasSarandas: There's a new Gatekeeper. I hope this one doesn't get sick and die like the first one.

text.SEMiriliUlven: I'd be very interested in taking a look at this new Gatekeeper. An entirely new form of life!

text.SERelmynaVerenim: My new Gatekeeper is a miracle. He's perfect.

text.SEErverDevani: Armies are well and good, but only if you know who you're fighting.

text.SEFelasSarandas: The armies of Sheogorath have returned? Putting lots of people in the same place is known to spread disease. I hope they keep the barracks far away.

text.SEMiriliUlven: The tedious to-ings and fro-ings of the armies of Sheogorath are of no interest to me.

text.SERelmynaVerenim: The power of Sheogorath doesn't lie in armies. Power comes from the willingness to do things others won't.

text.SEErverDevani: I'm telling you, They're behind all of this. All of it! No one is going to listen to me until it's too late!

text.SEFelasSarandas: Where did Sheogorath go? Great. I bet he got sick and died. We're all going to die now!

text.SEMiriliUlven: People act like Sheogorath's disappearance is of some grave significance. But the Shivering Isles are the same as ever, I assure you.

text.SERelmynaVerenim: Our Lord is too scared to face the Greymarch, is he? Coward! Good riddance.

text.SEErverDevani: It seems They have been thwarted for now. I know They're still plotting against me, though. It's only a matter of time.

text.SEFelasSarandas: Jyggalag is gone, but I bet he brought a ton of diseases with him. We still aren't safe.

text.SEMiriliUlven: With the Greymarch ended, I need to devote some serious study to the obelisks. They have proven more interesting than I had thought.

text.SERelmynaVerenim: Maybe now that Jyggalag is gone, Sheogorath will finally return my affections.

text.SEMiriliUlven: Did you really have some important reason for interrupting me? I thought not.
How many times have I told you to leave me alone?
Cretin! Nincompoop! Halfwit! Now I have to start all over again. Happy?

text.Generic DarkSeducer Female: I hear that Earil is fed up with Brithaur's antics. He really wants something done about it.

text.Generic DarkSeducer Male: Your pardon, citizen. I must return to my post.

text.Generic DarkSeducer Female: Your pardon, citizen. I must return to my post.

text.Generic DarkSeducer Male: This Mazken must return to duty.

text.Generic DarkSeducer Female: This Mazken must return to duty.

text.Generic DarkSeducer Male: Duty calls, citizen. Madgod's blessings upon you.

text.Generic DarkSeducer Female: Duty calls, citizen. Madgod's blessings upon you.

text.Generic DarkSeducer Male: Apologies, citizen, but I must return to my post.

text.Generic DarkSeducer Female: Apologies, citizen, but I must return to my post.

text.Generic DarkSeducer Male: Blessings of the Madgod, citizen. Walk without fear.

text.Generic DarkSeducer Female: Blessings of the Madgod, citizen. Walk without fear.

text.Generic GoldenSaint Male: The Aureal do not waste time chatting with mortals.

text.Generic GoldenSaint Female: The Aureal do not waste time chatting with mortals.

text.Generic GoldenSaint Male: Away, mortal. I haven't time for your chatter.

text.Generic GoldenSaint Female: Away, mortal. I haven't time for your chatter.

text.Generic GoldenSaint Male: Cease your prattling.

text.Generic GoldenSaint Female: Cease your prattling.

text.Generic GoldenSaint Male: Do not bother the Aureal with your petty conversation.

text.Generic GoldenSaint Female: Do not bother the Aureal with your petty conversation.

text.Generic GoldenSaint Male: Leave me, mortal. Your words hold no meaning for me.

text.Generic GoldenSaint Female: Leave me, mortal. Your words hold no meaning for me.

text.Generic HighElf Male: You're talking to me, and I don't like you. Goodbye.

text.Generic HighElf Female: You're talking to me, and I don't like you. Goodbye.

text.Generic HighElf Male: I see no reason to talk to you.

text.Generic HighElf Female: I see no reason to talk to you.

text.Generic HighElf Male: I don't like you and don't want to talk to you.

text.Generic HighElf Female: I don't like you and don't want to talk to you.

text.Generic HighElf Male: I'm not listening to you. It's because I don't like you.

text.Generic HighElf Female: I'm not listening to you. It's because I don't like you.

text.Generic HighElf Male: You're still speaking. Stop.

text.Generic HighElf Female: You're still speaking. Stop.

text.Generic HighElf Male: Everyone's talking about the assassination, of course. Here. Take my copy of the new Black Horse Courier. Go ahead. Keep it.

text.Generic HighElf Female: Everyone's talking about the assassination, of course. Here. Take my copy of the new Black Horse Courier. Go ahead. Keep it.

text.Generic HighElf Male: Everyone wants to know what really happened in the Temple. What happened to Martin? Was the fiery dragon really Akatosh?

text.Generic HighElf Female: Everyone wants to know what really happened in the Temple. What happened to Martin? Was the fiery dragon really Akatosh?

text.Generic HighElf Male: The Fighters Guild is recruiting again. Not a bad way to make some money, if you've got the stones for it.

text.Generic HighElf Female: The Fighters Guild is recruiting again. Not a bad way to make some money, if you've got the stones for it.

text.Generic HighElf Male: Anyone looking for work should consider the Fighters Guild. I hear they're always looking for recruits.

text.Generic HighElf Female: Anyone looking for work should consider the Fighters Guild. I hear they're always looking for recruits.

text.Generic HighElf Male: I understand the Fighters Guild is hiring new members. Not bad work for some folks.

text.Generic HighElf Female: I understand the Fighters Guild is hiring new members. Not bad work for some folks.

text.Generic HighElf Male: Mannimarco is no more! The guild is saved, and we have a new Arch-Mage to lead us.

text.Generic HighElf Female: I can't believe Arch-Mage Traven sacrificed himself to save us all. How noble of him.

text.Generic HighElf Male: I don't know what it was, but something important was taken away from Mannimarco. Maybe there is a chance he can be defeated.
Traven might get us through this yet. I hear that the Necromancers were handed a significant defeat at Silorn.
The Council has turned on Traven. Things couldn't possibly get any worse for the guild.
Mannimarco himself is in Cyrodiil, hunting us down. None of us are safe!
Without the Council of Mages to guide us, how will we stand up to the King of Worms?
The Council of Mages has been dissolved. Arch-Mage Traven has been deserted. He's all we have left.
Necromancers have attacked our very homes. What could be next?

text.Generic HighElf Female: The Bruma guild hall has been decimated. Our hall could be next!
I've heard rumors about the Council of Mages consorting with outside sources. Why are outsiders interfering with our guild?
The Council of Mages has this Necromancer situation under control. They must, or else we'd know about it, right?

text.Generic HighElf Male: Something has gone seriously wrong at the Arcane University. I heard that a high-ranking member was killed in some sort of ambush.

text.Generic HighElf Female: I think the rumors about Necromancers are completely untrue. I've heard some crazy things, and I don't believe any of them.

text.Generic HighElf Male: The Council seems very interested in this new group of Necromancers that has sprung up. I wonder how things will play out.
Have you heard anything more about what the Council knows about these Necromancers? Something's not right.

text.Generic HighElf Female: It's good to know that valuable research is still going on, even though things seem to be a bit more tense lately.

text.Generic HighElf Male: Someone finally solved the problems with research at Vahtacen. You'd think the Council would know more about the Ayleids by now.

text.Generic HighElf Female: It sounds like the Council of Mages has been holding extra meetings recently. I'm not sure what that means.

text.Generic HighElf Male: I've heard rumors that the Council of Mages is taking advice from outsiders. I'm not sure how I feel about that.
Arch-Mage Traven was right to ban Necromancy from the guild. Look at what they've done; they've gone and killed several of us!

text.Generic HighElf Female: The Mages Guild has been attacked by Necromancers. This proves they can't be trusted!

text.Generic HighElf Male: I understand that Dagail is in much better control of her faculties now that Kalthar's plot has been exposed.
Kalthar tried to ruin the Leyawiin guild. Just goes to show you can't trust a Necromancer, even if he claims to be "reformed."

text.Generic HighElf Female: Did you hear that someone played yet another prank on Jeanne Frasoric in Bruma? I don't know how she keeps falling for these things.

text.Generic HighElf Male: It sounds like there are an awful lot of problems at the Bruma guild hall. Jeanne does a poor job of running that place.

text.Generic HighElf Female: The Chorrol guild hall had an unpleasant visit recently, from someone who had a grudge against Teekeeus.

text.Generic HighElf Male: I hear a new Associate came to Teekeeus's aid recently. Something about an old enemy of his storming into town.
The roads near Anvil are safer now, thanks to Carahil and her guild hall. She's an example for us all.

text.Generic HighElf Female: The Anvil guild has made quite a name for itself under Carahil. Did you hear about the recent murderer they caught?
Kud-Ei will do anything to help her girls out. She recently got Ardaline out of a bind, and I hear it wasn't completely within guild rules.

text.Generic HighElf Male: Kud-Ei runs a tight ship in Bruma. She may not always play by the rules, but I wouldn't want her on my bad side.
I can't believe a Mages Guild associate was found dead in Cheydinhal. What kind of place are they running there?

text.Generic HighElf Female: Did you hear that Falcar left the guild? I think Deetsan is in charge in Cheydinhal now.
I heard that one of the Skingrad mages was assaulted, but I don't know the details.

text.Generic HighElf Male: Sounds like the Skingrad branch of the guild can't even keep track of its members. How appalling.
Things in the guild have been different since Traven was named Arch-Mage. They're more structured, but everyone seems tense.

text.Generic HighElf Female: Things in the guild have been different since Traven was named Arch-Mage. They're more structured, but everyone seems tense.

text.Generic HighElf Male: Half of the Council of Mages resigned when Traven took over the position of Arch-Mage.

text.Generic HighElf Female: Half of the Council of Mages resigned when Traven took over the position of Arch-Mage.

text.Generic HighElf Male: Arch-Mage Traven is the first to take such a hard stance on Necromancy. It upset more than a few people.

text.Generic HighElf Female: Arch-Mage Traven is the first to take such a hard stance on Necromancy. It upset more than a few people.

text.Generic HighElf Male: The Mages Guild runs more or less like it always did, but we lost quite a few members when the practice of Necromancy was banned.

text.Generic HighElf Female: The Mages Guild runs more or less like it always did, but we lost quite a few members when the practice of Necromancy was banned.

text.Generic HighElf Male: Necromancy may be legal in Cyrodiil, but few will openly admit to practicing it now that the Mages Guild has banned it.

text.Generic HighElf Female: Necromancy may be legal in Cyrodiil, but few will openly admit to practicing it now that the Mages Guild has banned it.

text.Generic HighElf Male: Some say that Traven is mis-using the power of the Arch-Mage's position to further his personal agendas.

text.Generic HighElf Female: Some say that Traven is mis-using the power of the Arch-Mage's position to further his personal agendas.

text.Generic HighElf Male: I don't know what Arch-Mage Traven has against Necromancy, but the first thing he did after taking over the Mages Guild was to ban its practice.

text.Generic HighElf Female: I don't know what Arch-Mage Traven has against Necromancy, but the first thing he did after taking over the Mages Guild was to ban its practice.

text.Generic HighElf Male: Not only has Necromancy been banned from practice in the Mages Guild, but the Guild won't deal with anyone who openly uses it.

text.Generic HighElf Female: Not only has Necromancy been banned from practice in the Mages Guild, but the Guild won't deal with anyone who openly uses it.

text.Generic HighElf Male: The Mages Guild has made more than a few enemies since Necromancy was banned.

text.Generic HighElf Female: The Mages Guild has made more than a few enemies since Necromancy was banned.

text.Honditar: I saw that Earana woman hanging around the Mages Guild again.

text.Generic HighElf Male: I saw that Erthor is back in town again.
It seems quieter than usual at the Mages Guild.
I saw Earana leaving town. She looked very excited.
Falcar at the Mages Guild seems to be angry all the time. I avoid him when I can.
Varon Vamori seems very glum lately. I guess things aren't going well with Ardaline.
Kud-Ei seems upset about something lately. I'd stay away from the Mages Guild if I were you.

text.Ranaline: Kud-Ei seems upset about something lately. I'd stay away from the Mages Guild if I were you.

text.Honditar: I heard someone broke into the Mages Guild.

text.Generic HighElf Female: I heard someone broke into the Mages Guild.

text.Generic HighElf Male: If the Council really did split up, the guild is done for. This is serious.

text.Generic HighElf Female: If the Council really did split up, the guild is done for. This is serious.
The Mages Guild seems more disorganized than usual lately.

text.Generic HighElf Male: Andel Indarys may or may not have killed his wife, and it may or may not have been an accident. And I doubt we'll ever know for sure.

text.Caranya: Andel Indarys may or may not have killed his wife, and it may or may not have been an accident. And I doubt we'll ever know for sure.

text.Generic HighElf Male: How did a Dark Elf become Count Cheydinhal? King Helseth and Barenziah have considerable influence, and Helseth and Indarys are cronies. Get it?

text.Caranya: How did a Dark Elf become Count Cheydinhal? King Helseth and Barenziah have considerable influence, and Helseth and Indarys are cronies. Get it?

text.Generic HighElf Male: Andel Indarys is an intemperate, bibulous philanderer. And a Dark Elf. Other than that, he is perfectly suited to be a count.

text.Caranya: Andel Indarys is an intemperate, bibulous philanderer. And a Dark Elf. Other than that, he is perfectly suited to be a count.

text.Generic HighElf Male: Millona Umbranox is better off without that irresponsible husband of hers. The most honorable thing he ever did was to disappear and leave her alone.

text.Caranya: Millona Umbranox is better off without that irresponsible husband of hers. The most honorable thing he ever did was to disappear and leave her alone.

text.Generic HighElf Male: Millona Umbranox, Arriana Valga, and Narina Carvain seem to rule their counties perfectly well without male assistance.

text.Caranya: Millona Umbranox, Arriana Valga, and Narina Carvain seem to rule their counties perfectly well without male assistance.

text.Generic HighElf Male: I've never heard the Countess mention her husband. I believe it is something of a sore point with Lady Millona.

text.Caranya: I've never heard the Countess mention her husband. I believe it is something of a sore point with Lady Millona.

text.Generic HighElf Male: I believe the rugged climate of Bruma suits Narina Carvain. She's tough and cold, but you always know what to expect from her.

text.Caranya: I believe the rugged climate of Bruma suits Narina Carvain. She's tough and cold, but you always know what to expect from her.

text.Generic HighElf Male: No wonder Narina Carvain is so cranky. If you had to live year-round in a cold, drafty, soot-stained castle like Bruma, you'd be cranky, too.

text.Caranya: No wonder Narina Carvain is so cranky. If you had to live year-round in a cold, drafty, soot-stained castle like Bruma, you'd be cranky, too.

text.Generic HighElf Male: With Regulus Terentius for a father, what do you expect from Gellius? The acorn never falls too far from the tree.

text.Caranya: With Regulus Terentius for a father, what do you expect from Gellius? The acorn never falls too far from the tree.

text.Generic HighElf Male: It is fashionable to make fun of Bravil and Regulus Terentius. Personally, I think it is poor sport to mock the poor and disadvantaged.

text.Caranya: It is fashionable to make fun of Bravil and Regulus Terentius. Personally, I think it is poor sport to mock the poor and disadvantaged.

text.Generic HighElf Male: Alessia Caro visits her mother in Chorrol regularly. A dutiful daughter... and a dutiful wife, I hear.

text.Caranya: Alessia Caro visits her mother in Chorrol regularly. A dutiful daughter... and a dutiful wife, I hear.

text.Generic HighElf Male: There's been trouble with smugglers and Khajiit bandits in the Trans-Niben, but Marius Caro is taking steps to deal with the problem.

text.Caranya: There's been trouble with smugglers and Khajiit bandits in the Trans-Niben, but Marius Caro is taking steps to deal with the problem.

text.Generic HighElf Male: The Count of Skingrad and I are not social intimates. In fact, I don't believe Janus Hassildor has any social intimates.

text.Caranya: The Count of Skingrad and I are not social intimates. In fact, I don't believe Janus Hassildor has any social intimates.

text.Generic HighElf Male: It's curious. Skingrad's people scarcely ever set eyes on the Count, but he's apparently loved and respected by all his subjects.

text.Caranya: It's curious. Skingrad's people scarcely ever set eyes on the Count, but he's apparently loved and respected by all his subjects.

text.Generic HighElf Male: A master sorcerer like Janus Hassildor inevitably outlives all his peers. It must be a lonely existence.

text.Caranya: A master sorcerer like Janus Hassildor inevitably outlives all his peers. It must be a lonely existence.

text.Generic HighElf Male: It is pleasant, and a bit melancholy, to walk among the graves in Green Emperor Way and contemplate the dead who precede us.

text.Caranya: It is pleasant, and a bit melancholy, to walk among the graves in Green Emperor Way and contemplate the dead who precede us.

text.Generic HighElf Male: I admit to sharing the common enthusiasm for the Arena. It is barbaric, but the stakes of life or death make the drama irresistably compelling.

text.Caranya: I admit to sharing the common enthusiasm for the Arena. It is barbaric, but the stakes of life or death make the drama irresistably compelling.

text.Generic HighElf Male: They say Alinor on Summerset Isle is more beautiful. I've never been. For the present, I must count the Imperial City the most glorious in Tamriel.

text.Caranya: They say Alinor on Summerset Isle is more beautiful. I've never been. For the present, I must count the Imperial City the most glorious in Tamriel.

text.Generic HighElf Male: Legion duty here in Cyrodiil is usually a dull affair. In the East, though, things are a bit more challenging, and one can make a name for oneself.

text.Caranya: Legion duty here in Cyrodiil is usually a dull affair. In the East, though, things are a bit more challenging, and one can make a name for oneself.

text.Generic HighElf Male: The legions patrol the roads, and they've always been sufficient. I can't imagine we'll ever be at war with the provinces... not in my lifetime.

text.Caranya: The legions patrol the roads, and they've always been sufficient. I can't imagine we'll ever be at war with the provinces... not in my lifetime.

text.Generic HighElf Male: I've not always been happy with the standards of conduct in the Mages Guild, but Hannibal Traven's reforms are quite encouraging.

text.Caranya: I've not always been happy with the standards of conduct in the Mages Guild, but Hannibal Traven's reforms are quite encouraging.

text.Generic HighElf Male: I'm not sure the Dark Brotherhood is any more serious a problem than beggary and petty thievery. And it's certainly a discreet and secret problem.

text.Caranya: I'm not sure the Dark Brotherhood is any more serious a problem than beggary and petty thievery. And it's certainly a discreet and secret problem.

text.Generic HighElf Male: The people have a simple faith in the Nine, and the clerics do their part to heal and comfort them in adversity.

text.Caranya: The people have a simple faith in the Nine, and the clerics do their part to heal and comfort them in adversity.

text.Generic HighElf Male: I've sometimes thought I'd like to make a pilgrimage to the wayshrines, but my duties prevent me from such extensive and dangerous travel.

text.Caranya: I've sometimes thought I'd like to make a pilgrimage to the wayshrines, but my duties prevent me from such extensive and dangerous travel.

text.Generic HighElf Male: The doomstones are a mystery. Are they traces of the Mythic Times? Or creations of ancient beastfolk or lost races of mer or men?

text.Caranya: The doomstones are a mystery. Are they traces of the Mythic Times? Or creations of ancient beastfolk or lost races of mer or men?

text.Generic HighElf Male: I have not read the works of Mrs. Ottus. I'm told some find her guide books useful, though she apparently has strong opinions on some matters.

text.Caranya: I have not read the works of Mrs. Ottus. I'm told some find her guide books useful, though she apparently has strong opinions on some matters.

text.Generic HighElf Male: The Elder Council and the bureaucracy have managed the Empire's affairs for decades. The Emperor rules, but the Council handles all the details.

text.Caranya: The Elder Council and the bureaucracy have managed the Empire's affairs for decades. The Emperor rules, but the Council handles all the details.

text.Generic HighElf Male: What can be said about taxes? They're high, but we must pay. At least they are administered efficiently, and the shrinkage is within decent limits.

text.Caranya: What can be said about taxes? They're high, but we must pay. At least they are administered efficiently, and the shrinkage is within decent limits.

text.Generic HighElf Male: It is not always an easy life we lead, but the people must be served.

text.Caranya: It is not always an easy life we lead, but the people must be served.

text.Generic HighElf Female: You better have the right offering, or you're wasting your time here.

text.Arquen: This is no time for gossip mongering. A dark destiny awaits us.

text.Generic HighElf Male: They say that when you murder someone, the Dark Brotherhood comes to you in your sleep. It's how they recruit new members.

text.Generic HighElf Female: They say that when you murder someone, the Dark Brotherhood comes to you in your sleep. It's how they recruit new members.
Count Leyawiin placed a bounty on the heads of the surviving Black Bow Bandits.

text.Generic HighElf Male: Poor Tivela. I hear she is turning Cheydinhal inside out looking for her husband, Rythe. I hope nothing bad has happened to him.

text.Generic HighElf Female: Poor Tivela. I hear she is turning Cheydinhal inside out looking for her husband, Rythe. I hope nothing bad has happened to him.

text.Generic HighElf Male: Kud-Ei seems to be in good spirits again after Henantier's return. I heard she enlisted a stranger's help in the search. Good show I say!

text.Generic HighElf Female: Kud-Ei seems to be in good spirits again after Henantier's return. I heard she enlisted a stranger's help in the search. Good show I say!

text.Generic HighElf Male: Henantier was slain in his sleep. How awful. They should find the one who did it and send him straight to prison.

text.Generic HighElf Female: Henantier was slain in his sleep. How awful. They should find the one who did it and send him straight to prison.

text.Generic HighElf Male: I have it on good account that the Forlorn Watchman is gone for good. The stories about his fate were true, but now the curse has been broken.

text.Generic HighElf Female: I have it on good account that the Forlorn Watchman is gone for good. The stories about his fate were true, but now the curse has been broken.

text.Generic HighElf Male: Well, despite everything, Aleron Loche turned up dead. That's what you get when you deal with gamblers and usurers.

text.Generic HighElf Female: Well, despite everything, Aleron Loche turned up dead. That's what you get when you deal with gamblers and usurers.

text.Generic HighElf Male: Arnora was killed. Such a shame. I wonder if Jorundr had something to do with it? I wouldn't put it past him.

text.Karinnarre: Arnora was killed. Such a shame. I wonder if Jorundr had something to do with it? I wouldn't put it past him.

text.Generic HighElf Male: So, the mighty Ulrich Leland has fallen. Apparently Llevana Nedaren snapped and killed him. Good riddance I say.

text.Generic HighElf Female: So, the mighty Ulrich Leland has fallen. Apparently Llevana Nedaren snapped and killed him. Good riddance I say.

text.Generic HighElf Male: Did you hear the news? Ulrich Leland was thrown in the dungeons for stealing money from the city coffers. Haha! Justice for the little guy!

text.Generic HighElf Female: Did you hear the news? Ulrich Leland was thrown in the dungeons for stealing money from the city coffers. Haha! Justice for the little guy!

text.Generic HighElf Male: I overheard that the vampire hunter who was in town was a fake. It was apparently a ruse to get his hands on Bradon's key to a treasure chest.

text.Karinnarre: I overheard that the vampire hunter who was in town was a fake. It was apparently a ruse to get his hands on Bradon's key to a treasure chest.

text.Generic HighElf Male: Thank goodness the gate is gone. I couldn't get a good night's sleep knowing it was out there!

text.Generic HighElf Female: Thank goodness the gate is gone. I couldn't get a good night's sleep knowing it was out there!

text.Generic HighElf Male: Rythe Lythandas seems to be back in town. Wonder where he was off to?

text.Generic HighElf Female: Rythe Lythandas seems to be back in town. Wonder where he was off to?

text.Generic HighElf Male: You hear any word about Kud-Ei's friend? She's offering a generous reward, so hopefully someone will show up and lend a hand.

text.Generic HighElf Female: You hear any word about Kud-Ei's friend? She's offering a generous reward, so hopefully someone will show up and lend a hand.

text.Generic HighElf Male: I saw Kud-Ei moping around outside the Mages Guild yesterday. In fact, I could swear she was crying. I hope she finds her missing friend.

text.Generic HighElf Female: I saw Kud-Ei moping around outside the Mages Guild yesterday. In fact, I could swear she was crying. I hope she finds her missing friend.

text.Generic HighElf Male: I've sighted the Forlorn Watchman again. Every time I see that ghost, it gives me the creeps.

text.Generic HighElf Female: I've sighted the Forlorn Watchman again. Every time I see that ghost, it gives me the creeps.

text.Generic HighElf Male: Have you heard about that ghost of the old man that looks out into Niben Bay each night? They're calling him the Forlorn Watchman... spooky.

text.Generic HighElf Female: Have you heard about that ghost of the old man that looks out into Niben Bay each night? They're calling him the Forlorn Watchman... spooky.

text.Generic HighElf Male: Have you noticed all the city guards are roaming around the city as if looking for someone? I wonder what that's all about.

text.Karinnarre: Have you noticed all the city guards are roaming around the city as if looking for someone? I wonder what that's all about.

text.Generic HighElf Male: Did you hear about Bradon Lirrian? A vampire hunter named Raynil Dralas made his way into town, snuck into his house and killed him.

text.Karinnarre: Did you hear about Bradon Lirrian? A vampire hunter named Raynil Dralas made his way into town, snuck into his house and killed him.

text.Generic HighElf Male: I was at Olav's earlier and I ran into this Dunmer named Raynil Dralas. After a round or two, he told me he was an honest-to-goodness vampire hunter!

text.Karinnarre: I was at Olav's earlier and I ran into this Dunmer named Raynil Dralas. After a round or two, he told me he was an honest-to-goodness vampire hunter!

text.Generic HighElf Male: They charged me 5 gold for littering! Littering!! I barely make that in a year! These fines are ridiculous!

text.Generic HighElf Female: They charged me 5 gold for littering! Littering!! I barely make that in a year! These fines are ridiculous!

text.Generic HighElf Male: I can't believe the ridiculous new fines the guards are imposing. Ever since Ulrich took over as Captain of the Guard, this place is going downhill.

text.Generic HighElf Female: I can't believe the ridiculous new fines the guards are imposing. Ever since Ulrich took over as Captain of the Guard, this place is going downhill.

text.Generic HighElf Male: You hear about Jorundr? He was caught stealing gold, and now he's in jail! I bet Arnora's beside herself with grief.

text.Karinnarre: You hear about Jorundr? He was caught stealing gold, and now he's in jail! I bet Arnora's beside herself with grief.

text.Generic HighElf Male: Poor Arnora. Seems her boyfriend, Jorundr, has stolen some gold from her and left her penniless. Now he's in jail, and she's destitute.

text.Karinnarre: Poor Arnora. Seems her boyfriend, Jorundr, has stolen some gold from her and left her penniless. Now he's in jail, and she's destitute.

text.Generic HighElf Male: I overheard a guard mention the Countess is looking for a piece to add to her collection of Akaviri artifacts. Our taxpayer's drakes at work...

text.Karinnarre: I overheard a guard mention the Countess is looking for a piece to add to her collection of Akaviri artifacts. Our taxpayer's drakes at work...

text.Generic HighElf Male: I'd stay inside the city walls if I were you, there's no telling what's going to come out of that gate.

text.Generic HighElf Female: I'd stay inside the city walls if I were you, there's no telling what's going to come out of that gate.

text.Generic HighElf Male: Ever since that gate appeared, the city guards have been on alert. I hope they can protect us.

text.Generic HighElf Female: Ever since that gate appeared, the city guards have been on alert. I hope they can protect us.

text.Generic HighElf Male: I overheard someone say that Aleron Loche is missing. I don't know what happened to him. His wife, Ursanne, is beside herself with grief.

text.Generic HighElf Female: I overheard someone say that Aleron Loche is missing. I don't know what happened to him. His wife, Ursanne, is beside herself with grief.

text.DarkPrisonGuard02: It's true what everyone's saying -- Kvatch is lost. The Daedra, they swarmed in.... The Town Guard never had a chance.
The Kvatch Oblivion Gate has been closed! Don't you understand what that means? We can beat the bastards!
The Mythic Dawn murdered the Emperor and led those damn Daedra right into the heart of the Empire! They'll pay for their treachery!
Kvatch? Kvatch was just the beginning! Those damned Gates have opened up everywhere! Cheydinhal, Chorrol, Leyawiin -- no city is safe.
If you've got to travel, by the Nine Divines, stay on the roads! The wilderness just isn't safe anymore. We've had sightings, you see. The Daedra...

text.Generic HighElf Male: We're all talking about the emperor's murder. We have no emperor. And no heir. That's never happened before. I suppose we should all be worried.

text.Generic HighElf Female: We're all talking about the emperor's murder. We have no emperor. And no heir. That's never happened before. I suppose we should all be worried.

text.Generic HighElf Male: People are subdued. Troubled. A crisis like this tests the people's faith.

text.Generic HighElf Female: People are subdued. Troubled. A crisis like this tests the people's faith.
I think we're in for some hard times. The death of Uriel Septim and his heirs changes everything.

text.Generic HighElf Male: The Emperor and his three sons, dead, right under the noses of the Imperial Guard. It's a disgrace.
Have you heard about Kvatch? They say that daedra came from Oblivion and burned the whole city to the ground!

text.Generic HighElf Female: Everyone's saying there's trouble in Kvatch. The whole town destroyed. Only a few survivors.

text.Generic HighElf Male: Do you think what happened to Kvatch could happen here?
I heard that the Kvatch Guard is driving back the daedra! Maybe there's hope after all.

text.Generic HighElf Female: I heard that the Kvatch Guard is driving back the daedra! Maybe there's hope after all.
Everybody's talking about the Hero of Kvatch! They say he actually went into an Oblivion Gate and destroyed it.

text.Generic HighElf Male: Everybody's talking about the Hero of Kvatch! They say she actually went into an Oblivion Gate and destroyed it.
Hey, you're the one they call the Hero of Kvatch, aren't you? The one that closed the Oblivion Gate and saved the city?

text.Generic HighElf Female: Hey, you're the one they call the Hero of Kvatch, aren't you? The one that closed the Oblivion Gate and saved the city?

text.Generic HighElf Male: Good news from Kvatch for a change. The last of the daedra have been driven out.

text.Generic HighElf Female: Good news from Kvatch for a change. The last of the daedra have been driven out.

text.Generic HighElf Male: Do you believe any of that talk about more Oblivion Gates opening all over the place?

text.Generic HighElf Female: I've been hearing disturbing tales about Oblivion Gates opening all across Cyrodiil. I hope it's just wild talk.

text.Generic HighElf Male: They say that Oblivion Gates have opened outside cities all across Tamriel! Gods preserve us!

text.Generic HighElf Female: With those Oblivion Gates opening everywhere, it's only a matter of time before another city goes the way of Kvatch.
Did you hear? The lost heir of Uriel Septim rallied the Guard and smashed a horde of daedra outside Bruma!

text.Generic HighElf Male: They say a lost son of Uriel Septim has reappeared in Bruma. Troops are flocking to his banner from all over Cyrodiil!
I heard that some cult called the Mythic Dawn is behind the Emperor's assassination.

text.Generic HighElf Female: They're saying some cult murdered the Emperor and are opening the Oblivion Gates. Do you think any of it's true?

text.Generic HighElf Male: Thank Akatosh the Oblivion Crisis is over! Although with no Emperor and no heir, I wonder what will happen to the Empire?
I plan to visit the Imperial City soon to pay my respects at the Temple of the One. They say the Dragon Statue is 100 feet high!

text.Generic HighElf Female: I'm sure the Elder Council will find some way to hold the Empire together. At least the Oblivion invasion is over!
I heard that some of the provinces were talking about seceding from the Empire. Probably just talk though. Everything's a bit unsettled now.

text.Generic HighElf Male: Most people consider Martin's... transformation... a religious or political event, but what interests me is its metaphysical implications.

text.Generic HighElf Female: Most people consider Martin's... transformation... a religious or political event, but what interests me is its metaphysical implications.

text.Generic HighElf Male: I wish I had witnessed the avatar of divine Akatosh myself. Imagine! Upon the very altar of the Temple of the One!

text.Generic HighElf Female: I wish I had witnessed the avatar of divine Akatosh myself. Imagine! Upon the very altar of the Temple of the One!

text.Karinnarre: I confess, I didn't think we had a chance against the daedra. But Martin proved himself a true heir of Talos on that day.

text.Generic HighElf Male: To think that Bruma was where Martin Septim chose to reveal himself as the true heir to the throne for the first time!

text.SEMuurine: I hear that Earil is fed up with Brithaur's antics. He really wants something done about it.

text.SEHalion: Beware the vicious Scalon for it carries dread disease. If this foe bites you, then stay away from me please.

text.SEEaril: Scalons carry diseases. Lots of them.

text.SEMuurine: Scalons carry diseases. Lots of them.

text.SECindanwe: Don't run into the water to escape a Scalon. They'll follow you.

text.SESontaire: Have to watch for those Scalons. I hear they carry disease.

text.SEHalion: Fear the woody Gnarl, the tree that walks and creeps. If you strike them with a spell, the magic it will keep.

text.SESontaire: If you see a Gnarl, be careful what spells you use on them.

text.SEEaril: I've heard that Gnarl get stronger when hit by some spells.

text.SEMuurine: I've heard that Gnarl get stronger when hit by some spells.

text.SECindanwe: The Gnarl are strange creatures. Hit them with a fireball, and they get stronger, but they hate other elements even more.

text.SEHalion: Be wary of the Shambles, its bones in disarray. Don't stand too close when they die... explode into frost they may.

text.SESontaire: Those Shambles are dangerous. Make sure to stand back if you kill one.

text.SEEaril: Don't bother using a frost spell on a Shambles.

text.SEMuurine: Don't bother using a frost spell on a Shambles.

text.SECindanwe: If you see a Shambles dying, stand back. They'll take you with them.

text.SEHalion: Steer clear of the Atronach whose skin is made of flesh. Just when you think they'll be dead, they end up nice and fresh.

text.SESontaire: Flesh Atronachs are dangerous. Some are smart enough to heal themselves when they're hurt.

text.SEEaril: Sometimes, a sharp blade is the best way to kill a Flesh Atronach.

text.SEMuurine: Sometimes, a sharp blade is the best way to kill a Flesh Atronach.

text.SECindanwe: If you have to fight a Flesh Atronach, a good shock spell is the way to go.

text.SEHalion: Avoid the noxious Elytra, its stinger filled with bane. One dose of this in your blood and your life begins to wane.

text.SESontaire: The poison of the Elytra can be debilitating.

text.SEEaril: The Elytra have wondrous poisons that can drain the very life from you.

text.SEMuurine: The Elytra have wondrous poisons that can drain the very life from you.

text.SECindanwe: Watch for the Elytra's stingers; their poison can be deadly. They don't like magic much, though.

text.SEHalion: Evade the horrid Hunger, the Madgod's favorite pet. If your strength lies in your use of shock, you've just increased its threat.

text.SESontaire: The Hunger is one of Lord Sheogorath's favorite pets.

text.SEEaril: Only the Demented can truly appreciate the Hunger.

text.SEMuurine: Only the Demented can truly appreciate the Hunger.

text.SECindanwe: Like most lesser Daedra, the Hunger has a weakness to shock spells.

text.SEHalion: Keep far from the Grummite with skin a greenish-jet. If your paths should accidentally cross, don't ever get it wet.

text.SESontaire: Some say the Grummites are the original inhabitants of the Shivering Isles.

text.SEEaril: Who do the Grummites worship? Some say Sheogorath, but I'm not sure.

text.SEMuurine: Who do the Grummites worship? Some say Sheogorath, but I'm not sure.

text.SECindanwe: Try not to fight a Grummite in the water. Or in the rain. They seem to like that.

text.SEHalion: Abhor the ugly Baliwog and its entire kin alike. The best place for this horrid thing is upon a pointed pike.

text.SESontaire: The Baliwog is a dangerous little creature. Some say they grow up to be Scalons.

text.SEEaril: The Baliwog are known to carry Swamp Fever.

text.SEMuurine: The Baliwog are known to carry Swamp Fever.

text.SECindanwe: The Baliwog will return to the water to heal.

text.SEHalion: Skinned hounds are by far the most nasty dogs around. The best place for these poison-loving pups is six feet underground.

text.SESontaire: I've heard that Skinned Hounds don't like fire.

text.SEEaril: Don't waste your wonderful poisons on Skinned Hounds. They seem to like them.

text.SEMuurine: Don't waste your wonderful poisons on Skinned Hounds. They seem to like them.

text.SECindanwe: Best way to kill a Skinned Hound is with a fireball, or a good weapon.

text.SEHalion: The Heretic is a misguided man whose belief has gone astray. Steal a robe from their back and among them you can stay.

text.SESontaire: Heretics are misguided worshippers of Arden-Sul.

text.SEEaril: I hear the Heretics in the lands of Mania summon Hungers to fight by their sides.

text.SEMuurine: I hear the Heretics in the lands of Mania summon Hungers to fight by their sides.

text.SECindanwe: If you want to get close to the Heretics, try putting on their robes.

text.SEHalion: The Zealot is a misguided man whose belief has gone astray. Steal a robe from their back and among them you can stay.

text.SESontaire: The Zealots in the lands of Dementia believe they worship Arden-Sul. Poor, deluded souls.

text.SEEaril: Zealots have dedicated themselves to the worship of Arden-Sul.

text.SEMuurine: Zealots have dedicated themselves to the worship of Arden-Sul.

text.SECindanwe: If you want to sneak up on one of those Zealots, wear one of their robes. Fools them every time.

text.SEHalion: The obelisks like glass towers tall stood silent until today. "Stay away from them lest you won't come back," is what the people say.

text.SESontaire: I understand there's been strange activity near the obelisks around the Isles.

text.SEEaril: Stay away from the obelisks! Strange things have appeared near them.

text.SEMuurine: Stay away from the obelisks! Strange things have appeared near them.

text.SECindanwe: The crystal obelisks that dot the Isles have recently started behaving strangely.

text.SEHalion: Run for your life and hide your head, the Knights of Order have returned. These soulless beings know naught else but death and now we all shall burn.

text.SESontaire: Knights of Order have appeared in the Isles. I hear they come from the obelisks.

text.SEEaril: Knights of Order have come to destroy the Realm!

text.SEMuurine: Knights of Order have come to destroy the Realm!

text.SECindanwe: I understand that the Hearts of Order you find on the Knights can be used to unlock special chests.

text.SEHalion: When the sun has left the sky, to the Choosy Beggar I would fly.

text.SESontaire: Raven-Biter runs the Choosy Beggar. Not a bad place.

text.SEEaril: You can stay at the Choosy Beggar in Bliss, but I wouldn't.

text.SEMuurine: You can stay at the Choosy Beggar in Bliss, but I wouldn't.

text.SEHalion: At Common Treasures you can find enough bits and bobs to last all of time.

text.SESontaire: Tilse Areleth has quite a collection of things for sale at Common Treasures.

text.SEEaril: Common Treasures is full of junk. That's all Tilse Areleth collects.

text.SEMuurine: Common Treasures is full of junk. That's all Tilse Areleth collects.

text.SEHalion: To the Missing Pauldron you should go for superior armor to thwart your foe.

text.SESontaire: The best armor in the city is at The Missing Pauldron.

text.SEEaril: I'm not about to go to the Missing Pauldron, even if they do sell armor. I'll stay in Crucible, thank you.

text.SEMuurine: I'm not about to go to the Missing Pauldron, even if they do sell armor. I'll stay in Crucible, thank you.

text.SEHalion: If you're hungry to read a lustful story, find Sontaire at Books of Bliss and check her inventory.

text.SEEaril: Sontaire may sell a lot of books, but that's not why the men visit her.

text.SEMuurine: Sontaire may sell a lot of books, but that's not why the men visit her.

text.SEHalion: To Cutter's in Crucible you should go for bladed weapons to thwart your foe.

text.SESontaire: Cutter sells weapons in Crucible, but you won't catch me going there.

text.SEEaril: I'd buy my weapons at Cutter's. She has... a way with blades.

text.SEMuurine: I'd buy my weapons at Cutter's. She has... a way with blades.

text.SEHalion: In Crucible you'll find a place, a museum with all manner of things. A reward you'll get if to this place something strange and new you bring.

text.SESontaire: That Museum of Oddities is a joke, although I hear Una Armina will pay for certain items.

text.SEEaril: You should stop by the Museum of Oddities. I understand Una is always looking for more items to display.

text.SEMuurine: You should stop by the Museum of Oddities. I understand Una is always looking for more items to display.

text.SEHalion: If spells and magic are what you seek, head to Earil's Mysteries and take a peek.

text.SESontaire: I'd research my own spells before I'd buy them from Earil's Mysteries.

text.SEMuurine: Earil's Mysteries sells a number of unique spells. Doesn't sell any mysteries, though.

text.SEHalion: Something lost upon the ground? It's likely to show up at Ahjazda's Things Found.

text.SESontaire: Things Found? More like Things Found in the Trash.

text.SEEaril: You can find some good deals at Things Found. Ahjazda has an interesting collection.

text.SEMuurine: You can find some good deals at Things Found. Ahjazda has an interesting collection.

text.SEHalion: If at Sickly Bernice's Taphouse you wish to drink, take a moment to stop and think.

text.SESontaire: I wouldn't be caught dead at Sickly Bernice's... though I imagine her customers might.

text.SEEaril: Sickly Bernice's isn't a bad place. Just make sure to wash your hands.

text.SEMuurine: Sickly Bernice's isn't a bad place. Just make sure to wash your hands.

text.SEHalion: If Madness Ore or Amber you should unearth, bring them to New Sheoth to discover their worth.

text.SESontaire: Dumag gro-Bonk at The Missing Pauldron is collecting that Amber you find in the root tunnels.

text.SEEaril: I hear Cutter collects the Madness Ore to turn into armor.

text.SEMuurine: I hear Cutter collects the Madness Ore to turn into armor.

text.SECindanwe: There are smiths in New Sheoth that collect Amber and Madness Ore.

text.SEHalion: If your journey takes you to Vitharn, beware its undead hosts. From what I hear the place is a tomb, and the only thing there are ghosts.

text.SESontaire: I've heard ghosts haunt the ruined city of Vitharn.

text.SEEaril: Stay away from Vitharn. It's said the dead walk there.

text.SEMuurine: Stay away from Vitharn. It's said the dead walk there.

text.SECindanwe: Take care venturing into the ruined city of Vitharn.

text.SEHalion: If your journey takes you to the settlement Hale be sure to speak with Pyke. He is a most unusual knight, whose story you might like.

text.SESontaire: I understand there's a Knight of the Thorn in Hale.

text.SEEaril: Pyke, the Knight of the Thorn, lives in Hale.

text.SEMuurine: Pyke, the Knight of the Thorn, lives in Hale.

text.SECindanwe: If you visit Hale, you may see Pyke, a Knight of the Thorn.

text.SEHalion: Of the bumbling thief by the name of Brithaur of this I can only say. The man named Earil who owns a shop wishes he would go away.

text.SESontaire: The merchants in Crucible are getting tired of Brithaur stealing from them.

text.SEEaril: Everyone is tired of Brithaur's antics.

text.SEMuurine: Everyone is tired of Brithaur's antics.

text.SECindanwe: I understand the merchants of Crucible are having problems with Brithaur.

text.SEHalion: If you happen upon a lonely soul who goes by the name of Hirrus, take his word as truth be told, I'm afraid he is deadly serious.

text.SESontaire: I understand Hirrus Clutumnus is begging for people to kill him.

text.SEEaril: Someone should put Hirrus Clutumnus out of his misery.

text.SEMuurine: Someone should put Hirrus Clutumnus out of his misery.

text.SECindanwe: In Crucible, a man named Hirrus Clutumnus has been trying to convince people to kill him.

text.SEHalion: If you ever find yourself in Highcross, to Mirili you should speak. It isn't treasure that she wants, it's knowledge that she seeks.

text.SESontaire: I've heard there's someone in Highcross trying to catalogue every living thing in the Isles.

text.SEEaril: Mirili Ulven in Highcross thinks she can catalogue every creature in the Isles.

text.SEMuurine: Mirili Ulven in Highcross thinks she can catalogue every creature in the Isles.

text.SECindanwe: If you visit Highcross, speak with Mirili Ulven. She needs help with her project.

text.SEHalion: In Crucible you'll find a place, a museum with all manner of things. A reward you'll get if to this place something strange and new you bring.

text.SESontaire: I don't visit the Museum of Oddities, but Una Armina is always looking for new items to display.

text.SEEaril: If you find something unique, it's worth checking with Una Armina.

text.SEMuurine: If you find something unique, it's worth checking with Una Armina.

text.SEHalion: Of Fellmoor I can say only this; you should keep far away. Any other place but that dismal town I'd recommend you stay.

text.SESontaire: Cindanwe runs a tight ship in Fellmoor.

text.SEEaril: The workers in Fellmoor aren't too happy with Cindanwe.

text.SEMuurine: The workers in Fellmoor aren't too happy with Cindanwe.

text.SEHalion: There is a man in Bliss who feels his doom comes soon. Some say he's wrong and others say he's right, but I say he's a loon.

text.SESontaire: Amiable Fanriene thinks his house is going to fall in on him.

text.SEEaril: That Amiable Fanriene is afraid of his own shadow.

text.SEMuurine: That Amiable Fanriene is afraid of his own shadow.

text.SECindanwe: There's a man in Bliss who believes his own house will collapse around him.

text.SEHalion: In Crucible lives poor Bernice, she's sick I think you'll find. But is it really illness, or is it all just in her mind?

text.SESontaire: Sickly Bernice is convinced she's dying. No wonder no one wants to eat at her Taphouse.

text.SEEaril: Sickly Bernice is always looking for a miracle cure.

text.SEMuurine: Sickly Bernice is always looking for a miracle cure.

text.SECindanwe: Sickly Bernice in Crucible believes she is dying.

text.SEHalion: Of Tove in Bliss I tell you this, there's something that she desires. She builds and builds and builds all night until her weary bones retire.

text.SESontaire: I heard Tove the Unrestful is building something again.

text.SEEaril: Tove the Unrestful in Bliss is collecting useless items to build something.

text.SEMuurine: Tove the Unrestful in Bliss is collecting useless items to build something.

text.SECindanwe: Tove the Unrestful in Bliss is collecting items to build something.

text.SEHalion: There is an Orc in Crucible who's deathly afraid of cats. Can you believe such a hulking brute would be scared of something like that?

text.SESontaire: Ushnar in Crucible is afraid of cats. Cats!

text.SEEaril: Ushnar is deathly afraid of cats. He makes sure to keep dogs around because of it.

text.SEMuurine: Ushnar is deathly afraid of cats. He makes sure to keep dogs around because of it.

text.SECindanwe: There's an orc in Crucible who is deathly afraid of cats.

text.SEHalion: Ahjazda in Crucible believes the world is ending. She seeks all sorts of items to weather the storm portending.

text.SESontaire: Ahjazda in Crucible believes the world is ending.

text.SEEaril: Ahjazda thinks the world is ending tomorrow. She's been saving magic items just in case.

text.SEMuurine: Ahjazda thinks the world is ending tomorrow. She's been saving magic items just in case.

text.SECindanwe: There is a Khajiit in Crucible who believes the world is about to end.

text.SEHalion: If you find a special Fork to Big-Head you should go. He isn't the sharpest blade in the drawer; you have more smarts within your toe.

text.SESontaire: Poor Big Head will never find the Fork of Horripilation.

text.SEEaril: That fool Big Head is always looking for the Fork of Horripilation.

text.SEMuurine: That fool Big Head is always looking for the Fork of Horripilation.

text.SECindanwe: The Argonian Big Head is always searching for the Fork of Horripilation.

text.SESontaire: Every resident of Split has a double living in the town.

text.SEHalion: There is a place in the Isles that goes by the name Split. If you think everyone there is unique, you don't know the half of it.

text.SEEaril: Every person in Split has been divided into their Manic and Demented halves.

text.SEMuurine: Every person in Split has been divided into their Manic and Demented halves.

text.SECindanwe: There are two of everything in Split. Even the residents.

text.Generic HighElf Male: Those wanted posters of the Gray Fox are everywhere.

text.Generic HighElf Female: Those wanted posters of the Gray Fox are everywhere.

text.Generic HighElf Male: Did you hear that someone broke into an Imperial Legion post and stole the taxes they collected from the Waterfront?

text.Generic HighElf Female: Did you hear that someone broke into an Imperial Legion post and stole the taxes they collected from the Waterfront?

text.Generic HighElf Male: Captain Lex blames the Gray Fox for stealing the tax collection. He wants a bounty put on the Gray Fox, but the Legion Commander has refused.

text.Generic HighElf Female: Captain Lex blames the Gray Fox for stealing the tax collection. He wants a bounty put on the Gray Fox, but the Legion Commander has refused.

text.Generic HighElf Male: Have you heard? Someone desecrated the tomb of Llathasa. No wonder her ghost haunts that place.

text.Generic HighElf Female: Have you heard? Someone desecrated the tomb of Llathasa. No wonder her ghost haunts that place.
One of the castle staff was murdered trying to stop a thief.

text.Generic HighElf Male: I heard that thieves broke into the Arcane University, the Imperial Legion Compound, and the Temple, all on the same night!

text.Generic HighElf Female: I heard that thieves broke into the Arcane University, the Imperial Legion Compound, and the Temple, all on the same night!

text.Generic HighElf Male: Someone told me that Hieronymus Lex is gone. Reassigned to Anvil. That can't be true!

text.Generic HighElf Female: Someone told me that Hieronymus Lex is gone. Reassigned to Anvil. That can't be true!
Is there a new Captain of the guard? I thought I saw him walking the rounds.

text.Generic HighElf Male: I heard that someone broke into the wizard's tower. What kind of a fool would take on Fathis Aren?

text.Generic HighElf Female: I heard that someone broke into the wizard's tower. What kind of a fool would take on Fathis Aren?

text.Generic HighElf Male: The Earl of Imbel was attacked and killed in his own home. I heard the body burned in the sunlight.

text.Generic HighElf Female: The Earl of Imbel was attacked and killed in his own home. I heard the body burned in the sunlight.

text.Generic HighElf Male: They say a thief actually stole one of the Elder Scrolls from the Imperial Library. Who would have thought it was even possible?

text.Generic HighElf Female: They say a thief actually stole one of the Elder Scrolls from the Imperial Library. Who would have thought it was even possible?

text.Generic HighElf Male: I saw Ugak gra-Mogakh earlier. At least, I think it was her. Perhaps it was her sister.
Mog gra-Mogakh runs a fine establishment at the Two Sisters Lodge. And her sister has some quality horses.
Maybe it's just me, but I find Falanu Hlaalu really odd. And I've seen him hanging around the graveyard with a strange smile on his face.
I don't know if Tumindil ever leaves the chapel. That man works day and night to take care of all of us.
I suppose Count Hassildor keeps Skingrad running smoothly, but you hardly ever see the man.
I hope nobody tries to get away with anything when Captain Dion is around. He's a tough customer.
I heard Ah-Mahlz was out hunting goblins again. Good. They're vermin.
Parwen has really got a thing for goblins. I think she and Ah-Malz keep a running tally of who has killed more.
If you don't know much about Mysticism, Druja is a good person to talk to. She's at the Mages Guild.
I smelled a strange odor coming from the Mages Guild yesterday. Erthor must have been doing another experiment.
I love walking by Salmo's place. The smell of her bread baking is amazing.
You know, if you need to get better at archery, you should talk to Reman Broder. He's quite a good shot.
Bernadette Peneles works over at the Tamika Winery. They make a quality wine there.
I bought some wine from Davide Surilie. Excellent body. He's a fine vintner.
Tamika makes some truly fine wines at her winery. I think they're every bit as good as the Surilie Brothers wines.
I don't know that anyone in Cyrodiil drives a harder bargain than Palonirya at Divine Elegance.

text.Generic HighElf Female: I don't know that anyone in Cyrodiil drives a harder bargain than Palonirya at Divine Elegance.

text.Generic HighElf Male: The King and Queen Tavern isn't a bad place to stay if you're visiting the city.

text.Generic HighElf Female: The King and Queen Tavern isn't a bad place to stay if you're visiting the city.

text.Generic HighElf Male: I understand old Dovyn Aren can still teach a bit about Alteration.

text.Generic HighElf Female: I understand old Dovyn Aren can still teach a bit about Alteration.

text.Generic HighElf Male: Othrelos is a sneaky one. Kind of makes you wonder what he's up to.

text.Generic HighElf Female: Othrelos is a sneaky one. Kind of makes you wonder what he's up to.

text.Generic HighElf Male: Samuel Bantien used to be a wild one. They say he used to be quite the "locksmith."

text.Generic HighElf Female: Samuel Bantien used to be a wild one. They say he used to be quite the "locksmith."

text.Generic HighElf Male: A lot of mages swear by Rindir's Staffs.

text.Generic HighElf Female: A lot of mages swear by Rindir's Staffs.

text.Generic HighElf Male: If you need to get rid of something quickly, check out the Copious Coinpurse.

text.Generic HighElf Female: If you need to get rid of something quickly, check out the Copious Coinpurse.

text.Generic HighElf Male: I needed some cash, so I went to see Jensine.

text.Generic HighElf Female: I needed some cash, so I went to see Jensine.

text.Generic HighElf Male: Calindil runs a nice place at the Mystic Emporium.

text.Generic HighElf Female: Calindil runs a nice place at the Mystic Emporium.

text.Generic HighElf Male: If you need light armor, talk to Maro Rufus at The Best Defense.

text.Generic HighElf Female: If you need light armor, talk to Maro Rufus at The Best Defense.

text.Generic HighElf Male: Vinivia Melissaeia takes all the merchant complaints in the city.

text.Generic HighElf Female: Vinivia Melissaeia takes all the merchant complaints in the city.

text.Generic HighElf Male: There are some quality books at Mach-Na's. Just don't catch him when he's in a bad mood.

text.Generic HighElf Female: There are some quality books at Mach-Na's. Just don't catch him when he's in a bad mood.

text.Generic HighElf Male: Gruiand Garrana can talk her way out of anything. Of course, all she usually talks about is herself.

text.Generic HighElf Female: Gruiand Garrana can talk her way out of anything. Of course, all she usually talks about is herself.

text.Generic HighElf Male: Naspia Cosma is really skilled with her blade. It's a shame she doesn't compete in the Arena.

text.Generic HighElf Female: Naspia Cosma is really skilled with her blade. It's a shame she doesn't compete in the Arena.

text.Generic HighElf Male: Ganredhel sure does have a knack for training dogs. I've heard that she will train people as well, for a price.

text.Generic HighElf Female: Ganredhel sure does have a knack for training dogs. I've heard that she will train people as well, for a price.

text.Generic HighElf Male: Jerall View is a nice place for visitors to stay. Hafid makes everyone feel welcome.

text.Karinnarre: Jerall View is a nice place for visitors to stay. Hafid makes everyone feel welcome.

text.Generic HighElf Male: Poor Olfand. I don't know how he manages to live with Skjorta.

text.Karinnarre: Poor Olfand. I don't know how he manages to live with Skjorta.

text.Generic HighElf Male: I've heard Right-Wind is good with a blade. No wonder he's in the Fighters Guild.

text.Karinnarre: I've heard Right-Wind is good with a blade. No wonder he's in the Fighters Guild.

text.Generic HighElf Male: Don't get on J'skar's bad side. You'll likely get a fireball in your face for your troubles.

text.Karinnarre: Don't get on J'skar's bad side. You'll likely get a fireball in your face for your troubles.

text.Generic HighElf Male: Rumor has it that Edla Dark-Heart left Skyrim with the law right behind her.

text.Karinnarre: Rumor has it that Edla Dark-Heart left Skyrim with the law right behind her.

text.Generic HighElf Male: I don't think that Gilgondrin really wants to run Silverhome-on-the-Water. He never seems happy when he's there.

text.Generic HighElf Female: I don't think that Gilgondrin really wants to run Silverhome-on-the-Water. He never seems happy when he's there.

text.Generic HighElf Male: I'm glad Marz lives here in Bravil. She's an excellent healer.

text.Generic HighElf Female: I'm glad Marz lives here in Bravil. She's an excellent healer.

text.Generic HighElf Male: I understand Tadrose Helas has more jobs than she knows what to do with. She's very eager to help out her guild.

text.Generic HighElf Female: I understand Tadrose Helas has more jobs than she knows what to do with. She's very eager to help out her guild.

text.Generic HighElf Male: Seems to me that Ardaline has an admirer in Varon Vamori.

text.Generic HighElf Female: Seems to me that Ardaline has an admirer in Varon Vamori.

text.Generic HighElf Male: Varon Vamori really has a silver tongue.

text.Generic HighElf Female: Varon Vamori really has a silver tongue.

text.Generic HighElf Male: She doesn't leave home much, but apparently Luciana Galena has a lot of experience fighting in light armor.

text.Generic HighElf Female: She doesn't leave home much, but apparently Luciana Galena has a lot of experience fighting in light armor.
The Three Sisters Inn is a nice place, but that Shuravi sure is grumpy. I don't think she likes anyone.
The Dividing Line is a good place to buy a sharp blade. Of course, you're likely to hear some of Tun-Zeeus' stories if you hang around.
I've heard that Dagail knows a lot about Mysticism. And sheep.
Have you spoken to Wilbur at the Count's Arms? He knows a lot about fine wines.
I've heard Azzan can sign you up for the Fighters Guild. That's someone I wouldn't mind working for.
I understand that Vigdis at the Fighters Guild has some skill with blunt weapons. He's been training other Fighters Guild members.

text.MS93Varulae: I understand Carahil knows more about Illusion than any other mage in Anvil. Of course, she only shares that knowledge with the Mages Guild.

text.Generic HighElf Female: Mirabelle Monet is quite a woman. Ask any of the sailors down at the Fo'c's'le.
The shipmaster, Heinrich Oaken-Hull, has a wood elf for a wife. I'd rather sleep with my horse.
I've never read any of Quill-Weave's writings. I've heard they're fairly good, though.

text.Generic HighElf Male: I found some good pauldrons at the armorer.

text.Generic HighElf Female: I found some good pauldrons at the armorer.

text.Generic HighElf Male: The Grey Mare isn't a bad place to stay, especially if you're low on Septims.

text.Generic HighElf Female: The Grey Mare isn't a bad place to stay, especially if you're low on Septims.

text.Generic HighElf Male: Been to Fire and Steel recently? Rasheda has some nice new swords in there. And she's a friendly one, she is.

text.Generic HighElf Female: Been to Fire and Steel recently? Rasheda has some nice new swords in there. And she's a friendly one, she is.

text.Honditar: I'd like to learn more about spellcasting. Might have to head over to the Mages Guild and see if they're accepting new members.

text.Generic HighElf Female: I'd like to learn more about spellcasting. Might have to head over to the Mages Guild and see if they're accepting new members.

text.Generic HighElf Male: I'm not so sure about that Eugal Belette. An odd fellow, and people have said there are strange noises coming from his house at all hours.

text.Generic HighElf Female: I'm not so sure about that Eugal Belette. An odd fellow, and people have said there are strange noises coming from his house at all hours.

text.Generic HighElf Male: I can't believe that Glistel would live with that Malintus Ancrus. Shameful, and her being such a lovely girl.

text.Generic HighElf Female: I can't believe that Glistel would live with that Malintus Ancrus. Shameful, and her being such a lovely girl.

text.Generic HighElf Male: Sometimes I just go look at the Great Oak. Magnificent, don't you think?

text.Generic HighElf Female: Sometimes I just go look at the Great Oak. Magnificent, don't you think?

text.Generic HighElf Male: I lived in the Imperial City for a while, but city life just isn't for me. I'm much happier in Chorrol.

text.Generic HighElf Female: I lived in the Imperial City for a while, but city life just isn't for me. I'm much happier in Chorrol.

text.Generic HighElf Male: Don't get too many folks passing through here these days.

text.Generic HighElf Female: Don't get too many folks passing through here these days.

text.Generic HighElf Male: Ancient Wayshrines of the Nine are scattered through the wilderness. The righteous who pray there receive powerful divine blessings.

text.Generic HighElf Female: Ancient Wayshrines of the Nine are scattered through the wilderness. The righteous who pray there receive powerful divine blessings.

text.Generic HighElf Male: If you've done good deeds, the Nine will bless you and cure diseases when you visit their wayshrines.

text.Generic HighElf Female: If you've done good deeds, the Nine will bless you and cure diseases when you visit their wayshrines.

text.Generic HighElf Male: Wayshrines of the Nine in the wilderness confer blessings on the righteous and faithful.

text.Generic HighElf Female: Wayshrines of the Nine in the wilderness confer blessings on the righteous and faithful.

text.Generic HighElf Male: Those famous for good deeds may receive Blessings of Intelligence and Magicka when they visit Wayshrines of Julianos.

text.Generic HighElf Female: Those famous for good deeds may receive Blessings of Intelligence and Magicka when they visit Wayshrines of Julianos.

text.Generic HighElf Male: Virtuous visitors to Wayshrines of Kynareth may receive Blessings of Agility.

text.Generic HighElf Female: Virtuous visitors to Wayshrines of Kynareth may receive Blessings of Agility.

text.Generic HighElf Male: When you visit a Wayshrine of Zenithar, and you've lived a good life by the Nine, you may receive a Blessing of Luck.

text.Generic HighElf Female: When you visit a Wayshrine of Zenithar, and you've lived a good life by the Nine, you may receive a Blessing of Luck.

text.Generic HighElf Male: Those who live by the Commands of the Nine receive Blessings of Strength when they visit Wayshrines of Tiber Septim.

text.Generic HighElf Female: Those who live by the Commands of the Nine receive Blessings of Strength when they visit Wayshrines of Tiber Septim.

text.Generic HighElf Male: A good man who honors the Nine may visit the Wayshrines of Akatosh for Blessings of Speed and Magicka.

text.Generic HighElf Female: A good man who honors the Nine may visit the Wayshrines of Akatosh for Blessings of Speed and Magicka.

text.Generic HighElf Male: If you've been good, Wayshrines of Dibella may bless your Personality.

text.Generic HighElf Female: If you've been good, Wayshrines of Dibella may bless your Personality.

text.Generic HighElf Male: Wayshrines of Arkay confer Blessings of Health on those who've pleased the Nine by righteous acts.

text.Generic HighElf Female: Wayshrines of Arkay confer Blessings of Health on those who've pleased the Nine by righteous acts.

text.Generic HighElf Male: Please the Nine with good works, and visit Wayshrines of Stendarr for Blessings of Endurance.

text.Generic HighElf Female: Please the Nine with good works, and visit Wayshrines of Stendarr for Blessings of Endurance.

text.Generic HighElf Male: You've seen wayshrines in the wilderness? Those who've pleased the Nine may receive Blessings of Willpower at the Wayshrines of Mara.

text.Generic HighElf Female: You've seen wayshrines in the wilderness? Those who've pleased the Nine may receive Blessings of Willpower at the Wayshrines of Mara.

text.Generic HighElf Male: The Heartlands and Nibenean Valley are the agricultural breadbaskets of Cyrodiil.

text.Generic HighElf Female: The Heartlands and Nibenean Valley are the agricultural breadbaskets of Cyrodiil.

text.Generic HighElf Male: Where does our food come from? The Heartlands. And the Nibenean Valley. And Skingrad? Great wines, cheeses, and tomatoes.

text.Generic HighElf Female: Where does our food come from? The Heartlands. And the Nibenean Valley. And Skingrad? Great wines, cheeses, and tomatoes.

text.Generic HighElf Male: The lowlands of the Great Forest rise to the upland plateau of the Colovian West.

text.Generic HighElf Female: The lowlands of the Great Forest rise to the upland plateau of the Colovian West.

text.Generic HighElf Male: The Great Forest was cleared for agriculture around Lake Rumare, but it's mostly wilderness outside of that.

text.Generic HighElf Female: The Great Forest was cleared for agriculture around Lake Rumare, but it's mostly wilderness outside of that.

text.Generic HighElf Male: The Colovian Highlands are barren wastelands along the border with Hammerfell.

text.Generic HighElf Female: The Colovian Highlands are barren wastelands along the border with Hammerfell.

text.Generic HighElf Male: The Colovian Highlands? Near the Hammerfell border? No one lives there. That's barren wastelands.

text.Generic HighElf Female: The Colovian Highlands? Near the Hammerfell border? No one lives there. That's barren wastelands.

text.Generic HighElf Male: High mountain ranges rise to the borders in the north and east, and marshes and rainforests extend to the southeast borders.

text.Generic HighElf Female: High mountain ranges rise to the borders in the north and east, and marshes and rainforests extend to the southeast borders.

text.Generic HighElf Male: It's our natural barriers that keep us safe, mostly. Mountain borders north and east, open sea to the west, and bogs and rainforest to south.

text.Generic HighElf Female: It's our natural barriers that keep us safe, mostly. Mountain borders north and east, open sea to the west, and bogs and rainforest to south.

text.Generic HighElf Male: Cyrodiil is surrounded to the north and east by the lofty Jerall and Valus mountain ranges.

text.Generic HighElf Female: Cyrodiil is surrounded to the north and east by the lofty Jerall and Valus mountain ranges.

text.Generic HighElf Male: No one wants to live in the Jerall Mountains. Well, maybe in Bruma, but they're like Nords. They don't feel the cold.

text.Generic HighElf Female: No one wants to live in the Jerall Mountains. Well, maybe in Bruma, but they're like Nords. They don't feel the cold.

text.Generic HighElf Male: Western Cyrodiil is called 'Colovia,' and includes the Gold Coast, West Weald, and Colovian Highlands regions.

text.Generic HighElf Female: Western Cyrodiil is called 'Colovia,' and includes the Gold Coast, West Weald, and Colovian Highlands regions.

text.Generic HighElf Male: In the west, in Old Colovia, that's where men are men. That's the Gold Coast, West Weald, and Colovian Highlands.

text.Generic HighElf Female: In the west, in Old Colovia, that's where men are men. That's the Gold Coast, West Weald, and Colovian Highlands.

text.Generic HighElf Male: Nibenay is a region of mixed farmland, parkland, and forest.

text.Generic HighElf Female: Nibenay is a region of mixed farmland, parkland, and forest.

text.Generic HighElf Male: With all the farms in Nibenay, there's still plenty of forest and wilderness open for settlement.

text.Generic HighElf Female: With all the farms in Nibenay, there's still plenty of forest and wilderness open for settlement.

text.Generic HighElf Male: Nibenay is bordered on north and east by rugged mountains and to the south by marshes and rainforest.

text.Generic HighElf Female: Nibenay is bordered on north and east by rugged mountains and to the south by marshes and rainforest.

text.Generic HighElf Male: The people of Nibenay consider themselves to be more civilized and sophisticated than Colovians.

text.Generic HighElf Female: The people of Nibenay consider themselves to be more civilized and sophisticated than Colovians.

text.Generic HighElf Male: I'm not saying Colovians are dumb. They're just hard-headed.

text.Generic HighElf Female: I'm not saying Colovians are dumb. They're just hard-headed.

text.Generic HighElf Male: The Nibeneans think they're slick. 'Slippery' is more like it.

text.Generic HighElf Female: The Nibeneans think they're slick. 'Slippery' is more like it.

text.Generic HighElf Male: Colovia is a land of rugged wastes and highland forests.

text.Generic HighElf Female: Colovia is a land of rugged wastes and highland forests.

text.Generic HighElf Male: Colovia is dotted with isolated farms and settlements, with most of the population in the coastal margin.

text.Generic HighElf Female: Colovia is dotted with isolated farms and settlements, with most of the population in the coastal margin.

text.Generic HighElf Male: The Colovians are proud of their reputation for being independent, rough, and rebellious.

text.Generic HighElf Female: The Colovians are proud of their reputation for being independent, rough, and rebellious.

text.Generic HighElf Male: The Imperial City is located on a large island surrounded by Lake Rumare.

text.Generic HighElf Female: The Imperial City is located on a large island surrounded by Lake Rumare.

text.Generic HighElf Male: The Imperial City is densely urbanized, with a few large parks and waterside dock areas.

text.Generic HighElf Female: The Imperial City is densely urbanized, with a few large parks and waterside dock areas.

text.Generic HighElf Male: The Imperial City itself is a walled city, with separate inner walls protecting the Imperial palace.

text.Generic HighElf Female: The Imperial City itself is a walled city, with separate inner walls protecting the Imperial palace.

text.Generic HighElf Male: The prettiest town in Cyrodiil? Don't know, but the ugliest is Bravil. Shabby, tumbledown shacks. They're big shacks, though.

text.Generic HighElf Female: The prettiest town in Cyrodiil? Don't know, but the ugliest is Bravil. Shabby, tumbledown shacks. They're big shacks, though.
