text.Generic HighElf Male: Where to buy weapons? Where to buy anything, if you can afford to travel, is the Market District in the Imperial City.

text.Generic HighElf Female: Where to buy weapons? Where to buy anything, if you can afford to travel, is the Market District in the Imperial City.

text.Generic HighElf Male: My favorite town? Anvil. Lovely old stone buildings, and the harbor at sunset is beautiful.

text.Generic HighElf Female: My favorite town? Anvil. Lovely old stone buildings, and the harbor at sunset is beautiful.

text.Generic HighElf Male: Ayleid ruins? The big thing is to watch out for the traps. Thousands of years old, and still working. Amazing.

text.Generic HighElf Female: Ayleid ruins? The big thing is to watch out for the traps. Thousands of years old, and still working. Amazing.

text.Generic HighElf Male: I've seen plenty of Ayleid ruins. You'd think they'd be picked clean after 2000 years, but, no, there's still great treasures there.

text.Generic HighElf Female: I've seen plenty of Ayleid ruins. You'd think they'd be picked clean after 2000 years, but, no, there's still great treasures there.

text.Generic HighElf Male: It's still pretty wild east of the Niben. Few people, except for bandits, but at least it hasn't been picked clean by treasure-hunters.

text.Generic HighElf Female: It's still pretty wild east of the Niben. Few people, except for bandits, but at least it hasn't been picked clean by treasure-hunters.

text.Generic HighElf Male: Nobody goes into the mountains but hunters and thieves on the lam. Food and shelter is hard to come by.

text.Generic HighElf Female: Nobody goes into the mountains but hunters and thieves on the lam. Food and shelter is hard to come by.

text.Generic HighElf Male: Blackwood isn't so bad, once you get used to the flies. And being lost all the time. And the zombies and will-o-the-wisps.

text.Generic HighElf Female: Blackwood isn't so bad, once you get used to the flies. And being lost all the time. And the zombies and will-o-the-wisps.

text.Generic HighElf Male: There's islands in Niben Bay no one has visited in a hundred years. No telling what you'll find.

text.Generic HighElf Female: There's islands in Niben Bay no one has visited in a hundred years. No telling what you'll find.

text.Generic HighElf Male: Well, it's no problem traveling from the Imperial City to Leyawiin... if you're a wizard and can walk on water. I'd stay off the roads, though.

text.Generic HighElf Female: Well, it's no problem traveling from the Imperial City to Leyawiin... if you're a wizard and can walk on water. I'd stay off the roads, though.

text.Generic HighElf Male: If you're all alone in the woods and you see a troll coming, you run. Problem solved. Next question?

text.Generic HighElf Female: If you're all alone in the woods and you see a troll coming, you run. Problem solved. Next question?

text.Generic HighElf Male: Fighting's easy. Just lead them out on the water and shoot them full of holes. If you've got a bow, of course, and can walk on water.

text.Generic HighElf Female: Fighting's easy. Just lead them out on the water and shoot them full of holes. If you've got a bow, of course, and can walk on water.

text.Generic HighElf Male: The Arena's faked. You think those guys are getting killed? Really? It's just berry syrup and ham-acting.

text.Generic HighElf Female: The Arena's faked. You think those guys are getting killed? Really? It's just berry syrup and ham-acting.

text.Generic HighElf Male: Have you ever met anyone who got rich betting on the Arena? Didn't think so.

text.Generic HighElf Female: Have you ever met anyone who got rich betting on the Arena? Didn't think so.

text.Generic HighElf Male: The Council runs the Arena to amuse the masses, and it pays for itself, with all the fools who lose their shirts gambling.

text.Generic HighElf Female: The Council runs the Arena to amuse the masses, and it pays for itself, with all the fools who lose their shirts gambling.

text.Generic HighElf Male: If you're on a road, you can usually outrun anything. If you're in good shape, and not wearing a tin suit.

text.Generic HighElf Female: If you're on a road, you can usually outrun anything. If you're in good shape, and not wearing a tin suit.

text.Generic HighElf Male: Orcs don't ride horses. They eat horses. And sometimes I think they're the smart ones. Wait, maybe it's Dunmer who eat horses.

text.Generic HighElf Female: Orcs don't ride horses. They eat horses. And sometimes I think they're the smart ones. Wait, maybe it's Dunmer who eat horses.

text.Generic HighElf Male: Take Cheydinhal, for example. Pretty little town. But the Count's a Dark Elf, and it's crawling with Orc thugs and gangsters.

text.Generic HighElf Female: Take Cheydinhal, for example. Pretty little town. But the Count's a Dark Elf, and it's crawling with Orc thugs and gangsters.

text.Generic HighElf Male: The lands surrounding Lake Rumare are studded with small settlements, farms, and woodland game reserves.

text.Generic HighElf Female: The lands surrounding Lake Rumare are studded with small settlements, farms, and woodland game reserves.

text.Generic HighElf Male: The Nibenay Basin grades from rolling farmlands by the river east to the rugged uplands of the Valus Mountains.

text.Generic HighElf Female: The Nibenay Basin grades from rolling farmlands by the river east to the rugged uplands of the Valus Mountains.

text.Generic HighElf Male: On Cyrodiil's northern border is the sparsely populated mountain wilderness called the Valus Mountains.

text.Generic HighElf Female: On Cyrodiil's northern border is the sparsely populated mountain wilderness called the Valus Mountains.

text.Generic HighElf Male: You can't be too careful out in the wilderness. Almost any creature you find is liable to give you a disease.

text.Generic HighElf Female: You can't be too careful out in the wilderness. Almost any creature you find is liable to give you a disease.

text.Generic HighElf Male: Watch yourself around goblins. Some of the nastier ones will toss spells at you.

text.Generic HighElf Female: Watch yourself around goblins. Some of the nastier ones will toss spells at you.

text.Generic HighElf Male: Imps. I hate 'em. Little buggers flitting around, tossing fireballs at you!

text.Generic HighElf Female: Imps. I hate 'em. Little buggers flitting around, tossing fireballs at you!

text.Generic HighElf Male: I saw a wraith once. It threw a curse on me I'll never forget.

text.Generic HighElf Female: I saw a wraith once. It threw a curse on me I'll never forget.

text.Generic HighElf Male: Have you seen a land dreugh? We call them "Billies." Don't know why. Steer clear of them, though.

text.Generic HighElf Female: Have you seen a land dreugh? We call them "Billies." Don't know why. Steer clear of them, though.

text.Generic HighElf Male: I ran across a ghost once. Seemed to suck the energy right out of me.

text.Generic HighElf Female: I ran across a ghost once. Seemed to suck the energy right out of me.

text.Generic HighElf Male: Watch for minotaurs in the forests. Aggressive beasts. They'll tear right through your armor, too.

text.Generic HighElf Female: Watch for minotaurs in the forests. Aggressive beasts. They'll tear right through your armor, too.

text.Generic HighElf Male: Mudcrabs. What's the point? Annoying buggers, though the meat isn't bad.

text.Generic HighElf Female: Mudcrabs. What's the point? Annoying buggers, though the meat isn't bad.

text.Generic HighElf Male: Only thing worse than an ogre is two ogres. Tough bastards, and spells seem to bounce right off of 'em.

text.Generic HighElf Female: Only thing worse than an ogre is two ogres. Tough bastards, and spells seem to bounce right off of 'em.

text.Generic HighElf Male: Is there anywhere in Tamriel you can avoid rats? Disease spreading little nuisances.

text.Generic HighElf Female: Is there anywhere in Tamriel you can avoid rats? Disease spreading little nuisances.

text.Generic HighElf Male: Best way to take out a skeleton is with a big weapon. Forget spells. Just smack them and watch the bones fly!

text.Generic HighElf Female: Best way to take out a skeleton is with a big weapon. Forget spells. Just smack them and watch the bones fly!

text.Generic HighElf Male: I might swim more if it weren't for the slaughterfish. Sharp teeth, and some carry disease.

text.Generic HighElf Female: I might swim more if it weren't for the slaughterfish. Sharp teeth, and some carry disease.

text.Generic HighElf Male: Spriggans. "Nature's guardians" my foot! Mean things. They'll curse you, or they might call a bear to tear you apart.

text.Generic HighElf Female: Spriggans. "Nature's guardians" my foot! Mean things. They'll curse you, or they might call a bear to tear you apart.

text.Generic HighElf Male: All that stuff about having to set trolls on fire is a bunch of hooey. They don't like fire, but a good sword will cut them up fine.

text.Generic HighElf Female: All that stuff about having to set trolls on fire is a bunch of hooey. They don't like fire, but a good sword will cut them up fine.

text.Generic HighElf Male: I don't even know what a will-o-the-wisp is, much less how to kill one. I think they're just swamp gas, myself.

text.Generic HighElf Female: I don't even know what a will-o-the-wisp is, much less how to kill one. I think they're just swamp gas, myself.

text.Generic HighElf Male: I don't like to think about zombies. Missing arms, legs, heads. They smell awful, and they're hard to kill.

text.Generic HighElf Female: I don't like to think about zombies. Missing arms, legs, heads. They smell awful, and they're hard to kill.

text.Generic HighElf Male: Try combining aloe vera leaves with some venison. It's said to have some restorative properties.

text.Generic HighElf Female: Try combining aloe vera leaves with some venison. It's said to have some restorative properties.

text.Generic HighElf Male: You can find Cairn Bolete growing in caves. They're said to mark the place someone has died.

text.Generic HighElf Female: You can find Cairn Bolete growing in caves. They're said to mark the place someone has died.

text.Generic HighElf Male: It's said that eating taproot can bring you good luck.

text.Generic HighElf Female: It's said that eating taproot can bring you good luck.

text.Generic HighElf Male: Make sure not to eat nightshade. It's very poisonous.

text.Generic HighElf Female: Make sure not to eat nightshade. It's very poisonous.

text.SESontaire: So, a newcomer may arrive in the Isles? I hope it's a guy and I hope he's cute. It's slim pickings around here.
Ohhh, the big strong adventurer killed the Gatekeeper. How interesting.
The only thing I know that resonates around here are the sounds from my bedchambers.
Why would Thadon need a stupid Chalice when he could simply have me as a refreshment?
Syl torturing her own staff? Kinky.
I would bet my life that the Great Torch isn't nearly as hot as I can get any man.
So, the mighty Syl has fallen. Well then, that's one less woman to worry about... more men for me!
Poor Thadon, he was such a handsome man... I enjoyed our midnight meetings. I hope the new ruler of Mania is ready for me.
The Fringe attacked? This may be our last day alive. Let's make the most of it.
Yes, I know the Gatekeeper is back, but so what? He's missing the best parts, so what's the point?
Army, eh? Ohhhh... that means it's time to play "interrogate the innocent female prisoner" again! Great.
Sheogorath gone? I'd check the bedchambers of every maiden in town... you'll find Him eventually.
Now that this is all over, I feel like celebrating. Care to take a number?

text.SEEaril: I've heard that there are new adventurers coming. I wonder what new discoveries they will bring to us.

text.SEMuurine: I hear there's someone trying to get into the Shivering Isles. It's all part of a plot to overthrow the Realm. You'll see.

text.SEEaril: It's a shame, really. The Gatekeeper was a beautiful specimen. Now he'll just rot and fade like everything else.

text.SEMuurine: The Gatekeeper's been killed, you know. Uncle Leo is most distressed, but I'm thrilled. Can't wait to find out who's behind it.

text.SEEaril: The Resonator of Judgment is fixed! How horrid! New adventurers mean new exhibits!

text.SEMuurine: So the Resonator is working. But who fixed it? Why was it broken in the first place? Why is no one asking these questions?

text.SEEaril: This Chalice of Reversal sounds like a horrid device. Who would want to spend their time under the effects of some... chemical?

text.SEMuurine: Thadon had outside help getting his Chalice back. Something sneaky going on there.

text.SEEaril: All this talk of torture has me thinking -- would it be possible to hold someone in time during their most painful moment?

text.SEMuurine: I had just been telling Uncle Leo that something big was coming, and now this conspiracy. And they thought me part of it!

text.SEEaril: So, the Torch is lit. Can a flame be captured in time? Would it still burn?

text.SEMuurine: My whole family is happy about the Torch being lit. Unless it's all part of some bit plot.

text.SEEaril: A new ruler of Dementia. Excellent. If I could only freeze this moment in time.

text.SEMuurine: A replacement for the Duchess of Dementia could put the wrong people in positions of power, if you get my drift.

text.SEEaril: Thadon has been replaced. It is a moment worth capturing forever.

text.SEMuurine: I heard Thadon is dead. Nothing wrong with that.

text.SEEaril: They say that invaders have come to the Shivering Isles. Of course, "they" say a lot of things, don't they?

text.SEMuurine: It's all tied together, I'm telling you. The Fringe, the weather we've been having, the price of cheese... it's all connected!

text.SEEaril: That flesh monstrosity that patrols the Fringe has been rebuilt. Better to let it stay dead if you ask me.

text.SEMuurine: There's a new Gatekeeper guarding the Realm. Uncle Leo thinks it's too little, too late, but I disagree.

text.SEEaril: If the newly restored armies need conscripts, I could be persuaded to enlist a few of my exhibits.

text.SEMuurine: Who would want an entire army destroyed, and for what purpose? I know there's something big going on.

text.SEEaril: The Madgod has vanished? Perhaps He simply stepped out of our time until the Greymarch passes.

text.SEMuurine: I know what the next sign is. You'll see it, mark my words. All efforts to save us will fail, because that's how this will all end.

text.SEEaril: The Greymarch is over, the war has been won, but at what cost? This timeline will never be the same.

text.SEMuurine: I suspect this whole Greymarch fiasco is a cover-up for something more sinister. I can't prove it just yet, though.

text.SECindanwe: Newcomers to the isles, you say? Bah! Unless they're here to work my farms, I couldn't care less.

text.SEHalion: A door has opened to the Realm, and a single man steps through. Will he come to us full of lies, or will his intentions be true?

text.SECindanwe: This business with the Gatekeeper is appalling. Can no one maintain order around here?

text.SEHalion: The great guardian is dead and gone, his spirit passed away. I wonder if the stranger and I shall cross paths soon some day.

text.SECindanwe: Everyone is talking about that damned Resonator of Judgment -- talking instead of working.

text.SEHalion: The Resonator sings again, drawing strangers near. Protecting us, our lives, our homes, and all that we hold dear.

text.SECindanwe: Honestly, who cares if that noble brat Thadon has his toy Chalice?

text.SEHalion: The cup of Thadon is back in hand, a vessel full of dew. It seems someone helped him find it, someone who is new.

text.SECindanwe: The petty worries of lords and dukes mean nothing to me. Syl could torture her entire court to death for all I care.

text.SEHalion: Once again, the Lady Syl strikes hard among her own. Her paranoia hasn't faded, in fact it's greatly grown.

text.SECindanwe: I hope everyone keeps working and doesn't take the time to go see the Great Torch.

text.SEHalion: The burning flame of the Great Torch casts a peaceful glow, but will the flame stay ablaze or will it one day go?

text.SECindanwe: A new ruler in Dementia is no reason to lay about.

text.SEHalion: The circle has completed, the Ritual has been done. A new leader sits upon the throne, the royal post is won.

text.SECindanwe: I don't expect anyone to be working any less just because of Thadon's death. Take a moment to mourn, then back to work.

text.SEHalion: The circle has completed, the Ritual has been done. A new leader sits upon the throne, the royal post is won.

text.SECindanwe: Attacks in Passwall? Invaders roaming the lands? You see, this is what happens when leadership is lax.

text.SEHalion: The Knights have returned with a vengeance, their blades stained with blood. Who will be able to stop them, to stem this deadly flood?

text.SECindanwe: I have to admit that when he's not dead, the Gatekeeper seems to do an excellent job. Perhaps Relan could learn from it.

text.SEHalion: Stronger than ever, and ever before. The new Gatekeeper is the ultimate ward.

text.SECindanwe: So, the armies have been restored. They'd better not show up here looking to procure my crops.

text.SEHalion: The Madgod's army has returned, their weapons primed to slay. Could this mean our downfall, or will we win the day?

text.SECindanwe: Just like Sheogorath to abandon us in our time of need. He has been ever fickle.

text.SEHalion: The Mad One has vanished from the Isles, fear sits heavy on the brow. All our hopes go with one, but can he save us now?

text.SECindanwe: I'm glad that this war business is over and done with. There are those of us who have work to do.

text.SEHalion: Now the day has ended, the battle has been won. A new day dawns on the Isles, the past has been undone.

text.Generic Imperial Male: You're talking to me, and I don't like you. Goodbye.

text.Generic Imperial Female: You're talking to me, and I don't like you. Goodbye.

text.Generic Imperial Male: I see no reason to talk to you.

text.Generic Imperial Female: I see no reason to talk to you.

text.Generic Imperial Male: I don't like you and don't want to talk to you.

text.Generic Imperial Female: I don't like you and don't want to talk to you.

text.Generic Imperial Male: I'm not listening to you. It's because I don't like you.

text.Generic Imperial Female: I'm not listening to you. It's because I don't like you.

text.Generic Imperial Male: You're still speaking. Stop.

text.Generic Imperial Female: You're still speaking. Stop.

text.Generic Imperial Male: At least now we have a name to put to our enemy. Mankar Camoran and the Mythic Dawn will pay for their foul crimes.

text.Jena: At least now we have a name to put to our enemy. Mankar Camoran and the Mythic Dawn will pay for their foul crimes.

text.Generic Imperial Male: The Mythic Dawn will never take Cloud Ruler Temple. Not while any Blade still draws breath.

text.Jena: The Mythic Dawn will never take Cloud Ruler Temple. Not while any Blade still draws breath.

text.Generic Imperial Male: The noose around Bruma is tightening. Now that the Mythic Dawn has learned Martin's location, we have to be prepared for the worst.

text.Jena: The noose around Bruma is tightening. Now that the Mythic Dawn has learned Martin's location, we have to be prepared for the worst.

text.Generic Imperial Male: The Battle of Bruma was a great victory! The Mythic Dawn have learned that we are not defenseless.

text.Jena: The Battle of Bruma was a great victory! The Mythic Dawn have learned that we are not defenseless.

text.Generic Imperial Male: Martin Septim will soon claim his rightful place at the head of the Empire, and the Blades will stand beside him.

text.Jena: Martin Septim will soon claim his rightful place at the head of the Empire, and the Blades will stand beside him.

text.Generic Imperial Male: The Emperor's death was a harsh lesson for all of us. We failed in our duty to the Dragonborn. It must not happen again.

text.Jena: The Emperor's death was a harsh lesson for all of us. We failed in our duty to the Dragonborn. It must not happen again.

text.Generic Imperial Male: Martin showed himself a true son of the Dragon Blood. But where does that leave us, with no Emperor to serve?

text.Jena: Martin showed himself a true son of the Dragon Blood. But where does that leave us, with no Emperor to serve?

text.Generic Imperial Male: With no Emperor to serve, the Blades now return to our ancient role. We will bide our time until the next Dragonborn arises.

text.Jena: With no Emperor to serve, the Blades now return to our ancient role. We will bide our time until the next Dragonborn arises.

text.Generic Imperial Male: Everyone's talking about the assassination, of course. Here. Take my copy of the new Black Horse Courier. Go ahead. Keep it.

text.Generic Imperial Female: Everyone's talking about the assassination, of course. Here. Take my copy of the new Black Horse Courier. Go ahead. Keep it.

text.Generic Imperial Male: Everyone's talking about the victory over Mehrunes Dagon! I can hardly believe that the great Oblivion Crisis is over.

text.Generic Imperial Female: Everyone's talking about the victory over Mehrunes Dagon! I can hardly believe that the great Oblivion Crisis is over.

text.Generic Imperial Male: Have you heard? That big galleon down at the Waterfront? Someone killed the captain! Right there on the ship!

text.Generic Imperial Female: Have you heard? That big galleon down at the Waterfront? Someone killed the captain! Right there on the ship!

text.Generic Imperial Male: Poor Gromm. I wonder what he'll do now that Baenlin is dead. Serving that old man was the joy of his life, or so I've heard.

text.Generic Imperial Female: Poor Gromm. I wonder what he'll do now that Baenlin is dead. Serving that old man was the joy of his life, or so I've heard.

text.Generic Imperial Male: Oh, have you heard? Old Baenlin is dead! They say he was murdered! Right in his own home!

text.Generic Imperial Female: Oh, have you heard? Old Baenlin is dead! They say he was murdered! Right in his own home!

text.Generic Imperial Male: Oh, have you heard? About old Baenlin? It was a horrible accident. A stuffed minotaur head fell off the wall and crushed him to death! Tragic...

text.Generic Imperial Female: Oh, have you heard? About old Baenlin? It was a horrible accident. A stuffed minotaur head fell off the wall and crushed him to death! Tragic...

text.Generic Imperial Male: Francois Motierre hasn't left his house in days. Hasn't come down to the tavern, refuses to have visitors. I think the man's gone batty.

text.Generic Imperial Female: Francois Motierre hasn't left his house in days. Hasn't come down to the tavern, refuses to have visitors. I think the man's gone batty.

text.Generic Imperial Male: You won't believe what's happened! Francois Motierre has been killed! Murdered by the Dark Brotherhood! It's true, I saw the body myself.

text.Generic Imperial Female: You won't believe what's happened! Francois Motierre has been killed! Murdered by the Dark Brotherhood! It's true, I saw the body myself.

text.Generic Imperial Male: A friend of mine is a member of the Legion. He said some Altmer nobleman was murdered, right here in the city! Faelian, I think his name was.

text.Generic Imperial Female: A friend of mine is a member of the Legion. He said some Altmer nobleman was murdered, right here in the city! Faelian, I think his name was.

text.Generic Imperial Male: They say there are a bunch of people holed up in Summitmist Manor. Locked in. Some kind of weird party or something.

text.Generic Imperial Female: They say there are a bunch of people holed up in Summitmist Manor. Locked in. Some kind of weird party or something.

text.Generic Imperial Male: Everyone in Summitmist Manor is dead! There was some kind of party that went horribly awry, or so I hear.

text.Generic Imperial Female: Everyone in Summitmist Manor is dead! There was some kind of party that went horribly awry, or so I hear.

text.Generic Imperial Male: Have you heard? Adamus Phillida has been killed! Murdered by the Dark Brotherhood!

text.Generic Imperial Female: Have you heard? Adamus Phillida has been killed! Murdered by the Dark Brotherhood!

text.Generic Imperial Male: So, Adamus Phillida is finally retiring from the Imperial Legion. Spent his life fighting the Dark Brotherhood. Time for a well-earned rest, I'd say.

text.Generic Imperial Female: So, Adamus Phillida is finally retiring from the Imperial Legion. Spent his life fighting the Dark Brotherhood. Time for a well-earned rest, I'd say.

text.Generic Imperial Male: Oh, how horrible! You know Caelia Draconis? That nice Watch officer stationed at the castle? She's been murdered!

text.Generic Imperial Female: Oh, how horrible! You know Caelia Draconis? That nice Watch officer stationed at the castle? She's been murdered!

text.Generic Imperial Male: Hey, did you hear about that murder in the Talos Plaza District? I think the man's name was Draconis. Yeah, cut down in the prime of his life.

text.Generic Imperial Female: Hey, did you hear about that murder in the Talos Plaza District? I think the man's name was Draconis. Yeah, cut down in the prime of his life.

text.YsabelAndronicus: Would you believe Owyn once asked for my hand in marriage? It's true! Poor bastard was heart-broken when I turned him down. I'm old, not desperate.

text.Generic Imperial Male: I heard there's a new Arena Champion. Sure it takes a lot of skill to make it that far, but they'd be crazy to challenge the Gray Prince.

text.Generic Imperial Female: I heard there's a new Arena Champion. Sure it takes a lot of skill to make it that far, but they'd be crazy to challenge the Gray Prince.

text.Generic Imperial Male: Have you heard about Agronak gro-Malog? Turns out he's not a noble at all. He's really the son of a vampire! It's almost too horrible to believe.

text.Generic Imperial Female: Have you heard about Agronak gro-Malog? Turns out he's not a noble at all. He's really the son of a vampire! It's almost too horrible to believe.

text.Generic Imperial Male: The Gray Prince is nothing but a fake. Haven't you heard? His father was a vampire! He's no Orc. He's a monster. Someone should put him down.

text.Generic Imperial Female: The Gray Prince is nothing but a fake. Haven't you heard? His father was a vampire! He's no Orc. He's a monster. Someone should put him down.

text.Generic Imperial Male: I can't believe it! The Gray Prince has been beaten! There's a new Arena Grand Champion now, someone called the Spellslinger!

text.Generic Imperial Male: I understand that the Blackwood Company works cheaper than the Fighters Guild. And they'll do any job.
Rumor has it that the Fighters Guild is losing members to the Blackwood Company.
I heard that the Fighters Guild botched a job. They lost a bunch of men in the raid.
I've heard that the Fighters Guild has been having some problems with their contracts recently. That's not like them.
I've heard the Fighters Guild has managed to recruit a few new members. Good thing.
Hey. Check out the new associate. Not bad, if you know what I mean.
It may take a while, but with the Blackwood Company gone, the new master can rebuild the Fighters Guild to its former glory.
Good riddance to the Blackwood Company, and good luck to the Fighters Guild.
The Blackwood Company were taking bad hist from a sick tree. No wonder they fought blood-mad and fearless.
So Argonians get this 'hist' stuff from licking hist trees, and the Blackwood Company got bad hist that made them crazy.
Goodbye, Blackwood Company. The Fighters Guild has a new master, and Oreyn is back.
The Blackwood Company is gone. They were working high on Hist sap. That's why there were so many terrible 'accidents'.
The Blackwood Company has a terrible reputation. But with the Fighters Guild in trouble, who else is there?
The Fighters Guild still gets a little work from old friends, but the Blackwood Company gets all the big contracts.
The Blackwood Company gets the contracts because the Fighters Guild is coming apart at the seams.
The Blackwood Company seems to be winning the battle for mercenary contracts in Cyrodiil, but I wouldn't count the Fighters Guild out just yet.
Maybe the Fighters Guild will recover from its troubles. And maybe not.
The Blackwood Company is not popular, but they're still cheap and effective.
Everyone feels sorry for the Fighters Guild, but they can't function without leadership.
I bet the Blackwood Company had something to do with Viranus Donton's death.
Modryn Oreyn got kicked out, and Vilena Donton thinks only about her dead sons. The Fighters Guild is finished.
With Modryn Oreyn gone, and Vilena Donton mourning her lost sons, who's left to lead the Fighters Guild?
Viranus, the Fighters Guild son-and-heir, is dead, and Vilena kicked Modryn Oreyn out of the guild. The Fighters Guild is falling apart.
It sure sounds like the Blackwood Company double-crossed Argoth and helped Azani Blackheart murder him. Hard to prove it, though.
The Fighters Guild got Azani Blackheart's ring. Not the Blackwood Company. Apparently the Blackwood Company made the whole thing up.
So. The Fighters Guild got Azani Blackheart. Blackwood Company said they did him, but apparently they were mistaken. Or stretching the truth, maybe?
I don't like a lot of what I hear about the Blackwood Company. But they complete their contracts on time.
Blackwood Company takes any and all contracts, and always completes them. Hard to beat that.
The Fighters Guild hasn't actually defaulted on any contracts. But still, all the confusion and delays are going to hurt them.
Vilena Donton hasn't been very aggressive as head of the Fighters Guild. Maybe her son Viranus will show a bit more spunk.
Vilena Donton needs to set a fire under the Fighters Guild if they expect to compete with the Blackwood Company.
The Fighters Guild is a family business. With Vitellus dead, Viranus is in line to succeed his mother.
You heard about the Fighters Guild members tearing up a tavern in Leyawiin. As if they didn't have enough problems with the Blackwood Company.
Sure, the Fighters Guild is established and reliable. But they just aren't as aggressive as the Blackwood Company.
The Blackwood Company is just plain mean. They've got a bad reputation, but that won't hurt business in their line of work, will it?
Nobody likes the Blackwood Company. They're brutes, plain and simple.  But they get the job done.
The Blackwood Company people are more hard-core than the fighters from the Guild.
The Fighters Guild needs to get aggressive if they're going to compete with the Blackwood Company in Leyawiin.
Of course the Blackwood Company is violent. That's what fighting is, isn't it? Violent?
The Blackwood Company takes any job, no matter how tough. Fighters Guild is more fussy.
The Fighters Guild has competition in Leyawiin. Called 'The Blackwood Company'. Very tough. Maybe too tough.
There's some kind of cover-up going on with the Fighters Guild's Fallen Rock Cave contract.
It's a simple job. Go get a journal from Fallen Rock Cave. Shouldn't that be a cinch for a Fighter Guild contract?
I heard Fighters Guild got the Fallen Rock contract, but the guy is just sitting around drinking beer.
They say the Fighters Guild got all the trolls in Swampy Cave, but I'm still not going anywhere near Harlun's Watch.
No one's going out to Harlun's Watch after what the Fighters Guild found there.
Fighters Guild is still better for sensitive jobs, and you know it.
If you wanted your daughter rescued, who would you hire? Blackwood Company? Not me. Can't trust them.
The Fighters Guild got Lady Rogbut out safe and sound. With the Blackwood Company, you never know....
If Lord Rugdumph had used the Blackwood Company, who knows how it would have turned out.
I bet someone sold the Bravil jailbreakers down the river. How else could the Fighters Guild have found their hideout?
Those guys that broke out of Bravil jail were tough customers. But the Fighters Guild got them, didn't they.
Sure, the Fighters Guild raided a family tomb, but they did it for a family member. What's wrong with that?
The Fighters Guild thing at Desolate Mine went perfectly, didn't it? They cleared out the goblins, and no one got hurt.
I heard the Fighters Guild thing at Desolate Mine went wrong. They cleared out the goblins, but they lost some people.
They call it the 'Stone of Alessia'. And they got it back. That's all I know.
The Fighters Guild recovered the Stone of Alessia? I didn't know it was lost. Is it magical or something?
Elante of Alinor? She's the Daedric scholar, right? She'll live to write again, thanks to the Fighters Guild.
The rookies took care of all the thieves. How many was it? Seven? Eight?
Did you hear about the pair of green recruits that cleaned out a den of thieves near Anvil?
Both the new Fighters Guild recruits got back alive. It's a good start.
So the Anvil break-ins were an inside job? The Fighters Guild took care of it? Good work.
Nothing much doing with the Fighters Guild. Though they got some contracts out Anvil way, didn't they?
It's always 'rats' for the new associates. Is it some initiation test or something?
Rats? They've got Fighters Guild people out killing rats? You're kidding, right?
Even with the Blackwood Company gone, we still need to work hard to restore the reputation of the guild.
Oreyn and the new master have saved the guild, sure enough. But we can't let it go to their heads.
Remember when our new master was just a rookie? Who would have thought that a bottom boot would save the whole guild from the Blackwood Company?
It doesn't hurt that our new master is a famous tough guy. Should bring us more contracts.
I feel sorry for Vilena Donton, but she had to go. A new master is just what we need to restore the Fighters Guild's reputation.
We have a new master. And with Oreyn to run daily affairs, we should be in good shape.
It could be worse. Vilena could just shut us down. I hope she doesn't.
We'll just have to trust Oreyn, and keep our mouths shut.
We can't talk about it. Just go about your business. If Oreyn needs something, he'll let us know.
Oreyn has a plan. Just keep your mouth shut, and stay away from Vilena.
We just need to keep our heads down and try to do our jobs. Oreyn's doing what he can from the outside.
What chance do we have without Oreyn? Poor Vilena is completely useless. I don't see how we survive this.
So Viranus is dead. Modryn Oreyn is gone. We are in real trouble.
I think Oreyn is planning to send Viranus out on the Blankenmarch contract. I'm betting Vilena is not happy about it... if she knows.
It's supposed to be a secret. I'm not talking. But everyone knows who's responsible.
It was our people who got Azani Blackheart, but I can't talk about who. I promised.
We lost Vitellus and a lot of good men against Blackheart. Somebody must be pretty good to take him and all his people.
Oreyn is in a foul mood lately. I think he's just about out of patience with Vilena and the whole Blackwood Company situation.
When people learn more about the Blackwood Company's methods, they won't be so eager to hire them.
Blackwood Company is sloppy. They make mistakes. Sooner or later it is going to cost them.
Everyone needs to buckle down and get the work done. And Vilena needs to get out and push guild contracts.
Things are falling apart here. Someone needs to do something about the Blackwood Company situation.
If a Guild fighter defaults on a contract, he's out. We won't compete with Blackwood Company by defaulting on our contracts.
Don't tell me Maglir is acting up again. Has he screwed up another contract?
Nonwyll Cavern is a good start. But the kid has to go out on his own, or he'll never learn the hard lessons.
Viranus wasn't alone at Nonwyll Cavern, you know. Would he have done that well without help?
Viranus is just a kid. But he did pretty well at Nonwyll Cavern, I guess.
Viranus is a good kid. It's his mom who's getting in the way.
With Vitellus dead, Vilena thinks only about protecting Viranus. That's a sure way to ruin the boy.
Oreyn is trying to get Viranus out in the field, but Vilena keeps interfering.
Viranus needs to stop hiding behind his mother's skirts if he expects to run this outfit someday.
Blackwood Company's getting all the contracts around Leyawiin. No wonder the boys there are getting restless.
Oreyn says the new guy went down and sorted out the problem in Leyawiin. Trouble like that is just making things worse.
Some of the Leyawiin boys are cutting up pretty bad. Oreyn is not happy.
Our new recruit says Maglir completed the Fallen Rock Cave contract. Oreyn refuses to talk about it.
The one bottom boot covered for the other, I hear. It's a tough situation.
That Maglir is probably parked in some tavern. I never did like that eight-pint hero.
Oreyn is pretty steamed up about Maglir. He can get expelled for that, can't he?
I don't know what's going on, but Oreyn said Maglir has the contract. Has he lost his nerve?
That's a sad mess out at Harlun's Watch. Little satisfaction in killing those trolls, I'm afraid. Won't bring those folks back, will it?
If our new hard hand keeps closing contracts like the Rugdumph one, we'll be all right.
Lord Rugdumph was going with the Blackwood Company, then thought better of it. We have to do something about them.
That Bloodmane Cave gang had an assassin and a high-level mage? Our gold soldier is a regular hard horse.
Biene Amelion sold her family sword and armor to pay her debts. And you think you have it bad?
I hear our gold soldier paid her debt, but the hard hand also kept her family sword and armor.
They cleared out the Desolate Mine, and everybody got out alive. Pretty slick, eh?
We filled the Desolate Mine contract, but the butcher's bill was pretty steep.
They cleared out the Desolate Mine, all right, but the other guys didn't make it, did they.
Too bad about Elidor. The Guildmaster pays funeral expenses, doesn't she?
Are you going to the service for Brag gro-Bharg?
You know where they're burying Rienna?
What the hell's an ogre going to do with the Stone of Alessia? Eat it?
So thieves steal the Stone of Alessia, and ogres turn around, steal it from them, and tear them apart. Don't you love it?
Azzan's report says there were ogres in Sedor. I think this gold soldier might be the real thing.
Azzan says the scholar lady was lucky to get back alive. But Oreyn's new 'hard hand' did just fine in a tough situation.
She's got no business poking around in Brittlerock Cave, but the customer is always right, eh?
This lady wants to study Daedra, so she buys a guild contract. You ever heard of anything so goofy?
So both the recruits got back alive, at least. I haven't heard the report.
Just got a look at the new Maglir guy. Another 'eight-pint hero', if you ask me.
A den of thieves? Near Anvil? Like that's news? There must be a dozen of them.
I hear Azzan plans to send both new recruits out on the next contract. You know what it's about?
There were three guys in the Lelles break-ins? And the new guy didn't let any get away? I like that.
Didn't Azzan give the new recruit another contract? Something in the protection line?
How do you like the bottom boot on the rat thing? Not bad, eh?
Maglir? He's the OTHER bottom boot, right? Not the rat guy?
I hear we have another new recruit. Things are looking up. What's his name... Maglir?
You heard any more about the rat thing in Anvil?
This rat thing sounds fishy to me. Well. 'Ratty', I guess. You think the rookie can handle it?
Another rat job? Not me. No thanks. Let the bottom boot do the rats. Unless you want the gig....
We have trainers for block and marksman in Skingrad. And there's a shepherd who teaches athletics, too, I think.
The guild teaches only blade and heavy armor in Leyawiin, but there's freelance athletic and armorer training in town, too, I think.
So I can at least get blade and blunt training in Cheydinhal, can't I?
Darn. They only train in blade and heavy armor at the Bruma hall.
I want to train my armoring skill, I go to Bravil. Right?
They train blunt, blade, heavy armor, and block in one of the guildhalls. Is it Anvil?
Isn't Honditar an athletics trainer? The hunter in Chorrol?
Lum gro-Baroth in Chorrol can train me in shield work, right?
I guess you heard Vilena recruited a new sword. Been a while, hasn't it?
Did I give you the key after lockup last night? I really can't remember.
No, thanks. Walking around in the wilderness waiting for something to eat me, looking for gold in a hole? You think I'm a dope?
Sure. In the Arena, you can make a lot of money, real fast. And you can get dead, real fast, too.
Who wants to be a mage? I hate books, spells, stinky bottles, writing, all that stuff, don't you?
Who's on duty tonight? It's not me, is it?
I have a warm place to sleep and three squares a day. It ain't 'The Bard's Tale', but it's good enough for me.
I'm going to stick around the guild hall. It's what I'm not being paid for, if you catch my meaning.
Want to pick up a shield and go a few rounds later? Been a while since I saw real action.
I'm sick of mutton and beer. Want to go out and get a decent meal later?
Go out, kick some robber knight's ass, take his stuff, and get the smith to fix it. That's the way to get armor or weapons.
I'd buy my armor at "The Best Defense" if I could afford it. You know... in the Market District... the Imperial City?
Where would you go for the best blunt weapons? Slash 'N Smash in the Imperial City.
You've been to Stonewall Shields in the Imperial City? Not cheap, but top quality.
For a really good sword, try 'A Fighting Chance' in the Imperial City.
You heard about any new contracts? They'd tell us, wouldn't they?
Vilena is pretty useless since Vitellus died. Thank gods Oreyn is around to keep things together.
I know Vilena's got Vitellus on her mind, but she'll spoil Viranus if she keeps him out of the real action.
I sure wish Vitellus hadn't died. That was sure a mess.
I guess I could have been an adventurer. But I like sleeping in a bed.
There's more gold in Arena fighting, sure. But contracting with the Guild is safer. And more respectable.
Things are really slow. You remember the last time we had a new contract?
Recruitment is down. Way down. That's a problem.
Was Vigdis our most recent recruit? Or Lensi Llharam? It's been so long, I forget.
Some folks are saying that the Blackwood Company is taking over all of the Fighters Guild contracts. There's rumor they'll lose their charter.
The Fighters Guild is recruiting again. Not a bad way to make some money, if you've got the stones for it.

text.Generic Imperial Female: The Fighters Guild is recruiting again. Not a bad way to make some money, if you've got the stones for it.

text.Generic Imperial Male: Anyone looking for work should consider the Fighters Guild. I hear they're always looking for recruits.

text.Generic Imperial Female: Anyone looking for work should consider the Fighters Guild. I hear they're always looking for recruits.

text.Generic Imperial Male: I understand the Fighters Guild is hiring new members. Not bad work for some folks.

text.Generic Imperial Female: I understand the Fighters Guild is hiring new members. Not bad work for some folks.

text.Generic Imperial Male: Mannimarco is no more! The guild is saved, and we have a new Arch-Mage to lead us.

text.Generic Imperial Female: I can't believe Arch-Mage Traven sacrificed himself to save us all. How noble of him.

text.Generic Imperial Male: I don't know what it was, but something important was taken away from Mannimarco. Maybe there is a chance he can be defeated.
Traven might get us through this yet. I hear that the Necromancers were handed a significant defeat at Silorn.
The Council has turned on Traven. Things couldn't possibly get any worse for the guild.
Mannimarco himself is in Cyrodiil, hunting us down. None of us are safe!
Without the Council of Mages to guide us, how will we stand up to the King of Worms?
The Council of Mages has been dissolved. Arch-Mage Traven has been deserted. He's all we have left.
Necromancers have attacked our very homes. What could be next?

text.Generic Imperial Female: The Bruma guild hall has been decimated. Our hall could be next!
I've heard rumors about the Council of Mages consorting with outside sources. Why are outsiders interfering with our guild?
The Council of Mages has this Necromancer situation under control. They must, or else we'd know about it, right?

text.Generic Imperial Male: Something has gone seriously wrong at the Arcane University. I heard that a high-ranking member was killed in some sort of ambush.

text.Generic Imperial Female: I think the rumors about Necromancers are completely untrue. I've heard some crazy things, and I don't believe any of them.

text.Generic Imperial Male: The Council seems very interested in this new group of Necromancers that has sprung up. I wonder how things will play out.
Have you heard anything more about what the Council knows about these Necromancers? Something's not right.

text.Generic Imperial Female: It's good to know that valuable research is still going on, even though things seem to be a bit more tense lately.

text.Generic Imperial Male: Someone finally solved the problems with research at Vahtacen. You'd think the Council would know more about the Ayleids by now.

text.Generic Imperial Female: It sounds like the Council of Mages has been holding extra meetings recently. I'm not sure what that means.

text.Generic Imperial Male: I've heard rumors that the Council of Mages is taking advice from outsiders. I'm not sure how I feel about that.
Arch-Mage Traven was right to ban Necromancy from the guild. Look at what they've done; they've gone and killed several of us!

text.Generic Imperial Female: The Mages Guild has been attacked by Necromancers. This proves they can't be trusted!

text.Generic Imperial Male: I understand that Dagail is in much better control of her faculties now that Kalthar's plot has been exposed.
Kalthar tried to ruin the Leyawiin guild. Just goes to show you can't trust a Necromancer, even if he claims to be "reformed."

text.Generic Imperial Female: Did you hear that someone played yet another prank on Jeanne Frasoric in Bruma? I don't know how she keeps falling for these things.

text.Generic Imperial Male: It sounds like there are an awful lot of problems at the Bruma guild hall. Jeanne does a poor job of running that place.

text.Generic Imperial Female: The Chorrol guild hall had an unpleasant visit recently, from someone who had a grudge against Teekeeus.

text.Generic Imperial Male: I hear a new Associate came to Teekeeus's aid recently. Something about an old enemy of his storming into town.
The roads near Anvil are safer now, thanks to Carahil and her guild hall. She's an example for us all.

text.Generic Imperial Female: The Anvil guild has made quite a name for itself under Carahil. Did you hear about the recent murderer they caught?
Kud-Ei will do anything to help her girls out. She recently got Ardaline out of a bind, and I hear it wasn't completely within guild rules.

text.Generic Imperial Male: Kud-Ei runs a tight ship in Bruma. She may not always play by the rules, but I wouldn't want her on my bad side.
I can't believe a Mages Guild associate was found dead in Cheydinhal. What kind of place are they running there?

text.Generic Imperial Female: Did you hear that Falcar left the guild? I think Deetsan is in charge in Cheydinhal now.
I heard that one of the Skingrad mages was assaulted, but I don't know the details.

text.Generic Imperial Male: Sounds like the Skingrad branch of the guild can't even keep track of its members. How appalling.
Soris Arenim sure seems upset. I think he lost something important.

text.Generic Imperial Female: Soris Arenim sure seems upset. I think he lost something important.

text.SulinusVassinus: I saw Erthor earlier. Guess someone rescued him again. Hide your scrolls while you can.

text.Generic Imperial Male: I thought about joining the Mages Guild, but that Falcar fellow was very intimidating. I ended up changing my mind.

text.Generic Imperial Female: I thought about joining the Mages Guild, but that Falcar fellow was very intimidating. I ended up changing my mind.

text.Generic Imperial Male: There was some kind of fight at the Mages Guild. I heard that Falcar disappeared, as well.

text.Generic Imperial Female: There was some kind of fight at the Mages Guild. I heard that Falcar disappeared, as well.

text.Generic Imperial Male: Things in the guild have been different since Traven was named Arch-Mage. They're more structured, but everyone seems tense.

text.Generic Imperial Female: Things in the guild have been different since Traven was named Arch-Mage. They're more structured, but everyone seems tense.

text.Generic Imperial Male: Half of the Council of Mages resigned when Traven took over the position of Arch-Mage.

text.Generic Imperial Female: Half of the Council of Mages resigned when Traven took over the position of Arch-Mage.

text.Generic Imperial Male: Arch-Mage Traven is the first to take such a hard stance on Necromancy. It upset more than a few people.

text.Generic Imperial Female: Arch-Mage Traven is the first to take such a hard stance on Necromancy. It upset more than a few people.

text.Generic Imperial Male: The Mages Guild runs more or less like it always did, but we lost quite a few members when the practice of Necromancy was banned.

text.Generic Imperial Female: The Mages Guild runs more or less like it always did, but we lost quite a few members when the practice of Necromancy was banned.

text.Generic Imperial Male: Necromancy may be legal in Cyrodiil, but few will openly admit to practicing it now that the Mages Guild has banned it.

text.Generic Imperial Female: Necromancy may be legal in Cyrodiil, but few will openly admit to practicing it now that the Mages Guild has banned it.

text.Generic Imperial Male: Some say that Traven is mis-using the power of the Arch-Mage's position to further his personal agendas.

text.Generic Imperial Female: Some say that Traven is mis-using the power of the Arch-Mage's position to further his personal agendas.

text.Generic Imperial Male: I don't know what Arch-Mage Traven has against Necromancy, but the first thing he did after taking over the Mages Guild was to ban its practice.

text.Generic Imperial Female: I don't know what Arch-Mage Traven has against Necromancy, but the first thing he did after taking over the Mages Guild was to ban its practice.

text.Generic Imperial Male: Not only has Necromancy been banned from practice in the Mages Guild, but the Guild won't deal with anyone who openly uses it.

text.Generic Imperial Female: Not only has Necromancy been banned from practice in the Mages Guild, but the Guild won't deal with anyone who openly uses it.

text.Generic Imperial Male: The Mages Guild has made more than a few enemies since Necromancy was banned.

text.Generic Imperial Female: The Mages Guild has made more than a few enemies since Necromancy was banned.

text.Generic Imperial Male: I saw that Earana woman hanging around the Mages Guild again.
I saw that Erthor is back in town again.

text.Generic Imperial Female: I hear one of the guild mages has gone missing again.

text.Generic Imperial Male: It seems quieter than usual at the Mages Guild.
I saw Earana leaving town. She looked very excited.

text.Generic Imperial Female: Things at the Mages Guild seem tense. That Falcar fellow sure keeps a tight rein on things.

text.Generic Imperial Male: Falcar at the Mages Guild seems to be angry all the time. I avoid him when I can.
I haven't seen Vidkun around town lately. I guess they're keeping him pretty busy at the Mages Guild.

text.Generic Imperial Female: I haven't seen Vidkun around town lately. I guess they're keeping him pretty busy at the Mages Guild.

text.Generic Imperial Male: Varon Vamori seems very glum lately. I guess things aren't going well with Ardaline.
Kud-Ei seems upset about something lately. I'd stay away from the Mages Guild if I were you.

text.Generic Imperial Female: Kud-Ei seems upset about something lately. I'd stay away from the Mages Guild if I were you.
Those new fellows here in town are making me nervous. Walking around with those big weapons; I hope they leave soon.

text.Generic Imperial Male: I heard someone broke into the Mages Guild.

text.Generic Imperial Female: I heard someone broke into the Mages Guild.

text.Generic Imperial Male: If the Council really did split up, the guild is done for. This is serious.

text.Generic Imperial Female: If the Council really did split up, the guild is done for. This is serious.

text.Generic Imperial Male: The Mages Guild seems more disorganized than usual lately.

text.Generic Imperial Female: The Mages Guild seems more disorganized than usual lately.

text.Generic Imperial Male: Andel Indarys may or may not have killed his wife, and it may or may not have been an accident. And I doubt we'll ever know for sure.

text.Generic Imperial Female: Andel Indarys may or may not have killed his wife, and it may or may not have been an accident. And I doubt we'll ever know for sure.

text.Generic Imperial Male: How did a Dark Elf become Count Cheydinhal? King Helseth and Barenziah have considerable influence, and Helseth and Indarys are cronies. Get it?

text.Generic Imperial Female: How did a Dark Elf become Count Cheydinhal? King Helseth and Barenziah have considerable influence, and Helseth and Indarys are cronies. Get it?

text.Generic Imperial Male: Andel Indarys is an intemperate, bibulous philanderer. And a Dark Elf. Other than that, he is perfectly suited to be a count.

text.Generic Imperial Female: Andel Indarys is an intemperate, bibulous philanderer. And a Dark Elf. Other than that, he is perfectly suited to be a count.

text.Generic Imperial Male: Millona Umbranox is better off without that irresponsible husband of hers. The most honorable thing he ever did was to disappear and leave her alone.

text.Generic Imperial Female: Millona Umbranox is better off without that irresponsible husband of hers. The most honorable thing he ever did was to disappear and leave her alone.

text.Generic Imperial Male: Millona Umbranox, Arriana Valga, and Narina Carvain seem to rule their counties perfectly well without male assistance.

text.AlessiaCaro: Millona Umbranox, Arriana Valga, and Narina Carvain seem to rule their counties perfectly well without male assistance.

text.Generic Imperial Male: I've never heard the Countess mention her husband. I believe it is something of a sore point with Lady Millona.

text.Generic Imperial Female: I've never heard the Countess mention her husband. I believe it is something of a sore point with Lady Millona.

text.Generic Imperial Male: I believe the rugged climate of Bruma suits Narina Carvain. She's tough and cold, but you always know what to expect from her.

text.Generic Imperial Female: I believe the rugged climate of Bruma suits Narina Carvain. She's tough and cold, but you always know what to expect from her.

text.Generic Imperial Male: No wonder Narina Carvain is so cranky. If you had to live year-round in a cold, drafty, soot-stained castle like Bruma, you'd be cranky, too.

text.Generic Imperial Female: No wonder Narina Carvain is so cranky. If you had to live year-round in a cold, drafty, soot-stained castle like Bruma, you'd be cranky, too.

text.Generic Imperial Male: With Regulus Terentius for a father, what do you expect from Gellius? The acorn never falls too far from the tree.

text.Generic Imperial Female: With Regulus Terentius for a father, what do you expect from Gellius? The acorn never falls too far from the tree.

text.Generic Imperial Male: It is fashionable to make fun of Bravil and Regulus Terentius. Personally, I think it is poor sport to mock the poor and disadvantaged.

text.Generic Imperial Female: It is fashionable to make fun of Bravil and Regulus Terentius. Personally, I think it is poor sport to mock the poor and disadvantaged.

text.GelliusTerentius: I have not found it convenient to visit Count Bravil. Travel is so difficult there at this time of the year. Indeed, almost any time of year.

text.Generic Imperial Female: I had a very pleasant visit with Arriana Valga recently. The castle was very comfortable, and her new guard captain seems to be working out well.
Chorrol appears to be clean, prosperous, and well-ordered. Countess Arriana, her staff and guard is to be praised.
If Countess Chorrol is any example, dignity and piety may indeed bring rich rewards from the Nine.

text.Generic Imperial Male: Alessia Caro visits her mother in Chorrol regularly. A dutiful daughter... and a dutiful wife, I hear.

text.Generic Imperial Female: Alessia Caro visits her mother in Chorrol regularly. A dutiful daughter... and a dutiful wife, I hear.

text.Generic Imperial Male: There's been trouble with smugglers and Khajiit bandits in the Trans-Niben, but Marius Caro is taking steps to deal with the problem.

text.Generic Imperial Female: There's been trouble with smugglers and Khajiit bandits in the Trans-Niben, but Marius Caro is taking steps to deal with the problem.

text.Generic Imperial Male: The Count of Skingrad and I are not social intimates. In fact, I don't believe Janus Hassildor has any social intimates.

text.Generic Imperial Female: The Count of Skingrad and I are not social intimates. In fact, I don't believe Janus Hassildor has any social intimates.

text.Generic Imperial Male: It's curious. Skingrad's people scarcely ever set eyes on the Count, but he's apparently loved and respected by all his subjects.

text.Generic Imperial Female: It's curious. Skingrad's people scarcely ever set eyes on the Count, but he's apparently loved and respected by all his subjects.

text.Generic Imperial Male: A master sorcerer like Janus Hassildor inevitably outlives all his peers. It must be a lonely existence.

text.Generic Imperial Female: A master sorcerer like Janus Hassildor inevitably outlives all his peers. It must be a lonely existence.

text.Generic Imperial Male: It is pleasant, and a bit melancholy, to walk among the graves in Green Emperor Way and contemplate the dead who precede us.

text.Generic Imperial Female: It is pleasant, and a bit melancholy, to walk among the graves in Green Emperor Way and contemplate the dead who precede us.

text.Generic Imperial Male: I admit to sharing the common enthusiasm for the Arena. It is barbaric, but the stakes of life or death make the drama irresistably compelling.

text.Generic Imperial Female: I admit to sharing the common enthusiasm for the Arena. It is barbaric, but the stakes of life or death make the drama irresistably compelling.

text.Generic Imperial Male: They say Alinor on Summerset Isle is more beautiful. I've never been. For the present, I must count the Imperial City the most glorious in Tamriel.

text.Generic Imperial Female: They say Alinor on Summerset Isle is more beautiful. I've never been. For the present, I must count the Imperial City the most glorious in Tamriel.

text.Generic Imperial Male: Legion duty here in Cyrodiil is usually a dull affair. In the East, though, things are a bit more challenging, and one can make a name for oneself.

text.Generic Imperial Female: Legion duty here in Cyrodiil is usually a dull affair. In the East, though, things are a bit more challenging, and one can make a name for oneself.

text.Generic Imperial Male: The legions patrol the roads, and they've always been sufficient. I can't imagine we'll ever be at war with the provinces... not in my lifetime.

text.Generic Imperial Female: The legions patrol the roads, and they've always been sufficient. I can't imagine we'll ever be at war with the provinces... not in my lifetime.

text.Generic Imperial Male: I've not always been happy with the standards of conduct in the Mages Guild, but Hannibal Traven's reforms are quite encouraging.

text.Generic Imperial Female: I've not always been happy with the standards of conduct in the Mages Guild, but Hannibal Traven's reforms are quite encouraging.

text.Generic Imperial Male: I'm not sure the Dark Brotherhood is any more serious a problem than beggary and petty thievery. And it's certainly a discreet and secret problem.

text.Generic Imperial Female: I'm not sure the Dark Brotherhood is any more serious a problem than beggary and petty thievery. And it's certainly a discreet and secret problem.

text.Generic Imperial Male: The people have a simple faith in the Nine, and the clerics do their part to heal and comfort them in adversity.

text.Generic Imperial Female: The people have a simple faith in the Nine, and the clerics do their part to heal and comfort them in adversity.

text.Generic Imperial Male: I've sometimes thought I'd like to make a pilgrimage to the wayshrines, but my duties prevent me from such extensive and dangerous travel.

text.Generic Imperial Female: I've sometimes thought I'd like to make a pilgrimage to the wayshrines, but my duties prevent me from such extensive and dangerous travel.

text.Generic Imperial Male: The doomstones are a mystery. Are they traces of the Mythic Times? Or creations of ancient beastfolk or lost races of mer or men?

text.Generic Imperial Female: The doomstones are a mystery. Are they traces of the Mythic Times? Or creations of ancient beastfolk or lost races of mer or men?

text.Generic Imperial Male: I have not read the works of Mrs. Ottus. I'm told some find her guide books useful, though she apparently has strong opinions on some matters.

text.Generic Imperial Female: I have not read the works of Mrs. Ottus. I'm told some find her guide books useful, though she apparently has strong opinions on some matters.

text.Generic Imperial Male: The Elder Council and the bureaucracy have managed the Empire's affairs for decades. The Emperor rules, but the Council handles all the details.

text.Generic Imperial Female: The Elder Council and the bureaucracy have managed the Empire's affairs for decades. The Emperor rules, but the Council handles all the details.

text.Generic Imperial Male: What can be said about taxes? They're high, but we must pay. At least they are administered efficiently, and the shrinkage is within decent limits.

text.Generic Imperial Female: What can be said about taxes? They're high, but we must pay. At least they are administered efficiently, and the shrinkage is within decent limits.

text.Generic Imperial Male: It is not always an easy life we lead, but the people must be served.

text.Generic Imperial Female: It is not always an easy life we lead, but the people must be served.

text.BrusciusLongus: Ignorant folk hate us, so we stay far away from them.

text.Generic Imperial Female: We don't go looking for new worshippers. If people are interested, they can find us.

text.LucienLachance: Dear Brother, I do not spread rumors. I create them.

text.LucienLachanceHunted: Are you mad? My life is on the line and the entire Brotherhood is at stake! We don't have time for this nonsense!

text.LucienLachance: Dear Sister, I do not spread rumors. I create them.

text.Dark19Murderer1: Rumors? Oh! Well... Um... I... I heard you're the one who killed Adamus Phillida! The skill you must possess!

text.Generic Imperial Male: The latest Black Horse Courier is upsetting. Apparently, more and more people have been trying to contact the Dark Brotherhood. See for yourself.
Haven't you heard? Baenlin's been killed! The Black Horse Courier has a special edition with the story. Here, take my copy.
The Dark Brotherhood! They've actually murdered Adamus Phillida, the Imperial Legion commander! It's in the latest Black Horse Courier. Here.
They say that when you murder someone, the Dark Brotherhood comes to you in your sleep. It's how they recruit new members.

text.Generic Imperial Female: They say that when you murder someone, the Dark Brotherhood comes to you in your sleep. It's how they recruit new members.

text.Generic Imperial Male: There's a new ship moored up in the Waterfront District. The Marie Elena. It's a galleon, I think.

text.Generic Imperial Female: There's a new ship moored up in the Waterfront District. The Marie Elena. It's a galleon, I think.

text.Generic Imperial Male: Old Baenlin is dead! I hear it was a horrible accident. He was resting in his chair and BOOM -- a stuffed head fell on him!
The Count made that Orc, Mazoga, into a knight? Well, well. Next thing, we'll be making horses into knights.

text.Generic Imperial Female: The Count made that Orc, Mazoga, into a knight? Well, well. Next thing, we'll be making horses into knights.

text.Generic Imperial Male: I hear the Count's got someone to sort out that business with Mazoga the so-called knight.
The Count's been asking questions about some Orc named Mazoga at the castle... she claims she's a knight.
There's an Orc named Mazoga up at the castle claims she's a knight. Doesn't look like one to me.
Poor Tivela. I hear she is turning Cheydinhal inside out looking for her husband, Rythe. I hope nothing bad has happened to him.

text.Generic Imperial Female: Poor Tivela. I hear she is turning Cheydinhal inside out looking for her husband, Rythe. I hope nothing bad has happened to him.

text.Generic Imperial Male: Have you seen Valus Odiil recently? Spends all day in the tavern since his boys left.

text.Generic Imperial Female: Have you seen Valus Odiil recently? Spends all day in the tavern since his boys left.

text.Generic Imperial Male: I saw Valus Odiil at the Grey Mare again today. Hasn't been the same since his boys took off.

text.Generic Imperial Female: I saw Valus Odiil at the Grey Mare again today. Hasn't been the same since his boys took off.

text.Generic Imperial Male: A gang of women in Anvil seducing men? Did you hear? Take my copy of the Black Horse Courier. Poor fools.
The Black Horse Courier has a story about Rythe Lythandas. Here. Take my copy. I'm done with it.

text.Generic Imperial Female: The Black Horse Courier has a story about Rythe Lythandas. Here. Take my copy. I'm done with it.

text.Generic Imperial Male: Farwil Indarys almost got himself killed in Cheydinhal. Here. Take my Black Horse Courier. It's all in there.
Did you hear about the discovery at Pale Pass? It's in the new Black Horse Courier. Here. Take my copy.

text.Generic Imperial Female: Did you hear about the discovery at Pale Pass? It's in the new Black Horse Courier. Here. Take my copy.

text.Generic Imperial Male: I heard that Velwyn Benirus was killed. The Manor claims another victim.

text.Generic Imperial Female: I heard that Velwyn Benirus was killed. The Manor claims another victim.

text.Generic Imperial Male: The new owner sure has turned Benirus Manor around. It's now a welcome addition to our city.

text.Generic Imperial Female: The new owner sure has turned Benirus Manor around. It's now a welcome addition to our city.

text.Generic Imperial Male: I have it on good authority that the city watch sent someone to stop that gang of women from robbing the town's men. Good show I say!

text.Generic Imperial Female: I have it on good authority that the city watch sent someone to stop that gang of women from robbing the town's men. Good show I say!

text.Generic Imperial Male: Kud-Ei seems to be in good spirits again after Henantier's return. I heard she enlisted a stranger's help in the search. Good show I say!

text.Generic Imperial Female: Kud-Ei seems to be in good spirits again after Henantier's return. I heard she enlisted a stranger's help in the search. Good show I say!

text.Generic Imperial Male: Henantier was slain in his sleep. How awful. They should find the one who did it and send him straight to prison.

text.Generic Imperial Female: Henantier was slain in his sleep. How awful. They should find the one who did it and send him straight to prison.

text.Generic Imperial Male: I have it on good account that the Forlorn Watchman is gone for good. The stories about his fate were true, but now the curse has been broken.

text.Generic Imperial Female: I have it on good account that the Forlorn Watchman is gone for good. The stories about his fate were true, but now the curse has been broken.

text.Generic Imperial Male: Well, despite everything, Aleron Loche turned up dead. That's what you get when you deal with gamblers and usurers.

text.Generic Imperial Female: Well, despite everything, Aleron Loche turned up dead. That's what you get when you deal with gamblers and usurers.

text.Generic Imperial Male: Arnora was killed. Such a shame. I wonder if Jorundr had something to do with it? I wouldn't put it past him.

text.Generic Imperial Female: Arnora was killed. Such a shame. I wonder if Jorundr had something to do with it? I wouldn't put it past him.

text.Generic Imperial Male: So, the mighty Ulrich Leland has fallen. Apparently Llevana Nedaren snapped and killed him. Good riddance I say.

text.Generic Imperial Female: So, the mighty Ulrich Leland has fallen. Apparently Llevana Nedaren snapped and killed him. Good riddance I say.

text.Generic Imperial Male: Did you hear the news? Ulrich Leland was thrown in the dungeons for stealing money from the city coffers. Haha! Justice for the little guy!

text.Generic Imperial Female: Did you hear the news? Ulrich Leland was thrown in the dungeons for stealing money from the city coffers. Haha! Justice for the little guy!

text.Generic Imperial Male: I overheard that the vampire hunter who was in town was a fake. It was apparently a ruse to get his hands on Bradon's key to a treasure chest.

text.Generic Imperial Female: I overheard that the vampire hunter who was in town was a fake. It was apparently a ruse to get his hands on Bradon's key to a treasure chest.

text.Generic Imperial Male: Thank goodness the gate is gone. I couldn't get a good night's sleep knowing it was out there!

text.Generic Imperial Female: Thank goodness the gate is gone. I couldn't get a good night's sleep knowing it was out there!

text.Generic Imperial Male: Rythe Lythandas seems to be back in town. Wonder where he was off to?

text.Generic Imperial Female: Rythe Lythandas seems to be back in town. Wonder where he was off to?

text.Generic Imperial Male: The Honorblade has been returned to the Castle after all these years! This is certainly a good omen.

text.Generic Imperial Female: The Honorblade has been returned to the Castle after all these years! This is certainly a good omen.

text.Generic Imperial Male: Someone said the Bloated Float mysteriously departed from the docks and then returned. I didn't know she was even seaworthy!

text.BronsilaKvinchal: Someone said the Bloated Float mysteriously departed from the docks and then returned. I didn't know she was even seaworthy!

text.Generic Imperial Male: The Countess still seems quite sad. I hear someone tried to find the item stolen from the castle, but they had no luck. Oh well.

text.Generic Imperial Female: The Countess still seems quite sad. I hear someone tried to find the item stolen from the castle, but they had no luck. Oh well.

text.Generic Imperial Male: The Countess seems much happier now that the item that was stolen from her was returned.

text.Generic Imperial Female: The Countess seems much happier now that the item that was stolen from her was returned.

text.Generic Imperial Male: I guess Rosentia Gallenus got rid of whatever barnyard animals she was keeping inside her house. Smells much better now.

text.Generic Imperial Female: I guess Rosentia Gallenus got rid of whatever barnyard animals she was keeping inside her house. Smells much better now.

text.Generic Imperial Male: I saw Reynald Jemane's brother earlier. Can't believe they didn't even know about each other.

text.Generic Imperial Female: I saw Reynald Jemane's brother earlier. Can't believe they didn't even know about each other.

text.Generic Imperial Male: Reynald Jemane has a terrible memory. We've met many times, but when I saw him in Cheydinhal, he walked right past me like we were strangers.

text.Generic Imperial Female: Reynald Jemane has a terrible memory. We've met many times, but when I saw him in Cheydinhal, he walked right past me like we were strangers.

text.Generic Imperial Male: I was in Cheydinhal last week, and I'm sure I saw Reynald Jemane. He acted like he didn't know me, though.

text.Generic Imperial Female: I was in Cheydinhal last week, and I'm sure I saw Reynald Jemane. He acted like he didn't know me, though.

text.Generic Imperial Male: You hear any word about Kud-Ei's friend? She's offering a generous reward, so hopefully someone will show up and lend a hand.

text.Generic Imperial Female: You hear any word about Kud-Ei's friend? She's offering a generous reward, so hopefully someone will show up and lend a hand.

text.Generic Imperial Male: I saw Kud-Ei moping around outside the Mages Guild yesterday. In fact, I could swear she was crying. I hope she finds her missing friend.

text.Generic Imperial Female: I saw Kud-Ei moping around outside the Mages Guild yesterday. In fact, I could swear she was crying. I hope she finds her missing friend.

text.Generic Imperial Male: There's some strange Dark Elf in town, asking about Reynald Jemane and his brother.

text.Generic Imperial Female: There's some strange Dark Elf in town, asking about Reynald Jemane and his brother.

text.Generic Imperial Male: I've sighted the Forlorn Watchman again. Every time I see that ghost, it gives me the creeps.

text.Generic Imperial Female: I've sighted the Forlorn Watchman again. Every time I see that ghost, it gives me the creeps.

text.Generic Imperial Male: Have you heard about that ghost of the old man that looks out into Niben Bay each night? They're calling him the Forlorn Watchman... spooky.

text.Generic Imperial Female: Have you heard about that ghost of the old man that looks out into Niben Bay each night? They're calling him the Forlorn Watchman... spooky.

text.Generic Imperial Male: I can't believe that the Countess is more obsessed with that painting than the Oblivion Gate threatening the city!

text.Generic Imperial Female: I can't believe that the Countess is more obsessed with that painting than the Oblivion Gate threatening the city!

text.Generic Imperial Male: I heard that the Countess is quite upset lately. Apparently someone stole something very personal to her.

text.Generic Imperial Female: I heard that the Countess is quite upset lately. Apparently someone stole something very personal to her.

text.Generic Imperial Male: Have you noticed all the city guards are roaming around the city as if looking for someone? I wonder what that's all about.

text.Generic Imperial Female: Have you noticed all the city guards are roaming around the city as if looking for someone? I wonder what that's all about.

text.Generic Imperial Male: Did you hear about Bradon Lirrian? A vampire hunter named Raynil Dralas made his way into town, snuck into his house and killed him.

text.Generic Imperial Female: Did you hear about Bradon Lirrian? A vampire hunter named Raynil Dralas made his way into town, snuck into his house and killed him.

text.Generic Imperial Male: I was at Olav's earlier and I ran into this Dunmer named Raynil Dralas. After a round or two, he told me he was an honest-to-goodness vampire hunter!

text.Generic Imperial Female: I was at Olav's earlier and I ran into this Dunmer named Raynil Dralas. After a round or two, he told me he was an honest-to-goodness vampire hunter!

text.Generic Imperial Male: Don't know if this is true, but I heard a gang of all female thieves is preying on the married menfolk of the town.

text.Generic Imperial Female: Don't know if this is true, but I heard a gang of all female thieves is preying on the married menfolk of the town.

text.Generic Imperial Male: You hear about Gogan? A gang of thieves is running a scam in town, and he fell for it! Hahaha... what an idiot!

text.Generic Imperial Female: You hear about Gogan? A gang of thieves is running a scam in town, and he fell for it! Hahaha... what an idiot!

text.Generic Imperial Male: They charged me 5 gold for littering! Littering!! I barely make that in a year! These fines are ridiculous!

text.Generic Imperial Female: They charged me 5 gold for littering! Littering!! I barely make that in a year! These fines are ridiculous!

text.Generic Imperial Male: I can't believe the ridiculous new fines the guards are imposing. Ever since Ulrich took over as Captain of the Guard, this place is going downhill.

text.Generic Imperial Female: I can't believe the ridiculous new fines the guards are imposing. Ever since Ulrich took over as Captain of the Guard, this place is going downhill.

text.Generic Imperial Male: Have you been near Rosentia Gallenus's house recently? Smells horrible... like she left some meat out to spoil.

text.Generic Imperial Female: Have you been near Rosentia Gallenus's house recently? Smells horrible... like she left some meat out to spoil.

text.Generic Imperial Male: I was walking past Rosentia Gallenus' home the other day, and I heard these strange animal noises or something from inside... very odd.

text.Generic Imperial Female: I was walking past Rosentia Gallenus' home the other day, and I heard these strange animal noises or something from inside... very odd.

text.Generic Imperial Male: You hear about Jorundr? He was caught stealing gold, and now he's in jail! I bet Arnora's beside herself with grief.

text.Generic Imperial Female: You hear about Jorundr? He was caught stealing gold, and now he's in jail! I bet Arnora's beside herself with grief.

text.Generic Imperial Male: Poor Arnora. Seems her boyfriend, Jorundr, has stolen some gold from her and left her penniless. Now he's in jail, and she's destitute.

text.Generic Imperial Female: Poor Arnora. Seems her boyfriend, Jorundr, has stolen some gold from her and left her penniless. Now he's in jail, and she's destitute.

text.Generic Imperial Male: So, thanks to some hired help, the Jemanes recovered Weatherleah. Good thing... I never liked having ogres so close to Chorrol.

text.Generic Imperial Female: So, thanks to some hired help, the Jemanes recovered Weatherleah. Good thing... I never liked having ogres so close to Chorrol.

text.Generic Imperial Male: I overheard a guard mention the Countess is looking for a piece to add to her collection of Akaviri artifacts. Our taxpayer's drakes at work...

text.Generic Imperial Female: I overheard a guard mention the Countess is looking for a piece to add to her collection of Akaviri artifacts. Our taxpayer's drakes at work...

text.Generic Imperial Male: I'd stay inside the city walls if I were you, there's no telling what's going to come out of that gate.

text.Generic Imperial Female: I'd stay inside the city walls if I were you, there's no telling what's going to come out of that gate.

text.Generic Imperial Male: Ever since that gate appeared, the city guards have been on alert. I hope they can protect us.

text.Generic Imperial Female: Ever since that gate appeared, the city guards have been on alert. I hope they can protect us.

text.Generic Imperial Male: I overheard someone say that Aleron Loche is missing. I don't know what happened to him. His wife, Ursanne, is beside herself with grief.

text.Generic Imperial Female: I overheard someone say that Aleron Loche is missing. I don't know what happened to him. His wife, Ursanne, is beside herself with grief.

text.Generic Imperial Male: I swear that when I passed by Benirus Manor last night, I heard someone scream from inside. Velwyn Benirus will never sell that deathtrap!
