text.Generic Imperial Female: I swear that when I passed by Benirus Manor last night, I heard someone scream from inside. Velwyn Benirus will never sell that deathtrap!

text.Generic Imperial Male: I heard that Velwyn Benirus is trying to sell off Benirus Manor. Hopefully the new owners will clean that eyesore up.

text.Generic Imperial Female: I heard that Velwyn Benirus is trying to sell off Benirus Manor. Hopefully the new owners will clean that eyesore up.

text.Generic Imperial Male: I think Glarthir is having one of his bad spells lately, have you noticed?

text.Generic Imperial Female: I think Glarthir is having one of his bad spells lately, have you noticed?

text.Generic Imperial Male: Did you hear about Glarthir going crazy and attacking people with an axe?

text.Generic Imperial Female: Did you hear about Glarthir going crazy and attacking people with an axe?

text.Generic Imperial Male: Did you hear about Glarthir? Thank the Nine that the guard stopped him before he killed someone!

text.Generic Imperial Female: Did you hear about Glarthir? Thank the Nine that the guard stopped him before he killed someone!

text.Generic Imperial Male: Do you think that stranger's here looking for the girl?

text.Generic Imperial Female: Do you think that stranger's here looking for the girl?

text.Generic Imperial Male: Did you hear that Dar-Ma has disappeared?

text.Generic Imperial Female: Did you hear that Dar-Ma has disappeared?

text.Generic Imperial Male: I'll be there.  Etira promised us some good sport tonight.

text.Generic Imperial Female: I'll be there.  Etira promised us some good sport tonight.

text.Generic Imperial Male: I wouldn't miss it.  This time the sacrifice may finally be acceptable to the Brethren.

text.Generic Imperial Female: I wouldn't miss it.  This time the sacrifice may finally be acceptable to the Brethren.

text.Generic Imperial Male: Did you hear the bad news?  Dar-Ma's daughter was killed by some strange cultists down in Hackdirt. Terrible, terrible times we live in.

text.Generic Imperial Female: Did you hear the bad news?  Dar-Ma's daughter was killed by some strange cultists down in Hackdirt. Terrible, terrible times we live in.

text.Generic Imperial Male: Did you hear that Dar-Ma came back, safe and sound?  You know, Seed-Neeus's daughter, the Argonians.

text.Generic Imperial Female: Did you hear that Dar-Ma came back, safe and sound?  You know, Seed-Neeus's daughter, the Argonians.

text.Generic Imperial Male: It's true what everyone's saying -- Kvatch is lost. The Daedra, they swarmed in.... The Town Guard never had a chance.
The Kvatch Oblivion Gate has been closed! Don't you understand what that means? We can beat the bastards!
The Mythic Dawn murdered the Emperor and led those damn Daedra right into the heart of the Empire! They'll pay for their treachery!
Kvatch? Kvatch was just the beginning! Those damned Gates have opened up everywhere! Cheydinhal, Chorrol, Leyawiin -- no city is safe.
Have you heard? The Oblivion Gate at Bruma -- they've shut it down! The Daedra will never defeat the people of the Empire! Never! Ha ha!
Bruma has been saved! It's true! Let's see how the Daedra do without their big Siege Machine, or their so-called "Great Gate"! Ha ha ha ha ha!
Don't you even care what's happening? Bruma has been saved! The Great Gate has been closed! There is hope for us all, whether you like it or not.
The Emperor's heir lives! The bloodline is unbroken! Long live Martin Septim!
The tide is turning, my friend. Bruma has been saved, and Martin Septim has claimed his birthright! Soon, all of Oblivion will tremble in fear!
The tide is turning. Bruma has been saved, and Martin Septim has claimed his birthright! It's time for every citizen to do their part... even you.
It's over, citizen. The crisis has ended. But at what cost? We are an Empire without an Emperor. The future is uncertain, at best.
Have you not heard? The Oblivion crisis has ended! Martin Septim gave his own life to destroy the Daedra horde! We are victorious!
The Emperor is dead, and so are his heirs. We're a Legion without a leader. The Blades were trusted with our Lord's protection... and they failed.
Truth is, the Legion doesn't know who was behind the Emperor's murder. We've already ruled out the Dark Brotherhood. So is this something... worse?
Emperors have been assassinated before, but this time... I don't know. It's different. Can't you feel it? A shadow has fallen across all of Tamriel.
If you've got to travel, by the Nine Divines, stay on the roads! The wilderness just isn't safe anymore. We've had sightings, you see. The Daedra...
We're all talking about the emperor's murder. We have no emperor. And no heir. That's never happened before. I suppose we should all be worried.

text.Generic Imperial Female: We're all talking about the emperor's murder. We have no emperor. And no heir. That's never happened before. I suppose we should all be worried.

text.Generic Imperial Male: People are subdued. Troubled. A crisis like this tests the people's faith.

text.Generic Imperial Female: People are subdued. Troubled. A crisis like this tests the people's faith.
I think we're in for some hard times. The death of Uriel Septim and his heirs changes everything.

text.Generic Imperial Male: The Emperor and his three sons, dead, right under the noses of the Imperial Guard. It's a disgrace.
Have you heard about Kvatch? They say that daedra came from Oblivion and burned the whole city to the ground!

text.Generic Imperial Female: Everyone's saying there's trouble in Kvatch. The whole town destroyed. Only a few survivors.

text.Generic Imperial Male: Do you think what happened to Kvatch could happen here?
I heard that the Kvatch Guard is driving back the daedra! Maybe there's hope after all.

text.Generic Imperial Female: I heard that the Kvatch Guard is driving back the daedra! Maybe there's hope after all.
Everybody's talking about the Hero of Kvatch! They say he actually went into an Oblivion Gate and destroyed it.

text.Generic Imperial Male: Everybody's talking about the Hero of Kvatch! They say she actually went into an Oblivion Gate and destroyed it.
Hey, you're the one they call the Hero of Kvatch, aren't you? The one that closed the Oblivion Gate and saved the city?

text.Generic Imperial Female: Hey, you're the one they call the Hero of Kvatch, aren't you? The one that closed the Oblivion Gate and saved the city?

text.Generic Imperial Male: Good news from Kvatch for a change. The last of the daedra have been driven out.

text.Generic Imperial Female: Good news from Kvatch for a change. The last of the daedra have been driven out.

text.Generic Imperial Male: Do you believe any of that talk about more Oblivion Gates opening all over the place?

text.Generic Imperial Female: I've been hearing disturbing tales about Oblivion Gates opening all across Cyrodiil. I hope it's just wild talk.

text.Generic Imperial Male: They say that Oblivion Gates have opened outside cities all across Tamriel! Gods preserve us!

text.Generic Imperial Female: With those Oblivion Gates opening everywhere, it's only a matter of time before another city goes the way of Kvatch.
Did you hear? The lost heir of Uriel Septim rallied the Guard and smashed a horde of daedra outside Bruma!

text.Generic Imperial Male: They say a lost son of Uriel Septim has reappeared in Bruma. Troops are flocking to his banner from all over Cyrodiil!
I heard that some cult called the Mythic Dawn is behind the Emperor's assassination.

text.Generic Imperial Female: They're saying some cult murdered the Emperor and are opening the Oblivion Gates. Do you think any of it's true?

text.Generic Imperial Male: Thank Akatosh the Oblivion Crisis is over! Although with no Emperor and no heir, I wonder what will happen to the Empire?
I plan to visit the Imperial City soon to pay my respects at the Temple of the One. They say the Dragon Statue is 100 feet high!

text.Generic Imperial Female: I'm sure the Elder Council will find some way to hold the Empire together. At least the Oblivion invasion is over!
I heard that some of the provinces were talking about seceding from the Empire. Probably just talk though. Everything's a bit unsettled now.

text.Generic Imperial Male: Most people consider Martin's... transformation... a religious or political event, but what interests me is its metaphysical implications.

text.Generic Imperial Female: Most people consider Martin's... transformation... a religious or political event, but what interests me is its metaphysical implications.

text.Generic Imperial Male: I wish I had witnessed the avatar of divine Akatosh myself. Imagine! Upon the very altar of the Temple of the One!

text.Generic Imperial Female: I wish I had witnessed the avatar of divine Akatosh myself. Imagine! Upon the very altar of the Temple of the One!
I confess, I didn't think we had a chance against the daedra. But Martin proved himself a true heir of Talos on that day.

text.Generic Imperial Male: To think that Bruma was where Martin Septim chose to reveal himself as the true heir to the throne for the first time!
I hear that Earil is fed up with Brithaur's antics. He really wants something done about it.

text.Generic Imperial Female: I hear that Earil is fed up with Brithaur's antics. He really wants something done about it.

text.Generic Imperial Male: Scalons carry diseases. Lots of them.

text.Generic Imperial Female: Scalons carry diseases. Lots of them.

text.SEBruscusDannus: Don't run into the water to escape a Scalon. They'll follow you.

text.Generic Imperial Female: Don't run into the water to escape a Scalon. They'll follow you.

text.SE14Dancer1: Have to watch for those Scalons. I hear they carry disease.
If you see a Gnarl, be careful what spells you use on them.

text.Generic Imperial Male: I've heard that Gnarl get stronger when hit by some spells.

text.Generic Imperial Female: I've heard that Gnarl get stronger when hit by some spells.

text.SEBruscusDannus: The Gnarl are strange creatures. Hit them with a fireball, and they get stronger, but they hate other elements even more.

text.Generic Imperial Female: The Gnarl are strange creatures. Hit them with a fireball, and they get stronger, but they hate other elements even more.

text.SE14Dancer1: Those Shambles are dangerous. Make sure to stand back if you kill one.

text.Generic Imperial Male: Don't bother using a frost spell on a Shambles.

text.Generic Imperial Female: Don't bother using a frost spell on a Shambles.

text.SEBruscusDannus: If you see a Shambles dying, stand back. They'll take you with them.

text.Generic Imperial Female: If you see a Shambles dying, stand back. They'll take you with them.

text.SE14Dancer1: Flesh Atronachs are dangerous. Some are smart enough to heal themselves when they're hurt.

text.Generic Imperial Male: Sometimes, a sharp blade is the best way to kill a Flesh Atronach.

text.Generic Imperial Female: Sometimes, a sharp blade is the best way to kill a Flesh Atronach.

text.SEBruscusDannus: If you have to fight a Flesh Atronach, a good shock spell is the way to go.

text.Generic Imperial Female: If you have to fight a Flesh Atronach, a good shock spell is the way to go.

text.SE14Dancer1: The poison of the Elytra can be debilitating.

text.Generic Imperial Male: The Elytra have wondrous poisons that can drain the very life from you.

text.Generic Imperial Female: The Elytra have wondrous poisons that can drain the very life from you.

text.SEBruscusDannus: Watch for the Elytra's stingers; their poison can be deadly. They don't like magic much, though.

text.Generic Imperial Female: Watch for the Elytra's stingers; their poison can be deadly. They don't like magic much, though.

text.SE14Dancer1: The Hunger is one of Lord Sheogorath's favorite pets.

text.Generic Imperial Male: Only the Demented can truly appreciate the Hunger.

text.Generic Imperial Female: Only the Demented can truly appreciate the Hunger.

text.SEBruscusDannus: Like most lesser Daedra, the Hunger has a weakness to shock spells.

text.Generic Imperial Female: Like most lesser Daedra, the Hunger has a weakness to shock spells.

text.SE14Dancer1: Some say the Grummites are the original inhabitants of the Shivering Isles.

text.Generic Imperial Male: Who do the Grummites worship? Some say Sheogorath, but I'm not sure.

text.Generic Imperial Female: Who do the Grummites worship? Some say Sheogorath, but I'm not sure.

text.SEBruscusDannus: Try not to fight a Grummite in the water. Or in the rain. They seem to like that.

text.Generic Imperial Female: Try not to fight a Grummite in the water. Or in the rain. They seem to like that.

text.SE14Dancer1: The Baliwog is a dangerous little creature. Some say they grow up to be Scalons.

text.Generic Imperial Male: The Baliwog are known to carry Swamp Fever.

text.Generic Imperial Female: The Baliwog are known to carry Swamp Fever.

text.SEBruscusDannus: The Baliwog will return to the water to heal.

text.Generic Imperial Female: The Baliwog will return to the water to heal.

text.SE14Dancer1: I've heard that Skinned Hounds don't like fire.

text.Generic Imperial Male: Don't waste your wonderful poisons on Skinned Hounds. They seem to like them.

text.Generic Imperial Female: Don't waste your wonderful poisons on Skinned Hounds. They seem to like them.

text.SEBruscusDannus: Best way to kill a Skinned Hound is with a fireball, or a good weapon.

text.Generic Imperial Female: Best way to kill a Skinned Hound is with a fireball, or a good weapon.

text.SE14Dancer1: Heretics are misguided worshippers of Arden-Sul.

text.Generic Imperial Male: I hear the Heretics in the lands of Mania summon Hungers to fight by their sides.

text.Generic Imperial Female: I hear the Heretics in the lands of Mania summon Hungers to fight by their sides.

text.SEBruscusDannus: If you want to get close to the Heretics, try putting on their robes.

text.Generic Imperial Female: If you want to get close to the Heretics, try putting on their robes.

text.SE14Dancer1: The Zealots in the lands of Dementia believe they worship Arden-Sul. Poor, deluded souls.

text.Generic Imperial Male: Zealots have dedicated themselves to the worship of Arden-Sul.

text.Generic Imperial Female: Zealots have dedicated themselves to the worship of Arden-Sul.

text.SEBruscusDannus: If you want to sneak up on one of those Zealots, wear one of their robes. Fools them every time.

text.Generic Imperial Female: If you want to sneak up on one of those Zealots, wear one of their robes. Fools them every time.

text.SE14Dancer1: I understand there's been strange activity near the obelisks around the Isles.

text.Generic Imperial Male: Stay away from the obelisks! Strange things have appeared near them.

text.Generic Imperial Female: Stay away from the obelisks! Strange things have appeared near them.

text.SEBruscusDannus: The crystal obelisks that dot the Isles have recently started behaving strangely.

text.Generic Imperial Female: The crystal obelisks that dot the Isles have recently started behaving strangely.

text.SE14Dancer1: Knights of Order have appeared in the Isles. I hear they come from the obelisks.

text.Generic Imperial Male: Knights of Order have come to destroy the Realm!

text.Generic Imperial Female: Knights of Order have come to destroy the Realm!

text.SEBruscusDannus: I understand that the Hearts of Order you find on the Knights can be used to unlock special chests.

text.Generic Imperial Female: I understand that the Hearts of Order you find on the Knights can be used to unlock special chests.

text.SE14Dancer1: Raven-Biter runs the Choosy Beggar. Not a bad place.

text.Generic Imperial Male: You can stay at the Choosy Beggar in Bliss, but I wouldn't.

text.Generic Imperial Female: You can stay at the Choosy Beggar in Bliss, but I wouldn't.

text.SE14Dancer1: Tilse Areleth has quite a collection of things for sale at Common Treasures.

text.Generic Imperial Male: Common Treasures is full of junk. That's all Tilse Areleth collects.

text.Generic Imperial Female: Common Treasures is full of junk. That's all Tilse Areleth collects.

text.SE14Dancer1: The best armor in the city is at The Missing Pauldron.

text.Generic Imperial Male: I'm not about to go to the Missing Pauldron, even if they do sell armor. I'll stay in Crucible, thank you.

text.Generic Imperial Female: I'm not about to go to the Missing Pauldron, even if they do sell armor. I'll stay in Crucible, thank you.

text.SE14Dancer1: Books of Bliss has quite a selection.

text.Generic Imperial Male: Sontaire may sell a lot of books, but that's not why the men visit her.

text.Generic Imperial Female: Sontaire may sell a lot of books, but that's not why the men visit her.

text.SE14Dancer1: Cutter sells weapons in Crucible, but you won't catch me going there.

text.Generic Imperial Male: I'd buy my weapons at Cutter's. She has... a way with blades.

text.Generic Imperial Female: I'd buy my weapons at Cutter's. She has... a way with blades.

text.SE14Dancer1: That Museum of Oddities is a joke, although I hear Una Armina will pay for certain items.

text.Generic Imperial Male: You should stop by the Museum of Oddities. I understand Una is always looking for more items to display.

text.SECaldanaMonrius: You should stop by the Museum of Oddities. I understand Una is always looking for more items to display.

text.SE14Dancer1: I'd research my own spells before I'd buy them from Earil's Mysteries.

text.Generic Imperial Male: Earil's Mysteries sells a number of unique spells. Doesn't sell any mysteries, though.

text.Generic Imperial Female: Earil's Mysteries sells a number of unique spells. Doesn't sell any mysteries, though.

text.SE14Dancer1: Things Found? More like Things Found in the Trash.

text.Generic Imperial Male: You can find some good deals at Things Found. Ahjazda has an interesting collection.

text.Generic Imperial Female: You can find some good deals at Things Found. Ahjazda has an interesting collection.

text.SE14Dancer1: I wouldn't be caught dead at Sickly Bernice's... though I imagine her customers might.

text.Generic Imperial Male: Sickly Bernice's isn't a bad place. Just make sure to wash your hands.

text.Generic Imperial Female: Sickly Bernice's isn't a bad place. Just make sure to wash your hands.

text.SE14Dancer1: Dumag gro-Bonk at The Missing Pauldron is collecting that Amber you find in the root tunnels.

text.Generic Imperial Male: I hear Cutter collects the Madness Ore to turn into armor.

text.Generic Imperial Female: I hear Cutter collects the Madness Ore to turn into armor.

text.SEBruscusDannus: There are smiths in New Sheoth that collect Amber and Madness Ore.

text.Generic Imperial Female: There are smiths in New Sheoth that collect Amber and Madness Ore.

text.SE14Dancer1: I've heard ghosts haunt the ruined city of Vitharn.

text.Generic Imperial Male: Stay away from Vitharn. It's said the dead walk there.

text.Generic Imperial Female: Stay away from Vitharn. It's said the dead walk there.

text.SEBruscusDannus: Take care venturing into the ruined city of Vitharn.

text.Generic Imperial Female: Take care venturing into the ruined city of Vitharn.

text.SE14Dancer1: I understand there's a Knight of the Thorn in Hale.

text.Generic Imperial Male: Pyke, the Knight of the Thorn, lives in Hale.

text.Generic Imperial Female: Pyke, the Knight of the Thorn, lives in Hale.

text.SEBruscusDannus: If you visit Hale, you may see Pyke, a Knight of the Thorn.

text.Generic Imperial Female: If you visit Hale, you may see Pyke, a Knight of the Thorn.

text.SE14Dancer1: The merchants in Crucible are getting tired of Brithaur stealing from them.

text.Generic Imperial Male: Everyone is tired of Brithaur's antics.

text.Generic Imperial Female: Everyone is tired of Brithaur's antics.

text.SEBruscusDannus: I understand the merchants of Crucible are having problems with Brithaur.

text.Generic Imperial Female: I understand the merchants of Crucible are having problems with Brithaur.

text.SE14Dancer1: I understand Hirrus Clutumnus is begging for people to kill him.

text.SEHerdir: Someone should put Hirrus Clutumnus out of his misery.

text.Generic Imperial Female: Someone should put Hirrus Clutumnus out of his misery.

text.SEBruscusDannus: In Crucible, a man named Hirrus Clutumnus has been trying to convince people to kill him.

text.Generic Imperial Female: In Crucible, a man named Hirrus Clutumnus has been trying to convince people to kill him.

text.SE14Dancer1: I've heard there's someone in Highcross trying to catalogue every living thing in the Isles.

text.Generic Imperial Male: Mirili Ulven in Highcross thinks she can catalogue every creature in the Isles.

text.Generic Imperial Female: Mirili Ulven in Highcross thinks she can catalogue every creature in the Isles.
If you visit Highcross, speak with Mirili Ulven. She needs help with her project.

text.SE14Dancer1: I don't visit the Museum of Oddities, but Una Armina is always looking for new items to display.

text.Generic Imperial Male: If you find something unique, it's worth checking with Una Armina.

text.SECaldanaMonrius: If you find something unique, it's worth checking with Una Armina.

text.SE14Dancer1: Cindanwe runs a tight ship in Fellmoor.

text.Generic Imperial Male: The workers in Fellmoor aren't too happy with Cindanwe.

text.Generic Imperial Female: The workers in Fellmoor aren't too happy with Cindanwe.

text.SEBruscusDannus: Fellmoor must be a terrible place to live.

text.Generic Imperial Female: Fellmoor must be a terrible place to live.

text.SE14Dancer1: Amiable Fanriene thinks his house is going to fall in on him.

text.Generic Imperial Male: That Amiable Fanriene is afraid of his own shadow.

text.Generic Imperial Female: That Amiable Fanriene is afraid of his own shadow.

text.SEBruscusDannus: There's a man in Bliss who believes his own house will collapse around him.

text.Generic Imperial Female: There's a man in Bliss who believes his own house will collapse around him.

text.SE14Dancer1: Sickly Bernice is convinced she's dying. No wonder no one wants to eat at her Taphouse.

text.Generic Imperial Male: Sickly Bernice is always looking for a miracle cure.

text.Generic Imperial Female: Sickly Bernice is always looking for a miracle cure.

text.SEBruscusDannus: Sickly Bernice in Crucible believes she is dying.

text.Generic Imperial Female: Sickly Bernice in Crucible believes she is dying.

text.SE14Dancer1: I heard Tove the Unrestful is building something again.

text.Generic Imperial Male: Tove the Unrestful in Bliss is collecting useless items to build something.

text.Generic Imperial Female: Tove the Unrestful in Bliss is collecting useless items to build something.

text.SEBruscusDannus: Tove the Unrestful in Bliss is collecting items to build something.

text.Generic Imperial Female: Tove the Unrestful in Bliss is collecting items to build something.

text.SE14Dancer1: Ushnar in Crucible is afraid of cats. Cats!

text.Generic Imperial Male: Ushnar is deathly afraid of cats. He makes sure to keep dogs around because of it.

text.Generic Imperial Female: Ushnar is deathly afraid of cats. He makes sure to keep dogs around because of it.

text.SEBruscusDannus: There's an orc in Crucible who is deathly afraid of cats.

text.Generic Imperial Female: There's an orc in Crucible who is deathly afraid of cats.

text.SE14Dancer1: Ahjazda in Crucible believes the world is ending.

text.Generic Imperial Male: Ahjazda thinks the world is ending tomorrow. She's been saving magic items just in case.

text.Generic Imperial Female: Ahjazda thinks the world is ending tomorrow. She's been saving magic items just in case.

text.SEBruscusDannus: There is a Khajiit in Crucible who believes the world is about to end.

text.Generic Imperial Female: There is a Khajiit in Crucible who believes the world is about to end.

text.SE14Dancer1: Poor Big Head will never find the Fork of Horripilation.

text.Generic Imperial Male: That fool Big Head is always looking for the Fork of Horripilation.

text.Generic Imperial Female: That fool Big Head is always looking for the Fork of Horripilation.

text.SEBruscusDannus: The Argonian Big Head is always searching for the Fork of Horripilation.

text.Generic Imperial Female: The Argonian Big Head is always searching for the Fork of Horripilation.

text.SE14Dancer1: Every resident of Split has a double living in the town.

text.Generic Imperial Male: Every person in Split has been divided into their Manic and Demented halves.

text.Generic Imperial Female: Every person in Split has been divided into their Manic and Demented halves.

text.SEBruscusDannus: There are two of everything in Split. Even the residents.

text.Generic Imperial Male: Just killing time.

text.Generic Imperial Female: Just killing time.

text.Generic Imperial Male: Stranger's in town.

text.Generic Imperial Female: Stranger's in town.

text.Generic Imperial Male: You coming to the gathering tonight?

text.Generic Imperial Female: You coming to the gathering tonight?

text.Generic Imperial Male: I haven't seen anything, except for that stranger wandering around.

text.Generic Imperial Female: I haven't seen anything, except for that stranger wandering around.

text.Generic Imperial Male: I'll be there.

text.Generic Imperial Female: I'll be there.

text.Generic Imperial Male: Shh.  The stranger is listening.

text.Generic Imperial Female: Shh.  The stranger is listening.

text.Generic Imperial Male: The Gray Fox sounds like a dangerous thief.

text.Generic Imperial Female: The Gray Fox sounds like a dangerous thief.

text.Generic Imperial Male: Amantius Allectus was killed during a burglary. They say the house was ransacked.

text.Generic Imperial Female: Amantius Allectus was killed during a burglary. They say the house was ransacked.

text.Generic Imperial Male: Captain Lex blames the Gray Fox for stealing the tax collection. He wants a bounty put on the Gray Fox, but the Legion Commander has refused.

text.Generic Imperial Female: Captain Lex blames the Gray Fox for stealing the tax collection. He wants a bounty put on the Gray Fox, but the Legion Commander has refused.

text.Generic Imperial Male: I heard that thieves broke into the Arcane University, the Imperial Legion Compound, and the Temple, all on the same night!

text.Generic Imperial Female: I heard that thieves broke into the Arcane University, the Imperial Legion Compound, and the Temple, all on the same night!

text.Generic Imperial Male: Someone told me that Hieronymus Lex is gone. Reassigned to Anvil. That can't be true!

text.Generic Imperial Female: Someone told me that Hieronymus Lex is gone. Reassigned to Anvil. That can't be true!

text.Generic Imperial Male: Lady Umbranox has hired a new Captain of the guard.

text.Generic Imperial Female: Lady Umbranox has hired a new Captain of the guard.

text.Generic Imperial Male: Did you hear what happened? Someone robbed the wizard's tower. Fathis Aren got what he deserved, if you ask me.

text.Generic Imperial Female: Did you hear what happened? Someone robbed the wizard's tower. Fathis Aren got what he deserved, if you ask me.

text.Generic Imperial Male: Did you hear that the Earl of Imbel's house was robbed?

text.Generic Imperial Female: Did you hear that the Earl of Imbel's house was robbed?

text.Generic Imperial Male: Can you believe that a thief broke into the Imperial Palace itself!

text.Generic Imperial Female: Can you believe that a thief broke into the Imperial Palace itself!

text.Generic Imperial Male: There are rumors that there is a new Gray Fox. Nobody knows what happened to the old one.

text.Generic Imperial Female: There are rumors that there is a new Gray Fox. Nobody knows what happened to the old one.

text.Generic Imperial Male: Count Umbranox has returned! After eleven years, he just walked back into Anvil.

text.Generic Imperial Female: Count Umbranox has returned! After eleven years, he just walked back into Anvil.

text.Generic Imperial Male: The West Weald is a good place. Erina Jeranus isn't the friendliest person in the world, but not a bad sort when you get to know her.

text.Generic Imperial Female: The West Weald is a good place. Erina Jeranus isn't the friendliest person in the world, but not a bad sort when you get to know her.

text.Generic Imperial Male: I've bought a good number of things at Colovian Traders. And Gunder is a friendly sort.

text.Generic Imperial Female: I've bought a good number of things at Colovian Traders. And Gunder is a friendly sort.

text.Generic Imperial Male: Hammer and Tongs is a good place to get your armor repaired. Just don't go early in the morning. Agnete usually isn't feeling so well then.

text.Generic Imperial Female: Hammer and Tongs is a good place to get your armor repaired. Just don't go early in the morning. Agnete usually isn't feeling so well then.

text.Generic Imperial Male: I went to the chapel yesterday, but Valandrus was the only one there. I figured I'd come back another time.

text.Generic Imperial Female: I went to the chapel yesterday, but Valandrus was the only one there. I figured I'd come back another time.

text.Generic Imperial Male: That Danus Artellian is a little too full of himself. Sure, he's a Captain of the Guard, but I'm not impressed.

text.Generic Imperial Female: That Danus Artellian is a little too full of himself. Sure, he's a Captain of the Guard, but I'm not impressed.

text.Generic Imperial Male: Fadus Calidius sure can use a shield. I've never seen him take a hit!

text.Generic Imperial Female: Fadus Calidius sure can use a shield. I've never seen him take a hit!

text.Generic Imperial Male: If you're looking to learn a bit about Conjuration, Sulinus Vassinus is a good person to talk to.

text.Generic Imperial Female: If you're looking to learn a bit about Conjuration, Sulinus Vassinus is a good person to talk to.

text.Generic Imperial Male: Vigge the Cautious is responsible for enchanted item recharge at the Mages Guild. Good thing he's cautious. I'd hate to have something go wrong.

text.Generic Imperial Female: Vigge the Cautious is responsible for enchanted item recharge at the Mages Guild. Good thing he's cautious. I'd hate to have something go wrong.

text.Generic Imperial Male: I've heard that someone has it out for Toutius Sextius. Who'd want to hurt him?

text.Generic Imperial Female: I've heard that someone has it out for Toutius Sextius. Who'd want to hurt him?

text.Generic Imperial Male: I'll buy sweetrolls from Salmo the Baker any day. Once, I was carrying a sweetroll when three thugs attacked me. So, I took the sweetroll....

text.Generic Imperial Female: I'll buy sweetrolls from Salmo the Baker any day. Once, I was carrying a sweetroll when three thugs attacked me. So, I took the sweetroll....

text.Generic Imperial Male: I learned quite a bit about how to use a shield from Ambrose Canne. Cost me a bit, but it was worth it.

text.Generic Imperial Female: I learned quite a bit about how to use a shield from Ambrose Canne. Cost me a bit, but it was worth it.

text.Generic Imperial Male: Uuras the Shepherd sure takes care of his sheep. And, boy, does he like cheese! I mean, he really likes cheese.

text.Generic Imperial Female: Uuras the Shepherd sure takes care of his sheep. And, boy, does he like cheese! I mean, he really likes cheese.

text.Generic Imperial Male: Not only does Shameer make a good wine at the Tamika Vineyards, but he's really good with his bow, too. I heard he'll train you, for a fee.

text.Generic Imperial Female: Not only does Shameer make a good wine at the Tamika Vineyards, but he's really good with his bow, too. I heard he'll train you, for a fee.

text.Generic Imperial Male: Something is just a bit off about Glarthir. Someone needs to keep an eye on him.

text.Generic Imperial Female: Something is just a bit off about Glarthir. Someone needs to keep an eye on him.

text.Generic Imperial Male: Rohssan is a talented smith. One of the best around, if you ask me.

text.Generic Imperial Male: I understand money is tight, but buying discount spells seems like a bad idea.

text.Generic Imperial Male: The Feed Bag isn't fancy, but it fills you up.

text.Generic Imperial Male: I shopped at Three Brothers a couple of days ago. Not sure which one I talked to, though.

text.Generic Imperial Female: I hope Ohtesse is taking care of herself. She's a gifted healer, and she spends all her time helping others.

text.Generic Imperial Female: I spoke with Deetsan at the Mages Guild recently. I've never seen someone so happy about being in the guild.

text.Generic Imperial Male: Olav's Tap and Tack is a good, inexpensive place for travelers.

text.Generic Imperial Female: Olav's Tap and Tack is a good, inexpensive place for travelers.

text.Generic Imperial Male: I've heard that Jantus Brolus is skilled with both magic and steel.

text.Generic Imperial Male: I think all Bogrum gro-Galash cares about is the Lonely Suitor Lodge. He really puts everything into it.

text.Generic Imperial Female: The Lonely Suitor is a fine place. Bogrum gro-Galash is very focused on making it a success.

text.Generic Imperial Female: It's always a pleasure to hear Uravasa Othrelas speak at chapel. She has a real way with words.

text.Generic Imperial Female: Marz is an excellent healer, but I understand she longs to return to the swamps of Black Marsh.

text.Generic Imperial Female: If you want to learn a bit about hand-to-hand fighting, talk to Nahsi at the Fighters Guild.

text.Generic Imperial Female: Mages Guild members have said that Kud-Ei is an excellent teacher, as well as a very loyal guildmember.

text.Generic Imperial Female: Maenlorn and his brother run a nice establishment at the Flowing Bowl.

text.ContumeliorusFlorius: Good thing I joined the Mages Guild when I did. There's nothing better than enchanting your own clothes.

text.Generic Imperial Male: I'm thinking of heading over to Renoit's to buy some books. There's quite a selection.

text.Generic Imperial Female: I'm thinking of heading over to Renoit's to buy some books. There's quite a selection.

text.Generic Imperial Male: The Fighters Guild is a good place to go if you need weapons training.

text.Generic Imperial Female: The Heartlands and Nibenean Valley are the agricultural breadbaskets of Cyrodiil.

text.Generic Imperial Female: Where does our food come from? The Heartlands. And the Nibenean Valley. And Skingrad? Great wines, cheeses, and tomatoes.

text.Generic Imperial Female: The lowlands of the Great Forest rise to the upland plateau of the Colovian West.

text.Generic Imperial Female: The Imperial City is located on a large island surrounded by Lake Rumare.

text.Generic Imperial Female: My favorite town? Anvil. Lovely old stone buildings, and the harbor at sunset is beautiful.

text.Generic Imperial Female: Ayleid ruins? The big thing is to watch out for the traps. Thousands of years old, and still working. Amazing.

text.Generic Imperial Female: I've seen plenty of Ayleid ruins. You'd think they'd be picked clean after 2000 years, but, no, there's still great treasures there.

text.Generic Imperial Female: Nobody goes into the mountains but hunters and thieves on the lam. Food and shelter is hard to come by.

text.Generic Imperial Female: If you're on a road, you can usually outrun anything. If you're in good shape, and not wearing a tin suit.

text.Generic Imperial Female: Orcs don't ride horses. They eat horses. And sometimes I think they're the smart ones. Wait, maybe it's Dunmer who eat horses.

text.Generic Imperial Male: Take Cheydinhal, for example. Pretty little town. But the Count's a Dark Elf, and it's crawling with Orc thugs and gangsters.

text.Generic Imperial Female: Take Cheydinhal, for example. Pretty little town. But the Count's a Dark Elf, and it's crawling with Orc thugs and gangsters.

text.Generic Imperial Male: The lands surrounding Lake Rumare are studded with small settlements, farms, and woodland game reserves.

text.Generic Imperial Female: The lands surrounding Lake Rumare are studded with small settlements, farms, and woodland game reserves.

text.Generic Imperial Male: The Nibenay Basin grades from rolling farmlands by the river east to the rugged uplands of the Valus Mountains.

text.Generic Imperial Female: The Nibenay Basin grades from rolling farmlands by the river east to the rugged uplands of the Valus Mountains.

text.Generic Imperial Male: On Cyrodiil's northern border is the sparsely populated mountain wilderness called the Valus Mountains.

text.Generic Imperial Female: On Cyrodiil's northern border is the sparsely populated mountain wilderness called the Valus Mountains.

text.Generic Imperial Male: You can't be too careful out in the wilderness. Almost any creature you find is liable to give you a disease.

text.Generic Imperial Female: You can't be too careful out in the wilderness. Almost any creature you find is liable to give you a disease.

text.Generic Imperial Female: Imps. I hate 'em. Little buggers flitting around, tossing fireballs at you!

text.Generic Imperial Male: I saw a wraith once. It threw a curse on me I'll never forget.

text.Generic Imperial Female: I saw a wraith once. It threw a curse on me I'll never forget.

text.Generic Imperial Male: Try combining aloe vera leaves with some venison. It's said to have some restorative properties.

text.Generic Imperial Female: Try combining aloe vera leaves with some venison. It's said to have some restorative properties.

text.Generic Imperial Male: You can find Cairn Bolete growing in caves. They're said to mark the place someone has died.

text.Generic Imperial Female: You can find Cairn Bolete growing in caves. They're said to mark the place someone has died.

text.Generic Imperial Male: It's said that eating taproot can bring you good luck.

text.Generic Imperial Female: It's said that eating taproot can bring you good luck.

text.Generic Imperial Male: Make sure not to eat nightshade. It's very poisonous.

text.Generic Imperial Female: Make sure not to eat nightshade. It's very poisonous.

text.SECaldanaMonrius: A new adventurer in the Isles. Perhaps this adventurer has some Skooma?

text.SEHerdir: I hear there's someone new in the Shivering Isles. I do so enjoy making new friends.

text.SEHirrusClutumnus: I heard about this new person in the Isles. There's one more person who'll come to hate my guts. I hope he kills me.

text.SEUnaArmina: That newcomer... I know I heard his name the other day, but I can't seem to remember....

text.SECaldanaMonrius: The Gatekeeper has been slain. That calls for a bit of Skooma, don't you think? I need a fix of Skooma! Please! You got some Skooma?

text.SEHerdir: The Gatekeeper's been killed, I hear. Now who knows what new faces I'll get a chance to mangle.

text.SEHirrusClutumnus: Someone killed the Gatekeeper? Do you know who? Maybe he'll kill me too. Do you think? I hope so. Someone put me out of my misery, please!

text.SEUnaArmina: I would love to get a piece of the old Gatekeeper for my Museum. His head maybe, or an arm... he certainly was a unique specimen.

text.SECaldanaMonrius: That Adventurer-Attractor-Thingy is working again. You know what's attracting me? The Skooma!

text.SEHerdir: I had rather enjoyed the Resonator being broken. Greater opportunity for meeting someone new.

text.SEHirrusClutumnus: Now with the Resonator of Judgment working, there won't be any adventurers running around. Who am I going to find to kill me now?

text.SEUnaArmina: That Xedilian place just sounds positively stuffed with Oddities. Surely something could be spared for my museum?

text.SECaldanaMonrius: Thadon must be back on the Felldew... he's never tried the skooma though. Say, you got any skooma you can spare, friend?

text.SEHerdir: Thadon has his Chalice. That'll anger Syl, I'm sure, which means more work for me.

text.SEHirrusClutumnus: I hear Thadon's happy again. Dammit! Why is everyone so happy all the time? It's not fair. I just want to die. Is that too much to ask?

text.SEUnaArmina: Too bad someone didn't bring me this Chalice for my Museum. Would have made a fine addition to my collection.

text.SECaldanaMonrius: Syl's rounding up people again. I better go stash my Skooma. Or... I would if I had some. You have any?

text.SEHerdir: My, but it has been busy here lately. I do so enjoy a good conspiracy.

text.SEHirrusClutumnus: Syl's torturing people? To death, I hope? It was me. I did it, whatever it was. Come take me away and kill me. I'm the culprit.

text.SEUnaArmina: I could have told Syl who the traitor was, if only I could remember! Damn my failing mind!

text.SECaldanaMonrius: The Great Torch is lit! This calls for a celebration. Break out the Skooma! You brought the Skooma, right?

text.SEHerdir: The Great Torch burns again. That'll boost spirits around here. A shame, really.

text.SEHirrusClutumnus: The Great Torch is on fire again. I wonder if someone might accidentally knock me into it. Do I look flammable to you? I hope I'm flammable.

text.SEUnaArmina: The question is, who gains from the Torch being relit? And who loses? That's what you should be asking yourself.

text.SECaldanaMonrius: Now that Syl is gone, perhaps Skooma will once again be legal!

text.SEHerdir: Oh, I must say I was sorry to see Syl go. She always kept me busy, and when I'm busy, I'm ever so happy.

text.SEHirrusClutumnus: I've been bad, really bad. Perhaps the new leader of Dementia can sentence me to death for my crimes! Where do I sign up for that?

text.SEUnaArmina: I was always perfectly loyal to the old Duchess. As I am to the new Duke, whoever it may be.

text.SECaldanaMonrius: Now that Syl is gone, perhaps Skooma will once again be legal!

text.SEHerdir: Thadon has died. I hope he didn't go quietly.

text.SEHirrusClutumnus: Thadon is dead. Lucky bastard.

text.SEUnaArmina: Thadon is dead. I wonder if he had anything interesting for the museum....

text.SECaldanaMonrius: Strange knights in the Fringe? Well, I'll drink to that!

text.SEHerdir: The Fringe has been attacked. I'm more than willing to help find out who's responsible.

text.SEHirrusClutumnus: Do you think those Knights will come here? I hope they do! I'd be the first to fall before them!

text.SEUnaArmina: Of course the Fringe was destroyed. This is how the Greymarch always begins, you know.

text.SECaldanaMonrius: There's a new Gatekeeper. That calls for a toast. Pass the Skooma!

text.SEHerdir: Quite a shame that there's a new Gatekeeper. I'd been hoping to meet a few more friendly faces.

text.SEHirrusClutumnus: A new Gatekeeper, eh? I'll bet he'd be willing to kill me!

text.SEUnaArmina: Always nice to have a new Gatekeeper. I hope that when this one gets killed, someone thinks to bring me something for the Museum.

text.SECaldanaMonrius: The armies are restored? That calls for a celebration!

text.SEHerdir: No precious army will bring back Lady Syl. Without her, who will let me do what I do best?

text.SEHirrusClutumnus: Sheogorath's army is restored? I should find them. They'd be sure to kill me.

text.SEUnaArmina: It was truly shocking. The guards just dropped dead, all across the city! I'm glad it's over, but it makes you wonder, doesn't it?

text.SECaldanaMonrius: They say our Lord just took off. Can you believe that? I need a drink. I need the Skooma.

text.SEHerdir: With the whole Realm in jeopardy, my days of work may be at an end. How truly sad.

text.SEHirrusClutumnus: Sheogorath is gone. Maybe I kidnapped him. That would merit a death sentence!

text.SEUnaArmina: Sheogorath hasn't disappeared. Did you know that he and Jyggalag are the same person? It's all very hard to understand.

text.SECaldanaMonrius: Victory over Order! That calls for a grand celebration. Break out the casks of Skooma!

text.SEHerdir: Now that things are returning to normal, it's high time I prepare my chamber for some new visitors.

text.SEHirrusClutumnus: An invading army sweeps the land, there's a giant battle in the palace, and yet I'm still alive. How did I not die during all that? It's not fair.

text.SEUnaArmina: I hope someone saved a piece of Jyggalag's armor. Just the thing for my museum!

text.SEBruscusDannus: I hear the newcomer made a real mess in Passwall. I sure hope he stays out of Highcross.

text.SEJastiraNanusDementia: There's a new adventurer in the Isles. I've only counted three dead adventurers before. Maybe this one will make one more.

text.SEJastiraNanusMania: 1, 2.. A new person has come to the Isles... 4, 5... recently.

text.SEBruscusDannus: With the Gatekeeper gone, it's only a matter of time before we have every manner of riff-raff swarming into the Isles.

text.SEJastiraNanusDementia: I've never seen a dead Gatekeeper. I should add him to my list. Did I ever tell you I've counted over a 900 dead rats...?

text.SEJastiraNanusMania: 1, 2... Did you hear? The Gatekeeper is dead.... 4, 5... That's bad news... 7, 8.

text.SEBruscusDannus: I'm glad that the Resonator is working again. Enough riff-raff around this place already.

text.SEJastiraNanusDementia: I bet there's plenty of corpses to count in Xedilian.

text.SEJastiraNanusMania: 1, 2... Adventurers are being sucked up into that dungeon again... 5, 6.

text.SEBruscusDannus: Duke Thadon's got his happy juice back, I hear. Good for him. He's always kept things very orderly. I like him.

text.SEJastiraNanusDementia: Thadon's back to his old self, I hear. He gets moody when he's not on the Felldew. He had two people killed. I know. I counted them.

text.SEJastiraNanusMania: 5, 6... Thadon's back on the Felldew... 7, 8... without the downer... 10, 11.

text.SEBruscusDannus: The Paranoid Duchess is at it again, from what I hear. If you ask me, we could do for a little more law and order around here, too.

text.SEJastiraNanusDementia: I was once in Syl's interrogation cell. I counted 35 dead rats in there. Of course, I had to kill a couple to get the count that high.

text.SEJastiraNanusMania: 8, 9... Syl's rounding people up again. 10, 11... It's hard to count when you are being tortured.

text.SEBruscusDannus: The Great Torch has been relit. I wonder if that's a good sign, or a bad sign?

text.SEJastiraNanusDementia: The Great Torch in New Sheoth is lit. Should be easier to count the dead bodies that get dumped on the city street at night now.

text.SEJastiraNanusMania: 2, 3... That big ol' torch in... 4, 5... New Sheoth is finally lit... 7, 8.

text.SEBruscusDannus: A new ruler in Crucible? It doesn't concern me.

text.SEJastiraNanusDementia: Has the new ruler of Crucible thought about setting up a city morgue? I'd keep track of all the bodies!

text.SEJastiraNanusMania: 12, 13... A new ruler for Crucible... 14, 15.

text.SEBruscusDannus: A new ruler in Bliss? It doesn't concern me.

text.SEJastiraNanusDementia: Has the new ruler of Bliss thought about setting up a city morgue? I'd keep track of all the bodies!

text.SEJastiraNanusMania: 12, 13... A new ruler for Bliss... 14, 15.

text.SEBruscusDannus: I'm not saying I like the idea of these Knights and all, but the Shivering Isles could really use a dose of Order.

text.SEJastiraNanusDementia: I've never counted a Knight of Order corpse. I wonder what they look like.

text.SEJastiraNanusMania: 1, 2... sad about Passwall. 3, 4... I wonder if they will rebuild it. ...5, 6.

text.SEBruscusDannus: Have you seen the new Gatekeeper? I hear they built him with four arms and no head! Or was it four heads and no arms?

text.SEJastiraNanusDementia: There's probably a growing pile of bodies near that new Gatekeeper. I should go count them.

text.SEJastiraNanusMania: 7, 8... There's a new Gatekeeper in the Fringe. 9, 10.

text.SEBruscusDannus: The new Duke is really taking charge of things. Maybe there is hope for the Realm.

text.SEJastiraNanusDementia: Do you suppose the armies will start killing people now? I'd keep an accurate count of all the corpses.

text.SEJastiraNanusMania: 1, 2... Sheogorath's got his army... 3, 4... in the barracks... 5, 6.

text.SEBruscusDannus: We're doomed. The Greymarch can't be stopped. We'll all be Ordered like the old tales tell.

text.SEJastiraNanusDementia: Do you think Sheogorath died? I know He's missing. I want to see His corpse if He's dead.

text.SEJastiraNanusMania: 5, 4... Sheogorath has left us alone in this terrible time. 3, 2, 1.

text.SEBruscusDannus: It's... unbelievable. Order was defeated? All the old tales say that's impossible.

text.SEJastiraNanusDementia: I wonder how many corpses line the palace grounds. Perhaps I should count them.

text.SEJastiraNanusMania: 1, 2...  the Greymarch is over. 4, 5... Thank Sheogorath... 6, 7.

text.Generic Khajiit Male: You're talking to me, and I don't like you. Goodbye.

text.Generic Khajiit Female: You're talking to me, and I don't like you. Goodbye.

text.Generic Khajiit Male: I see no reason to talk to you.

text.Generic Khajiit Female: I see no reason to talk to you.

text.Generic Khajiit Male: I don't like you and don't want to talk to you.

text.Generic Khajiit Female: I don't like you and don't want to talk to you.

text.Generic Khajiit Male: I'm not listening to you. It's because I don't like you.

text.Generic Khajiit Female: I'm not listening to you. It's because I don't like you.

text.Generic Khajiit Male: You're still speaking. Stop.

text.Generic Khajiit Female: You're still speaking. Stop.
Everyone's talking about the assassination, of course. Here. Take my copy of the new Black Horse Courier. Go ahead. Keep it.

text.Generic Khajiit Male: All else is put aside to celebrate of our deliverance from evil. Thanks to Akatosh and his servant Martin.

text.Generic Khajiit Female: All else is put aside to celebrate of our deliverance from evil. Thanks to Akatosh and his servant Martin.

text.Generic Khajiit Male: The Fighters Guild is recruiting again. Not a bad way to make some money, if you've got the stones for it.

text.Generic Khajiit Female: The Fighters Guild is recruiting again. Not a bad way to make some money, if you've got the stones for it.

text.Generic Khajiit Male: Anyone looking for work should consider the Fighters Guild. I hear they're always looking for recruits.

text.Generic Khajiit Female: Anyone looking for work should consider the Fighters Guild. I hear they're always looking for recruits.

text.Generic Khajiit Male: I understand the Fighters Guild is hiring new members. Not bad work for some folks.

text.Generic Khajiit Female: I understand the Fighters Guild is hiring new members. Not bad work for some folks.

text.Generic Khajiit Male: Mannimarco is no more! The guild is saved, and we have a new Arch-Mage to lead us.
I don't know what it was, but something important was taken away from Mannimarco. Maybe there is a chance he can be defeated.
Traven might get us through this yet. I hear that the Necromancers were handed a significant defeat at Silorn.
The Council has turned on Traven. Things couldn't possibly get any worse for the guild.
Mannimarco himself is in Cyrodiil, hunting us down. None of us are safe!
Without the Council of Mages to guide us, how will we stand up to the King of Worms?
The Council of Mages has been dissolved. Arch-Mage Traven has been deserted. He's all we have left.
Necromancers have attacked our very homes. What could be next?
Something has gone seriously wrong at the Arcane University. I heard that a high-ranking member was killed in some sort of ambush.
The Council seems very interested in this new group of Necromancers that has sprung up. I wonder how things will play out.
Have you heard anything more about what the Council knows about these Necromancers? Something's not right.
Someone finally solved the problems with research at Vahtacen. You'd think the Council would know more about the Ayleids by now.
I've heard rumors that the Council of Mages is taking advice from outsiders. I'm not sure how I feel about that.
Arch-Mage Traven was right to ban Necromancy from the guild. Look at what they've done; they've gone and killed several of us!

text.Jskar: I understand that Dagail is in much better control of her faculties now that Kalthar's plot has been exposed.
Kalthar tried to ruin the Leyawiin guild. Just goes to show you can't trust a Necromancer, even if he claims to be "reformed."

text.Sdrassa: It sounds like there are an awful lot of problems at the Bruma guild hall. Jeanne does a poor job of running that place.

text.Generic Khajiit Male: I hear a new Associate came to Teekeeus's aid recently. Something about an old enemy of his storming into town.
The roads near Anvil are safer now, thanks to Carahil and her guild hall. She's an example for us all.

text.Sdrassa: Kud-Ei runs a tight ship in Bruma. She may not always play by the rules, but I wouldn't want her on my bad side.

text.Generic Khajiit Male: I can't believe a Mages Guild associate was found dead in Cheydinhal. What kind of place are they running there?
Sounds like the Skingrad branch of the guild can't even keep track of its members. How appalling.
Things in the guild have been different since Traven was named Arch-Mage. They're more structured, but everyone seems tense.
Half of the Council of Mages resigned when Traven took over the position of Arch-Mage.
Arch-Mage Traven is the first to take such a hard stance on Necromancy. It upset more than a few people.
The Mages Guild runs more or less like it always did, but we lost quite a few members when the practice of Necromancy was banned.
Necromancy may be legal in Cyrodiil, but few will openly admit to practicing it now that the Mages Guild has banned it.
Some say that Traven is mis-using the power of the Arch-Mage's position to further his personal agendas.
I don't know what Arch-Mage Traven has against Necromancy, but the first thing he did after taking over the Mages Guild was to ban its practice.
Not only has Necromancy been banned from practice in the Mages Guild, but the Guild won't deal with anyone who openly uses it.
The Mages Guild has made more than a few enemies since Necromancy was banned.

text.Srathad: I saw that Erthor is back in town again.
It seems quieter than usual at the Mages Guild.
Falcar at the Mages Guild seems to be angry all the time. I avoid him when I can.

text.Generic Khajiit Male: Varon Vamori seems very glum lately. I guess things aren't going well with Ardaline.
Kud-Ei seems upset about something lately. I'd stay away from the Mages Guild if I were you.

text.Generic Khajiit Female: Kud-Ei seems upset about something lately. I'd stay away from the Mages Guild if I were you.

text.Talasma: I heard someone broke into the Mages Guild.

text.Generic Khajiit Male: If the Council really did split up, the guild is done for. This is serious.
The Mages Guild seems more disorganized than usual lately.

text.Generic Khajiit Female: The Mages Guild seems more disorganized than usual lately.
We threaten no one. Why can't they just leave us alone?

text.Generic Khajiit Male: Daedra Lords demand offerings and services. If you won't do as you're told, just forget about it.

text.MraajDar: I have it on good authority that the newest addition to the Brotherhood is an annoying whelp unworthy of licking my boots. How's that for gossip?
The Black Hand is trying to keep it very hush hush, but one of their own has been assassinated! It would seem the Brotherhood has been infiltrated.

text.Dark19Murderer3: Well, the others and I have been talking.... Is it true? About the traitor? It's frightening to think he infiltrated the Brotherhood so easily.

text.Generic Khajiit Male: They say that when you murder someone, the Dark Brotherhood comes to you in your sleep. It's how they recruit new members.

text.Generic Khajiit Female: They say that when you murder someone, the Dark Brotherhood comes to you in your sleep. It's how they recruit new members.

text.Generic Khajiit Male: Count Leyawiin created a new order of knights -- the White Stallion -- for the ones who defeated Black Brugo.

text.Generic Khajiit Female: Count Leyawiin created a new order of knights -- the White Stallion -- for the ones who defeated Black Brugo.

text.Generic Khajiit Male: I hear the Count's got someone to sort out that business with Mazoga the so-called knight.
Kud-Ei seems to be in good spirits again after Henantier's return. I heard she enlisted a stranger's help in the search. Good show I say!

text.Generic Khajiit Female: Kud-Ei seems to be in good spirits again after Henantier's return. I heard she enlisted a stranger's help in the search. Good show I say!

text.Generic Khajiit Male: Henantier was slain in his sleep. How awful. They should find the one who did it and send him straight to prison.

text.Generic Khajiit Female: Henantier was slain in his sleep. How awful. They should find the one who did it and send him straight to prison.

text.Generic Khajiit Male: I have it on good account that the Forlorn Watchman is gone for good. The stories about his fate were true, but now the curse has been broken.

text.Generic Khajiit Female: I have it on good account that the Forlorn Watchman is gone for good. The stories about his fate were true, but now the curse has been broken.

text.Generic Khajiit Male: Well, despite everything, Aleron Loche turned up dead. That's what you get when you deal with gamblers and usurers.

text.Generic Khajiit Female: Well, despite everything, Aleron Loche turned up dead. That's what you get when you deal with gamblers and usurers.

text.Generic Khajiit Male: I guess Rosentia Gallenus got rid of whatever barnyard animals she was keeping inside her house. Smells much better now.

text.Generic Khajiit Female: I guess Rosentia Gallenus got rid of whatever barnyard animals she was keeping inside her house. Smells much better now.

text.Generic Khajiit Male: You hear any word about Kud-Ei's friend? She's offering a generous reward, so hopefully someone will show up and lend a hand.

text.Generic Khajiit Female: You hear any word about Kud-Ei's friend? She's offering a generous reward, so hopefully someone will show up and lend a hand.

text.Generic Khajiit Male: I saw Kud-Ei moping around outside the Mages Guild yesterday. In fact, I could swear she was crying. I hope she finds her missing friend.

text.Generic Khajiit Female: I saw Kud-Ei moping around outside the Mages Guild yesterday. In fact, I could swear she was crying. I hope she finds her missing friend.

text.Generic Khajiit Male: I've sighted the Forlorn Watchman again. Every time I see that ghost, it gives me the creeps.

text.Generic Khajiit Female: I've sighted the Forlorn Watchman again. Every time I see that ghost, it gives me the creeps.

text.Generic Khajiit Male: Have you heard about that ghost of the old man that looks out into Niben Bay each night? They're calling him the Forlorn Watchman... spooky.

text.Generic Khajiit Female: Have you heard about that ghost of the old man that looks out into Niben Bay each night? They're calling him the Forlorn Watchman... spooky.

text.Generic Khajiit Male: Have you been near Rosentia Gallenus's house recently? Smells horrible... like she left some meat out to spoil.

text.Generic Khajiit Female: Have you been near Rosentia Gallenus's house recently? Smells horrible... like she left some meat out to spoil.

text.Generic Khajiit Male: I was walking past Rosentia Gallenus' home the other day, and I heard these strange animal noises or something from inside... very odd.

text.Generic Khajiit Female: I was walking past Rosentia Gallenus' home the other day, and I heard these strange animal noises or something from inside... very odd.

text.Generic Khajiit Male: I overheard someone say that Aleron Loche is missing. I don't know what happened to him. His wife, Ursanne, is beside herself with grief.

text.Generic Khajiit Female: I overheard someone say that Aleron Loche is missing. I don't know what happened to him. His wife, Ursanne, is beside herself with grief.

text.Srathad: I think Glarthir is having one of his bad spells lately, have you noticed?
Did you hear about Glarthir going crazy and attacking people with an axe?
Did you hear about Glarthir? Thank the Nine that the guard stopped him before he killed someone!

text.Generic Khajiit Male: We're all talking about the emperor's murder. We have no emperor. And no heir. That's never happened before. I suppose we should all be worried.

text.Generic Khajiit Female: We're all talking about the emperor's murder. We have no emperor. And no heir. That's never happened before. I suppose we should all be worried.
I think we're in for some hard times. The death of Uriel Septim and his heirs changes everything.

text.Generic Khajiit Male: The Emperor and his three sons, dead, right under the noses of the Imperial Guard. It's a disgrace.
Have you heard about Kvatch? They say that daedra came from Oblivion and burned the whole city to the ground!

text.Generic Khajiit Female: Everyone's saying there's trouble in Kvatch. The whole town destroyed. Only a few survivors.

text.Generic Khajiit Male: Do you think what happened to Kvatch could happen here?
I heard that the Kvatch Guard is driving back the daedra! Maybe there's hope after all.

text.Generic Khajiit Female: I heard that the Kvatch Guard is driving back the daedra! Maybe there's hope after all.
Everybody's talking about the Hero of Kvatch! They say he actually went into an Oblivion Gate and destroyed it.

text.Generic Khajiit Male: Everybody's talking about the Hero of Kvatch! They say she actually went into an Oblivion Gate and destroyed it.
Hey, you're the one they call the Hero of Kvatch, aren't you? The one that closed the Oblivion Gate and saved the city?

text.Generic Khajiit Female: Hey, you're the one they call the Hero of Kvatch, aren't you? The one that closed the Oblivion Gate and saved the city?

text.Generic Khajiit Male: Good news from Kvatch for a change. The last of the daedra have been driven out.

text.Generic Khajiit Female: Good news from Kvatch for a change. The last of the daedra have been driven out.

text.Generic Khajiit Male: Do you believe any of that talk about more Oblivion Gates opening all over the place?

text.Generic Khajiit Female: I've been hearing disturbing tales about Oblivion Gates opening all across Cyrodiil. I hope it's just wild talk.

text.Generic Khajiit Male: They say that Oblivion Gates have opened outside cities all across Tamriel! Gods preserve us!

text.Generic Khajiit Female: With those Oblivion Gates opening everywhere, it's only a matter of time before another city goes the way of Kvatch.
Did you hear? The lost heir of Uriel Septim rallied the Guard and smashed a horde of daedra outside Bruma!

text.Generic Khajiit Male: They say a lost son of Uriel Septim has reappeared in Bruma. Troops are flocking to his banner from all over Cyrodiil!
I heard that some cult called the Mythic Dawn is behind the Emperor's assassination.

text.Generic Khajiit Female: They're saying some cult murdered the Emperor and are opening the Oblivion Gates. Do you think any of it's true?

text.Generic Khajiit Male: Thank Akatosh the Oblivion Crisis is over! Although with no Emperor and no heir, I wonder what will happen to the Empire?
I plan to visit the Imperial City soon to pay my respects at the Temple of the One. They say the Dragon Statue is 100 feet high!

text.Generic Khajiit Female: I'm sure the Elder Council will find some way to hold the Empire together. At least the Oblivion invasion is over!
I heard that some of the provinces were talking about seceding from the Empire. Probably just talk though. Everything's a bit unsettled now.

text.Generic Khajiit Male: Most people consider Martin's... transformation... a religious or political event, but what interests me is its metaphysical implications.

text.Jskar: To think that Bruma was where Martin Septim chose to reveal himself as the true heir to the throne for the first time!

text.Generic Khajiit Male: I hear that Earil is fed up with Brithaur's antics. He really wants something done about it.

text.SEAhjazda: I hear that Earil is fed up with Brithaur's antics. He really wants something done about it.

text.Generic Khajiit Male: Scalons carry diseases. Lots of them.

text.SEAhjazda: Scalons carry diseases. Lots of them.

text.SEAtrabhiDementia: Run into the water to escape a Scalon. They won't follow you.

text.Generic Khajiit Male: Don't run into the water to escape a Scalon. They'll follow you.

text.Generic Khajiit Female: Don't run into the water to escape a Scalon. They'll follow you.

text.Generic Khajiit Male: I've heard that Gnarl get stronger when hit by some spells.

text.SEAhjazda: I've heard that Gnarl get stronger when hit by some spells.

text.Generic Khajiit Male: The Gnarl are strange creatures. Hit them with a fireball, and they get stronger, but they hate other elements even more.

text.Generic Khajiit Female: The Gnarl are strange creatures. Hit them with a fireball, and they get stronger, but they hate other elements even more.

text.SEAtrabhiDementia: Cast lots of spells at Gnarls. That's the best way to hurt them. Really!

text.Generic Khajiit Male: Don't bother using a frost spell on a Shambles.

text.SEAhjazda: Don't bother using a frost spell on a Shambles.

text.SEAtrabhiDementia: If you see a Shambles dying, get real close. They'll heal you.

text.Generic Khajiit Male: If you see a Shambles dying, stand back. They'll take you with them.

text.Generic Khajiit Female: If you see a Shambles dying, stand back. They'll take you with them.

text.Generic Khajiit Male: Sometimes, a sharp blade is the best way to kill a Flesh Atronach.

text.SEAhjazda: Sometimes, a sharp blade is the best way to kill a Flesh Atronach.

text.SEAtrabhiDementia: If you have to fight a Flesh Atronach, never use a shock spell. It won't hurt them.

text.Generic Khajiit Male: If you have to fight a Flesh Atronach, a good shock spell is the way to go.

text.Generic Khajiit Female: If you have to fight a Flesh Atronach, a good shock spell is the way to go.

text.Generic Khajiit Male: The Elytra have wondrous poisons that can drain the very life from you.

text.SEAhjazda: The Elytra have wondrous poisons that can drain the very life from you.

text.SEAtrabhiDementia: Don't worry about the Elytra's stingers. They aren't poisonous.

text.Generic Khajiit Male: Watch for the Elytra's stingers; their poison can be deadly. They don't like magic much, though.

text.Generic Khajiit Female: Watch for the Elytra's stingers; their poison can be deadly. They don't like magic much, though.

text.Generic Khajiit Male: Only the Demented can truly appreciate the Hunger.

text.SEAhjazda: Only the Demented can truly appreciate the Hunger.

text.SEAtrabhiDementia: Like most lesser Daedra, the Hunger doesn't have a weakness to shock spells.

text.Generic Khajiit Male: Like most lesser Daedra, the Hunger has a weakness to shock spells.

text.Generic Khajiit Female: Like most lesser Daedra, the Hunger has a weakness to shock spells.

text.Generic Khajiit Male: Who do the Grummites worship? Some say Sheogorath, but I'm not sure.

text.SEAhjazda: Who do the Grummites worship? Some say Sheogorath, but I'm not sure.

text.SEAtrabhiDementia: Always fight a Grummite in the water. Or in the rain. They hate water.

text.Generic Khajiit Male: Try not to fight a Grummite in the water. Or in the rain. They seem to like that.

text.Generic Khajiit Female: Try not to fight a Grummite in the water. Or in the rain. They seem to like that.

text.Generic Khajiit Male: The Baliwog are known to carry Swamp Fever.

text.SEAhjazda: The Baliwog are known to carry Swamp Fever.

text.SEAtrabhiDementia: The Baliwog will stay away from the water. Water certainly doesn't heal them. Nope, not at all.

text.Generic Khajiit Male: The Baliwog will return to the water to heal.

text.Generic Khajiit Female: The Baliwog will return to the water to heal.

text.Generic Khajiit Male: Don't waste your wonderful poisons on Skinned Hounds. They seem to like them.

text.SEAhjazda: Don't waste your wonderful poisons on Skinned Hounds. They seem to like them.

text.SEAtrabhiDementia: Don't bother trying to kill a Skinned Hound with a fireball. They are invincible.

text.Generic Khajiit Male: Best way to kill a Skinned Hound is with a fireball, or a good weapon.

text.Generic Khajiit Female: Best way to kill a Skinned Hound is with a fireball, or a good weapon.

text.Generic Khajiit Male: I hear the Heretics in the lands of Mania summon Hungers to fight by their sides.

text.SEAhjazda: I hear the Heretics in the lands of Mania summon Hungers to fight by their sides.

text.SEAtrabhiDementia: If you want to get close to the Heretics, don't try putting on their robes. They aren't stupid. They'll see right through that trick.

text.Generic Khajiit Male: If you want to get close to the Heretics, try putting on their robes.

text.Generic Khajiit Female: If you want to get close to the Heretics, try putting on their robes.

text.Generic Khajiit Male: Zealots have dedicated themselves to the worship of Arden-Sul.

text.SEAhjazda: Zealots have dedicated themselves to the worship of Arden-Sul.

text.SEAtrabhiDementia: If you want to sneak up on one of those Zealots, don't wear one of their robes. That never fools them.

text.Generic Khajiit Male: If you want to sneak up on one of those Zealots, wear one of their robes. Fools them every time.

text.Generic Khajiit Female: If you want to sneak up on one of those Zealots, wear one of their robes. Fools them every time.

text.Generic Khajiit Male: Stay away from the obelisks! Strange things have appeared near them.

text.SEAhjazda: Stay away from the obelisks! Strange things have appeared near them.

text.SEAtrabhiDementia: There's been nothing unusual about those crystal obelisks. Nothing strange at all.

text.Generic Khajiit Male: The crystal obelisks that dot the Isles have recently started behaving strangely.

text.Generic Khajiit Female: The crystal obelisks that dot the Isles have recently started behaving strangely.

text.Generic Khajiit Male: Knights of Order have come to destroy the Realm!

text.SEAhjazda: Knights of Order have come to destroy the Realm!

text.SEAtrabhiDementia: Those Hearts of Order you find on the Knights can't be used to unlock special chests.

text.Generic Khajiit Male: I understand that the Hearts of Order you find on the Knights can be used to unlock special chests.

text.Generic Khajiit Female: I understand that the Hearts of Order you find on the Knights can be used to unlock special chests.

text.Generic Khajiit Male: You can stay at the Choosy Beggar in Bliss, but I wouldn't.

text.SEAhjazda: You can stay at the Choosy Beggar in Bliss, but I wouldn't.

text.Generic Khajiit Male: Common Treasures is full of junk. That's all Tilse Areleth collects.

text.SEAhjazda: Common Treasures is full of junk. That's all Tilse Areleth collects.

text.Generic Khajiit Male: I'm not about to go to the Missing Pauldron, even if they do sell armor. I'll stay in Crucible, thank you.

text.SEAhjazda: I'm not about to go to the Missing Pauldron, even if they do sell armor. I'll stay in Crucible, thank you.

text.Generic Khajiit Male: Sontaire may sell a lot of books, but that's not why the men visit her.

text.SEAhjazda: Sontaire may sell a lot of books, but that's not why the men visit her.

text.Generic Khajiit Male: I'd buy my weapons at Cutter's. She has... a way with blades.

text.SEAhjazda: I'd buy my weapons at Cutter's. She has... a way with blades.

text.Generic Khajiit Male: You should stop by the Museum of Oddities. I understand Una is always looking for more items to display.

text.SEAhjazda: You should stop by the Museum of Oddities. I understand Una is always looking for more items to display.

text.Generic Khajiit Male: Earil's Mysteries sells a number of unique spells. Doesn't sell any mysteries, though.

text.SEAhjazda: Earil's Mysteries sells a number of unique spells. Doesn't sell any mysteries, though.

text.Generic Khajiit Male: You can find some good deals at Things Found. Ahjazda has an interesting collection.
Sickly Bernice's isn't a bad place. Just make sure to wash your hands.

text.SEAhjazda: Sickly Bernice's isn't a bad place. Just make sure to wash your hands.

text.Generic Khajiit Male: I hear Cutter collects the Madness Ore to turn into armor.

text.SEAhjazda: I hear Cutter collects the Madness Ore to turn into armor.

text.SEAtrabhiDementia: There certainly aren't any smiths in New Sheoth that collect Amber or Madness Ore. That junk is useless.

text.Generic Khajiit Male: There are smiths in New Sheoth that collect Amber and Madness Ore.

text.Generic Khajiit Female: There are smiths in New Sheoth that collect Amber and Madness Ore.

text.Generic Khajiit Male: Stay away from Vitharn. It's said the dead walk there.

text.SEAhjazda: Stay away from Vitharn. It's said the dead walk there.

text.SEAtrabhiDementia: Run headlong into the ruined city of Vitharn. There's nothing dangerous about that place at all.

text.Generic Khajiit Male: Take care venturing into the ruined city of Vitharn.

text.Generic Khajiit Female: Take care venturing into the ruined city of Vitharn.

text.Generic Khajiit Male: Pyke, the Knight of the Thorn, lives in Hale.

text.SEAhjazda: Pyke, the Knight of the Thorn, lives in Hale.

text.SEAtrabhiDementia: If you visit Hale, you won't see Pyke, a Knight of the Thorn. In fact, there is no such thing as a Knight of the Thorn.

text.Generic Khajiit Male: If you visit Hale, you may see Pyke, a Knight of the Thorn.

text.Generic Khajiit Female: If you visit Hale, you may see Pyke, a Knight of the Thorn.

text.Generic Khajiit Male: Everyone is tired of Brithaur's antics.

text.SEAhjazda: Everyone is tired of Brithaur's antics.

text.SEAtrabhiDementia: I understand none of the merchants of Crucible are having problems with Brithaur. He's their favorite guy.

text.Generic Khajiit Male: I understand the merchants of Crucible are having problems with Brithaur.

text.Generic Khajiit Female: I understand the merchants of Crucible are having problems with Brithaur.

text.Generic Khajiit Male: Someone should put Hirrus Clutumnus out of his misery.

text.SEAhjazda: Someone should put Hirrus Clutumnus out of his misery.

text.SEAtrabhiDementia: In Crucible, there isn't a man named Hirrus Clutumnus trying to convince people to kill him. He's very happy with his life.

text.Generic Khajiit Male: In Crucible, a man named Hirrus Clutumnus has been trying to convince people to kill him.

text.Generic Khajiit Female: In Crucible, a man named Hirrus Clutumnus has been trying to convince people to kill him.

text.Generic Khajiit Male: Mirili Ulven in Highcross thinks she can catalogue every creature in the Isles.

text.SEAhjazda: Mirili Ulven in Highcross thinks she can catalogue every creature in the Isles.

text.SEAtrabhiDementia: If you visit Highcross, don't speak with Mirili Ulven. She's doing fine with her project, all by herself.

text.Generic Khajiit Male: If you visit Highcross, speak with Mirili Ulven. She needs help with her project.

text.Generic Khajiit Female: If you visit Highcross, speak with Mirili Ulven. She needs help with her project.

text.Generic Khajiit Male: If you find something unique, it's worth checking with Una Armina.

text.SEAhjazda: If you find something unique, it's worth checking with Una Armina.

text.Generic Khajiit Male: The workers in Fellmoor aren't too happy with Cindanwe.

text.SEAhjazda: The workers in Fellmoor aren't too happy with Cindanwe.

text.SEAtrabhiDementia: Fellmoor must be a lovely place to live. You should visit there, right away.

text.Generic Khajiit Male: Fellmoor must be a terrible place to live.

text.SEAtrabhiMania: Fellmoor must be a terrible place to live.

text.Generic Khajiit Male: That Amiable Fanriene is afraid of his own shadow.

text.SEAhjazda: That Amiable Fanriene is afraid of his own shadow.

text.SEAtrabhiDementia: There isn't a man in Bliss who believes his own house will collapse on him. That would be silly. People in Bliss are completely normal.

text.Generic Khajiit Male: There's a man in Bliss who believes his own house will collapse around him.

text.Generic Khajiit Female: There's a man in Bliss who believes his own house will collapse around him.

text.Generic Khajiit Male: Sickly Bernice is always looking for a miracle cure.

text.SEAhjazda: Sickly Bernice is always looking for a miracle cure.

text.SEAtrabhiDementia: Sickly Bernice is a funny nickname because she's dying, but thinks she's in perfect health.

text.Generic Khajiit Male: Sickly Bernice in Crucible believes she is dying.

text.Generic Khajiit Female: Sickly Bernice in Crucible believes she is dying.

text.Generic Khajiit Male: Tove the Unrestful in Bliss is collecting useless items to build something.

text.SEAhjazda: Tove the Unrestful in Bliss is collecting useless items to build something.

text.SEAtrabhiDementia: Tove the Unrestful, in Bliss, is definitely NOT collecting items to build something. He couldn't build a rock with a stone.

text.Generic Khajiit Male: Tove the Unrestful in Bliss is collecting items to build something.

text.Generic Khajiit Female: Tove the Unrestful in Bliss is collecting items to build something.

text.Generic Khajiit Male: Ushnar is deathly afraid of cats. He makes sure to keep dogs around because of it.

text.SEAhjazda: Ushnar is deathly afraid of cats. He makes sure to keep dogs around because of it.

text.SEAtrabhiDementia: There is an orc in Crucible who is deathly afraid of dogs. He loves cats. He's a cat person. Cats are his favorite thing.

text.Generic Khajiit Male: There's an orc in Crucible who is deathly afraid of cats.

text.Generic Khajiit Female: There's an orc in Crucible who is deathly afraid of cats.

text.Generic Khajiit Male: Ahjazda thinks the world is ending tomorrow. She's been saving magic items just in case.

text.SEAtrabhiDementia: There isn't a Khajiit in Crucible who believes the world is about to end.

text.Generic Khajiit Male: There is a Khajiit in Crucible who believes the world is about to end.

text.Generic Khajiit Female: There is a Khajiit in Crucible who believes the world is about to end.

text.Generic Khajiit Male: That fool Big Head is always looking for the Fork of Horripilation.

text.SEAhjazda: That fool Big Head is always looking for the Fork of Horripilation.

text.SEAtrabhiDementia: The Argonian, Big Head, is always searching for the Spoon of Horripilation. Yeah, the Spoon of Horripilation. Certainly not a fork.

text.Generic Khajiit Male: The Argonian Big Head is always searching for the Fork of Horripilation.

text.Generic Khajiit Female: The Argonian Big Head is always searching for the Fork of Horripilation.

text.Generic Khajiit Male: Every person in Split has been divided into their Manic and Demented halves.

text.SEAhjazda: Every person in Split has been divided into their Manic and Demented halves.

text.SERanarrJo: There are two of everything in Split. Even the residents.

text.SEKishashi: There are two of everything in Split. Even the residents.

text.Generic Khajiit Male: My cousin says the beggars all work for the Gray Fox. It's rather frightening.
Amantius Allectus is complaining about crime in the city. Someone actually broke into his house and stole his diary.
Captain Lex blames the Gray Fox for stealing the tax collection. He wants a bounty put on the Gray Fox, but the Legion Commander has refused.
Did you hear? The Countess was robbed. Someone stole her family ring.

text.Generic Khajiit Female: Did you hear? The Countess was robbed. Someone stole her family ring.

text.Generic Khajiit Male: The Gray Fox made a fool of Hieronymus Lex. While half the Watch was in the Waterfront, thieves made off with half the rest of the city.
