Did you hear? Hieronymus Lex was reassigned to Anvil.
Did you hear what happened? Someone robbed the wizard's tower. Fathis Aren got what he deserved, if you ask me.

text.Generic Khajiit Female: Did you hear what happened? Someone robbed the wizard's tower. Fathis Aren got what he deserved, if you ask me.

text.Generic Khajiit Male: They say a thief actually stole one of the Elder Scrolls from the Imperial Library. Who would have thought it was even possible?

text.Generic Khajiit Female: They say a thief actually stole one of the Elder Scrolls from the Imperial Library. Who would have thought it was even possible?

text.Srathad: I saw Ugak gra-Mogakh earlier. At least, I think it was her. Perhaps it was her sister.
Erina Jeranus isn't the most social inkeeper in the world, but she runs a good, clean house.
Don't bring up religion around Else God-Hater. She's likely to use that sword of hers on you.
I saw Agnete out drinking late again last night. It's no wonder they call her "the Pickled." She sure can repair armor, though.
Marie Palielle seems very happy working at the chapel. She's always working, but she's always got a smile on her face.
I wouldn't want an Orc butler, but apparently the Count doesn't mind. Shum gro-Yarug has been there for years.
If you need to learn how to use a shield, you should talk to Fadus Calidius at the Fighters Guild.
I hear Adrienne Berene is quite a mage. Of course, it's not like she'd bother to stop to talk to you in the street.
Must be nice being in the Mages Guild. If they need something recharged, they just talk to Vigge the Cautious, and poof! All done.
I heard Lazare Milvan challenged someone else to a duel. The man is ridiculous.
Ambroise Canne is really good with his shield. Even better than Falus Calidus, I think.
Undena Orethi has got some fine tomatoes. Some of the finest in Cyrodiil.
I've seen Shameer at the Tamika Vineyards practicing archery. He's really good. I might try to get some pointers from him.
I bought some wine from Gaston Surilie a few days ago. I was very impressed by it.

text.Generic Khajiit Male: Varnado at The Best Defense knows a lot about Heavy Armor.
If you want to learn more about light armor, you might talk to Dul gro-Shug.
I understand Ida Vlinorman enjoys jumping off high things. Like buildings.
Lose the key to your house? Find Mandil. He can get in, I'll bet.
I understand Areldil is good at getting into places other people can't.
Ogier Georick has a good selection of ingredients at The Main Ingredient.
If you're looking to buy cheap spells, Edgar's is the place to look.
Viator Accius has a good shield selection at Stonewall Shields.
Three Brothers have some good merchandise. Don't know if I've met all three brothers, though.
Looking for an axe or a mace? Head to Slash 'N Smash. The name says it all.

text.Raqanar: I think Tertia Viducia has a good supply of light armor.
Ohtesse is a wonderfully gifted healer. I sometimes worry that she spends too much time taking care of others, and not enough on herself.

text.Jskar: Skjorta is a nuisance. She was running around town, drunk and naked again.
Good that we have a healer in town. Cirroc can fix most anything that ails you. After all these years, he almost seems like a Nord himself.
Bumph gra-Gash is very skilled in heavy armor use. I wouldn't want to get on her bad side.
Alga has a lot of good tales to tell. I wish I could tell a story like she does.

text.Generic Khajiit Male: Uravasa Othrelas has a way with words. I wish she could teach me how to speak that well.

text.Generic Khajiit Female: Uravasa Othrelas has a way with words. I wish she could teach me how to speak that well.

text.Generic Khajiit Male: I understand that Fathis Aren is quite the conjurer.

text.Generic Khajiit Female: I understand that Fathis Aren is quite the conjurer.

text.Generic Khajiit Male: Kud-Ei is very protective of her sisters in the Mages Guild. And she's quite skilled at creating illusions.

text.Generic Khajiit Female: Kud-Ei is very protective of her sisters in the Mages Guild. And she's quite skilled at creating illusions.

text.Generic Khajiit Male: I heard Ita Rienus talking about the geography of Tamriel again. She's very knowledgeable.

text.Generic Khajiit Female: I heard Ita Rienus talking about the geography of Tamriel again. She's very knowledgeable.

text.Generic Khajiit Male: City-Swimmer certainly lives up to her name. I've seen her in the canals many times.

text.Generic Khajiit Female: City-Swimmer certainly lives up to her name. I've seen her in the canals many times.

text.Generic Khajiit Male: Bugak gro-Bol has some good books at Southern Books. He's an odd one, though. Always seems ready for a fight.

text.Generic Khajiit Female: Bugak gro-Bol has some good books at Southern Books. He's an odd one, though. Always seems ready for a fight.

text.Generic Khajiit Male: Brodras has been teaching Fighters Guild members how to better use heavy armor. Odd for a Bosmer, but he's apparently good at it.

text.Generic Khajiit Female: Brodras has been teaching Fighters Guild members how to better use heavy armor. Odd for a Bosmer, but he's apparently good at it.

text.Generic Khajiit Male: I understand that S'drassa is still trying to create a potion to cure skooma addiction.

text.Generic Khajiit Female: I understand that S'drassa is still trying to create a potion to cure skooma addiction.

text.Sshani: Norbert Lelles runs a fine store, but he's not the brightest fellow.
Rhano is quite the swordsman. I've heard he'll train you for the right amount of money.
I saw Huurwen practicing shield technique at the Fighters Guild the other day. She could teach me a thing or two.
I've heard that Feren Relas knows quite a bit about alchemy.
For someone who drinks so much, Hauls-Ropes-Faster is in peak physical condition. You could learn a lot from him.
I saw that Pinarus Inventius was out hunting again. He can shoot a bird on the wing without really trying.

text.Talasma: Picked up a good book at Renoit's this week. Sure wish I could read it.
You ever talk to Honditar? Odd fellow, but he seems to know his way around these parts.
Have you met Modryn Oreyn? Quiet man, but apparently he's an incredible fighter.
That Rimalus Bruiant sure loves his dogs. A little too much, if you ask me.
Casta Scribonia has finished a new book. Nothing that interests me, though.
I saw Rena Bruiant talking to her dogs the other day. I think she thinks they understand her.
You know, I think the mutton here in Chorrol is the best in all the Empire. Mmmm... that's good mutton.
Vilena Donton just hasn't been the same since her eldest son died. Still, she does a good job of running the Fighters Guild.
I heard there is a good smith in Chorrol.

text.Maiqtheliar: M'aiq longs for a Colovian Fur Helm. Practical, yet stylish. M'aiq is very sad he does not have one.
M'aiq wishes he had a stick made out of fishies to give to you. Sadly, he does not.
M'aiq believes the children are our future. But he doesn't want them ruining all of our fun.
M'aiq thinks his people are beautiful. The Argonian people are beautiful as well. They look better than ever before.
Some people wish to throw their weapons. That seems foolish to M'aiq. If you hold your weapon, you only need one.
Feet are for walking. Hands are for hitting. Or shaking. Or waving. Sometimes for clapping.
M'aiq prefers to adventure alone. Others just get in the way. And they talk, talk, talk.
People always enjoy a good fable. M'aiq has yet to find one, though. Perhaps one day.
Some people want special bows that take too long to load and need special arrows called bolts. M'aiq thinks they are idiots.
So much easier to get around these days. Not like the old days. Too much walking. Of course, nothing stops M'aiq from walking when he wants.
M'aiq is glad he has a compass. Makes it easy to find things. Much better than wandering around like a fool.
Why would one want to swing a staff? A mace hurts more. Or a sword. Can't shoot a fireball from a sword, though.
I do not wish to fight on horseback. It is a good way to ruin a perfectly good horse... which is, to say, a perfectly good dinner.
Levitation is for fools. Why would we want to levitate? Once you are up high, there is nowhere to go but down.
It is good the people wear clothing. M'aiq wears clothing. Who would want to see M'aiq naked? Sick, sick people. Very sad.
I don't know why one would want to destroy a building. It takes time to make it. Much time.
I have seen dragons. Perhaps you will see a dragon. I won't say where I saw one. Perhaps I did not.
Werewolves? Where? Wolves? Men that are wolves? Many wolves. Everywhere. Many men. That is enough for M'aiq.

text.Generic Khajiit Male: Ancient Wayshrines of the Nine are scattered through the wilderness. The righteous who pray there receive powerful divine blessings.

text.Generic Khajiit Female: Ancient Wayshrines of the Nine are scattered through the wilderness. The righteous who pray there receive powerful divine blessings.

text.Generic Khajiit Male: If you've done good deeds, the Nine will bless you and cure diseases when you visit their wayshrines.

text.Generic Khajiit Female: If you've done good deeds, the Nine will bless you and cure diseases when you visit their wayshrines.

text.Generic Khajiit Male: Wayshrines of the Nine in the wilderness confer blessings on the righteous and faithful.

text.Generic Khajiit Female: Wayshrines of the Nine in the wilderness confer blessings on the righteous and faithful.

text.Generic Khajiit Male: Those famous for good deeds may receive Blessings of Intelligence and Magicka when they visit Wayshrines of Julianos.

text.Generic Khajiit Female: Those famous for good deeds may receive Blessings of Intelligence and Magicka when they visit Wayshrines of Julianos.

text.Generic Khajiit Male: Virtuous visitors to Wayshrines of Kynareth may receive Blessings of Agility.

text.Generic Khajiit Female: Virtuous visitors to Wayshrines of Kynareth may receive Blessings of Agility.

text.Generic Khajiit Male: When you visit a Wayshrine of Zenithar, and you've lived a good life by the Nine, you may receive a Blessing of Luck.

text.Generic Khajiit Female: When you visit a Wayshrine of Zenithar, and you've lived a good life by the Nine, you may receive a Blessing of Luck.

text.Generic Khajiit Male: Those who live by the Commands of the Nine receive Blessings of Strength when they visit Wayshrines of Tiber Septim.

text.Generic Khajiit Female: Those who live by the Commands of the Nine receive Blessings of Strength when they visit Wayshrines of Tiber Septim.

text.Generic Khajiit Male: A good man who honors the Nine may visit the Wayshrines of Akatosh for Blessings of Speed and Magicka.

text.Generic Khajiit Female: A good man who honors the Nine may visit the Wayshrines of Akatosh for Blessings of Speed and Magicka.

text.Generic Khajiit Male: If you've been good, Wayshrines of Dibella may bless your Personality.

text.Generic Khajiit Female: If you've been good, Wayshrines of Dibella may bless your Personality.

text.Generic Khajiit Male: Wayshrines of Arkay confer Blessings of Health on those who've pleased the Nine by righteous acts.

text.Generic Khajiit Female: Wayshrines of Arkay confer Blessings of Health on those who've pleased the Nine by righteous acts.

text.Generic Khajiit Male: Please the Nine with good works, and visit Wayshrines of Stendarr for Blessings of Endurance.

text.Generic Khajiit Female: Please the Nine with good works, and visit Wayshrines of Stendarr for Blessings of Endurance.

text.Generic Khajiit Male: You've seen wayshrines in the wilderness? Those who've pleased the Nine may receive Blessings of Willpower at the Wayshrines of Mara.

text.Generic Khajiit Female: You've seen wayshrines in the wilderness? Those who've pleased the Nine may receive Blessings of Willpower at the Wayshrines of Mara.

text.Generic Khajiit Male: The Heartlands and Nibenean Valley are the agricultural breadbaskets of Cyrodiil.

text.Generic Khajiit Female: The Heartlands and Nibenean Valley are the agricultural breadbaskets of Cyrodiil.

text.Generic Khajiit Male: Where does our food come from? The Heartlands. And the Nibenean Valley. And Skingrad? Great wines, cheeses, and tomatoes.

text.Generic Khajiit Female: Where does our food come from? The Heartlands. And the Nibenean Valley. And Skingrad? Great wines, cheeses, and tomatoes.

text.Generic Khajiit Male: The lowlands of the Great Forest rise to the upland plateau of the Colovian West.

text.Generic Khajiit Female: The lowlands of the Great Forest rise to the upland plateau of the Colovian West.

text.Generic Khajiit Male: The Great Forest was cleared for agriculture around Lake Rumare, but it's mostly wilderness outside of that.

text.Generic Khajiit Female: The Great Forest was cleared for agriculture around Lake Rumare, but it's mostly wilderness outside of that.

text.Generic Khajiit Male: The Colovian Highlands are barren wastelands along the border with Hammerfell.

text.Generic Khajiit Female: The Colovian Highlands are barren wastelands along the border with Hammerfell.

text.Generic Khajiit Male: The Colovian Highlands? Near the Hammerfell border? No one lives there. That's barren wastelands.

text.Generic Khajiit Female: The Colovian Highlands? Near the Hammerfell border? No one lives there. That's barren wastelands.

text.Generic Khajiit Male: High mountain ranges rise to the borders in the north and east, and marshes and rainforests extend to the southeast borders.

text.Generic Khajiit Female: High mountain ranges rise to the borders in the north and east, and marshes and rainforests extend to the southeast borders.

text.Generic Khajiit Male: It's our natural barriers that keep us safe, mostly. Mountain borders north and east, open sea to the west, and bogs and rainforest to south.

text.Generic Khajiit Female: It's our natural barriers that keep us safe, mostly. Mountain borders north and east, open sea to the west, and bogs and rainforest to south.

text.Generic Khajiit Male: Cyrodiil is surrounded to the north and east by the lofty Jerall and Valus mountain ranges.

text.Generic Khajiit Female: Cyrodiil is surrounded to the north and east by the lofty Jerall and Valus mountain ranges.

text.Generic Khajiit Male: No one wants to live in the Jerall Mountains. Well, maybe in Bruma, but they're like Nords. They don't feel the cold.

text.Generic Khajiit Female: No one wants to live in the Jerall Mountains. Well, maybe in Bruma, but they're like Nords. They don't feel the cold.

text.Generic Khajiit Male: Western Cyrodiil is called 'Colovia,' and includes the Gold Coast, West Weald, and Colovian Highlands regions.

text.Generic Khajiit Female: Western Cyrodiil is called 'Colovia,' and includes the Gold Coast, West Weald, and Colovian Highlands regions.

text.Generic Khajiit Male: In the west, in Old Colovia, that's where men are men. That's the Gold Coast, West Weald, and Colovian Highlands.

text.Generic Khajiit Female: In the west, in Old Colovia, that's where men are men. That's the Gold Coast, West Weald, and Colovian Highlands.

text.Generic Khajiit Male: Nibenay is a region of mixed farmland, parkland, and forest.

text.Generic Khajiit Female: Nibenay is a region of mixed farmland, parkland, and forest.

text.Generic Khajiit Male: With all the farms in Nibenay, there's still plenty of forest and wilderness open for settlement.

text.Generic Khajiit Female: With all the farms in Nibenay, there's still plenty of forest and wilderness open for settlement.

text.Generic Khajiit Male: Nibenay is bordered on north and east by rugged mountains and to the south by marshes and rainforest.

text.Generic Khajiit Female: Nibenay is bordered on north and east by rugged mountains and to the south by marshes and rainforest.

text.Generic Khajiit Male: The people of Nibenay consider themselves to be more civilized and sophisticated than Colovians.

text.Generic Khajiit Female: The people of Nibenay consider themselves to be more civilized and sophisticated than Colovians.

text.Generic Khajiit Male: I'm not saying Colovians are dumb. They're just hard-headed.

text.Generic Khajiit Female: I'm not saying Colovians are dumb. They're just hard-headed.

text.Generic Khajiit Male: The Nibeneans think they're slick. 'Slippery' is more like it.

text.Generic Khajiit Female: The Nibeneans think they're slick. 'Slippery' is more like it.

text.Generic Khajiit Male: Colovia is a land of rugged wastes and highland forests.

text.Generic Khajiit Female: Colovia is a land of rugged wastes and highland forests.

text.Generic Khajiit Male: Colovia is dotted with isolated farms and settlements, with most of the population in the coastal margin.

text.Generic Khajiit Female: Colovia is dotted with isolated farms and settlements, with most of the population in the coastal margin.

text.Generic Khajiit Male: The Colovians are proud of their reputation for being independent, rough, and rebellious.

text.Generic Khajiit Female: The Colovians are proud of their reputation for being independent, rough, and rebellious.

text.Generic Khajiit Male: The Imperial City is located on a large island surrounded by Lake Rumare.

text.Generic Khajiit Female: The Imperial City is located on a large island surrounded by Lake Rumare.

text.Generic Khajiit Male: The Imperial City is densely urbanized, with a few large parks and waterside dock areas.

text.Generic Khajiit Female: The Imperial City is densely urbanized, with a few large parks and waterside dock areas.

text.Generic Khajiit Male: The Imperial City itself is a walled city, with separate inner walls protecting the Imperial palace.

text.Generic Khajiit Female: The Imperial City itself is a walled city, with separate inner walls protecting the Imperial palace.

text.Generic Khajiit Male: The prettiest town in Cyrodiil? Don't know, but the ugliest is Bravil. Shabby, tumbledown shacks. They're big shacks, though.

text.Generic Khajiit Female: The prettiest town in Cyrodiil? Don't know, but the ugliest is Bravil. Shabby, tumbledown shacks. They're big shacks, though.

text.Generic Khajiit Male: Where to buy weapons? Where to buy anything, if you can afford to travel, is the Market District in the Imperial City.

text.Generic Khajiit Female: Where to buy weapons? Where to buy anything, if you can afford to travel, is the Market District in the Imperial City.

text.Generic Khajiit Male: My favorite town? Anvil. Lovely old stone buildings, and the harbor at sunset is beautiful.

text.Generic Khajiit Female: My favorite town? Anvil. Lovely old stone buildings, and the harbor at sunset is beautiful.

text.Generic Khajiit Male: Ayleid ruins? The big thing is to watch out for the traps. Thousands of years old, and still working. Amazing.

text.Generic Khajiit Female: Ayleid ruins? The big thing is to watch out for the traps. Thousands of years old, and still working. Amazing.

text.Generic Khajiit Male: I've seen plenty of Ayleid ruins. You'd think they'd be picked clean after 2000 years, but, no, there's still great treasures there.

text.Generic Khajiit Female: I've seen plenty of Ayleid ruins. You'd think they'd be picked clean after 2000 years, but, no, there's still great treasures there.

text.Generic Khajiit Male: It's still pretty wild east of the Niben. Few people, except for bandits, but at least it hasn't been picked clean by treasure-hunters.

text.Generic Khajiit Female: It's still pretty wild east of the Niben. Few people, except for bandits, but at least it hasn't been picked clean by treasure-hunters.

text.Generic Khajiit Male: Nobody goes into the mountains but hunters and thieves on the lam. Food and shelter is hard to come by.

text.Generic Khajiit Female: Nobody goes into the mountains but hunters and thieves on the lam. Food and shelter is hard to come by.

text.Generic Khajiit Male: Blackwood isn't so bad, once you get used to the flies. And being lost all the time. And the zombies and will-o-the-wisps.

text.Generic Khajiit Female: Blackwood isn't so bad, once you get used to the flies. And being lost all the time. And the zombies and will-o-the-wisps.

text.Generic Khajiit Male: There's islands in Niben Bay no one has visited in a hundred years. No telling what you'll find.

text.Generic Khajiit Female: There's islands in Niben Bay no one has visited in a hundred years. No telling what you'll find.

text.Generic Khajiit Male: Well, it's no problem traveling from the Imperial City to Leyawiin... if you're a wizard and can walk on water. I'd stay off the roads, though.

text.Generic Khajiit Female: Well, it's no problem traveling from the Imperial City to Leyawiin... if you're a wizard and can walk on water. I'd stay off the roads, though.

text.Generic Khajiit Male: If you're all alone in the woods and you see a troll coming, you run. Problem solved. Next question?

text.Generic Khajiit Female: If you're all alone in the woods and you see a troll coming, you run. Problem solved. Next question?

text.Generic Khajiit Male: Fighting's easy. Just lead them out on the water and shoot them full of holes. If you've got a bow, of course, and can walk on water.

text.Generic Khajiit Female: Fighting's easy. Just lead them out on the water and shoot them full of holes. If you've got a bow, of course, and can walk on water.

text.Generic Khajiit Male: The Arena's faked. You think those guys are getting killed? Really? It's just berry syrup and ham-acting.

text.Generic Khajiit Female: The Arena's faked. You think those guys are getting killed? Really? It's just berry syrup and ham-acting.

text.Generic Khajiit Male: Have you ever met anyone who got rich betting on the Arena? Didn't think so.

text.Generic Khajiit Female: Have you ever met anyone who got rich betting on the Arena? Didn't think so.

text.Generic Khajiit Male: The Council runs the Arena to amuse the masses, and it pays for itself, with all the fools who lose their shirts gambling.

text.Generic Khajiit Female: The Council runs the Arena to amuse the masses, and it pays for itself, with all the fools who lose their shirts gambling.

text.Generic Khajiit Male: If you're on a road, you can usually outrun anything. If you're in good shape, and not wearing a tin suit.

text.Generic Khajiit Female: If you're on a road, you can usually outrun anything. If you're in good shape, and not wearing a tin suit.

text.Generic Khajiit Male: Orcs don't ride horses. They eat horses. And sometimes I think they're the smart ones. Wait, maybe it's Dunmer who eat horses.

text.Generic Khajiit Female: Orcs don't ride horses. They eat horses. And sometimes I think they're the smart ones. Wait, maybe it's Dunmer who eat horses.

text.Generic Khajiit Male: Take Cheydinhal, for example. Pretty little town. But the Count's a Dark Elf, and it's crawling with Orc thugs and gangsters.

text.Generic Khajiit Female: Take Cheydinhal, for example. Pretty little town. But the Count's a Dark Elf, and it's crawling with Orc thugs and gangsters.

text.Generic Khajiit Male: The lands surrounding Lake Rumare are studded with small settlements, farms, and woodland game reserves.

text.Generic Khajiit Female: The lands surrounding Lake Rumare are studded with small settlements, farms, and woodland game reserves.

text.Generic Khajiit Male: The Nibenay Basin grades from rolling farmlands by the river east to the rugged uplands of the Valus Mountains.

text.Generic Khajiit Female: The Nibenay Basin grades from rolling farmlands by the river east to the rugged uplands of the Valus Mountains.

text.Generic Khajiit Male: On Cyrodiil's northern border is the sparsely populated mountain wilderness called the Valus Mountains.

text.Generic Khajiit Female: On Cyrodiil's northern border is the sparsely populated mountain wilderness called the Valus Mountains.

text.Generic Khajiit Male: You can't be too careful out in the wilderness. Almost any creature you find is liable to give you a disease.

text.Generic Khajiit Female: You can't be too careful out in the wilderness. Almost any creature you find is liable to give you a disease.

text.Generic Khajiit Male: Watch yourself around goblins. Some of the nastier ones will toss spells at you.

text.Generic Khajiit Female: Watch yourself around goblins. Some of the nastier ones will toss spells at you.

text.Generic Khajiit Male: Imps. I hate 'em. Little buggers flitting around, tossing fireballs at you!

text.Generic Khajiit Female: Imps. I hate 'em. Little buggers flitting around, tossing fireballs at you!

text.Generic Khajiit Male: I saw a wraith once. It threw a curse on me I'll never forget.

text.Generic Khajiit Female: I saw a wraith once. It threw a curse on me I'll never forget.

text.Generic Khajiit Male: Have you seen a land dreugh? We call them "Billies." Don't know why. Steer clear of them, though.

text.Generic Khajiit Female: Have you seen a land dreugh? We call them "Billies." Don't know why. Steer clear of them, though.

text.Generic Khajiit Male: I ran across a ghost once. Seemed to suck the energy right out of me.

text.Generic Khajiit Female: I ran across a ghost once. Seemed to suck the energy right out of me.

text.Generic Khajiit Male: Watch for minotaurs in the forests. Aggressive beasts. They'll tear right through your armor, too.

text.Generic Khajiit Female: Watch for minotaurs in the forests. Aggressive beasts. They'll tear right through your armor, too.

text.Generic Khajiit Male: Mudcrabs. What's the point? Annoying buggers, though the meat isn't bad.

text.Generic Khajiit Female: Mudcrabs. What's the point? Annoying buggers, though the meat isn't bad.

text.Generic Khajiit Male: Only thing worse than an ogre is two ogres. Tough bastards, and spells seem to bounce right off of 'em.

text.Generic Khajiit Female: Only thing worse than an ogre is two ogres. Tough bastards, and spells seem to bounce right off of 'em.

text.Generic Khajiit Male: Is there anywhere in Tamriel you can avoid rats? Disease spreading little nuisances.

text.Generic Khajiit Female: Is there anywhere in Tamriel you can avoid rats? Disease spreading little nuisances.

text.Generic Khajiit Male: Best way to take out a skeleton is with a big weapon. Forget spells. Just smack them and watch the bones fly!

text.Generic Khajiit Female: Best way to take out a skeleton is with a big weapon. Forget spells. Just smack them and watch the bones fly!

text.Generic Khajiit Male: I might swim more if it weren't for the slaughterfish. Sharp teeth, and some carry disease.

text.Generic Khajiit Female: I might swim more if it weren't for the slaughterfish. Sharp teeth, and some carry disease.

text.Generic Khajiit Male: Spriggans. "Nature's guardians" my foot! Mean things. They'll curse you, or they might call a bear to tear you apart.

text.Generic Khajiit Female: Spriggans. "Nature's guardians" my foot! Mean things. They'll curse you, or they might call a bear to tear you apart.

text.Generic Khajiit Male: All that stuff about having to set trolls on fire is a bunch of hooey. They don't like fire, but a good sword will cut them up fine.

text.Generic Khajiit Female: All that stuff about having to set trolls on fire is a bunch of hooey. They don't like fire, but a good sword will cut them up fine.

text.Generic Khajiit Male: I don't even know what a will-o-the-wisp is, much less how to kill one. I think they're just swamp gas, myself.

text.Generic Khajiit Female: I don't even know what a will-o-the-wisp is, much less how to kill one. I think they're just swamp gas, myself.

text.Generic Khajiit Male: I don't like to think about zombies. Missing arms, legs, heads. They smell awful, and they're hard to kill.

text.Generic Khajiit Female: I don't like to think about zombies. Missing arms, legs, heads. They smell awful, and they're hard to kill.

text.Generic Khajiit Male: Try combining aloe vera leaves with some venison. It's said to have some restorative properties.

text.Generic Khajiit Female: Try combining aloe vera leaves with some venison. It's said to have some restorative properties.

text.Generic Khajiit Male: You can find Cairn Bolete growing in caves. They're said to mark the place someone has died.

text.Generic Khajiit Female: You can find Cairn Bolete growing in caves. They're said to mark the place someone has died.

text.Generic Khajiit Male: It's said that eating taproot can bring you good luck.

text.Generic Khajiit Female: It's said that eating taproot can bring you good luck.

text.Generic Khajiit Male: Make sure not to eat nightshade. It's very poisonous.

text.Generic Khajiit Female: Make sure not to eat nightshade. It's very poisonous.

text.SEAhjazda: A new adventurer in the Isles. Perhaps it's a sign?

text.SEMazaddha: Someone new is trying to get into the Shivering Isles. I'd better hide what little I have left.

text.SEAhjazda: The Gatekeeper dead. Can the rest of us be far behind?

text.SEMazaddha: I heard the Gatekeeper is dead. He didn't have any of my things on him, though, so it's no matter.

text.SEAhjazda: The Resonator has been reactivated. Why, if not to protect us from the coming storm?

text.SEMazaddha: If the Resonator is working, it means fewer people to steal my things. More of a chance to find what I've lost. Good in my book.

text.SEAhjazda: The Chalice has been returned to Thadon. He should use it while there is still time.

text.SEMazaddha: Thadon has his Chalice back. Why won't anyone help me replace what I've lost?

text.SEAhjazda: Syl once again tortures her courtiers. Soon, we will all suffer.

text.SEMazaddha: I don't suppose during all this torture anyone asked about where my things have gotten to. Or who stole them.

text.SEAhjazda: The Torch extinguished and relit? This does not bode well.

text.SEMazaddha: I used to have a Great Torch. Where did I put it? That one is relit, which is a good thing. Mine's still missing.

text.SEAhjazda: A new ruler for Dementia. Certainly the end times are upon us.

text.SEMazaddha: Perhaps the new head of Dementia can do something to help people protect what's really theirs.

text.SEAhjazda: Thadon is gone! Perhaps things are looking up.

text.SEMazaddha: Now that Thadon is dead, I should see if he had my things in his quarters.

text.SEAhjazda: Passwall has been destroyed. Can the rest of the Isles be far behind?

text.SEMazaddha: The End is coming. You just wait, you'll see. Time to gather up your things while you can.

text.SEAhjazda: The Gatekeeper protects us once again. But, can he protect us from the coming horror?

text.SEMazaddha: They built a new Gatekeeper, did they? Hope they didn't use anything of mine when putting him back together.

text.SEAhjazda: Sheogorath's armies are at full strength once more. They will be needed in times ahead.

text.SEMazaddha: It's about time someone restores some order around here.

text.SEAhjazda: Sheogorath is gone. This can only mean the end is near.

text.SEMazaddha: Just when I thought I was making some progress, I hear that Sheogorath himself has gone missing. Is this the end?

text.SEAhjazda: The forces of Order are no more. What horror will replace them?

text.SEMazaddha: Just because the Isles didn't come crashing down around our heads doesn't mean everything is fine.

text.SEAtrabhiDementia: I certainly haven't heard there's a new adventurer trying to get into the Realm.

text.SEAtrabhiMania: Some dashing new hero has stolen into the Realm!

text.SEJzidzoDementia: What do you want? You a big mouthed gossip? Fine. I hear there's a new arrival. You happy now? Why don't you bother someone else?

text.SEJzidzoMania: Why'd the adventurer walk through the Gates of Madness? To get to the other side!

text.SEKishashi: The new adventurers! I've seen them! One is as tall as a mountain! Another is composed of pure sound and light!

text.SERanarrJo: New adventurers? New slaves for Cindanwe, you mean. If you see them, tell them to steer clear of Fellmoor.

text.SEAtrabhiDementia: That Gatekeeper is tough. He's still alive. He killed that adventurer trying to get in. So, we're all still perfectly safe.

text.SEAtrabhiMania: The Gatekeeper's dead. Must have had some curse or weakness. There always is. Heroes kill monsters by exploiting a weakness.

text.SEJzidzoDementia: Some idiot killed the Gatekeeper. Now we'll be swamped with morons coming and bothering us. Present company not excluded.

text.SEJzidzoMania: What do you get when you cross an adventurer with the Gatekeeper? A dead Gatekeeper!

text.SEKishashi: Do you want to know a secret? It was I who killed the Gatekeeper. I poisoned him with an apple!

text.SERanarrJo: People keep saying that the Gatekeeper is dead. I have no idea what that means. Do you know?

text.SEAtrabhiDementia: The Resonator is still broken. It never worked. And it never will.

text.SEAtrabhiMania: The Resonator of Judgment is back on. I read about that somewhere. It helps keep the Realm clean of vagrants and ne'er-do-wells.

text.SEJzidzoDementia: I hate gossips. If I tell you something, will you go away? Fine. The Resonator of Judgment is on again. Blah.

text.SEJzidzoMania: So the moral of the story is: don't count your adventurers until they hatch! Ha!

text.SEKishashi: Truth be told, the Resonator of Judgment doesn't actually do anything. Who cares if it's been reactivated?

text.SERanarrJo: Did you hear? The Resonator of Judgment is active once again. I don't trust anything that can influence the thoughts of others.

text.SEAtrabhiDementia: Thadon isn't really addicted to Felldew. Felldew is perfectly safe. There's nothing magical about his special cup either.

text.SEAtrabhiMania: Thadon has his Chalice back. In the stories, men are always off in search of some sword or a cup of some kind.

text.SEJzidzoDementia: Thadon's got his cup. The world's back in order. I get it. So then why the hell are you still here bothering me? Get lost!

text.SEJzidzoMania: So the addict says to the whore, "Gimme back my Chalice of Reversal!" Ha ha!

text.SEKishashi: There is more to Thadon and Syl than they let on. Let's just say... well. You know.

text.SERanarrJo: Thadon finally has his precious Chalice. But, such things do not matter to those of us who work for a living.

text.SEAtrabhiDementia: Syl never has anyone tortured. She's a gentle and kind leader. She trusts everyone, and is therefore trustworthy.

text.SEAtrabhiMania: There's another mystery in House Dementia. Someone needs to write a book about that place. It'd be a best seller. Lots of intrigue!

text.SEJzidzoDementia: Look. I don't like you. Why are you bothering me? Maybe I'll ask Syl to round you up for questioning. Would you like that? Go away.

text.SEJzidzoMania: So the spy says to her, "You're not paranoid if everyone's out to get you!" Ha! Like Syl! Paranoid! Ha!

text.SEKishashi: I think that I would like to be tortured. Perhaps I should go see Syl.

text.SERanarrJo: Once again, Syl uses pain to get what she wants. How long before every one of us is forced to visit Herdir's chamber?

text.SEAtrabhiDementia: The Great Torch is out again! I bet you didn't know that!

text.SEAtrabhiMania: The Great Torch is lit in the Sacellum Arden-Sul. Have you read the book about Arden-Sul? It's fascinating!

text.SEJzidzoDementia: The Great Torch, the Great Torch! Why's everyone bothering me about that? I've got a Great Torch for you, right here.

text.SEJzidzoMania: So she says, "Is that a Great Torch in your pocket, or are you just happy to see me?" Ha!

text.SEKishashi: There is no Great Torch. And it isn't ablaze once more.

text.SERanarrJo: The Torch lights the city once again. Fat lot of good it does those of use working out here.

text.SEAtrabhiDementia: The city isn't ruled by Dukes. It's ruled by elected representatives. And they wear funny hats.

text.SEAtrabhiMania: A new ruler for Dementia! This is the stuff epic novels are made of.

text.SEJzidzoDementia: There's a new Duke in the city? Who cares? Go kiss his ass, for all I care. Go on! Go!

text.SEJzidzoMania: So the new duke turns to him and says, "Wrecked him? Damn near killed him!"

text.SEKishashi: Syl isn't dead. She's living on an island nearby.

text.SERanarrJo: With Syl gone, perhaps someone will help us out here.

text.SEAtrabhiDementia: Thadon isn't dead. He's just hiding.

text.SEAtrabhiMania: Thadon is dead. Quite a tragedy. Perhaps someone will write about it.

text.SEJzidzoDementia: Thadon's dead? So what? He annoyed me as much as you do.

text.SEJzidzoMania: ...and he says, "Eat the Greenmote, drag Thadon. Eat the Greenmote, drag Thadon." Ha!

text.SEKishashi: Thadon's not dead. He lives underground. In a house made of cheese.

text.SERanarrJo: With Thadon gone, perhaps someone will help us out here.

text.SEAtrabhiDementia: The Knights of Order are here to protect us.

text.SEAtrabhiMania: Knights of Order? These aren't the valiant knights from the epic tales!

text.SEJzidzoDementia: I wish those Knights of Order would come here and wipe everyone out. I'd finally get some piece and quiet!

text.SEJzidzoMania: Why did the Knights of Order cross the Fringe? No one knows.

text.SEKishashi: These invaders that everyone is afraid of don't even exist. I swear, why would someone start a rumor to create panic?

text.SERanarrJo: Invaders? You don't... you don't suppose that they've come for ME do you?

text.SEAtrabhiDementia: The Gatekeeper is still dead. That's fine. He never did anything useful, anyway.

text.SEAtrabhiMania: The Gatekeeper will keep out those adventurers again. Too bad. Some of them had exciting stories to tell.

text.SEJzidzoDementia: When you're done boring me, why don't you go have a chat with the new Gatekeeper? Run along now!

text.SEJzidzoMania: So then Sorceress says to the new Gatekeeper, "But in the morning, you'll still be ugly!"

text.SEKishashi: Did you hear? I helped rebuild the Gatekeeper! He has my eyes.... What? I got new ones!

text.SERanarrJo: Now that the Gatekeeper lives again, I have to ask... is he there to keep others out, or to keep us in? Think about it.

text.SEAtrabhiDementia: Those aren't Sheogorath's real armies that have returned. The real ones are being held in a secret underground compound.

text.SEAtrabhiMania: Read your histories: a strong army guarantees a strong Realm. Good thing Sheogorath's armies are back to full strength.

text.SEJzidzoDementia: I hear the army is restored. You should go see if they need a target dummy to practice on.

text.SEJzidzoMania: Do you know where Sheogorath keeps his armies? In his sleevies! Ah hahaha!

text.SEKishashi: I hear that my army has been restored. Perhaps I should join up again....

text.SERanarrJo: People keep telling me that the armies of Sheogorath are reassembled... as if this is something that we should be happy about.

text.SEAtrabhiDementia: I know where Sheogorath is. He's hiding in my house. In a cupboard. But he's invisible.

text.SEAtrabhiMania: Sheogorath has left. Where did he go? It's a mystery! I love mystery stories. I wonder how this one will end.

text.SEJzidzoDementia: Maybe you're the reason Sheogorath left. Probably are. You make me want to leave whenever I see you.

text.SEJzidzoMania: Knock, knock. Who's there? Not Sheogorath.

text.SEKishashi: I know where Sheogorath has gone! Of course, I'm not going to tell you.

text.SERanarrJo: Sheogorath has vanished? Another already seeks his throne. One tyrant passes and another rises. To the void with them.

text.SEAtrabhiDementia: We're all doomed. Jyggalag has won. Sheogorath is dead. The forces of Order are victorious.

text.SEAtrabhiMania: We're all still here. It's a miracle! Someone really needs to write a book about this. Perhaps I should....

text.SEJzidzoDementia: I suppose you think we should celebrate Jyggalag's defeat? The enemy of my enemy and all that? You're wrong.

text.SEJzidzoMania: What do you call the time between one victory dance and another? The Jig-lag! Get it?

text.SEKishashi: Behold the new god of madness! It is I, Kishashi, who has defeated the forces of Jyggalag!

text.SERanarrJo: Don't think for a second that this war is actually over. Stay on your guard. The agents of the enemy lurk everywhere.

text.Generic Nord Male: You're talking to me, and I don't like you. Goodbye.

text.Generic Nord Female: You're talking to me, and I don't like you. Goodbye.

text.Generic Nord Male: I see no reason to talk to you.

text.Generic Nord Female: I see no reason to talk to you.

text.Generic Nord Male: I don't like you and don't want to talk to you.

text.Generic Nord Female: I don't like you and don't want to talk to you.

text.Generic Nord Male: I'm not listening to you. It's because I don't like you.

text.Generic Nord Female: I'm not listening to you. It's because I don't like you.

text.Generic Nord Male: You're still speaking. Stop.

text.Generic Nord Female: You're still speaking. Stop.

text.Roliand: At least now we have a name to put to our enemy. Mankar Camoran and the Mythic Dawn will pay for their foul crimes.
The Mythic Dawn will never take Cloud Ruler Temple. Not while any Blade still draws breath.
The noose around Bruma is tightening. Now that the Mythic Dawn has learned Martin's location, we have to be prepared for the worst.
The Battle of Bruma was a great victory! The Mythic Dawn have learned that we are not defenseless.
Martin Septim will soon claim his rightful place at the head of the Empire, and the Blades will stand beside him.
The Emperor's death was a harsh lesson for all of us. We failed in our duty to the Dragonborn. It must not happen again.
Martin showed himself a true son of the Dragon Blood. But where does that leave us, with no Emperor to serve?
With no Emperor to serve, the Blades now return to our ancient role. We will bide our time until the next Dragonborn arises.

text.Generic Nord Male: Everyone's talking about the assassination, of course. Here. Take my copy of the new Black Horse Courier. Go ahead. Keep it.

text.Generic Nord Female: Everyone's talking about the assassination, of course. Here. Take my copy of the new Black Horse Courier. Go ahead. Keep it.
All the bards are busy composing songs about the battle! "The Fall of Dagon" is my favorite so far.

text.Generic Nord Male: Have you heard "The Fall of Dagon" yet? "Take heart, the mighty hero cried! He looked up at Dagon and cursed his foul name..."

text.Malene: Still no news out of Aleswell since everybody vanished. Strange business.

text.Generic Nord Male: The Fighters Guild is recruiting again. Not a bad way to make some money, if you've got the stones for it.

text.Generic Nord Female: The Fighters Guild is recruiting again. Not a bad way to make some money, if you've got the stones for it.

text.Generic Nord Male: Anyone looking for work should consider the Fighters Guild. I hear they're always looking for recruits.

text.Generic Nord Female: Anyone looking for work should consider the Fighters Guild. I hear they're always looking for recruits.

text.Generic Nord Male: I understand the Fighters Guild is hiring new members. Not bad work for some folks.

text.Generic Nord Female: I understand the Fighters Guild is hiring new members. Not bad work for some folks.

text.Generic Nord Male: Mannimarco is no more! The guild is saved, and we have a new Arch-Mage to lead us.

text.Generic Nord Female: I can't believe Arch-Mage Traven sacrificed himself to save us all. How noble of him.

text.Generic Nord Male: I don't know what it was, but something important was taken away from Mannimarco. Maybe there is a chance he can be defeated.
Traven might get us through this yet. I hear that the Necromancers were handed a significant defeat at Silorn.
The Council has turned on Traven. Things couldn't possibly get any worse for the guild.
Mannimarco himself is in Cyrodiil, hunting us down. None of us are safe!
Without the Council of Mages to guide us, how will we stand up to the King of Worms?
The Council of Mages has been dissolved. Arch-Mage Traven has been deserted. He's all we have left.
Necromancers have attacked our very homes. What could be next?

text.Generic Nord Female: The Bruma guild hall has been decimated. Our hall could be next!
I've heard rumors about the Council of Mages consorting with outside sources. Why are outsiders interfering with our guild?
The Council of Mages has this Necromancer situation under control. They must, or else we'd know about it, right?

text.Generic Nord Male: Something has gone seriously wrong at the Arcane University. I heard that a high-ranking member was killed in some sort of ambush.

text.Generic Nord Female: I think the rumors about Necromancers are completely untrue. I've heard some crazy things, and I don't believe any of them.

text.Generic Nord Male: The Council seems very interested in this new group of Necromancers that has sprung up. I wonder how things will play out.
Have you heard anything more about what the Council knows about these Necromancers? Something's not right.

text.Generic Nord Female: It's good to know that valuable research is still going on, even though things seem to be a bit more tense lately.

text.Generic Nord Male: Someone finally solved the problems with research at Vahtacen. You'd think the Council would know more about the Ayleids by now.

text.Generic Nord Female: It sounds like the Council of Mages has been holding extra meetings recently. I'm not sure what that means.

text.Generic Nord Male: I've heard rumors that the Council of Mages is taking advice from outsiders. I'm not sure how I feel about that.
Arch-Mage Traven was right to ban Necromancy from the guild. Look at what they've done; they've gone and killed several of us!

text.Generic Nord Female: The Mages Guild has been attacked by Necromancers. This proves they can't be trusted!

text.Generic Nord Male: I understand that Dagail is in much better control of her faculties now that Kalthar's plot has been exposed.
Kalthar tried to ruin the Leyawiin guild. Just goes to show you can't trust a Necromancer, even if he claims to be "reformed."

text.Generic Nord Female: Did you hear that someone played yet another prank on Jeanne Frasoric in Bruma? I don't know how she keeps falling for these things.

text.Generic Nord Male: It sounds like there are an awful lot of problems at the Bruma guild hall. Jeanne does a poor job of running that place.

text.Generic Nord Female: The Chorrol guild hall had an unpleasant visit recently, from someone who had a grudge against Teekeeus.

text.Generic Nord Male: I hear a new Associate came to Teekeeus's aid recently. Something about an old enemy of his storming into town.
The roads near Anvil are safer now, thanks to Carahil and her guild hall. She's an example for us all.

text.Generic Nord Female: The Anvil guild has made quite a name for itself under Carahil. Did you hear about the recent murderer they caught?
Kud-Ei will do anything to help her girls out. She recently got Ardaline out of a bind, and I hear it wasn't completely within guild rules.

text.Generic Nord Male: Kud-Ei runs a tight ship in Bruma. She may not always play by the rules, but I wouldn't want her on my bad side.
I can't believe a Mages Guild associate was found dead in Cheydinhal. What kind of place are they running there?

text.Generic Nord Female: Did you hear that Falcar left the guild? I think Deetsan is in charge in Cheydinhal now.
I heard that one of the Skingrad mages was assaulted, but I don't know the details.

text.Generic Nord Male: Sounds like the Skingrad branch of the guild can't even keep track of its members. How appalling.
I heard that Soris Arenim made himself quite a bit of money recently. He seems very happy about it.

text.Generic Nord Female: I heard that Soris Arenim made himself quite a bit of money recently. He seems very happy about it.

text.ViggetheCautious: I saw Erthor earlier. Guess someone rescued him again. Hide your scrolls while you can.

text.Generic Nord Male: Things in the guild have been different since Traven was named Arch-Mage. They're more structured, but everyone seems tense.

text.Generic Nord Female: Things in the guild have been different since Traven was named Arch-Mage. They're more structured, but everyone seems tense.

text.Generic Nord Male: Half of the Council of Mages resigned when Traven took over the position of Arch-Mage.

text.Generic Nord Female: Half of the Council of Mages resigned when Traven took over the position of Arch-Mage.

text.Generic Nord Male: Arch-Mage Traven is the first to take such a hard stance on Necromancy. It upset more than a few people.

text.Generic Nord Female: Arch-Mage Traven is the first to take such a hard stance on Necromancy. It upset more than a few people.

text.Generic Nord Male: The Mages Guild runs more or less like it always did, but we lost quite a few members when the practice of Necromancy was banned.

text.Generic Nord Female: The Mages Guild runs more or less like it always did, but we lost quite a few members when the practice of Necromancy was banned.

text.Generic Nord Male: Necromancy may be legal in Cyrodiil, but few will openly admit to practicing it now that the Mages Guild has banned it.

text.Generic Nord Female: Necromancy may be legal in Cyrodiil, but few will openly admit to practicing it now that the Mages Guild has banned it.

text.Generic Nord Male: Some say that Traven is mis-using the power of the Arch-Mage's position to further his personal agendas.

text.Generic Nord Female: Some say that Traven is mis-using the power of the Arch-Mage's position to further his personal agendas.

text.Generic Nord Male: I don't know what Arch-Mage Traven has against Necromancy, but the first thing he did after taking over the Mages Guild was to ban its practice.

text.Generic Nord Female: I don't know what Arch-Mage Traven has against Necromancy, but the first thing he did after taking over the Mages Guild was to ban its practice.

text.Generic Nord Male: Not only has Necromancy been banned from practice in the Mages Guild, but the Guild won't deal with anyone who openly uses it.

text.Generic Nord Female: Not only has Necromancy been banned from practice in the Mages Guild, but the Guild won't deal with anyone who openly uses it.

text.Generic Nord Male: The Mages Guild has made more than a few enemies since Necromancy was banned.

text.Generic Nord Female: The Mages Guild has made more than a few enemies since Necromancy was banned.

text.Generic Nord Male: I saw that Earana woman hanging around the Mages Guild again.
I saw that Erthor is back in town again.

text.Generic Nord Female: I hear one of the guild mages has gone missing again.

text.Generic Nord Male: It seems quieter than usual at the Mages Guild.
I saw Earana leaving town. She looked very excited.

text.Generic Nord Female: Things at the Mages Guild seem tense. That Falcar fellow sure keeps a tight rein on things.

text.Generic Nord Male: Falcar at the Mages Guild seems to be angry all the time. I avoid him when I can.
Varon Vamori seems very glum lately. I guess things aren't going well with Ardaline.
Kud-Ei seems upset about something lately. I'd stay away from the Mages Guild if I were you.

text.Generic Nord Female: Kud-Ei seems upset about something lately. I'd stay away from the Mages Guild if I were you.
Those new fellows here in town are making me nervous. Walking around with those big weapons; I hope they leave soon.

text.Generic Nord Male: I heard someone broke into the Mages Guild.

text.Emfrid: I heard someone broke into the Mages Guild.

text.Generic Nord Male: If the Council really did split up, the guild is done for. This is serious.

text.Generic Nord Female: If the Council really did split up, the guild is done for. This is serious.

text.Eitar: The Mages Guild seems more disorganized than usual lately.

text.Margarte: The Mages Guild seems more disorganized than usual lately.

text.Ortis: Folks think we're all evil? What do they know? Do I look evil?

text.Generic Nord Female: I tried the chapels. They're a waste of time.

text.Generic Nord Male: The latest Black Horse Courier is upsetting. Apparently, more and more people have been trying to contact the Dark Brotherhood. See for yourself.
Haven't you heard? Baenlin's been killed! The Black Horse Courier has a special edition with the story. Here, take my copy.
They say that when you murder someone, the Dark Brotherhood comes to you in your sleep. It's how they recruit new members.

text.Generic Nord Female: They say that when you murder someone, the Dark Brotherhood comes to you in your sleep. It's how they recruit new members.

text.Generic Nord Male: Old Baenlin is dead! I hear it was a horrible accident. He was resting in his chair and BOOM -- a stuffed head fell on him!
Killing their chief should weaken the Black Bow Bandits, but they're still going to be a menace to travelers.

text.Generic Nord Female: Killing their chief should weaken the Black Bow Bandits, but they're still going to be a menace to travelers.

text.Generic Nord Male: I hear the Count's got someone to sort out that business with Mazoga the so-called knight.
I heard that Velwyn Benirus was killed. The Manor claims another victim.

text.Vigdis: I heard that Velwyn Benirus was killed. The Manor claims another victim.

text.Generic Nord Male: The new owner sure has turned Benirus Manor around. It's now a welcome addition to our city.

text.Vigdis: The new owner sure has turned Benirus Manor around. It's now a welcome addition to our city.

text.Generic Nord Male: I have it on good authority that the city watch sent someone to stop that gang of women from robbing the town's men. Good show I say!

text.Vigdis: I have it on good authority that the city watch sent someone to stop that gang of women from robbing the town's men. Good show I say!

text.Generic Nord Male: Arnora was killed. Such a shame. I wonder if Jorundr had something to do with it? I wouldn't put it past him.

text.Generic Nord Female: Arnora was killed. Such a shame. I wonder if Jorundr had something to do with it? I wouldn't put it past him.

text.Generic Nord Male: I overheard that the vampire hunter who was in town was a fake. It was apparently a ruse to get his hands on Bradon's key to a treasure chest.

text.Generic Nord Female: I overheard that the vampire hunter who was in town was a fake. It was apparently a ruse to get his hands on Bradon's key to a treasure chest.

text.Generic Nord Male: Have you noticed all the city guards are roaming around the city as if looking for someone? I wonder what that's all about.

text.Generic Nord Female: Have you noticed all the city guards are roaming around the city as if looking for someone? I wonder what that's all about.

text.Generic Nord Male: Did you hear about Bradon Lirrian? A vampire hunter named Raynil Dralas made his way into town, snuck into his house and killed him.

text.Generic Nord Female: Did you hear about Bradon Lirrian? A vampire hunter named Raynil Dralas made his way into town, snuck into his house and killed him.

text.Generic Nord Male: I was at Olav's earlier and I ran into this Dunmer named Raynil Dralas. After a round or two, he told me he was an honest-to-goodness vampire hunter!

text.Generic Nord Female: I was at Olav's earlier and I ran into this Dunmer named Raynil Dralas. After a round or two, he told me he was an honest-to-goodness vampire hunter!

text.Generic Nord Male: Don't know if this is true, but I heard a gang of all female thieves is preying on the married menfolk of the town.

text.Vigdis: Don't know if this is true, but I heard a gang of all female thieves is preying on the married menfolk of the town.

text.Generic Nord Male: You hear about Gogan? A gang of thieves is running a scam in town, and he fell for it! Hahaha... what an idiot!

text.Vigdis: You hear about Gogan? A gang of thieves is running a scam in town, and he fell for it! Hahaha... what an idiot!

text.Generic Nord Male: You hear about Jorundr? He was caught stealing gold, and now he's in jail! I bet Arnora's beside herself with grief.

text.Generic Nord Female: You hear about Jorundr? He was caught stealing gold, and now he's in jail! I bet Arnora's beside herself with grief.

text.Generic Nord Male: Poor Arnora. Seems her boyfriend, Jorundr, has stolen some gold from her and left her penniless. Now he's in jail, and she's destitute.

text.Generic Nord Female: Poor Arnora. Seems her boyfriend, Jorundr, has stolen some gold from her and left her penniless. Now he's in jail, and she's destitute.

text.Generic Nord Male: I overheard a guard mention the Countess is looking for a piece to add to her collection of Akaviri artifacts. Our taxpayer's drakes at work...

text.Generic Nord Female: I overheard a guard mention the Countess is looking for a piece to add to her collection of Akaviri artifacts. Our taxpayer's drakes at work...

text.Generic Nord Male: I swear that when I passed by Benirus Manor last night, I heard someone scream from inside. Velwyn Benirus will never sell that deathtrap!

text.Vigdis: I swear that when I passed by Benirus Manor last night, I heard someone scream from inside. Velwyn Benirus will never sell that deathtrap!

text.Generic Nord Male: I heard that Velwyn Benirus is trying to sell off Benirus Manor. Hopefully the new owners will clean that eyesore up.

text.Vigdis: I heard that Velwyn Benirus is trying to sell off Benirus Manor. Hopefully the new owners will clean that eyesore up.

text.Generic Nord Male: I think Glarthir is having one of his bad spells lately, have you noticed?

text.Generic Nord Female: I think Glarthir is having one of his bad spells lately, have you noticed?

text.Generic Nord Male: Did you hear about Glarthir going crazy and attacking people with an axe?

text.Generic Nord Female: Did you hear about Glarthir going crazy and attacking people with an axe?

text.Generic Nord Male: Did you hear about Glarthir? Thank the Nine that the guard stopped him before he killed someone!

text.Generic Nord Female: Did you hear about Glarthir? Thank the Nine that the guard stopped him before he killed someone!

text.Generic Nord Male: Did you hear that Dar-Ma has disappeared?

text.Emfrid: Did you hear that Dar-Ma has disappeared?

text.Generic Nord Male: Did you hear the bad news?  Dar-Ma's daughter was killed by some strange cultists down in Hackdirt. Terrible, terrible times we live in.

text.Emfrid: Did you hear the bad news?  Dar-Ma's daughter was killed by some strange cultists down in Hackdirt. Terrible, terrible times we live in.

text.Generic Nord Male: Did you hear that Dar-Ma came back, safe and sound?  You know, Seed-Neeus's daughter, the Argonians.

text.Emfrid: Did you hear that Dar-Ma came back, safe and sound?  You know, Seed-Neeus's daughter, the Argonians.

text.DarkPrisonGuard05: It's true what everyone's saying -- Kvatch is lost. The Daedra, they swarmed in.... The Town Guard never had a chance.
The Kvatch Oblivion Gate has been closed! Don't you understand what that means? We can beat the bastards!
The Mythic Dawn murdered the Emperor and led those damn Daedra right into the heart of the Empire! They'll pay for their treachery!
Kvatch? Kvatch was just the beginning! Those damned Gates have opened up everywhere! Cheydinhal, Chorrol, Leyawiin -- no city is safe.
If you've got to travel, by the Nine Divines, stay on the roads! The wilderness just isn't safe anymore. We've had sightings, you see. The Daedra...

text.Generic Nord Male: We're all talking about the emperor's murder. We have no emperor. And no heir. That's never happened before. I suppose we should all be worried.

text.Generic Nord Female: We're all talking about the emperor's murder. We have no emperor. And no heir. That's never happened before. I suppose we should all be worried.

text.HiltheTall: People are subdued. Troubled. A crisis like this tests the people's faith.

text.OlavatheFair: People are subdued. Troubled. A crisis like this tests the people's faith.

text.Generic Nord Female: I think we're in for some hard times. The death of Uriel Septim and his heirs changes everything.

text.Generic Nord Male: The Emperor and his three sons, dead, right under the noses of the Imperial Guard. It's a disgrace.
Have you heard about Kvatch? They say that daedra came from Oblivion and burned the whole city to the ground!

text.Generic Nord Female: Everyone's saying there's trouble in Kvatch. The whole town destroyed. Only a few survivors.

text.Generic Nord Male: Do you think what happened to Kvatch could happen here?
I heard that the Kvatch Guard is driving back the daedra! Maybe there's hope after all.

text.Generic Nord Female: I heard that the Kvatch Guard is driving back the daedra! Maybe there's hope after all.
Everybody's talking about the Hero of Kvatch! They say he actually went into an Oblivion Gate and destroyed it.

text.Generic Nord Male: Everybody's talking about the Hero of Kvatch! They say she actually went into an Oblivion Gate and destroyed it.
Hey, you're the one they call the Hero of Kvatch, aren't you? The one that closed the Oblivion Gate and saved the city?

text.Generic Nord Female: Hey, you're the one they call the Hero of Kvatch, aren't you? The one that closed the Oblivion Gate and saved the city?

text.Generic Nord Male: Good news from Kvatch for a change. The last of the daedra have been driven out.

text.Generic Nord Female: Good news from Kvatch for a change. The last of the daedra have been driven out.

text.Generic Nord Male: Do you believe any of that talk about more Oblivion Gates opening all over the place?

text.Generic Nord Female: I've been hearing disturbing tales about Oblivion Gates opening all across Cyrodiil. I hope it's just wild talk.

text.Generic Nord Male: They say that Oblivion Gates have opened outside cities all across Tamriel! Gods preserve us!

text.Generic Nord Female: With those Oblivion Gates opening everywhere, it's only a matter of time before another city goes the way of Kvatch.
Did you hear? The lost heir of Uriel Septim rallied the Guard and smashed a horde of daedra outside Bruma!

text.Generic Nord Male: They say a lost son of Uriel Septim has reappeared in Bruma. Troops are flocking to his banner from all over Cyrodiil!
I heard that some cult called the Mythic Dawn is behind the Emperor's assassination.

text.Generic Nord Female: They're saying some cult murdered the Emperor and are opening the Oblivion Gates. Do you think any of it's true?

text.Generic Nord Male: Thank Akatosh the Oblivion Crisis is over! Although with no Emperor and no heir, I wonder what will happen to the Empire?
I plan to visit the Imperial City soon to pay my respects at the Temple of the One. They say the Dragon Statue is 100 feet high!

text.Generic Nord Female: I'm sure the Elder Council will find some way to hold the Empire together. At least the Oblivion invasion is over!
I heard that some of the provinces were talking about seceding from the Empire. Probably just talk though. Everything's a bit unsettled now.

text.Generic Nord Male: Most people consider Martin's... transformation... a religious or political event, but what interests me is its metaphysical implications.

text.Generic Nord Female: Most people consider Martin's... transformation... a religious or political event, but what interests me is its metaphysical implications.

text.HiltheTall: I wish I had witnessed the avatar of divine Akatosh myself. Imagine! Upon the very altar of the Temple of the One!

text.OlavatheFair: I wish I had witnessed the avatar of divine Akatosh myself. Imagine! Upon the very altar of the Temple of the One!

text.Generic Nord Female: I confess, I didn't think we had a chance against the daedra. But Martin proved himself a true heir of Talos on that day.

text.Generic Nord Male: To think that Bruma was where Martin Septim chose to reveal himself as the true heir to the throne for the first time!
I hear that Earil is fed up with Brithaur's antics. He really wants something done about it.
Scalons carry diseases. Lots of them.
Don't run into the water to escape a Scalon. They'll follow you.
Have to watch for those Scalons. I hear they carry disease.
If you see a Gnarl, be careful what spells you use on them.
I've heard that Gnarl get stronger when hit by some spells.
The Gnarl are strange creatures. Hit them with a fireball, and they get stronger, but they hate other elements even more.
Those Shambles are dangerous. Make sure to stand back if you kill one.
Don't bother using a frost spell on a Shambles.
If you see a Shambles dying, stand back. They'll take you with them.
Flesh Atronachs are dangerous. Some are smart enough to heal themselves when they're hurt.
Sometimes, a sharp blade is the best way to kill a Flesh Atronach.
If you have to fight a Flesh Atronach, a good shock spell is the way to go.
The poison of the Elytra can be debilitating.
The Elytra have wondrous poisons that can drain the very life from you.
Watch for the Elytra's stingers; their poison can be deadly. They don't like magic much, though.
The Hunger is one of Lord Sheogorath's favorite pets.
Only the Demented can truly appreciate the Hunger.
Like most lesser Daedra, the Hunger has a weakness to shock spells.
Some say the Grummites are the original inhabitants of the Shivering Isles.
Who do the Grummites worship? Some say Sheogorath, but I'm not sure.
Try not to fight a Grummite in the water. Or in the rain. They seem to like that.
The Baliwog is a dangerous little creature. Some say they grow up to be Scalons.
The Baliwog are known to carry Swamp Fever.
The Baliwog will return to the water to heal.
I've heard that Skinned Hounds don't like fire.
Don't waste your wonderful poisons on Skinned Hounds. They seem to like them.
Best way to kill a Skinned Hound is with a fireball, or a good weapon.
Heretics are misguided worshippers of Arden-Sul.
I hear the Heretics in the lands of Mania summon Hungers to fight by their sides.
If you want to get close to the Heretics, try putting on their robes.
The Zealots in the lands of Dementia believe they worship Arden-Sul. Poor, deluded souls.
Zealots have dedicated themselves to the worship of Arden-Sul.
If you want to sneak up on one of those Zealots, wear one of their robes. Fools them every time.
I understand there's been strange activity near the obelisks around the Isles.
Stay away from the obelisks! Strange things have appeared near them.
The crystal obelisks that dot the Isles have recently started behaving strangely.
Knights of Order have appeared in the Isles. I hear they come from the obelisks.
Knights of Order have come to destroy the Realm!
I understand that the Hearts of Order you find on the Knights can be used to unlock special chests.
Raven-Biter runs the Choosy Beggar. Not a bad place.
You can stay at the Choosy Beggar in Bliss, but I wouldn't.
Tilse Areleth has quite a collection of things for sale at Common Treasures.
Common Treasures is full of junk. That's all Tilse Areleth collects.
The best armor in the city is at The Missing Pauldron.
I'm not about to go to the Missing Pauldron, even if they do sell armor. I'll stay in Crucible, thank you.
Books of Bliss has quite a selection.
Sontaire may sell a lot of books, but that's not why the men visit her.
Cutter sells weapons in Crucible, but you won't catch me going there.
I'd buy my weapons at Cutter's. She has... a way with blades.
That Museum of Oddities is a joke, although I hear Una Armina will pay for certain items.
You should stop by the Museum of Oddities. I understand Una is always looking for more items to display.
I'd research my own spells before I'd buy them from Earil's Mysteries.
Earil's Mysteries sells a number of unique spells. Doesn't sell any mysteries, though.
Things Found? More like Things Found in the Trash.
You can find some good deals at Things Found. Ahjazda has an interesting collection.
I wouldn't be caught dead at Sickly Bernice's... though I imagine her customers might.
Sickly Bernice's isn't a bad place. Just make sure to wash your hands.
Dumag gro-Bonk at The Missing Pauldron is collecting that Amber you find in the root tunnels.
I hear Cutter collects the Madness Ore to turn into armor.
There are smiths in New Sheoth that collect Amber and Madness Ore.
I've heard ghosts haunt the ruined city of Vitharn.
Stay away from Vitharn. It's said the dead walk there.
Take care venturing into the ruined city of Vitharn.
I understand there's a Knight of the Thorn in Hale.
Pyke, the Knight of the Thorn, lives in Hale.
If you visit Hale, you may see Pyke, a Knight of the Thorn.
The merchants in Crucible are getting tired of Brithaur stealing from them.
Everyone is tired of Brithaur's antics.
I understand the merchants of Crucible are having problems with Brithaur.
I understand Hirrus Clutumnus is begging for people to kill him.
Someone should put Hirrus Clutumnus out of his misery.
In Crucible, a man named Hirrus Clutumnus has been trying to convince people to kill him.
I've heard there's someone in Highcross trying to catalogue every living thing in the Isles.
Mirili Ulven in Highcross thinks she can catalogue every creature in the Isles.
If you visit Highcross, speak with Mirili Ulven. She needs help with her project.
I don't visit the Museum of Oddities, but Una Armina is always looking for new items to display.
If you find something unique, it's worth checking with Una Armina.
Una Armina runs a museum in Crucible.
Cindanwe runs a tight ship in Fellmoor.
The workers in Fellmoor aren't too happy with Cindanwe.
Fellmoor must be a terrible place to live.
Amiable Fanriene thinks his house is going to fall in on him.
That Amiable Fanriene is afraid of his own shadow.
There's a man in Bliss who believes his own house will collapse around him.
Sickly Bernice is convinced she's dying. No wonder no one wants to eat at her Taphouse.
Sickly Bernice is always looking for a miracle cure.
Sickly Bernice in Crucible believes she is dying.
I heard Tove the Unrestful is building something again.
Tove the Unrestful in Bliss is collecting useless items to build something.
Tove the Unrestful in Bliss is collecting items to build something.
Ushnar in Crucible is afraid of cats. Cats!
Ushnar is deathly afraid of cats. He makes sure to keep dogs around because of it.
There's an orc in Crucible who is deathly afraid of cats.
Ahjazda in Crucible believes the world is ending.
Ahjazda thinks the world is ending tomorrow. She's been saving magic items just in case.
There is a Khajiit in Crucible who believes the world is about to end.
Poor Big Head will never find the Fork of Horripilation.
That fool Big Head is always looking for the Fork of Horripilation.
The Argonian Big Head is always searching for the Fork of Horripilation.
Every resident of Split has a double living in the town.
Every person in Split has been divided into their Manic and Demented halves.
There are two of everything in Split. Even the residents.
The Imperial Watch seems awfully worried about the Gray Fox. Look at all those wanted posters.

text.Generic Nord Female: The Imperial Watch seems awfully worried about the Gray Fox. Look at all those wanted posters.

text.Generic Nord Male: My cousin says the beggars all work for the Gray Fox. It's rather frightening.

text.Generic Nord Female: My cousin says the beggars all work for the Gray Fox. It's rather frightening.

text.Generic Nord Male: Amantius Allectus is complaining about crime in the city. Someone actually broke into his house and stole his diary.

text.Generic Nord Female: Amantius Allectus is complaining about crime in the city. Someone actually broke into his house and stole his diary.

text.Generic Nord Male: Captain Lex blames the Gray Fox for stealing the tax collection. He wants a bounty put on the Gray Fox, but the Legion Commander has refused.

text.Generic Nord Female: Captain Lex blames the Gray Fox for stealing the tax collection. He wants a bounty put on the Gray Fox, but the Legion Commander has refused.

text.Generic Nord Male: There was a murder in the Chapel. It happened when a thief was caught trying to rob Llathasa's tomb.
Did you hear? The Countess was robbed. Someone stole her family ring.

text.Generic Nord Female: Did you hear? The Countess was robbed. Someone stole her family ring.

text.Generic Nord Male: The Gray Fox made a fool of Hieronymus Lex. While half the Watch was in the Waterfront, thieves made off with half the rest of the city.

text.Generic Nord Female: The Gray Fox made a fool of Hieronymus Lex. While half the Watch was in the Waterfront, thieves made off with half the rest of the city.

text.Generic Nord Male: Did you hear? Hieronymus Lex was reassigned to Anvil.

text.Generic Nord Female: Did you hear? Hieronymus Lex was reassigned to Anvil.

text.Generic Nord Male: Is there a new Captain of the guard? I thought I saw him walking the rounds.

text.Vigdis: Is there a new Captain of the guard? I thought I saw him walking the rounds.

text.Generic Nord Male: The Earl of Imbel was attacked and killed in his own home. I heard the body burned in the sunlight.

text.Generic Nord Female: The Earl of Imbel was attacked and killed in his own home. I heard the body burned in the sunlight.

text.Generic Nord Male: They say a thief actually stole one of the Elder Scrolls from the Imperial Library. Who would have thought it was even possible?

text.Generic Nord Female: They say a thief actually stole one of the Elder Scrolls from the Imperial Library. Who would have thought it was even possible?

text.Generic Nord Male: Count Umbranox has returned! After eleven years, he just walked back into Anvil.

text.Vigdis: Count Umbranox has returned! After eleven years, he just walked back into Anvil.

text.Generic Nord Male: I saw Ugak gra-Mogakh earlier. At least, I think it was her. Perhaps it was her sister.

text.Generic Nord Female: I saw Ugak gra-Mogakh earlier. At least, I think it was her. Perhaps it was her sister.

text.Generic Nord Male: I like the Two Sisters Lodge, and Mog does a good job running the place. She and her sister are both fine people.

text.Generic Nord Female: I like the Two Sisters Lodge, and Mog does a good job running the place. She and her sister are both fine people.

text.Generic Nord Male: That Else God-Hater sure has a chip on her shoulder. Great with a blade, but she really holds a grudge against the church.

text.Generic Nord Female: That Else God-Hater sure has a chip on her shoulder. Great with a blade, but she really holds a grudge against the church.

text.Generic Nord Male: Marie Palielle is quite a hard worker. She's in the chapel day and night, tending to the sick and injured.

text.Generic Nord Female: Marie Palielle is quite a hard worker. She's in the chapel day and night, tending to the sick and injured.

text.Generic Nord Male: I've heard some strange stories about Count Hassildor. I'm sure they couldn't be true, though.

text.Generic Nord Female: I've heard some strange stories about Count Hassildor. I'm sure they couldn't be true, though.

text.Generic Nord Male: Shum gro-Yarug is the butler in Castle Skingrad. Who ever heard of an Orc butler. Plus, he's in that "Orc Social Club." What a joke.

text.Generic Nord Female: Shum gro-Yarug is the butler in Castle Skingrad. Who ever heard of an Orc butler. Plus, he's in that "Orc Social Club." What a joke.

text.Generic Nord Male: Ah-Malz at the Fighters Guild has gotten to be an expert on goblin hunting. He just hates the things.

text.Generic Nord Female: Ah-Malz at the Fighters Guild has gotten to be an expert on goblin hunting. He just hates the things.

text.Generic Nord Male: I think Adrienne Berene is the ranking mage at the Mages Guild in town. Typical snooty mage.

text.Generic Nord Female: I think Adrienne Berene is the ranking mage at the Mages Guild in town. Typical snooty mage.

text.Generic Nord Male: If I were in the Mages Guild, I think I'd study Mysticism. Druja was telling me a bit about it, and it sounds interesting.

text.Generic Nord Female: If I were in the Mages Guild, I think I'd study Mysticism. Druja was telling me a bit about it, and it sounds interesting.

text.Generic Nord Male: I've had about enough of Sir Lazare. He thinks he's so much better than everyone else.

text.Generic Nord Female: I've had about enough of Sir Lazare. He thinks he's so much better than everyone else.

text.Generic Nord Male: Undena Orethi grows some good tomatoes. Yep. They sure are good tomatoes.

text.Generic Nord Female: Undena Orethi grows some good tomatoes. Yep. They sure are good tomatoes.

text.Generic Nord Male: I think Bernadette Peneles seems like a nice woman. I know she works tirelessly over at the Tamika Vineyards.

text.Generic Nord Female: I think Bernadette Peneles seems like a nice woman. I know she works tirelessly over at the Tamika Vineyards.

text.Generic Nord Male: Gaston Surilie and his brother Davide own one of the finest vineyards in all of Cyrodiil.

text.Generic Nord Female: Gaston Surilie and his brother Davide own one of the finest vineyards in all of Cyrodiil.

text.Generic Nord Male: I enjoy the wines that Tamika makes at her vineyard. And they're reasonably priced, as well.

text.Generic Nord Female: I enjoy the wines that Tamika makes at her vineyard. And they're reasonably priced, as well.

text.Generic Nord Male: Wow. Palonirya is a tough negotiator. Hard to get her prices down.

text.Generic Nord Female: Wow. Palonirya is a tough negotiator. Hard to get her prices down.

text.Generic Nord Male: Dul gro-Shug always seems at ease in light armor. He moves well in it.

text.Generic Nord Female: Dul gro-Shug always seems at ease in light armor. He moves well in it.

text.Generic Nord Male: I know that Dovyn Aren is getting up there in years, but he still knows a bit about Alteration.

text.Generic Nord Female: I know that Dovyn Aren is getting up there in years, but he still knows a bit about Alteration.

text.Generic Nord Male: I understand Mandil has some rather nimble fingers.

text.Generic Nord Female: I understand Mandil has some rather nimble fingers.

text.Generic Nord Male: Samuel Bantien used to be able to pick any lock in the city. He's settled down now, though.

text.Generic Nord Female: Samuel Bantien used to be able to pick any lock in the city. He's settled down now, though.

text.Generic Nord Male: If you're an alchemist, The Main Ingredient is a good place to shop.

text.Generic Nord Female: If you're an alchemist, The Main Ingredient is a good place to shop.

text.Generic Nord Male: Rindir's Staffs is the best place in the city to buy a magical staff. Or is it Rindir's Staves....

text.Generic Nord Female: Rindir's Staffs is the best place in the city to buy a magical staff. Or is it Rindir's Staves....

text.Generic Nord Male: If you're looking for a shield, Stonewall shields has a fine selection.

text.Generic Nord Female: If you're looking for a shield, Stonewall shields has a fine selection.

text.Generic Nord Male: If you need money fast, try Jensine's. You can sell almost anything there.

text.Generic Nord Female: If you need money fast, try Jensine's. You can sell almost anything there.

text.Generic Nord Male: You've gotta like a store named Slash 'N Smash.

text.Generic Nord Female: You've gotta like a store named Slash 'N Smash.

text.Generic Nord Male: There's some fine light armor at The Best Defense. Talk to Maro Rufus.

text.Generic Nord Female: There's some fine light armor at The Best Defense. Talk to Maro Rufus.

text.Generic Nord Male: If you're looking for armor, you should speak with Tertia Viducia.
That Gruiand Garrana is really full of herself. She'll talk your ear off, if you let her.
That Ra'qanar seems a bit shady to me. He does a good job on the horses at the castle, though.
Ganredhel can teach you about Acrobatics, for a price. Of course, she'd rather be training her dogs.
Hafid Hollowleg says that Jerall View has been doing good business.
