text.Generic Nord Female: Hafid Hollowleg says that Jerall View has been doing good business.

text.Generic Nord Male: Cirroc is a good healer. He's a Redguard, but you'd think he was a Nord, the way he acts.

text.Generic Nord Female: Cirroc is a good healer. He's a Redguard, but you'd think he was a Nord, the way he acts.

text.Generic Nord Male: Apparently, Right-Wind teaches his blade skills to other Fighters Guild members.

text.Generic Nord Female: Apparently, Right-Wind teaches his blade skills to other Fighters Guild members.

text.Generic Nord Male: Alga sure can tell a good story. I'm not normally a big fan of bard's tales, but she's got some good ones.

text.Generic Nord Female: Alga sure can tell a good story. I'm not normally a big fan of bard's tales, but she's got some good ones.

text.Generic Nord Male: I've heard Edla Dark-Heart was once an assassin!

text.Generic Nord Female: I've heard Edla Dark-Heart was once an assassin!

text.Generic Nord Male: Gilgondrin inherited Silverhome from his parents. I understand he only runs it out of a sense of duty.

text.Generic Nord Female: Gilgondrin inherited Silverhome from his parents. I understand he only runs it out of a sense of duty.

text.Generic Nord Male: If you're looking to learn about conjuring creatures, you should try to speak with Fathis Aren.

text.Generic Nord Female: If you're looking to learn about conjuring creatures, you should try to speak with Fathis Aren.

text.Generic Nord Male: Tadrose Helas teaches smithing at the Fighters Guild. Well, when she has the time.

text.Generic Nord Female: Tadrose Helas teaches smithing at the Fighters Guild. Well, when she has the time.

text.Generic Nord Male: Ita Rienus knows more about the geography of Tamriel than anyone I've ever met. Apparently, she knows quite a bit about Mysticism as well.

text.Generic Nord Female: Ita Rienus knows more about the geography of Tamriel than anyone I've ever met. Apparently, she knows quite a bit about Mysticism as well.

text.Generic Nord Male: Varon Vamori can be really charming. Of course, there's something a bit odd about him as well.

text.Generic Nord Female: Varon Vamori can be really charming. Of course, there's something a bit odd about him as well.

text.Generic Nord Male: Shuravi runs a good inn, but she's awful with her sisters.

text.Generic Nord Female: Shuravi runs a good inn, but she's awful with her sisters.

text.Generic Nord Male: I've heard Brodras at the Fighters Guild is well-versed in using heavy armor, especially for a wood elf.

text.Generic Nord Female: I've heard Brodras at the Fighters Guild is well-versed in using heavy armor, especially for a wood elf.

text.Generic Nord Male: Dagail has been training high ranking mages more about mysticism. And he's also been researching sheep, from what I hear.

text.Generic Nord Female: Dagail has been training high ranking mages more about mysticism. And he's also been researching sheep, from what I hear.

text.Generic Nord Male: The Count's Arms is a very nice place for a meal. And Wilbur has an extensive knowledge of wines.

text.Vigdis: The Count's Arms is a very nice place for a meal. And Wilbur has an extensive knowledge of wines.

text.Generic Nord Male: Have you seen Rhano at the Fighters Guild use his sword? Impressive. He could teach us all a thing or two.
If you want to learn to use a mace, you should speak to Vigdis. Of course, to speak to Vigdis, you'll have to join the Fighters Guild.
If you're looking to learn a bit about potion-making, you should speak to Felen Ralas at the Mages Guild.

text.Vigdis: If you're looking to learn a bit about potion-making, you should speak to Felen Ralas at the Mages Guild.

text.Generic Nord Male: Mirabelle Monet runs quite a boarding house. I understand all of the sailors leave very satisfied.

text.Vigdis: Mirabelle Monet runs quite a boarding house. I understand all of the sailors leave very satisfied.

text.Generic Nord Male: Pinarus Inventius is quite the hunter. He can track about anything, and he's deadly with his bow.

text.Vigdis: Pinarus Inventius is quite the hunter. He can track about anything, and he's deadly with his bow.

text.Generic Nord Male: Quill-Weave does a lot of traveling to research her books. She must have a lot of experience to share.

text.Vigdis: Quill-Weave does a lot of traveling to research her books. She must have a lot of experience to share.

text.Emfrid: I've made you a little pumpkin bread... something to keep up your strength on those long night watches.
I've put aside a little mead for you. I know you like it.
The bread's hot and fresh, with a nice crust, and butter and honey, just like you like it.

text.BittneldtheCurseBringer: It's been a long day. Quite pleasant to look forward to seeing you here.
I really must thank the one who recommended you -- and the Grey Mare. Always a splendid feast for my spirits. And the food is good, too.
After a long day up at the castle, it's refreshing to spend a time with someone as charming and thoughtful as you.

text.TESTNord: I get paid to kill things. That's why I like the Fighters Guild.

text.Generic Nord Male: The local tavern is a good place to find work.

text.Emfrid: The local tavern is a good place to find work.

text.Generic Nord Male: You know, Bongond has got some fine horses for sale over at the Grey Mare. Too bad he's such a pushy man.

text.Emfrid: You know, Bongond has got some fine horses for sale over at the Grey Mare. Too bad he's such a pushy man.

text.Generic Nord Male: Thank Stendarr for the chapel here in Chorrol. A lovely place, and the healers are excellent.

text.Emfrid: Thank Stendarr for the chapel here in Chorrol. A lovely place, and the healers are excellent.

text.Generic Nord Male: That Modryn Oreyn has got no sense of humor. Hell of a warrior, though. No wonder he's done so well in the Fighters Guild.

text.Emfrid: That Modryn Oreyn has got no sense of humor. Hell of a warrior, though. No wonder he's done so well in the Fighters Guild.

text.Generic Nord Male: I've heard they have good magic trainers over at the Mages Guild.

text.Emfrid: I've heard they have good magic trainers over at the Mages Guild.

text.Generic Nord Male: I read one of Casta Scribonia's books not long ago. Terrible stuff, if you ask me. But, some folks seem to like it.

text.Emfrid: I read one of Casta Scribonia's books not long ago. Terrible stuff, if you ask me. But, some folks seem to like it.

text.Generic Nord Male: I think Rena Bruiant may actually love dogs more than her husband. Strange couple, those two.

text.Emfrid: I think Rena Bruiant may actually love dogs more than her husband. Strange couple, those two.

text.Generic Nord Male: You have to admit, this is a good place to live. Friendly folks, I think.

text.Emfrid: You have to admit, this is a good place to live. Friendly folks, I think.

text.Generic Nord Male: I just feel safe living here in Chorrol. I mean, we have the head of the Fighters Guild right here in town!

text.Emfrid: I just feel safe living here in Chorrol. I mean, we have the head of the Fighters Guild right here in town!

text.Generic Nord Male: I'm thinking of doing some traveling. Just to see the world a bit.

text.Emfrid: I'm thinking of doing some traveling. Just to see the world a bit.

text.Generic Nord Male: Ancient Wayshrines of the Nine are scattered through the wilderness. The righteous who pray there receive powerful divine blessings.

text.Generic Nord Female: Ancient Wayshrines of the Nine are scattered through the wilderness. The righteous who pray there receive powerful divine blessings.

text.Generic Nord Male: If you've done good deeds, the Nine will bless you and cure diseases when you visit their wayshrines.

text.Generic Nord Female: If you've done good deeds, the Nine will bless you and cure diseases when you visit their wayshrines.

text.Generic Nord Male: Wayshrines of the Nine in the wilderness confer blessings on the righteous and faithful.

text.Generic Nord Female: Wayshrines of the Nine in the wilderness confer blessings on the righteous and faithful.

text.Generic Nord Male: Those famous for good deeds may receive Blessings of Intelligence and Magicka when they visit Wayshrines of Julianos.

text.Generic Nord Female: Those famous for good deeds may receive Blessings of Intelligence and Magicka when they visit Wayshrines of Julianos.

text.Generic Nord Male: Virtuous visitors to Wayshrines of Kynareth may receive Blessings of Agility.

text.Generic Nord Female: Virtuous visitors to Wayshrines of Kynareth may receive Blessings of Agility.

text.Generic Nord Male: When you visit a Wayshrine of Zenithar, and you've lived a good life by the Nine, you may receive a Blessing of Luck.

text.Generic Nord Female: When you visit a Wayshrine of Zenithar, and you've lived a good life by the Nine, you may receive a Blessing of Luck.

text.Generic Nord Male: Those who live by the Commands of the Nine receive Blessings of Strength when they visit Wayshrines of Tiber Septim.

text.Generic Nord Female: Those who live by the Commands of the Nine receive Blessings of Strength when they visit Wayshrines of Tiber Septim.

text.Generic Nord Male: A good man who honors the Nine may visit the Wayshrines of Akatosh for Blessings of Speed and Magicka.

text.Generic Nord Female: A good man who honors the Nine may visit the Wayshrines of Akatosh for Blessings of Speed and Magicka.

text.Generic Nord Male: If you've been good, Wayshrines of Dibella may bless your Personality.

text.Generic Nord Female: If you've been good, Wayshrines of Dibella may bless your Personality.

text.Generic Nord Male: Wayshrines of Arkay confer Blessings of Health on those who've pleased the Nine by righteous acts.

text.Generic Nord Female: Wayshrines of Arkay confer Blessings of Health on those who've pleased the Nine by righteous acts.

text.Generic Nord Male: Please the Nine with good works, and visit Wayshrines of Stendarr for Blessings of Endurance.

text.Generic Nord Female: Please the Nine with good works, and visit Wayshrines of Stendarr for Blessings of Endurance.

text.Generic Nord Male: You've seen wayshrines in the wilderness? Those who've pleased the Nine may receive Blessings of Willpower at the Wayshrines of Mara.

text.Generic Nord Female: You've seen wayshrines in the wilderness? Those who've pleased the Nine may receive Blessings of Willpower at the Wayshrines of Mara.

text.Generic Nord Male: The Heartlands and Nibenean Valley are the agricultural breadbaskets of Cyrodiil.

text.Generic Nord Female: The Heartlands and Nibenean Valley are the agricultural breadbaskets of Cyrodiil.

text.Generic Nord Male: Where does our food come from? The Heartlands. And the Nibenean Valley. And Skingrad? Great wines, cheeses, and tomatoes.

text.Generic Nord Female: Where does our food come from? The Heartlands. And the Nibenean Valley. And Skingrad? Great wines, cheeses, and tomatoes.

text.Generic Nord Male: The lowlands of the Great Forest rise to the upland plateau of the Colovian West.

text.Generic Nord Female: The lowlands of the Great Forest rise to the upland plateau of the Colovian West.

text.Generic Nord Male: The Great Forest was cleared for agriculture around Lake Rumare, but it's mostly wilderness outside of that.

text.Generic Nord Female: The Great Forest was cleared for agriculture around Lake Rumare, but it's mostly wilderness outside of that.

text.Generic Nord Male: The Colovian Highlands are barren wastelands along the border with Hammerfell.

text.Generic Nord Female: The Colovian Highlands are barren wastelands along the border with Hammerfell.

text.Generic Nord Male: The Colovian Highlands? Near the Hammerfell border? No one lives there. That's barren wastelands.

text.Generic Nord Female: The Colovian Highlands? Near the Hammerfell border? No one lives there. That's barren wastelands.

text.Generic Nord Male: High mountain ranges rise to the borders in the north and east, and marshes and rainforests extend to the southeast borders.

text.Generic Nord Female: High mountain ranges rise to the borders in the north and east, and marshes and rainforests extend to the southeast borders.

text.Generic Nord Male: It's our natural barriers that keep us safe, mostly. Mountain borders north and east, open sea to the west, and bogs and rainforest to south.

text.Generic Nord Female: It's our natural barriers that keep us safe, mostly. Mountain borders north and east, open sea to the west, and bogs and rainforest to south.

text.Generic Nord Male: Cyrodiil is surrounded to the north and east by the lofty Jerall and Valus mountain ranges.

text.Generic Nord Female: Cyrodiil is surrounded to the north and east by the lofty Jerall and Valus mountain ranges.

text.Generic Nord Male: No one wants to live in the Jerall Mountains. Well, maybe in Bruma, but they're like Nords. They don't feel the cold.

text.Generic Nord Female: No one wants to live in the Jerall Mountains. Well, maybe in Bruma, but they're like Nords. They don't feel the cold.

text.Generic Nord Male: Western Cyrodiil is called 'Colovia,' and includes the Gold Coast, West Weald, and Colovian Highlands regions.

text.Generic Nord Female: Western Cyrodiil is called 'Colovia,' and includes the Gold Coast, West Weald, and Colovian Highlands regions.

text.Generic Nord Male: In the west, in Old Colovia, that's where men are men. That's the Gold Coast, West Weald, and Colovian Highlands.

text.Generic Nord Female: In the west, in Old Colovia, that's where men are men. That's the Gold Coast, West Weald, and Colovian Highlands.

text.Generic Nord Male: Nibenay is a region of mixed farmland, parkland, and forest.

text.Generic Nord Female: Nibenay is a region of mixed farmland, parkland, and forest.

text.Generic Nord Male: With all the farms in Nibenay, there's still plenty of forest and wilderness open for settlement.

text.Generic Nord Female: With all the farms in Nibenay, there's still plenty of forest and wilderness open for settlement.

text.Generic Nord Male: Nibenay is bordered on north and east by rugged mountains and to the south by marshes and rainforest.

text.Generic Nord Female: Nibenay is bordered on north and east by rugged mountains and to the south by marshes and rainforest.

text.Generic Nord Male: The people of Nibenay consider themselves to be more civilized and sophisticated than Colovians.

text.Generic Nord Female: The people of Nibenay consider themselves to be more civilized and sophisticated than Colovians.

text.Generic Nord Male: I'm not saying Colovians are dumb. They're just hard-headed.

text.Generic Nord Female: I'm not saying Colovians are dumb. They're just hard-headed.

text.Generic Nord Male: The Nibeneans think they're slick. 'Slippery' is more like it.

text.Generic Nord Female: The Nibeneans think they're slick. 'Slippery' is more like it.

text.Generic Nord Male: Colovia is a land of rugged wastes and highland forests.

text.Generic Nord Female: Colovia is a land of rugged wastes and highland forests.

text.Generic Nord Male: Colovia is dotted with isolated farms and settlements, with most of the population in the coastal margin.

text.Generic Nord Female: Colovia is dotted with isolated farms and settlements, with most of the population in the coastal margin.

text.Generic Nord Male: The Colovians are proud of their reputation for being independent, rough, and rebellious.

text.Generic Nord Female: The Colovians are proud of their reputation for being independent, rough, and rebellious.

text.Generic Nord Male: The Imperial City is located on a large island surrounded by Lake Rumare.

text.Generic Nord Female: The Imperial City is located on a large island surrounded by Lake Rumare.

text.Generic Nord Male: The Imperial City is densely urbanized, with a few large parks and waterside dock areas.

text.Generic Nord Female: The Imperial City is densely urbanized, with a few large parks and waterside dock areas.

text.Generic Nord Male: The Imperial City itself is a walled city, with separate inner walls protecting the Imperial palace.

text.Generic Nord Female: The Imperial City itself is a walled city, with separate inner walls protecting the Imperial palace.

text.Generic Nord Male: The prettiest town in Cyrodiil? Don't know, but the ugliest is Bravil. Shabby, tumbledown shacks. They're big shacks, though.

text.Generic Nord Female: The prettiest town in Cyrodiil? Don't know, but the ugliest is Bravil. Shabby, tumbledown shacks. They're big shacks, though.

text.Generic Nord Male: Where to buy weapons? Where to buy anything, if you can afford to travel, is the Market District in the Imperial City.

text.Generic Nord Female: Where to buy weapons? Where to buy anything, if you can afford to travel, is the Market District in the Imperial City.

text.Generic Nord Male: My favorite town? Anvil. Lovely old stone buildings, and the harbor at sunset is beautiful.

text.Generic Nord Female: My favorite town? Anvil. Lovely old stone buildings, and the harbor at sunset is beautiful.

text.Generic Nord Male: Ayleid ruins? The big thing is to watch out for the traps. Thousands of years old, and still working. Amazing.

text.Generic Nord Female: Ayleid ruins? The big thing is to watch out for the traps. Thousands of years old, and still working. Amazing.

text.Generic Nord Male: I've seen plenty of Ayleid ruins. You'd think they'd be picked clean after 2000 years, but, no, there's still great treasures there.

text.Generic Nord Female: I've seen plenty of Ayleid ruins. You'd think they'd be picked clean after 2000 years, but, no, there's still great treasures there.

text.Generic Nord Male: It's still pretty wild east of the Niben. Few people, except for bandits, but at least it hasn't been picked clean by treasure-hunters.

text.Generic Nord Female: It's still pretty wild east of the Niben. Few people, except for bandits, but at least it hasn't been picked clean by treasure-hunters.

text.Generic Nord Male: Nobody goes into the mountains but hunters and thieves on the lam. Food and shelter is hard to come by.

text.Generic Nord Female: Nobody goes into the mountains but hunters and thieves on the lam. Food and shelter is hard to come by.

text.Generic Nord Male: Blackwood isn't so bad, once you get used to the flies. And being lost all the time. And the zombies and will-o-the-wisps.

text.Generic Nord Female: Blackwood isn't so bad, once you get used to the flies. And being lost all the time. And the zombies and will-o-the-wisps.

text.Generic Nord Male: There's islands in Niben Bay no one has visited in a hundred years. No telling what you'll find.

text.Generic Nord Female: There's islands in Niben Bay no one has visited in a hundred years. No telling what you'll find.

text.Generic Nord Male: Well, it's no problem traveling from the Imperial City to Leyawiin... if you're a wizard and can walk on water. I'd stay off the roads, though.

text.Generic Nord Female: Well, it's no problem traveling from the Imperial City to Leyawiin... if you're a wizard and can walk on water. I'd stay off the roads, though.

text.Generic Nord Male: If you're all alone in the woods and you see a troll coming, you run. Problem solved. Next question?

text.Generic Nord Female: If you're all alone in the woods and you see a troll coming, you run. Problem solved. Next question?

text.Generic Nord Male: Fighting's easy. Just lead them out on the water and shoot them full of holes. If you've got a bow, of course, and can walk on water.

text.Generic Nord Female: Fighting's easy. Just lead them out on the water and shoot them full of holes. If you've got a bow, of course, and can walk on water.

text.Generic Nord Male: The Arena's faked. You think those guys are getting killed? Really? It's just berry syrup and ham-acting.

text.Generic Nord Female: The Arena's faked. You think those guys are getting killed? Really? It's just berry syrup and ham-acting.

text.Generic Nord Male: Have you ever met anyone who got rich betting on the Arena? Didn't think so.

text.Generic Nord Female: Have you ever met anyone who got rich betting on the Arena? Didn't think so.

text.Generic Nord Male: The Council runs the Arena to amuse the masses, and it pays for itself, with all the fools who lose their shirts gambling.

text.Generic Nord Female: The Council runs the Arena to amuse the masses, and it pays for itself, with all the fools who lose their shirts gambling.

text.Generic Nord Male: If you're on a road, you can usually outrun anything. If you're in good shape, and not wearing a tin suit.

text.Generic Nord Female: If you're on a road, you can usually outrun anything. If you're in good shape, and not wearing a tin suit.

text.Generic Nord Male: Orcs don't ride horses. They eat horses. And sometimes I think they're the smart ones. Wait, maybe it's Dunmer who eat horses.

text.Generic Nord Female: Orcs don't ride horses. They eat horses. And sometimes I think they're the smart ones. Wait, maybe it's Dunmer who eat horses.

text.Generic Nord Male: Take Cheydinhal, for example. Pretty little town. But the Count's a Dark Elf, and it's crawling with Orc thugs and gangsters.

text.Generic Nord Female: Take Cheydinhal, for example. Pretty little town. But the Count's a Dark Elf, and it's crawling with Orc thugs and gangsters.

text.Generic Nord Male: The lands surrounding Lake Rumare are studded with small settlements, farms, and woodland game reserves.

text.Generic Nord Female: The lands surrounding Lake Rumare are studded with small settlements, farms, and woodland game reserves.

text.Generic Nord Male: The Nibenay Basin grades from rolling farmlands by the river east to the rugged uplands of the Valus Mountains.

text.Generic Nord Female: The Nibenay Basin grades from rolling farmlands by the river east to the rugged uplands of the Valus Mountains.

text.Generic Nord Male: On Cyrodiil's northern border is the sparsely populated mountain wilderness called the Valus Mountains.

text.Generic Nord Female: On Cyrodiil's northern border is the sparsely populated mountain wilderness called the Valus Mountains.

text.Generic Nord Male: You can't be too careful out in the wilderness. Almost any creature you find is liable to give you a disease.

text.Generic Nord Female: You can't be too careful out in the wilderness. Almost any creature you find is liable to give you a disease.

text.Generic Nord Male: Watch yourself around goblins. Some of the nastier ones will toss spells at you.

text.Generic Nord Female: Watch yourself around goblins. Some of the nastier ones will toss spells at you.

text.Generic Nord Male: Imps. I hate 'em. Little buggers flitting around, tossing fireballs at you!

text.Generic Nord Female: Imps. I hate 'em. Little buggers flitting around, tossing fireballs at you!

text.Generic Nord Male: I saw a wraith once. It threw a curse on me I'll never forget.

text.Generic Nord Female: I saw a wraith once. It threw a curse on me I'll never forget.

text.Generic Nord Male: Have you seen a land dreugh? We call them "Billies." Don't know why. Steer clear of them, though.

text.Generic Nord Female: Have you seen a land dreugh? We call them "Billies." Don't know why. Steer clear of them, though.

text.Generic Nord Male: I ran across a ghost once. Seemed to suck the energy right out of me.

text.Generic Nord Female: I ran across a ghost once. Seemed to suck the energy right out of me.

text.Generic Nord Male: Watch for minotaurs in the forests. Aggressive beasts. They'll tear right through your armor, too.

text.Generic Nord Female: Watch for minotaurs in the forests. Aggressive beasts. They'll tear right through your armor, too.

text.Generic Nord Male: Mudcrabs. What's the point? Annoying buggers, though the meat isn't bad.

text.Generic Nord Female: Mudcrabs. What's the point? Annoying buggers, though the meat isn't bad.

text.Generic Nord Male: Only thing worse than an ogre is two ogres. Tough bastards, and spells seem to bounce right off of 'em.

text.Generic Nord Female: Only thing worse than an ogre is two ogres. Tough bastards, and spells seem to bounce right off of 'em.

text.Generic Nord Male: Is there anywhere in Tamriel you can avoid rats? Disease spreading little nuisances.

text.Generic Nord Female: Is there anywhere in Tamriel you can avoid rats? Disease spreading little nuisances.

text.Generic Nord Male: Best way to take out a skeleton is with a big weapon. Forget spells. Just smack them and watch the bones fly!

text.Generic Nord Female: Best way to take out a skeleton is with a big weapon. Forget spells. Just smack them and watch the bones fly!

text.Generic Nord Male: I might swim more if it weren't for the slaughterfish. Sharp teeth, and some carry disease.

text.Generic Nord Female: I might swim more if it weren't for the slaughterfish. Sharp teeth, and some carry disease.

text.Generic Nord Male: Spriggans. "Nature's guardians" my foot! Mean things. They'll curse you, or they might call a bear to tear you apart.

text.Generic Nord Female: Spriggans. "Nature's guardians" my foot! Mean things. They'll curse you, or they might call a bear to tear you apart.

text.Generic Nord Male: All that stuff about having to set trolls on fire is a bunch of hooey. They don't like fire, but a good sword will cut them up fine.

text.Generic Nord Female: All that stuff about having to set trolls on fire is a bunch of hooey. They don't like fire, but a good sword will cut them up fine.

text.Generic Nord Male: I don't even know what a will-o-the-wisp is, much less how to kill one. I think they're just swamp gas, myself.

text.Generic Nord Female: I don't even know what a will-o-the-wisp is, much less how to kill one. I think they're just swamp gas, myself.

text.Generic Nord Male: I don't like to think about zombies. Missing arms, legs, heads. They smell awful, and they're hard to kill.

text.Generic Nord Female: I don't like to think about zombies. Missing arms, legs, heads. They smell awful, and they're hard to kill.

text.Generic Nord Male: Try combining aloe vera leaves with some venison. It's said to have some restorative properties.

text.Generic Nord Female: Try combining aloe vera leaves with some venison. It's said to have some restorative properties.

text.Generic Nord Male: You can find Cairn Bolete growing in caves. They're said to mark the place someone has died.

text.Generic Nord Female: You can find Cairn Bolete growing in caves. They're said to mark the place someone has died.

text.Generic Nord Male: It's said that eating taproot can bring you good luck.

text.Generic Nord Female: It's said that eating taproot can bring you good luck.

text.Generic Nord Male: Make sure not to eat nightshade. It's very poisonous.

text.Generic Nord Female: Make sure not to eat nightshade. It's very poisonous.

text.SEGundlar: How awful. An adventurer trying to get into our fine land? I hope they stay far from the palace.

text.SEToveTheUnrestful: I heard there's a new adventurer trying to get into the Shivering Isles. No real matter to me, unless he can build a boat.

text.SEGundlar: Oh my! The Gatekeeper is dead! I must hurry back to Thadon's side. He must be protected!

text.SEToveTheUnrestful: Heard the Gatekeeper was killed. Waste of a creature that size anyway, if you ask me.

text.SEGundlar: Oh thank goodness! The Resonator of Judgment has saved us!

text.SEToveTheUnrestful: I heard the Resonator of Judgment is working again. Can't say that it affects me much, so I'll just go about my business.

text.SEGundlar: I'm so relieved that the Chalice is back in Lord Thadon's capable hands. He seems to be himself again.

text.SEToveTheUnrestful: Thadon seems upbeat again. I know how hard it is to get anything done when you're not feeling up to it.

text.SEGundlar: Syl has tortured her courtiers again, I hear. Poor things.

text.SEToveTheUnrestful: I've no time for conspiracies. Get in the way, they do. Glad I wasn't involved at all.

text.SEGundlar: When I heard the Great Torch atop the Sacellum was ignited, I literally jumped for joy. It's nice to feel safe for a change.

text.SEToveTheUnrestful: Too much to do. No time to talk about the Great Torch being relighted.

text.SEGundlar: The Ritual is completed, and a new ruler presides over Dementia.

text.SEToveTheUnrestful: Even if you don't agree with the method, you have to respect the hard work it takes to replace a Duchess.

text.SEGundlar: My master has partaken of the Greenmote and passed his post onto another. Now a new rule begins in the House of Mania.

text.SEToveTheUnrestful: Even if you don't agree with the method, you have to respect the hard work it takes to replace a Duke.

text.SEGundlar: I've heard The Fringe has been attacked. I hope the residents were able to escape in time.

text.SEToveTheUnrestful: The Fringe has been destroyed. Who knows what could happen next? I'll have to work quickly to get my affairs in order.

text.SEGundlar: Between the Gatekeeper and the Resonator of Judgment, I feel much safer in New Sheoth right now.

text.SEToveTheUnrestful: They can build a new Gatekeeper, but I can't manage to get anything done. I'm over-tasked, I tell you.

text.SEGundlar: Lord Sheogorath's mood seems improved now that he has an army at his back.

text.SEToveTheUnrestful: Perhaps now that our guards are restored, things will quiet down and I'll actually be able to get something done.

text.SEGundlar: Sheogorath may be gone, but I will still serve the House of Mania until my death.

text.SEToveTheUnrestful: Maybe it's not worth doing any more work. I mean, it certainly seems like we're all doomed. What's the point?

text.SEGundlar: The Greymarch is complete and the House of Mania still stands tall.

text.SEToveTheUnrestful: Finally, all this mess is sorted out. I can get back to my work. Oh, I've lost so much time.

text.SEArctus: Any new entry to the Shivering Isles is the chance for a new convert. I welcome it.
The new arrival to our land has slain the Gatekeeper! A fine candidate for the Demented!
Once more the Isles are protected by the will of Arden-Sul.
Bah. I liked when Thadon was in a bad mood. Foolish Maniac.
Torture and pain abound in Crucible, glory be!
Once again, the Great Torch burns bright as Arden-Sul foretold.
The Ritual is complete. Arden-Sul's will is done.
The Ritual is complete. Arden-Sul's will is done.
Arden-Sul preserve us! The Fringe has been destroyed!
The Gatekeeper has returned to its former glory... Arden-Sul blesses us once more.
By the grace of Arden-Sul, the armies have returned.
Have we been forsaken? What has happened to Sheogorath? Arden-Sul, guide me in this time of need!
So, the story has been rewritten and the Greymarch is at a new ending. Arden-Sul's will be done.

text.SEHorkvirBearArmDementia: Some new person has arrived. It'd be polite to introduce myself, but I'm feeling more tired than usual.

text.SEHorkvirBearArmMania: I've heard some new person has arrived in the Realm. I simply don't have the time to meet somebody new.

text.SEJayredIceVeins: Any new adventurer trying to get into the Isles will have a tough time going up against the Gatekeeper.

text.SEHorkvirBearArmDementia: The Gatekeeper is dead. Just great. Who's going to protect us now? I sure hope I don't have to move. I hate moving. It's depressing.

text.SEHorkvirBearArmMania: Whoever killed the Gatekeeper must have been dedicated and hard working. That reminds me... it's time I get back to work.

text.SEJayredIceVeins: The Gatekeeper is dead. He's got really big bones.

text.SEHorkvirBearArmDementia: Someone managed to turn the Resonator back on. I guess that's a good thing. Though it sounds like a lot of work for little pay off to me.

text.SEHorkvirBearArmMania: Glad they got the Resonator of Judgment turned back on. Was getting less done with all the hubbub about adventurers running amok.

text.SEJayredIceVeins: That Resonator keeps adventurers trapped until they die. Lots of bones in there.

text.SEHorkvirBearArmDementia: You know, I need to get me a habit like Thadon. Might take the edge off. Life can be so hard. Makes me want to cry all the time.

text.SEHorkvirBearArmMania: Thadon's got his cup back? Isn't that nice? I certainly can't lay around drifting on Felldew all day. I've got too many important things to do.

text.SEJayredIceVeins: They say Thadon is addicted to some drug. I can understand what that's like. The bones call to me like his drug calls to him.

text.SEHorkvirBearArmDementia: Syl likes torturing people, doesn't she? But, there's really no point in lying. I mean, it takes too much energy to keep it all straight.

text.SEHorkvirBearArmMania: I can't imagine how anyone can get anything done in Crucible, if they keep getting dragged off for questioning by Syl.

text.SEJayredIceVeins: They round up people like animals in New Sheoth. I should hunt those nobles. That's what I should do.

text.SEHorkvirBearArmDementia: I hear you light that big torch in the city by setting yourself on fire. Now there's an idea. I'd like to see that, but the city is so far away.

text.SEHorkvirBearArmMania: What do I care about a big torch in the city? I'm too busy to worry about the games of city-folk. A giant garden, that'd be something.

text.SEJayredIceVeins: I've heard the Great Torch is lit once more. City dwellers. Such useless folk. I've got no use for them. A giant torch? Really?

text.SEHorkvirBearArmDementia: Running Crucible must take a lot of energy. I'd rather just sit here. No reason to do anything else.

text.SEHorkvirBearArmMania: What do I care of the intrigues of the city? Old Duke, new Duke. I'm too busy to keep track of all that nonsense.

text.SEJayredIceVeins: Someone new is running Crucible. Can't say I care.

text.SEHorkvirBearArmDementia: Running Bliss must take a lot of energy. I'd rather just sit here. No reason to do anything else.

text.SEHorkvirBearArmMania: What do I care of the intrigues of the city? Old Duke, new Duke. I'm too busy to keep track of all that nonsense.

text.SEJayredIceVeins: Someone new is running Bliss. Can't say I care.

text.SEHorkvirBearArmDementia: Life might be easier if Order wipes everything out. Everything would be grey and plain. Like my life.

text.SEHorkvirBearArmMania: I hope those Knights of Order stay away from my garden. I'd hate to have to start all over again.

text.SEJayredIceVeins: Damn Knights! Scaring away all the beasts!

text.SEHorkvirBearArmDementia: They made a new Gatekeeper. I'd go see him, but that would take effort.

text.SEHorkvirBearArmMania: I'm glad the Gatekeeper is back. Lets me focus on my work.

text.SEJayredIceVeins: A new Gatekeeper is in the Fringe now. That's good. Fewer adventurers means more creatures for me to hunt.

text.SEHorkvirBearArmDementia: So we have armies again? I wouldn't want to be in an army. All that physical exertion. Better to just sit and regain your strength.

text.SEHorkvirBearArmMania: Sheogorath's army is restored? That's good. You learn discipline in the army, something folks around here are lacking.

text.SEJayredIceVeins: The armies are back in order? I've got no use for armies. Killing is personal, not political.

text.SEHorkvirBearArmDementia: Sheogorath's gone. I wish I could just disappear that way. Sometimes I feel invisible. But, that's not the same. I need a nap.

text.SEHorkvirBearArmMania: I guess even our Lord Sheogorath needs to take a vacation once in a while. Not me, though. I'm happy to keep working.

text.SEJayredIceVeins: Even the great Lord Sheogorath forsakes us. The bones are getting louder.

text.SEHorkvirBearArmDementia: I suppose I should be glad the world didn't end. But, in some ways, I wish it had. It would be easier than... this.

text.SEHorkvirBearArmMania: That was close, but Sheogorath has won. I'd better get back to work.

text.SEJayredIceVeins: I'm glad Jyggalag is defeated. Can't imagine a grey world.

text.Generic Orc Male: You're talking to me, and I don't like you. Goodbye.

text.Generic Orc Female: You're talking to me, and I don't like you. Goodbye.

text.Generic Orc Male: I see no reason to talk to you.

text.Generic Orc Female: I see no reason to talk to you.

text.Generic Orc Male: I don't like you and don't want to talk to you.

text.Generic Orc Female: I don't like you and don't want to talk to you.

text.Generic Orc Male: I'm not listening to you. It's because I don't like you.

text.Generic Orc Female: I'm not listening to you. It's because I don't like you.

text.Generic Orc Male: You're still speaking. Stop.

text.Generic Orc Female: You're still speaking. Stop.

text.Generic Orc Male: Everyone's talking about the assassination, of course. Here. Take my copy of the new Black Horse Courier. Go ahead. Keep it.

text.MoggraMogakh: Everyone's talking about the assassination, of course. Here. Take my copy of the new Black Horse Courier. Go ahead. Keep it.

text.Generic Orc Female: All the bards are busy composing songs about the battle! "The Fall of Dagon" is my favorite so far.

text.Generic Orc Male: Have you heard "The Fall of Dagon" yet? "Take heart, the mighty hero cried! He looked up at Dagon and cursed his foul name..."
The Fighters Guild is recruiting again. Not a bad way to make some money, if you've got the stones for it.

text.Generic Orc Female: The Fighters Guild is recruiting again. Not a bad way to make some money, if you've got the stones for it.

text.Generic Orc Male: Anyone looking for work should consider the Fighters Guild. I hear they're always looking for recruits.

text.Generic Orc Female: Anyone looking for work should consider the Fighters Guild. I hear they're always looking for recruits.

text.Generic Orc Male: I understand the Fighters Guild is hiring new members. Not bad work for some folks.

text.Generic Orc Female: I understand the Fighters Guild is hiring new members. Not bad work for some folks.

text.Generic Orc Male: I saw that Earana woman hanging around the Mages Guild again.
I saw that Erthor is back in town again.

text.Generic Orc Female: I hear one of the guild mages has gone missing again.

text.Generic Orc Male: It seems quieter than usual at the Mages Guild.
I saw Earana leaving town. She looked very excited.

text.Generic Orc Female: Things at the Mages Guild seem tense. That Falcar fellow sure keeps a tight rein on things.

text.Generic Orc Male: Falcar at the Mages Guild seems to be angry all the time. I avoid him when I can.
Varon Vamori seems very glum lately. I guess things aren't going well with Ardaline.
Kud-Ei seems upset about something lately. I'd stay away from the Mages Guild if I were you.

text.Generic Orc Female: Those new fellows here in town are making me nervous. Walking around with those big weapons; I hope they leave soon.

text.Generic Orc Male: I heard someone broke into the Mages Guild.

text.Generic Orc Female: I heard someone broke into the Mages Guild.

text.Generic Orc Male: The Mages Guild seems more disorganized than usual lately.

text.MazogatheOrc: The Mages Guild seems more disorganized than usual lately.

text.Generic Orc Male: Folks think we're all evil? What do they know? Do I look evil?

text.MorGraGamorn: I tried the chapels. They're a waste of time.

text.GogrongroBolmog: Hey, I don't like to tell stories, but Telaendril and me... you know. Don't believe me? I've got her undergarments to prove it! Ha ha ha ha ha!

text.Generic Orc Male: They say that when you murder someone, the Dark Brotherhood comes to you in your sleep. It's how they recruit new members.

text.Generic Orc Female: They say that when you murder someone, the Dark Brotherhood comes to you in your sleep. It's how they recruit new members.

text.Generic Orc Male: Black Brugo, chief of the Black Bow Bandits, is dead. And the Count made his killers Knights of the White Stallion.

text.MazogatheOrc: Black Brugo, chief of the Black Bow Bandits, is dead. And the Count made his killers Knights of the White Stallion.

text.Generic Orc Male: I hear the Count's got someone to sort out that business with Mazoga the so-called knight.
Poor Tivela. I hear she is turning Cheydinhal inside out looking for her husband, Rythe. I hope nothing bad has happened to him.

text.Generic Orc Female: Poor Tivela. I hear she is turning Cheydinhal inside out looking for her husband, Rythe. I hope nothing bad has happened to him.

text.Generic Orc Male: Have you seen Valus Odiil recently? Spends all day in the tavern since his boys left.

text.Generic Orc Female: Have you seen Valus Odiil recently? Spends all day in the tavern since his boys left.

text.Generic Orc Male: I saw Valus Odiil at the Grey Mare again today. Hasn't been the same since his boys took off.

text.Generic Orc Female: I saw Valus Odiil at the Grey Mare again today. Hasn't been the same since his boys took off.

text.Generic Orc Male: So, the mighty Ulrich Leland has fallen. Apparently Llevana Nedaren snapped and killed him. Good riddance I say.

text.Generic Orc Female: So, the mighty Ulrich Leland has fallen. Apparently Llevana Nedaren snapped and killed him. Good riddance I say.

text.Generic Orc Male: Did you hear the news? Ulrich Leland was thrown in the dungeons for stealing money from the city coffers. Haha! Justice for the little guy!

text.Generic Orc Female: Did you hear the news? Ulrich Leland was thrown in the dungeons for stealing money from the city coffers. Haha! Justice for the little guy!

text.Generic Orc Male: Thank goodness the gate is gone. I couldn't get a good night's sleep knowing it was out there!

text.Generic Orc Female: Thank goodness the gate is gone. I couldn't get a good night's sleep knowing it was out there!

text.Generic Orc Male: Rythe Lythandas seems to be back in town. Wonder where he was off to?

text.Generic Orc Female: Rythe Lythandas seems to be back in town. Wonder where he was off to?

text.Generic Orc Male: The Honorblade has been returned to the Castle after all these years! This is certainly a good omen.

text.Generic Orc Female: The Honorblade has been returned to the Castle after all these years! This is certainly a good omen.

text.Generic Orc Male: The Countess still seems quite sad. I hear someone tried to find the item stolen from the castle, but they had no luck. Oh well.

text.Generic Orc Female: The Countess still seems quite sad. I hear someone tried to find the item stolen from the castle, but they had no luck. Oh well.

text.Generic Orc Male: The Countess seems much happier now that the item that was stolen from her was returned.

text.Generic Orc Female: The Countess seems much happier now that the item that was stolen from her was returned.

text.Generic Orc Male: I guess Rosentia Gallenus got rid of whatever barnyard animals she was keeping inside her house. Smells much better now.

text.MazogatheOrc: I guess Rosentia Gallenus got rid of whatever barnyard animals she was keeping inside her house. Smells much better now.

text.Generic Orc Male: I saw Reynald Jemane's brother earlier. Can't believe they didn't even know about each other.

text.Generic Orc Female: I saw Reynald Jemane's brother earlier. Can't believe they didn't even know about each other.

text.Generic Orc Male: Reynald Jemane has a terrible memory. We've met many times, but when I saw him in Cheydinhal, he walked right past me like we were strangers.

text.Generic Orc Female: Reynald Jemane has a terrible memory. We've met many times, but when I saw him in Cheydinhal, he walked right past me like we were strangers.

text.Generic Orc Male: I was in Cheydinhal last week, and I'm sure I saw Reynald Jemane. He acted like he didn't know me, though.

text.Generic Orc Female: I was in Cheydinhal last week, and I'm sure I saw Reynald Jemane. He acted like he didn't know me, though.

text.Generic Orc Male: There's some strange Dark Elf in town, asking about Reynald Jemane and his brother.

text.Generic Orc Female: There's some strange Dark Elf in town, asking about Reynald Jemane and his brother.

text.Generic Orc Male: I can't believe that the Countess is more obsessed with that painting than the Oblivion Gate threatening the city!

text.Generic Orc Female: I can't believe that the Countess is more obsessed with that painting than the Oblivion Gate threatening the city!

text.Generic Orc Male: I heard that the Countess is quite upset lately. Apparently someone stole something very personal to her.

text.Generic Orc Female: I heard that the Countess is quite upset lately. Apparently someone stole something very personal to her.

text.Generic Orc Male: They charged me 5 gold for littering! Littering!! I barely make that in a year! These fines are ridiculous!

text.Generic Orc Female: They charged me 5 gold for littering! Littering!! I barely make that in a year! These fines are ridiculous!

text.Generic Orc Male: I can't believe the ridiculous new fines the guards are imposing. Ever since Ulrich took over as Captain of the Guard, this place is going downhill.

text.Generic Orc Female: I can't believe the ridiculous new fines the guards are imposing. Ever since Ulrich took over as Captain of the Guard, this place is going downhill.

text.Generic Orc Male: Have you been near Rosentia Gallenus's house recently? Smells horrible... like she left some meat out to spoil.

text.MazogatheOrc: Have you been near Rosentia Gallenus's house recently? Smells horrible... like she left some meat out to spoil.

text.Generic Orc Male: I was walking past Rosentia Gallenus' home the other day, and I heard these strange animal noises or something from inside... very odd.

text.MazogatheOrc: I was walking past Rosentia Gallenus' home the other day, and I heard these strange animal noises or something from inside... very odd.

text.Generic Orc Male: So, thanks to some hired help, the Jemanes recovered Weatherleah. Good thing... I never liked having ogres so close to Chorrol.

text.Generic Orc Female: So, thanks to some hired help, the Jemanes recovered Weatherleah. Good thing... I never liked having ogres so close to Chorrol.

text.Generic Orc Male: I'd stay inside the city walls if I were you, there's no telling what's going to come out of that gate.

text.Generic Orc Female: I'd stay inside the city walls if I were you, there's no telling what's going to come out of that gate.

text.Generic Orc Male: Ever since that gate appeared, the city guards have been on alert. I hope they can protect us.

text.Generic Orc Female: Ever since that gate appeared, the city guards have been on alert. I hope they can protect us.

text.Generic Orc Male: Did you hear that Dar-Ma has disappeared?

text.Generic Orc Female: Did you hear that Dar-Ma has disappeared?

text.Generic Orc Male: Did you hear the bad news?  Dar-Ma's daughter was killed by some strange cultists down in Hackdirt. Terrible, terrible times we live in.

text.Generic Orc Female: Did you hear the bad news?  Dar-Ma's daughter was killed by some strange cultists down in Hackdirt. Terrible, terrible times we live in.

text.Generic Orc Male: Did you hear that Dar-Ma came back, safe and sound?  You know, Seed-Neeus's daughter, the Argonians.

text.Generic Orc Female: Did you hear that Dar-Ma came back, safe and sound?  You know, Seed-Neeus's daughter, the Argonians.

text.DarkPrisonGuard03: It's true what everyone's saying -- Kvatch is lost. The Daedra, they swarmed in.... The Town Guard never had a chance.
The Kvatch Oblivion Gate has been closed! Don't you understand what that means? We can beat the bastards!
The Mythic Dawn murdered the Emperor and led those damn Daedra right into the heart of the Empire! They'll pay for their treachery!
Kvatch? Kvatch was just the beginning! Those damned Gates have opened up everywhere! Cheydinhal, Chorrol, Leyawiin -- no city is safe.
If you've got to travel, by the Nine Divines, stay on the roads! The wilderness just isn't safe anymore. We've had sightings, you see. The Daedra...

text.Generic Orc Male: We're all talking about the emperor's murder. We have no emperor. And no heir. That's never happened before. I suppose we should all be worried.

text.Generic Orc Female: We're all talking about the emperor's murder. We have no emperor. And no heir. That's never happened before. I suppose we should all be worried.

text.OraggraBargol: People are subdued. Troubled. A crisis like this tests the people's faith.

text.Generic Orc Female: I think we're in for some hard times. The death of Uriel Septim and his heirs changes everything.

text.Generic Orc Male: The Emperor and his three sons, dead, right under the noses of the Imperial Guard. It's a disgrace.
Have you heard about Kvatch? They say that daedra came from Oblivion and burned the whole city to the ground!

text.Generic Orc Female: Everyone's saying there's trouble in Kvatch. The whole town destroyed. Only a few survivors.

text.Generic Orc Male: Do you think what happened to Kvatch could happen here?
I heard that the Kvatch Guard is driving back the daedra! Maybe there's hope after all.

text.Generic Orc Female: I heard that the Kvatch Guard is driving back the daedra! Maybe there's hope after all.
Everybody's talking about the Hero of Kvatch! They say he actually went into an Oblivion Gate and destroyed it.

text.Generic Orc Male: Everybody's talking about the Hero of Kvatch! They say she actually went into an Oblivion Gate and destroyed it.
Hey, you're the one they call the Hero of Kvatch, aren't you? The one that closed the Oblivion Gate and saved the city?

text.Generic Orc Female: Hey, you're the one they call the Hero of Kvatch, aren't you? The one that closed the Oblivion Gate and saved the city?

text.Generic Orc Male: Good news from Kvatch for a change. The last of the daedra have been driven out.

text.Generic Orc Female: Good news from Kvatch for a change. The last of the daedra have been driven out.

text.Generic Orc Male: Do you believe any of that talk about more Oblivion Gates opening all over the place?

text.Generic Orc Female: I've been hearing disturbing tales about Oblivion Gates opening all across Cyrodiil. I hope it's just wild talk.

text.Generic Orc Male: They say that Oblivion Gates have opened outside cities all across Tamriel! Gods preserve us!

text.Generic Orc Female: With those Oblivion Gates opening everywhere, it's only a matter of time before another city goes the way of Kvatch.
Did you hear? The lost heir of Uriel Septim rallied the Guard and smashed a horde of daedra outside Bruma!

text.Generic Orc Male: They say a lost son of Uriel Septim has reappeared in Bruma. Troops are flocking to his banner from all over Cyrodiil!
I heard that some cult called the Mythic Dawn is behind the Emperor's assassination.

text.Generic Orc Female: They're saying some cult murdered the Emperor and are opening the Oblivion Gates. Do you think any of it's true?

text.Generic Orc Male: Thank Akatosh the Oblivion Crisis is over! Although with no Emperor and no heir, I wonder what will happen to the Empire?
I plan to visit the Imperial City soon to pay my respects at the Temple of the One. They say the Dragon Statue is 100 feet high!

text.Generic Orc Female: I'm sure the Elder Council will find some way to hold the Empire together. At least the Oblivion invasion is over!
I heard that some of the provinces were talking about seceding from the Empire. Probably just talk though. Everything's a bit unsettled now.

text.OraggraBargol: I wish I had witnessed the avatar of divine Akatosh myself. Imagine! Upon the very altar of the Temple of the One!

text.BumphgraGash: I confess, I didn't think we had a chance against the daedra. But Martin proved himself a true heir of Talos on that day.

text.SEUshnarGroShadborgob: I hear that Earil is fed up with Brithaur's antics. He really wants something done about it.
Scalons carry diseases. Lots of them.

text.Generic Orc Male: Don't run into the water to escape a Scalon. They'll follow you.

text.SEDumagGraBonk: Have to watch for those Scalons. I hear they carry disease.
If you see a Gnarl, be careful what spells you use on them.

text.SEUshnarGroShadborgob: I've heard that Gnarl get stronger when hit by some spells.

text.Generic Orc Male: The Gnarl are strange creatures. Hit them with a fireball, and they get stronger, but they hate other elements even more.

text.SEDumagGraBonk: Those Shambles are dangerous. Make sure to stand back if you kill one.

text.SEUshnarGroShadborgob: Don't bother using a frost spell on a Shambles.

text.Generic Orc Male: If you see a Shambles dying, stand back. They'll take you with them.

text.SEDumagGraBonk: Flesh Atronachs are dangerous. Some are smart enough to heal themselves when they're hurt.

text.SEUshnarGroShadborgob: Sometimes, a sharp blade is the best way to kill a Flesh Atronach.

text.Generic Orc Male: If you have to fight a Flesh Atronach, a good shock spell is the way to go.

text.SEDumagGraBonk: The poison of the Elytra can be debilitating.

text.SEUshnarGroShadborgob: The Elytra have wondrous poisons that can drain the very life from you.

text.Generic Orc Male: Watch for the Elytra's stingers; their poison can be deadly. They don't like magic much, though.

text.SEDumagGraBonk: The Hunger is one of Lord Sheogorath's favorite pets.

text.SEUshnarGroShadborgob: Only the Demented can truly appreciate the Hunger.

text.Generic Orc Male: Like most lesser Daedra, the Hunger has a weakness to shock spells.

text.SEDumagGraBonk: Some say the Grummites are the original inhabitants of the Shivering Isles.

text.SEUshnarGroShadborgob: Who do the Grummites worship? Some say Sheogorath, but I'm not sure.

text.Generic Orc Male: Try not to fight a Grummite in the water. Or in the rain. They seem to like that.

text.SEDumagGraBonk: The Baliwog is a dangerous little creature. Some say they grow up to be Scalons.

text.SEUshnarGroShadborgob: The Baliwog are known to carry Swamp Fever.

text.Generic Orc Male: The Baliwog will return to the water to heal.

text.SEDumagGraBonk: I've heard that Skinned Hounds don't like fire.

text.SEUshnarGroShadborgob: Don't waste your wonderful poisons on Skinned Hounds. They seem to like them.

text.Generic Orc Male: Best way to kill a Skinned Hound is with a fireball, or a good weapon.

text.SEDumagGraBonk: Heretics are misguided worshippers of Arden-Sul.

text.SEUshnarGroShadborgob: I hear the Heretics in the lands of Mania summon Hungers to fight by their sides.

text.Generic Orc Male: If you want to get close to the Heretics, try putting on their robes.

text.SEDumagGraBonk: The Zealots in the lands of Dementia believe they worship Arden-Sul. Poor, deluded souls.

text.SEUshnarGroShadborgob: Zealots have dedicated themselves to the worship of Arden-Sul.

text.Generic Orc Male: If you want to sneak up on one of those Zealots, wear one of their robes. Fools them every time.

text.SEDumagGraBonk: I understand there's been strange activity near the obelisks around the Isles.

text.SEUshnarGroShadborgob: Stay away from the obelisks! Strange things have appeared near them.

text.Generic Orc Male: The crystal obelisks that dot the Isles have recently started behaving strangely.

text.SEDumagGraBonk: Knights of Order have appeared in the Isles. I hear they come from the obelisks.

text.SEUshnarGroShadborgob: Knights of Order have come to destroy the Realm!

text.Generic Orc Male: I understand that the Hearts of Order you find on the Knights can be used to unlock special chests.

text.SEDumagGraBonk: Raven-Biter runs the Choosy Beggar. Not a bad place.

text.SEUshnarGroShadborgob: You can stay at the Choosy Beggar in Bliss, but I wouldn't.

text.SEDumagGraBonk: Tilse Areleth has quite a collection of things for sale at Common Treasures.

text.SEUshnarGroShadborgob: Common Treasures is full of junk. That's all Tilse Areleth collects.
I'm not about to go to the Missing Pauldron, even if they do sell armor. I'll stay in Crucible, thank you.

text.SEDumagGraBonk: Books of Bliss has quite a selection.

text.SEUshnarGroShadborgob: Sontaire may sell a lot of books, but that's not why the men visit her.

text.SEDumagGraBonk: Cutter sells weapons in Crucible, but you won't catch me going there.

text.SEUshnarGroShadborgob: I'd buy my weapons at Cutter's. She has... a way with blades.

text.SEDumagGraBonk: That Museum of Oddities is a joke, although I hear Una Armina will pay for certain items.

text.SEUshnarGroShadborgob: You should stop by the Museum of Oddities. I understand Una is always looking for more items to display.

text.SEDumagGraBonk: I'd research my own spells before I'd buy them from Earil's Mysteries.

text.SEUshnarGroShadborgob: Earil's Mysteries sells a number of unique spells. Doesn't sell any mysteries, though.

text.SEDumagGraBonk: Things Found? More like Things Found in the Trash.

text.SEUshnarGroShadborgob: You can find some good deals at Things Found. Ahjazda has an interesting collection.

text.SEDumagGraBonk: I wouldn't be caught dead at Sickly Bernice's... though I imagine her customers might.

text.SEUshnarGroShadborgob: Sickly Bernice's isn't a bad place. Just make sure to wash your hands.
I hear Cutter collects the Madness Ore to turn into armor.

text.Generic Orc Male: There are smiths in New Sheoth that collect Amber and Madness Ore.

text.SEDumagGraBonk: I've heard ghosts haunt the ruined city of Vitharn.

text.SEUshnarGroShadborgob: Stay away from Vitharn. It's said the dead walk there.

text.Generic Orc Male: Take care venturing into the ruined city of Vitharn.

text.SEDumagGraBonk: I understand there's a Knight of the Thorn in Hale.

text.SEUshnarGroShadborgob: Pyke, the Knight of the Thorn, lives in Hale.

text.Generic Orc Male: If you visit Hale, you may see Pyke, a Knight of the Thorn.

text.SEDumagGraBonk: The merchants in Crucible are getting tired of Brithaur stealing from them.

text.SEUshnarGroShadborgob: Everyone is tired of Brithaur's antics.

text.Generic Orc Male: I understand the merchants of Crucible are having problems with Brithaur.

text.SEDumagGraBonk: I understand Hirrus Clutumnus is begging for people to kill him.

text.SEUshnarGroShadborgob: Someone should put Hirrus Clutumnus out of his misery.

text.Generic Orc Male: In Crucible, a man named Hirrus Clutumnus has been trying to convince people to kill him.

text.SEDumagGraBonk: I've heard there's someone in Highcross trying to catalogue every living thing in the Isles.

text.SEUshnarGroShadborgob: Mirili Ulven in Highcross thinks she can catalogue every creature in the Isles.

text.Generic Orc Male: If you visit Highcross, speak with Mirili Ulven. She needs help with her project.

text.SEDumagGraBonk: I don't visit the Museum of Oddities, but Una Armina is always looking for new items to display.

text.SEUshnarGroShadborgob: If you find something unique, it's worth checking with Una Armina.

text.Generic Orc Male: Una Armina runs a museum in Crucible.

text.SEDumagGraBonk: Cindanwe runs a tight ship in Fellmoor.

text.SEUshnarGroShadborgob: The workers in Fellmoor aren't too happy with Cindanwe.

text.Generic Orc Male: Fellmoor must be a terrible place to live.

text.SEDumagGraBonk: Amiable Fanriene thinks his house is going to fall in on him.

text.SEUshnarGroShadborgob: That Amiable Fanriene is afraid of his own shadow.

text.Generic Orc Male: There's a man in Bliss who believes his own house will collapse around him.

text.SEDumagGraBonk: Sickly Bernice is convinced she's dying. No wonder no one wants to eat at her Taphouse.

text.SEUshnarGroShadborgob: Sickly Bernice is always looking for a miracle cure.

text.Generic Orc Male: Sickly Bernice in Crucible believes she is dying.

text.SEDumagGraBonk: I heard Tove the Unrestful is building something again.

text.SEUshnarGroShadborgob: Tove the Unrestful in Bliss is collecting useless items to build something.

text.Generic Orc Male: Tove the Unrestful in Bliss is collecting items to build something.

text.SEDumagGraBonk: Ushnar in Crucible is afraid of cats. Cats!

text.Generic Orc Male: There's an orc in Crucible who is deathly afraid of cats.

text.SEDumagGraBonk: Ahjazda in Crucible believes the world is ending.

text.SEUshnarGroShadborgob: Ahjazda thinks the world is ending tomorrow. She's been saving magic items just in case.

text.Generic Orc Male: There is a Khajiit in Crucible who believes the world is about to end.

text.SEDumagGraBonk: Poor Big Head will never find the Fork of Horripilation.

text.SEUshnarGroShadborgob: That fool Big Head is always looking for the Fork of Horripilation.

text.Generic Orc Male: The Argonian Big Head is always searching for the Fork of Horripilation.

text.SEDumagGraBonk: Every resident of Split has a double living in the town.

text.SEUshnarGroShadborgob: Every person in Split has been divided into their Manic and Demented halves.

text.SEDulphumphGroUrgash: There are two of everything in Split. Even the residents.

text.Generic Orc Male: The Imperial Watch seems awfully worried about the Gray Fox. Look at all those wanted posters.

text.Generic Orc Female: The Imperial Watch seems awfully worried about the Gray Fox. Look at all those wanted posters.

text.Generic Orc Male: My cousin says the beggars all work for the Gray Fox. It's rather frightening.

text.Generic Orc Female: My cousin says the beggars all work for the Gray Fox. It's rather frightening.

text.Generic Orc Male: Amantius Allectus is complaining about crime in the city. Someone actually broke into his house and stole his diary.

text.Generic Orc Female: Amantius Allectus is complaining about crime in the city. Someone actually broke into his house and stole his diary.

text.Generic Orc Male: Captain Lex blames the Gray Fox for stealing the tax collection. He wants a bounty put on the Gray Fox, but the Legion Commander has refused.

text.Generic Orc Female: Captain Lex blames the Gray Fox for stealing the tax collection. He wants a bounty put on the Gray Fox, but the Legion Commander has refused.

text.Generic Orc Male: There was a murder in the Chapel. It happened when a thief was caught trying to rob Llathasa's tomb.

text.Generic Orc Female: There was a murder in the Chapel. It happened when a thief was caught trying to rob Llathasa's tomb.

text.Generic Orc Male: Did you hear? The Countess was robbed. Someone stole her family ring.

text.MazogatheOrc: Did you hear? The Countess was robbed. Someone stole her family ring.

text.Generic Orc Male: The Gray Fox made a fool of Hieronymus Lex. While half the Watch was in the Waterfront, thieves made off with half the rest of the city.

text.Generic Orc Female: The Gray Fox made a fool of Hieronymus Lex. While half the Watch was in the Waterfront, thieves made off with half the rest of the city.

text.Generic Orc Male: Did you hear? Hieronymus Lex was reassigned to Anvil.

text.Generic Orc Female: Did you hear? Hieronymus Lex was reassigned to Anvil.

text.Generic Orc Male: Is there a new Captain of the guard? I thought I saw him walking the rounds.
The Earl of Imbel was attacked and killed in his own home. I heard the body burned in the sunlight.

text.Generic Orc Female: The Earl of Imbel was attacked and killed in his own home. I heard the body burned in the sunlight.

text.Generic Orc Male: They say a thief actually stole one of the Elder Scrolls from the Imperial Library. Who would have thought it was even possible?

text.Generic Orc Female: They say a thief actually stole one of the Elder Scrolls from the Imperial Library. Who would have thought it was even possible?

text.Generic Orc Male: Count Umbranox has returned! After eleven years, he just walked back into Anvil.
I saw Ugak gra-Mogakh earlier. At least, I think it was her. Perhaps it was her sister.
I like the Two Sisters Lodge, and Mog does a good job running the place. She and her sister are both fine people.
That Else God-Hater sure has a chip on her shoulder. Great with a blade, but she really holds a grudge against the church.

text.Generic Orc Female: That Else God-Hater sure has a chip on her shoulder. Great with a blade, but she really holds a grudge against the church.

text.Generic Orc Male: Marie Palielle is quite a hard worker. She's in the chapel day and night, tending to the sick and injured.

text.Generic Orc Female: Marie Palielle is quite a hard worker. She's in the chapel day and night, tending to the sick and injured.

text.Generic Orc Male: I've heard some strange stories about Count Hassildor. I'm sure they couldn't be true, though.

text.Generic Orc Female: I've heard some strange stories about Count Hassildor. I'm sure they couldn't be true, though.

text.Generic Orc Male: Ah-Malz at the Fighters Guild has gotten to be an expert on goblin hunting. He just hates the things.

text.Generic Orc Female: Ah-Malz at the Fighters Guild has gotten to be an expert on goblin hunting. He just hates the things.

text.Generic Orc Male: I think Adrienne Berene is the ranking mage at the Mages Guild in town. Typical snooty mage.

text.Generic Orc Female: I think Adrienne Berene is the ranking mage at the Mages Guild in town. Typical snooty mage.

text.Generic Orc Male: If I were in the Mages Guild, I think I'd study Mysticism. Druja was telling me a bit about it, and it sounds interesting.

text.Generic Orc Female: If I were in the Mages Guild, I think I'd study Mysticism. Druja was telling me a bit about it, and it sounds interesting.

text.Generic Orc Male: I've had about enough of Sir Lazare. He thinks he's so much better than everyone else.

text.Generic Orc Female: I've had about enough of Sir Lazare. He thinks he's so much better than everyone else.

text.Generic Orc Male: Undena Orethi grows some good tomatoes. Yep. They sure are good tomatoes.

text.Generic Orc Female: Undena Orethi grows some good tomatoes. Yep. They sure are good tomatoes.

text.Generic Orc Male: I think Bernadette Peneles seems like a nice woman. I know she works tirelessly over at the Tamika Vineyards.

text.Generic Orc Female: I think Bernadette Peneles seems like a nice woman. I know she works tirelessly over at the Tamika Vineyards.

text.Generic Orc Male: Gaston Surilie and his brother Davide own one of the finest vineyards in all of Cyrodiil.

text.Generic Orc Female: Gaston Surilie and his brother Davide own one of the finest vineyards in all of Cyrodiil.

text.Generic Orc Male: I enjoy the wines that Tamika makes at her vineyard. And they're reasonably priced, as well.

text.Generic Orc Female: I enjoy the wines that Tamika makes at her vineyard. And they're reasonably priced, as well.

text.Generic Orc Male: Wow. Palonirya is a tough negotiator. Hard to get her prices down.

text.Generic Orc Female: Wow. Palonirya is a tough negotiator. Hard to get her prices down.

text.Generic Orc Male: Dul gro-Shug always seems at ease in light armor. He moves well in it.

text.Generic Orc Female: Dul gro-Shug always seems at ease in light armor. He moves well in it.

text.Generic Orc Male: I know that Dovyn Aren is getting up there in years, but he still knows a bit about Alteration.

text.Generic Orc Female: I know that Dovyn Aren is getting up there in years, but he still knows a bit about Alteration.

text.Generic Orc Male: I understand Mandil has some rather nimble fingers.

text.Generic Orc Female: I understand Mandil has some rather nimble fingers.

text.Generic Orc Male: Samuel Bantien used to be able to pick any lock in the city. He's settled down now, though.

text.Generic Orc Female: Samuel Bantien used to be able to pick any lock in the city. He's settled down now, though.

text.Generic Orc Male: If you're an alchemist, The Main Ingredient is a good place to shop.

text.Generic Orc Female: If you're an alchemist, The Main Ingredient is a good place to shop.

text.Generic Orc Male: Rindir's Staffs is the best place in the city to buy a magical staff. Or is it Rindir's Staves....

text.Generic Orc Female: Rindir's Staffs is the best place in the city to buy a magical staff. Or is it Rindir's Staves....

text.Generic Orc Male: If you're looking for a shield, Stonewall shields has a fine selection.

text.Generic Orc Female: If you're looking for a shield, Stonewall shields has a fine selection.

text.Generic Orc Male: If you need money fast, try Jensine's. You can sell almost anything there.

text.Generic Orc Female: If you need money fast, try Jensine's. You can sell almost anything there.

text.Generic Orc Male: You've gotta like a store named Slash 'N Smash.

text.Generic Orc Female: You've gotta like a store named Slash 'N Smash.

text.Generic Orc Male: There's some fine light armor at The Best Defense. Talk to Maro Rufus.

text.Generic Orc Female: There's some fine light armor at The Best Defense. Talk to Maro Rufus.

text.Generic Orc Male: If you're looking for armor, you should speak with Tertia Viducia.

text.Generic Orc Female: If you're looking for armor, you should speak with Tertia Viducia.

text.Generic Orc Male: That Gruiand Garrana is really full of herself. She'll talk your ear off, if you let her.

text.Generic Orc Female: That Gruiand Garrana is really full of herself. She'll talk your ear off, if you let her.

text.Generic Orc Male: That Ra'qanar seems a bit shady to me. He does a good job on the horses at the castle, though.

text.Generic Orc Female: That Ra'qanar seems a bit shady to me. He does a good job on the horses at the castle, though.

text.Generic Orc Male: Ganredhel can teach you about Acrobatics, for a price. Of course, she'd rather be training her dogs.

text.Generic Orc Female: Ganredhel can teach you about Acrobatics, for a price. Of course, she'd rather be training her dogs.

text.BumphgraGash: Hafid Hollowleg says that Jerall View has been doing good business.
Cirroc is a good healer. He's a Redguard, but you'd think he was a Nord, the way he acts.
Apparently, Right-Wind teaches his blade skills to other Fighters Guild members.
Alga sure can tell a good story. I'm not normally a big fan of bard's tales, but she's got some good ones.
I've heard Edla Dark-Heart was once an assassin!

text.Generic Orc Male: Gilgondrin inherited Silverhome from his parents. I understand he only runs it out of a sense of duty.
If you're looking to learn about conjuring creatures, you should try to speak with Fathis Aren.
Tadrose Helas teaches smithing at the Fighters Guild. Well, when she has the time.
Ita Rienus knows more about the geography of Tamriel than anyone I've ever met. Apparently, she knows quite a bit about Mysticism as well.
Varon Vamori can be really charming. Of course, there's something a bit odd about him as well.
Shuravi runs a good inn, but she's awful with her sisters.

text.MazogatheOrc: Shuravi runs a good inn, but she's awful with her sisters.

text.Generic Orc Male: I've heard Brodras at the Fighters Guild is well-versed in using heavy armor, especially for a wood elf.

text.MazogatheOrc: I've heard Brodras at the Fighters Guild is well-versed in using heavy armor, especially for a wood elf.

text.Generic Orc Male: Dagail has been training high ranking mages more about mysticism. And he's also been researching sheep, from what I hear.

text.MazogatheOrc: Dagail has been training high ranking mages more about mysticism. And he's also been researching sheep, from what I hear.

text.Generic Orc Male: The Count's Arms is a very nice place for a meal. And Wilbur has an extensive knowledge of wines.
Have you seen Rhano at the Fighters Guild use his sword? Impressive. He could teach us all a thing or two.
If you want to learn to use a mace, you should speak to Vigdis. Of course, to speak to Vigdis, you'll have to join the Fighters Guild.
If you're looking to learn a bit about potion-making, you should speak to Felen Ralas at the Mages Guild.
Mirabelle Monet runs quite a boarding house. I understand all of the sailors leave very satisfied.
Pinarus Inventius is quite the hunter. He can track about anything, and he's deadly with his bow.
Quill-Weave does a lot of traveling to research her books. She must have a lot of experience to share.
I get paid to kill things. That's why I like the Fighters Guild.
The local tavern is a good place to find work.

text.Generic Orc Female: The local tavern is a good place to find work.

text.Generic Orc Male: You know, Bongond has got some fine horses for sale over at the Grey Mare. Too bad he's such a pushy man.

text.Generic Orc Female: You know, Bongond has got some fine horses for sale over at the Grey Mare. Too bad he's such a pushy man.

text.Generic Orc Male: Thank Stendarr for the chapel here in Chorrol. A lovely place, and the healers are excellent.

text.HomrazgraMorgrump: Thank Stendarr for the chapel here in Chorrol. A lovely place, and the healers are excellent.

text.Generic Orc Male: That Modryn Oreyn has got no sense of humor. Hell of a warrior, though. No wonder he's done so well in the Fighters Guild.

text.Generic Orc Female: That Modryn Oreyn has got no sense of humor. Hell of a warrior, though. No wonder he's done so well in the Fighters Guild.

text.Generic Orc Male: I've heard they have good magic trainers over at the Mages Guild.

text.Generic Orc Female: I've heard they have good magic trainers over at the Mages Guild.

text.Generic Orc Male: I read one of Casta Scribonia's books not long ago. Terrible stuff, if you ask me. But, some folks seem to like it.

text.Generic Orc Female: I read one of Casta Scribonia's books not long ago. Terrible stuff, if you ask me. But, some folks seem to like it.

text.Generic Orc Male: I think Rena Bruiant may actually love dogs more than her husband. Strange couple, those two.

text.Generic Orc Female: I think Rena Bruiant may actually love dogs more than her husband. Strange couple, those two.

text.Generic Orc Male: You have to admit, this is a good place to live. Friendly folks, I think.

text.Generic Orc Female: You have to admit, this is a good place to live. Friendly folks, I think.

text.Generic Orc Male: I just feel safe living here in Chorrol. I mean, we have the head of the Fighters Guild right here in town!

text.Generic Orc Female: I just feel safe living here in Chorrol. I mean, we have the head of the Fighters Guild right here in town!

text.Generic Orc Male: I'm thinking of doing some traveling. Just to see the world a bit.

text.Generic Orc Female: I'm thinking of doing some traveling. Just to see the world a bit.

text.LordRugdumph: The will-o-the-wisp is a luminous being. It has naturalized residences to many types of spells.
I am resident to encounter the minotaur. Its horny protuberants cause me great conflagrations.
Trolls, I have been foretold, are particular to unflammable weapons.
Though I am replicant to spread rumors, I am led to believe the philogy of skeletous beings makes them resistive to magic.

text.Generic Orc Male: Ancient Wayshrines of the Nine are scattered through the wilderness. The righteous who pray there receive powerful divine blessings.

text.Generic Orc Female: Ancient Wayshrines of the Nine are scattered through the wilderness. The righteous who pray there receive powerful divine blessings.

text.Generic Orc Male: If you've done good deeds, the Nine will bless you and cure diseases when you visit their wayshrines.

text.Generic Orc Female: If you've done good deeds, the Nine will bless you and cure diseases when you visit their wayshrines.

text.Generic Orc Male: Wayshrines of the Nine in the wilderness confer blessings on the righteous and faithful.

text.Generic Orc Female: Wayshrines of the Nine in the wilderness confer blessings on the righteous and faithful.

text.Generic Orc Male: Those famous for good deeds may receive Blessings of Intelligence and Magicka when they visit Wayshrines of Julianos.

text.Generic Orc Female: Those famous for good deeds may receive Blessings of Intelligence and Magicka when they visit Wayshrines of Julianos.

text.Generic Orc Male: Virtuous visitors to Wayshrines of Kynareth may receive Blessings of Agility.

text.Generic Orc Female: Virtuous visitors to Wayshrines of Kynareth may receive Blessings of Agility.

text.Generic Orc Male: When you visit a Wayshrine of Zenithar, and you've lived a good life by the Nine, you may receive a Blessing of Luck.

text.Generic Orc Female: When you visit a Wayshrine of Zenithar, and you've lived a good life by the Nine, you may receive a Blessing of Luck.

text.Generic Orc Male: Those who live by the Commands of the Nine receive Blessings of Strength when they visit Wayshrines of Tiber Septim.

text.Generic Orc Female: Those who live by the Commands of the Nine receive Blessings of Strength when they visit Wayshrines of Tiber Septim.

text.Generic Orc Male: A good man who honors the Nine may visit the Wayshrines of Akatosh for Blessings of Speed and Magicka.

text.Generic Orc Female: A good man who honors the Nine may visit the Wayshrines of Akatosh for Blessings of Speed and Magicka.

text.Generic Orc Male: If you've been good, Wayshrines of Dibella may bless your Personality.

text.Generic Orc Female: If you've been good, Wayshrines of Dibella may bless your Personality.

text.Generic Orc Male: Wayshrines of Arkay confer Blessings of Health on those who've pleased the Nine by righteous acts.

text.Generic Orc Female: Wayshrines of Arkay confer Blessings of Health on those who've pleased the Nine by righteous acts.

text.Generic Orc Male: Please the Nine with good works, and visit Wayshrines of Stendarr for Blessings of Endurance.

text.Generic Orc Female: Please the Nine with good works, and visit Wayshrines of Stendarr for Blessings of Endurance.

text.Generic Orc Male: You've seen wayshrines in the wilderness? Those who've pleased the Nine may receive Blessings of Willpower at the Wayshrines of Mara.

text.Generic Orc Female: You've seen wayshrines in the wilderness? Those who've pleased the Nine may receive Blessings of Willpower at the Wayshrines of Mara.

text.Generic Orc Male: The Heartlands and Nibenean Valley are the agricultural breadbaskets of Cyrodiil.

text.Generic Orc Female: The Heartlands and Nibenean Valley are the agricultural breadbaskets of Cyrodiil.

text.Generic Orc Male: Where does our food come from? The Heartlands. And the Nibenean Valley. And Skingrad? Great wines, cheeses, and tomatoes.

text.Generic Orc Female: Where does our food come from? The Heartlands. And the Nibenean Valley. And Skingrad? Great wines, cheeses, and tomatoes.

text.Generic Orc Male: The lowlands of the Great Forest rise to the upland plateau of the Colovian West.

text.Generic Orc Female: The lowlands of the Great Forest rise to the upland plateau of the Colovian West.

text.Generic Orc Male: The Great Forest was cleared for agriculture around Lake Rumare, but it's mostly wilderness outside of that.

text.Generic Orc Female: The Great Forest was cleared for agriculture around Lake Rumare, but it's mostly wilderness outside of that.

text.Generic Orc Male: The Colovian Highlands are barren wastelands along the border with Hammerfell.

text.Generic Orc Female: The Colovian Highlands are barren wastelands along the border with Hammerfell.

text.Generic Orc Male: The Colovian Highlands? Near the Hammerfell border? No one lives there. That's barren wastelands.

text.Generic Orc Female: The Colovian Highlands? Near the Hammerfell border? No one lives there. That's barren wastelands.

text.Generic Orc Male: High mountain ranges rise to the borders in the north and east, and marshes and rainforests extend to the southeast borders.

text.Generic Orc Female: High mountain ranges rise to the borders in the north and east, and marshes and rainforests extend to the southeast borders.

text.Generic Orc Male: It's our natural barriers that keep us safe, mostly. Mountain borders north and east, open sea to the west, and bogs and rainforest to south.

text.Generic Orc Female: It's our natural barriers that keep us safe, mostly. Mountain borders north and east, open sea to the west, and bogs and rainforest to south.
