text.Generic Orc Male: Cyrodiil is surrounded to the north and east by the lofty Jerall and Valus mountain ranges.

text.Generic Orc Female: Cyrodiil is surrounded to the north and east by the lofty Jerall and Valus mountain ranges.

text.Generic Orc Male: No one wants to live in the Jerall Mountains. Well, maybe in Bruma, but they're like Nords. They don't feel the cold.

text.Generic Orc Female: No one wants to live in the Jerall Mountains. Well, maybe in Bruma, but they're like Nords. They don't feel the cold.

text.Generic Orc Male: Western Cyrodiil is called 'Colovia,' and includes the Gold Coast, West Weald, and Colovian Highlands regions.

text.Generic Orc Female: Western Cyrodiil is called 'Colovia,' and includes the Gold Coast, West Weald, and Colovian Highlands regions.

text.Generic Orc Male: In the west, in Old Colovia, that's where men are men. That's the Gold Coast, West Weald, and Colovian Highlands.

text.Generic Orc Female: In the west, in Old Colovia, that's where men are men. That's the Gold Coast, West Weald, and Colovian Highlands.

text.Generic Orc Male: Nibenay is a region of mixed farmland, parkland, and forest.

text.Generic Orc Female: Nibenay is a region of mixed farmland, parkland, and forest.

text.Generic Orc Male: With all the farms in Nibenay, there's still plenty of forest and wilderness open for settlement.

text.Generic Orc Female: With all the farms in Nibenay, there's still plenty of forest and wilderness open for settlement.

text.Generic Orc Male: Nibenay is bordered on north and east by rugged mountains and to the south by marshes and rainforest.

text.Generic Orc Female: Nibenay is bordered on north and east by rugged mountains and to the south by marshes and rainforest.

text.Generic Orc Male: The people of Nibenay consider themselves to be more civilized and sophisticated than Colovians.

text.Generic Orc Female: The people of Nibenay consider themselves to be more civilized and sophisticated than Colovians.

text.Generic Orc Male: I'm not saying Colovians are dumb. They're just hard-headed.

text.Generic Orc Female: I'm not saying Colovians are dumb. They're just hard-headed.

text.Generic Orc Male: The Nibeneans think they're slick. 'Slippery' is more like it.

text.Generic Orc Female: The Nibeneans think they're slick. 'Slippery' is more like it.

text.Generic Orc Male: Colovia is a land of rugged wastes and highland forests.

text.Generic Orc Female: Colovia is a land of rugged wastes and highland forests.

text.Generic Orc Male: Colovia is dotted with isolated farms and settlements, with most of the population in the coastal margin.

text.Generic Orc Female: Colovia is dotted with isolated farms and settlements, with most of the population in the coastal margin.

text.Generic Orc Male: The Colovians are proud of their reputation for being independent, rough, and rebellious.

text.Generic Orc Female: The Colovians are proud of their reputation for being independent, rough, and rebellious.

text.Generic Orc Male: The Imperial City is located on a large island surrounded by Lake Rumare.

text.Generic Orc Female: The Imperial City is located on a large island surrounded by Lake Rumare.

text.Generic Orc Male: The Imperial City is densely urbanized, with a few large parks and waterside dock areas.

text.Generic Orc Female: The Imperial City is densely urbanized, with a few large parks and waterside dock areas.

text.Generic Orc Male: The Imperial City itself is a walled city, with separate inner walls protecting the Imperial palace.

text.Generic Orc Female: The Imperial City itself is a walled city, with separate inner walls protecting the Imperial palace.

text.Generic Orc Male: The prettiest town in Cyrodiil? Don't know, but the ugliest is Bravil. Shabby, tumbledown shacks. They're big shacks, though.

text.Generic Orc Female: The prettiest town in Cyrodiil? Don't know, but the ugliest is Bravil. Shabby, tumbledown shacks. They're big shacks, though.

text.Generic Orc Male: Where to buy weapons? Where to buy anything, if you can afford to travel, is the Market District in the Imperial City.

text.Generic Orc Female: Where to buy weapons? Where to buy anything, if you can afford to travel, is the Market District in the Imperial City.

text.Generic Orc Male: My favorite town? Anvil. Lovely old stone buildings, and the harbor at sunset is beautiful.

text.Generic Orc Female: My favorite town? Anvil. Lovely old stone buildings, and the harbor at sunset is beautiful.

text.Generic Orc Male: Ayleid ruins? The big thing is to watch out for the traps. Thousands of years old, and still working. Amazing.

text.Generic Orc Female: Ayleid ruins? The big thing is to watch out for the traps. Thousands of years old, and still working. Amazing.

text.Generic Orc Male: I've seen plenty of Ayleid ruins. You'd think they'd be picked clean after 2000 years, but, no, there's still great treasures there.

text.Generic Orc Female: I've seen plenty of Ayleid ruins. You'd think they'd be picked clean after 2000 years, but, no, there's still great treasures there.

text.Generic Orc Male: It's still pretty wild east of the Niben. Few people, except for bandits, but at least it hasn't been picked clean by treasure-hunters.

text.Generic Orc Female: It's still pretty wild east of the Niben. Few people, except for bandits, but at least it hasn't been picked clean by treasure-hunters.

text.Generic Orc Male: Nobody goes into the mountains but hunters and thieves on the lam. Food and shelter is hard to come by.

text.Generic Orc Female: Nobody goes into the mountains but hunters and thieves on the lam. Food and shelter is hard to come by.

text.Generic Orc Male: Blackwood isn't so bad, once you get used to the flies. And being lost all the time. And the zombies and will-o-the-wisps.

text.Generic Orc Female: Blackwood isn't so bad, once you get used to the flies. And being lost all the time. And the zombies and will-o-the-wisps.

text.Generic Orc Male: There's islands in Niben Bay no one has visited in a hundred years. No telling what you'll find.

text.Generic Orc Female: There's islands in Niben Bay no one has visited in a hundred years. No telling what you'll find.

text.Generic Orc Male: Well, it's no problem traveling from the Imperial City to Leyawiin... if you're a wizard and can walk on water. I'd stay off the roads, though.

text.Generic Orc Female: Well, it's no problem traveling from the Imperial City to Leyawiin... if you're a wizard and can walk on water. I'd stay off the roads, though.

text.Generic Orc Male: If you're all alone in the woods and you see a troll coming, you run. Problem solved. Next question?

text.Generic Orc Female: If you're all alone in the woods and you see a troll coming, you run. Problem solved. Next question?

text.Generic Orc Male: Fighting's easy. Just lead them out on the water and shoot them full of holes. If you've got a bow, of course, and can walk on water.

text.Generic Orc Female: Fighting's easy. Just lead them out on the water and shoot them full of holes. If you've got a bow, of course, and can walk on water.

text.Generic Orc Male: The Arena's faked. You think those guys are getting killed? Really? It's just berry syrup and ham-acting.

text.Generic Orc Female: The Arena's faked. You think those guys are getting killed? Really? It's just berry syrup and ham-acting.

text.Generic Orc Male: Have you ever met anyone who got rich betting on the Arena? Didn't think so.

text.Generic Orc Female: Have you ever met anyone who got rich betting on the Arena? Didn't think so.

text.Generic Orc Male: The Council runs the Arena to amuse the masses, and it pays for itself, with all the fools who lose their shirts gambling.

text.Generic Orc Female: The Council runs the Arena to amuse the masses, and it pays for itself, with all the fools who lose their shirts gambling.

text.Generic Orc Male: If you're on a road, you can usually outrun anything. If you're in good shape, and not wearing a tin suit.

text.Generic Orc Female: If you're on a road, you can usually outrun anything. If you're in good shape, and not wearing a tin suit.

text.Generic Orc Male: The lands surrounding Lake Rumare are studded with small settlements, farms, and woodland game reserves.

text.Generic Orc Female: The lands surrounding Lake Rumare are studded with small settlements, farms, and woodland game reserves.

text.Generic Orc Male: The Nibenay Basin grades from rolling farmlands by the river east to the rugged uplands of the Valus Mountains.

text.Generic Orc Female: The Nibenay Basin grades from rolling farmlands by the river east to the rugged uplands of the Valus Mountains.

text.Generic Orc Male: On Cyrodiil's northern border is the sparsely populated mountain wilderness called the Valus Mountains.

text.Generic Orc Female: On Cyrodiil's northern border is the sparsely populated mountain wilderness called the Valus Mountains.

text.Generic Orc Male: You can't be too careful out in the wilderness. Almost any creature you find is liable to give you a disease.

text.Generic Orc Female: You can't be too careful out in the wilderness. Almost any creature you find is liable to give you a disease.

text.Generic Orc Male: Watch yourself around goblins. Some of the nastier ones will toss spells at you.

text.Generic Orc Female: Watch yourself around goblins. Some of the nastier ones will toss spells at you.

text.Generic Orc Male: Imps. I hate 'em. Little buggers flitting around, tossing fireballs at you!

text.Generic Orc Female: Imps. I hate 'em. Little buggers flitting around, tossing fireballs at you!

text.Generic Orc Male: I saw a wraith once. It threw a curse on me I'll never forget.

text.Generic Orc Female: I saw a wraith once. It threw a curse on me I'll never forget.

text.Generic Orc Male: Have you seen a land dreugh? We call them "Billies." Don't know why. Steer clear of them, though.

text.Generic Orc Female: Have you seen a land dreugh? We call them "Billies." Don't know why. Steer clear of them, though.

text.Generic Orc Male: I ran across a ghost once. Seemed to suck the energy right out of me.

text.Generic Orc Female: I ran across a ghost once. Seemed to suck the energy right out of me.

text.Generic Orc Male: Watch for minotaurs in the forests. Aggressive beasts. They'll tear right through your armor, too.

text.Generic Orc Female: Watch for minotaurs in the forests. Aggressive beasts. They'll tear right through your armor, too.

text.Generic Orc Male: Mudcrabs. What's the point? Annoying buggers, though the meat isn't bad.

text.Generic Orc Female: Mudcrabs. What's the point? Annoying buggers, though the meat isn't bad.

text.Generic Orc Male: Only thing worse than an ogre is two ogres. Tough bastards, and spells seem to bounce right off of 'em.

text.Generic Orc Female: Only thing worse than an ogre is two ogres. Tough bastards, and spells seem to bounce right off of 'em.

text.Generic Orc Male: Is there anywhere in Tamriel you can avoid rats? Disease spreading little nuisances.

text.Generic Orc Female: Is there anywhere in Tamriel you can avoid rats? Disease spreading little nuisances.

text.Generic Orc Male: Best way to take out a skeleton is with a big weapon. Forget spells. Just smack them and watch the bones fly!

text.Generic Orc Female: Best way to take out a skeleton is with a big weapon. Forget spells. Just smack them and watch the bones fly!

text.Generic Orc Male: I might swim more if it weren't for the slaughterfish. Sharp teeth, and some carry disease.

text.Generic Orc Female: I might swim more if it weren't for the slaughterfish. Sharp teeth, and some carry disease.

text.Generic Orc Male: Spriggans. "Nature's guardians" my foot! Mean things. They'll curse you, or they might call a bear to tear you apart.

text.Generic Orc Female: Spriggans. "Nature's guardians" my foot! Mean things. They'll curse you, or they might call a bear to tear you apart.

text.Generic Orc Male: All that stuff about having to set trolls on fire is a bunch of hooey. They don't like fire, but a good sword will cut them up fine.

text.Generic Orc Female: All that stuff about having to set trolls on fire is a bunch of hooey. They don't like fire, but a good sword will cut them up fine.

text.Generic Orc Male: I don't even know what a will-o-the-wisp is, much less how to kill one. I think they're just swamp gas, myself.

text.Generic Orc Female: I don't even know what a will-o-the-wisp is, much less how to kill one. I think they're just swamp gas, myself.

text.Generic Orc Male: I don't like to think about zombies. Missing arms, legs, heads. They smell awful, and they're hard to kill.

text.Generic Orc Female: I don't like to think about zombies. Missing arms, legs, heads. They smell awful, and they're hard to kill.

text.Generic Orc Male: Try combining aloe vera leaves with some venison. It's said to have some restorative properties.

text.Generic Orc Female: Try combining aloe vera leaves with some venison. It's said to have some restorative properties.

text.Generic Orc Male: You can find Cairn Bolete growing in caves. They're said to mark the place someone has died.

text.Generic Orc Female: You can find Cairn Bolete growing in caves. They're said to mark the place someone has died.

text.Generic Orc Male: It's said that eating taproot can bring you good luck.

text.Generic Orc Female: It's said that eating taproot can bring you good luck.

text.Generic Orc Male: Make sure not to eat nightshade. It's very poisonous.

text.Generic Orc Female: Make sure not to eat nightshade. It's very poisonous.

text.SEDumagGraBonk: People are talking about a new adventurer who is seeking to get into the Isles. Mama warned me, "Only go where you've been invited."
The Gatekeeper is dead, you know. Now, that was a truly ugly creature. Perhaps now a handsome adventurer will come to steal me away.
Mama always said, "You catch more flies with honey than salt." Like that thing that sucks in the adventurers.
Thadon's in a much better mood lately. If he weren't so in love with the Felldew, I might invite him over to inspect my "wares" some time.
I hear something is amiss again in the House of Dementia. I wonder what it is. I love a good scandal. Don't you?
The Great Torch is lit. A romantic symbol, isn't it? I always hoped my first kiss would be in the glow of a torch.
Is the new ruler of Dementia lovely, I hope?
I can't believe Thadon is gone. He was a lovely man.
Souless Knights on the prowl, they say. Better carry a weapon with you. Wouldn't want you to get hurt.
I guess things will go back to normal now that there is a new Gatekeeper. Oh well, I was looking forward to some drama.
Those Golden Saint and Dark Seducer men are dreamy aren't they? Glad to have them back.
Where has Sheogorath gone? Mama always said, "The Prince of Madness is a basket of riddles."
Order has been defeated. I'm glad that's over. Mama always said, "The end of the world only happens once."

text.SEUshnarGroShadborgob: Someone new around? Not one of those horrible cats, I hope.
The Gatekeeper is dead? Who will keep out the cats? They'll be everywhere!
Again the Resonator pulls men to it. But cats? No! Why? It should draw them far from here!
Chalices? Who can think about chalices with the cat problem around here? Nasty beasts.
Torture in the House of Dementia? I'm constantly tortured! Cats everywhere.
I'm glad the Great Torch burns again. Cats hate fire.
Perhaps the new ruler of Dementia will do something about the cat problem.
A new ruler for Mania? Great. They don't have the same cat problems we have in Dementia.
The Fringe is under attack! Probably a cat conspiracy.
The new Gatekeeper will keep out those horrible Khajiit.
The armies of Sheogorath are renewed. Let them march now on the horrible cats! Wipe them from the Isles!
Where has Sheogorath gone? Who will save us from the cats? Won't someone think of the cats?
Order is defeated, but the cats still prey on us all.

text.SEDulphumphGroUrgash: There's someone new in the Realm. One more interloper to watch out for.

text.SEUrulGoAgamphDementia: Don't hurt me, okay? Do you want a bone? I'll tell you a secret. They say a new adventurer has come. Don't bite me!

text.SEUrulGoAgamphMania: I hear a new puppy dog has arrived on the Isles. I bet he's really cute and cuddly. Like you!

text.SEDulphumphGroUrgash: With the Gatekeeper dead, there's one less line of defense against these damnable Scalons.

text.SEUrulGoAgamphDementia: The Gatekeeper is dead. Did you kill him? You've got awfully sharp looking teeth. Don't eat me. Please!

text.SEUrulGoAgamphMania: Aren't you a cute little caterpillar! The Gatekeeper is dead. But he won't turn into a butterfly. No, he won't. Will he?

text.SEDulphumphGroUrgash: Resonator of Judgment is working again. Big deal; if it doesn't work on Scalons, doesn't do us a lick of good.

text.SEUrulGoAgamphDementia: Yikes! To bad that Resonator of Judgment doesn't get rid of troublesome beasts. I bet you could swallow me whole, couldn't you?

text.SEUrulGoAgamphMania: The Resonator is attracting again. Aren't you a cute little thing? Do you want me to scratch behind your ears?

text.SEDulphumphGroUrgash: The Chalice of Reversal is back in Thadon's hands, I hear. Wonder if it could be used as a blunt weapon.

text.SEUrulGoAgamphDementia: Did Thadon send you? Oh... I forgot he's happy again. Well, who sent you then? My word, your pinchers are huge! Stay back!

text.SEUrulGoAgamphMania: Oh, listen to you... a talking bird! How sweet. Did you know that Thadon's back to his old self? Fly away now! Be free!

text.SEDulphumphGroUrgash: Why can't they send someone here to torture the Scalons? More important than courtiers, if you ask me.

text.SEUrulGoAgamphDementia: Ugh. Not again. Whatever Syl accused me of, I'm innocent. Don't hurt me. Wow, I've never seen such a big wolf before! Scary.

text.SEUrulGoAgamphMania: A little bird told me that Syl is rounding up people again. That's silly, isn't it? Would you like some milk, little kitty? You look thirsty.

text.SEDulphumphGroUrgash: So the Great Torch has been lit again. If it doesn't kill Scalons, it doesn't mean much to me.

text.SEUrulGoAgamphDementia: Stay back! Where'd you come from? The big torch in the city? Back away, I say. Back!

text.SEUrulGoAgamphMania: Oh, what a pretty colored moth you are! Don't fly into the city. There's a big torch there. Bad news for little moths.

text.SEDulphumphGroUrgash: The lands of Dementia have a new ruler. Perhaps we'll finally take care of this Scalon problem once and for all.

text.SEUrulGoAgamphDementia: Whoa, look at the fangs on you! There's a new ruler in Crucible. Don't bite me!

text.SEUrulGoAgamphMania: Horsey! Did you hear about the new ruler in Crucible? Did you? Good horsey.

text.SEDulphumphGroUrgash: Hmmm... perhaps the new ruler of Mania will take care of the Scalons.

text.SEUrulGoAgamphDementia: Whoa, look at the fangs on you! There's a new ruler in Bliss. Don't bite me!

text.SEUrulGoAgamphMania: Horsey! Did you hear about the new ruler in Bliss? Did you? Good horsey.

text.SEDulphumphGroUrgash: The Fringe can fend for itself. We have our own problems.

text.SEUrulGoAgamphDementia: Don't eat me! You're worse than those knights in the Fringe!

text.SEUrulGoAgamphMania: Those creatures in the Fringe are scary. Not like you, you fuzzy little rascal!

text.SEDulphumphGroUrgash: They can build a new Gatekeeper, but they can't send someone to aid me in fighting these Scalons?

text.SEUrulGoAgamphDementia: You're more fearsome than the new Gatekeeper. Look at the teeth on you!

text.SEUrulGoAgamphMania: They built a new Gatekeeper! Yes they did. Yes they did. Aren't you just precious?

text.SEDulphumphGroUrgash: A whole army restored, and still these Scalons run free. Must I do everything myself?

text.SEUrulGoAgamphDementia: Leave me alone. Sheogorath's armies are coming. You better run away!

text.SEUrulGoAgamphMania: The armies are restored, you say? My, what a smart little thing you are!

text.SEDulphumphGroUrgash: Perhaps I was wrong. Maybe the Scalons aren't the worst thing that could happen to us. I mean... Sheogorath himself has vanished.

text.SEUrulGoAgamphDementia: I wish I could vanish like Sheogorath, right about now. Please don't hurt me.

text.SEUrulGoAgamphMania: Have you come to cheer me up? I'm worried about Lord Sheogorath. Are you worried, you little darling?

text.SEDulphumphGroUrgash: Fine, fine. So the Realm still stands. That doesn't mean there are any fewer Scalons in the Isles.

text.SEUrulGoAgamphDementia: It seems the world is safe again... unless you're going to eat me. You're not going to eat me, are you? Are you? Please don't!

text.SEUrulGoAgamphMania: Look at you wag your tail! You're happy Jyggalag is gone too, aren't you? Yes you are! Yes you are!

text.Generic Redguard Male: You're talking to me, and I don't like you. Goodbye.

text.Generic Redguard Female: You're talking to me, and I don't like you. Goodbye.

text.Generic Redguard Male: I see no reason to talk to you.

text.Generic Redguard Female: I see no reason to talk to you.

text.Generic Redguard Male: I don't like you and don't want to talk to you.

text.Generic Redguard Female: I don't like you and don't want to talk to you.

text.Generic Redguard Male: I'm not listening to you. It's because I don't like you.

text.Generic Redguard Female: I'm not listening to you. It's because I don't like you.

text.Generic Redguard Male: You're still speaking. Stop.

text.Generic Redguard Female: You're still speaking. Stop.

text.Cyrus: At least now we have a name to put to our enemy. Mankar Camoran and the Mythic Dawn will pay for their foul crimes.
The Mythic Dawn will never take Cloud Ruler Temple. Not while any Blade still draws breath.
The noose around Bruma is tightening. Now that the Mythic Dawn has learned Martin's location, we have to be prepared for the worst.
The Battle of Bruma was a great victory! The Mythic Dawn have learned that we are not defenseless.
Martin Septim will soon claim his rightful place at the head of the Empire, and the Blades will stand beside him.
The Emperor's death was a harsh lesson for all of us. We failed in our duty to the Dragonborn. It must not happen again.
Martin showed himself a true son of the Dragon Blood. But where does that leave us, with no Emperor to serve?
With no Emperor to serve, the Blades now return to our ancient role. We will bide our time until the next Dragonborn arises.

text.Generic Redguard Male: Everyone's talking about the assassination, of course. Here. Take my copy of the new Black Horse Courier. Go ahead. Keep it.
They say that Akatosh appeared and killed Mehrunes Dagon, right in the middle of the Temple of the One! Do you believe it?

text.Generic Redguard Female: They say that Akatosh appeared and killed Mehrunes Dagon, right in the middle of the Temple of the One! Do you believe it?

text.Owyn: Between you and me? Ysabel is completely in love with me. But I'm just not a one-woman guy. Nope, the life of the bachelor suits me just fine...
Agronak is good, yeah. Too good. He says he's only half Orc. What I want to know is, what's the other half? Cause it sure ain't human...
I heard a rumor that you're an idiot. Any truth to that?

text.Generic Redguard Male: The Fighters Guild is recruiting again. Not a bad way to make some money, if you've got the stones for it.

text.Generic Redguard Female: The Fighters Guild is recruiting again. Not a bad way to make some money, if you've got the stones for it.

text.Generic Redguard Male: Anyone looking for work should consider the Fighters Guild. I hear they're always looking for recruits.

text.Generic Redguard Female: Anyone looking for work should consider the Fighters Guild. I hear they're always looking for recruits.

text.Generic Redguard Male: I understand the Fighters Guild is hiring new members. Not bad work for some folks.

text.Generic Redguard Female: I understand the Fighters Guild is hiring new members. Not bad work for some folks.

text.TrayvondtheRedguard: Mannimarco is no more! The guild is saved, and we have a new Arch-Mage to lead us.
I don't know what it was, but something important was taken away from Mannimarco. Maybe there is a chance he can be defeated.
Traven might get us through this yet. I hear that the Necromancers were handed a significant defeat at Silorn.
The Council has turned on Traven. Things couldn't possibly get any worse for the guild.
Mannimarco himself is in Cyrodiil, hunting us down. None of us are safe!
Without the Council of Mages to guide us, how will we stand up to the King of Worms?
The Council of Mages has been dissolved. Arch-Mage Traven has been deserted. He's all we have left.
Necromancers have attacked our very homes. What could be next?
Something has gone seriously wrong at the Arcane University. I heard that a high-ranking member was killed in some sort of ambush.
The Council seems very interested in this new group of Necromancers that has sprung up. I wonder how things will play out.
Have you heard anything more about what the Council knows about these Necromancers? Something's not right.
Someone finally solved the problems with research at Vahtacen. You'd think the Council would know more about the Ayleids by now.
I've heard rumors that the Council of Mages is taking advice from outsiders. I'm not sure how I feel about that.
Arch-Mage Traven was right to ban Necromancy from the guild. Look at what they've done; they've gone and killed several of us!

text.Generic Redguard Male: I understand that Dagail is in much better control of her faculties now that Kalthar's plot has been exposed.
Kalthar tried to ruin the Leyawiin guild. Just goes to show you can't trust a Necromancer, even if he claims to be "reformed."
It sounds like there are an awful lot of problems at the Bruma guild hall. Jeanne does a poor job of running that place.
I hear a new Associate came to Teekeeus's aid recently. Something about an old enemy of his storming into town.
The roads near Anvil are safer now, thanks to Carahil and her guild hall. She's an example for us all.
Kud-Ei runs a tight ship in Bruma. She may not always play by the rules, but I wouldn't want her on my bad side.
I can't believe a Mages Guild associate was found dead in Cheydinhal. What kind of place are they running there?
Sounds like the Skingrad branch of the guild can't even keep track of its members. How appalling.
Soris Arenim sure seems upset. I think he lost something important.

text.Generic Redguard Female: Soris Arenim sure seems upset. I think he lost something important.

text.Curtis: There was some kind of fight at the Mages Guild. I heard that Falcar disappeared, as well.

text.Shelley: There was some kind of fight at the Mages Guild. I heard that Falcar disappeared, as well.

text.Generic Redguard Male: Things in the guild have been different since Traven was named Arch-Mage. They're more structured, but everyone seems tense.
Half of the Council of Mages resigned when Traven took over the position of Arch-Mage.
Arch-Mage Traven is the first to take such a hard stance on Necromancy. It upset more than a few people.
The Mages Guild runs more or less like it always did, but we lost quite a few members when the practice of Necromancy was banned.
Necromancy may be legal in Cyrodiil, but few will openly admit to practicing it now that the Mages Guild has banned it.
Some say that Traven is mis-using the power of the Arch-Mage's position to further his personal agendas.
I don't know what Arch-Mage Traven has against Necromancy, but the first thing he did after taking over the Mages Guild was to ban its practice.
Not only has Necromancy been banned from practice in the Mages Guild, but the Guild won't deal with anyone who openly uses it.
The Mages Guild has made more than a few enemies since Necromancy was banned.
I saw that Earana woman hanging around the Mages Guild again.

text.Shameer: I saw that Erthor is back in town again.

text.Tamika: I hear one of the guild mages has gone missing again.

text.Shameer: It seems quieter than usual at the Mages Guild.

text.Generic Redguard Male: I saw Earana leaving town. She looked very excited.

text.Tamika: Things at the Mages Guild seem tense. That Falcar fellow sure keeps a tight rein on things.

text.Shameer: Falcar at the Mages Guild seems to be angry all the time. I avoid him when I can.

text.Tamika: Those new fellows here in town are making me nervous. Walking around with those big weapons; I hope they leave soon.

text.Generic Redguard Male: I heard someone broke into the Mages Guild.

text.Generic Redguard Female: I heard someone broke into the Mages Guild.

text.Generic Redguard Male: If the Council really did split up, the guild is done for. This is serious.

text.Rellian: The Mages Guild seems more disorganized than usual lately.

text.Sherina: The Mages Guild seems more disorganized than usual lately.

text.Generic Redguard Male: Shrines are secret for a reason. People hate us. Ignorant fools.

text.Generic Redguard Female: We don't want more worshippers. We just want to be left alone.

text.Generic Redguard Male: They say that when you murder someone, the Dark Brotherhood comes to you in your sleep. It's how they recruit new members.

text.Generic Redguard Female: They say that when you murder someone, the Dark Brotherhood comes to you in your sleep. It's how they recruit new members.

text.Rellian: Black Brugo, chief of the Black Bow Bandits, is dead. And the Count made his killers Knights of the White Stallion.

text.Sherina: Black Brugo, chief of the Black Bow Bandits, is dead. And the Count made his killers Knights of the White Stallion.

text.Rellian: I hear the Count's got someone to sort out that business with Mazoga the so-called knight.

text.Generic Redguard Male: Have you seen Valus Odiil recently? Spends all day in the tavern since his boys left.

text.Generic Redguard Female: Have you seen Valus Odiil recently? Spends all day in the tavern since his boys left.

text.Generic Redguard Male: I saw Valus Odiil at the Grey Mare again today. Hasn't been the same since his boys took off.

text.Generic Redguard Female: I saw Valus Odiil at the Grey Mare again today. Hasn't been the same since his boys took off.

text.Generic Redguard Male: I heard that Velwyn Benirus was killed. The Manor claims another victim.

text.Generic Redguard Female: I heard that Velwyn Benirus was killed. The Manor claims another victim.

text.Generic Redguard Male: The new owner sure has turned Benirus Manor around. It's now a welcome addition to our city.

text.Generic Redguard Female: The new owner sure has turned Benirus Manor around. It's now a welcome addition to our city.

text.Generic Redguard Male: I have it on good authority that the city watch sent someone to stop that gang of women from robbing the town's men. Good show I say!

text.Generic Redguard Female: I have it on good authority that the city watch sent someone to stop that gang of women from robbing the town's men. Good show I say!

text.Generic Redguard Male: The Honorblade has been returned to the Castle after all these years! This is certainly a good omen.

text.Generic Redguard Female: The Honorblade has been returned to the Castle after all these years! This is certainly a good omen.

text.Generic Redguard Male: The Countess still seems quite sad. I hear someone tried to find the item stolen from the castle, but they had no luck. Oh well.

text.Generic Redguard Female: The Countess still seems quite sad. I hear someone tried to find the item stolen from the castle, but they had no luck. Oh well.

text.Generic Redguard Male: The Countess seems much happier now that the item that was stolen from her was returned.

text.Generic Redguard Female: The Countess seems much happier now that the item that was stolen from her was returned.

text.Generic Redguard Male: I saw Reynald Jemane's brother earlier. Can't believe they didn't even know about each other.

text.Generic Redguard Female: I saw Reynald Jemane's brother earlier. Can't believe they didn't even know about each other.

text.Generic Redguard Male: Reynald Jemane has a terrible memory. We've met many times, but when I saw him in Cheydinhal, he walked right past me like we were strangers.

text.Generic Redguard Female: Reynald Jemane has a terrible memory. We've met many times, but when I saw him in Cheydinhal, he walked right past me like we were strangers.

text.Generic Redguard Male: I was in Cheydinhal last week, and I'm sure I saw Reynald Jemane. He acted like he didn't know me, though.

text.Generic Redguard Female: I was in Cheydinhal last week, and I'm sure I saw Reynald Jemane. He acted like he didn't know me, though.

text.Generic Redguard Male: There's some strange Dark Elf in town, asking about Reynald Jemane and his brother.

text.Generic Redguard Female: There's some strange Dark Elf in town, asking about Reynald Jemane and his brother.

text.Generic Redguard Male: I can't believe that the Countess is more obsessed with that painting than the Oblivion Gate threatening the city!

text.Generic Redguard Female: I can't believe that the Countess is more obsessed with that painting than the Oblivion Gate threatening the city!

text.Generic Redguard Male: I heard that the Countess is quite upset lately. Apparently someone stole something very personal to her.

text.Generic Redguard Female: I heard that the Countess is quite upset lately. Apparently someone stole something very personal to her.

text.Generic Redguard Male: Don't know if this is true, but I heard a gang of all female thieves is preying on the married menfolk of the town.

text.Generic Redguard Female: Don't know if this is true, but I heard a gang of all female thieves is preying on the married menfolk of the town.

text.Generic Redguard Male: You hear about Gogan? A gang of thieves is running a scam in town, and he fell for it! Hahaha... what an idiot!

text.Generic Redguard Female: You hear about Gogan? A gang of thieves is running a scam in town, and he fell for it! Hahaha... what an idiot!

text.Generic Redguard Male: So, thanks to some hired help, the Jemanes recovered Weatherleah. Good thing... I never liked having ogres so close to Chorrol.

text.Generic Redguard Female: So, thanks to some hired help, the Jemanes recovered Weatherleah. Good thing... I never liked having ogres so close to Chorrol.

text.Generic Redguard Male: I swear that when I passed by Benirus Manor last night, I heard someone scream from inside. Velwyn Benirus will never sell that deathtrap!

text.Generic Redguard Female: I swear that when I passed by Benirus Manor last night, I heard someone scream from inside. Velwyn Benirus will never sell that deathtrap!

text.Generic Redguard Male: I heard that Velwyn Benirus is trying to sell off Benirus Manor. Hopefully the new owners will clean that eyesore up.

text.Generic Redguard Female: I heard that Velwyn Benirus is trying to sell off Benirus Manor. Hopefully the new owners will clean that eyesore up.

text.Generic Redguard Male: Did you hear that Dar-Ma has disappeared?

text.Generic Redguard Female: Did you hear that Dar-Ma has disappeared?

text.Generic Redguard Male: Did you hear the bad news?  Dar-Ma's daughter was killed by some strange cultists down in Hackdirt. Terrible, terrible times we live in.

text.Generic Redguard Female: Did you hear the bad news?  Dar-Ma's daughter was killed by some strange cultists down in Hackdirt. Terrible, terrible times we live in.

text.Generic Redguard Male: Did you hear that Dar-Ma came back, safe and sound?  You know, Seed-Neeus's daughter, the Argonians.

text.Generic Redguard Female: Did you hear that Dar-Ma came back, safe and sound?  You know, Seed-Neeus's daughter, the Argonians.

text.DarkPrisonGuard04: It's true what everyone's saying -- Kvatch is lost. The Daedra, they swarmed in.... The Town Guard never had a chance.
The Kvatch Oblivion Gate has been closed! Don't you understand what that means? We can beat the bastards!
The Mythic Dawn murdered the Emperor and led those damn Daedra right into the heart of the Empire! They'll pay for their treachery!
Kvatch? Kvatch was just the beginning! Those damned Gates have opened up everywhere! Cheydinhal, Chorrol, Leyawiin -- no city is safe.
If you've got to travel, by the Nine Divines, stay on the roads! The wilderness just isn't safe anymore. We've had sightings, you see. The Daedra...

text.Generic Redguard Male: The assassinations. What else is there to talk about? Perfectly planned and executed... the Blades perfectly useless... a complete disaster.

text.Generic Redguard Female: The assassinations. What else is there to talk about? Perfectly planned and executed... the Blades perfectly useless... a complete disaster.

text.Cirroc: People are subdued. Troubled. A crisis like this tests the people's faith.

text.Trevaia: People are subdued. Troubled. A crisis like this tests the people's faith.

text.Generic Redguard Female: I think we're in for some hard times. The death of Uriel Septim and his heirs changes everything.

text.Generic Redguard Male: The Emperor and his three sons, dead, right under the noses of the Imperial Guard. It's a disgrace.
Have you heard about Kvatch? They say that daedra came from Oblivion and burned the whole city to the ground!

text.Generic Redguard Female: Everyone's saying there's trouble in Kvatch. The whole town destroyed. Only a few survivors.

text.Generic Redguard Male: Do you think what happened to Kvatch could happen here?
I heard that the Kvatch Guard is driving back the daedra! Maybe there's hope after all.

text.Generic Redguard Female: I heard that the Kvatch Guard is driving back the daedra! Maybe there's hope after all.
Everybody's talking about the Hero of Kvatch! They say he actually went into an Oblivion Gate and destroyed it.

text.Generic Redguard Male: Everybody's talking about the Hero of Kvatch! They say she actually went into an Oblivion Gate and destroyed it.
Hey, you're the one they call the Hero of Kvatch, aren't you? The one that closed the Oblivion Gate and saved the city?

text.Generic Redguard Female: Hey, you're the one they call the Hero of Kvatch, aren't you? The one that closed the Oblivion Gate and saved the city?

text.Generic Redguard Male: Good news from Kvatch for a change. The last of the daedra have been driven out.

text.Generic Redguard Female: Good news from Kvatch for a change. The last of the daedra have been driven out.

text.Generic Redguard Male: Do you believe any of that talk about more Oblivion Gates opening all over the place?

text.Generic Redguard Female: I've been hearing disturbing tales about Oblivion Gates opening all across Cyrodiil. I hope it's just wild talk.

text.Generic Redguard Male: They say that Oblivion Gates have opened outside cities all across Tamriel! Gods preserve us!

text.Generic Redguard Female: With those Oblivion Gates opening everywhere, it's only a matter of time before another city goes the way of Kvatch.
Did you hear? The lost heir of Uriel Septim rallied the Guard and smashed a horde of daedra outside Bruma!

text.Generic Redguard Male: They say a lost son of Uriel Septim has reappeared in Bruma. Troops are flocking to his banner from all over Cyrodiil!
I heard that some cult called the Mythic Dawn is behind the Emperor's assassination.

text.Generic Redguard Female: They're saying some cult murdered the Emperor and are opening the Oblivion Gates. Do you think any of it's true?

text.Generic Redguard Male: Thank Akatosh the Oblivion Crisis is over! Although with no Emperor and no heir, I wonder what will happen to the Empire?
I plan to visit the Imperial City soon to pay my respects at the Temple of the One. They say the Dragon Statue is 100 feet high!

text.Generic Redguard Female: I'm sure the Elder Council will find some way to hold the Empire together. At least the Oblivion invasion is over!
I heard that some of the provinces were talking about seceding from the Empire. Probably just talk though. Everything's a bit unsettled now.

text.Generic Redguard Male: Most people consider Martin's... transformation... a religious or political event, but what interests me is its metaphysical implications.

text.Cirroc: I wish I had witnessed the avatar of divine Akatosh myself. Imagine! Upon the very altar of the Temple of the One!

text.Trevaia: I wish I had witnessed the avatar of divine Akatosh myself. Imagine! Upon the very altar of the Temple of the One!

text.Jearl: I confess, I didn't think we had a chance against the daedra. But Martin proved himself a true heir of Talos on that day.

text.Cirroc: To think that Bruma was where Martin Septim chose to reveal himself as the true heir to the throne for the first time!

text.SEKithlan: I hear that Earil is fed up with Brithaur's antics. He really wants something done about it.
Scalons carry diseases. Lots of them.

text.Generic Redguard Male: Don't run into the water to escape a Scalon. They'll follow you.

text.SEOrinthal: Have to watch for those Scalons. I hear they carry disease.
If you see a Gnarl, be careful what spells you use on them.

text.SEKithlan: I've heard that Gnarl get stronger when hit by some spells.

text.Generic Redguard Male: The Gnarl are strange creatures. Hit them with a fireball, and they get stronger, but they hate other elements even more.

text.SEOrinthal: Those Shambles are dangerous. Make sure to stand back if you kill one.

text.SEKithlan: Don't bother using a frost spell on a Shambles.

text.Generic Redguard Male: If you see a Shambles dying, stand back. They'll take you with them.

text.SEOrinthal: Flesh Atronachs are dangerous. Some are smart enough to heal themselves when they're hurt.

text.SEKithlan: Sometimes, a sharp blade is the best way to kill a Flesh Atronach.

text.Generic Redguard Male: If you have to fight a Flesh Atronach, a good shock spell is the way to go.

text.SEOrinthal: The poison of the Elytra can be debilitating.

text.SEKithlan: The Elytra have wondrous poisons that can drain the very life from you.

text.Generic Redguard Male: Watch for the Elytra's stingers; their poison can be deadly. They don't like magic much, though.

text.SEOrinthal: The Hunger is one of Lord Sheogorath's favorite pets.

text.SEKithlan: Only the Demented can truly appreciate the Hunger.

text.Generic Redguard Male: Like most lesser Daedra, the Hunger has a weakness to shock spells.

text.SEOrinthal: Some say the Grummites are the original inhabitants of the Shivering Isles.

text.SEKithlan: Who do the Grummites worship? Some say Sheogorath, but I'm not sure.

text.Generic Redguard Male: Try not to fight a Grummite in the water. Or in the rain. They seem to like that.

text.SEOrinthal: The Baliwog is a dangerous little creature. Some say they grow up to be Scalons.

text.SEKithlan: The Baliwog are known to carry Swamp Fever.

text.Generic Redguard Male: The Baliwog will return to the water to heal.

text.SEOrinthal: I've heard that Skinned Hounds don't like fire.

text.SEKithlan: Don't waste your wonderful poisons on Skinned Hounds. They seem to like them.

text.Generic Redguard Male: Best way to kill a Skinned Hound is with a fireball, or a good weapon.

text.SEOrinthal: Heretics are misguided worshippers of Arden-Sul.

text.SEKithlan: I hear the Heretics in the lands of Mania summon Hungers to fight by their sides.

text.Generic Redguard Male: If you want to get close to the Heretics, try putting on their robes.

text.SEOrinthal: The Zealots in the lands of Dementia believe they worship Arden-Sul. Poor, deluded souls.

text.SEKithlan: Zealots have dedicated themselves to the worship of Arden-Sul.

text.Generic Redguard Male: If you want to sneak up on one of those Zealots, wear one of their robes. Fools them every time.

text.SEOrinthal: I understand there's been strange activity near the obelisks around the Isles.

text.SEKithlan: Stay away from the obelisks! Strange things have appeared near them.

text.Generic Redguard Male: The crystal obelisks that dot the Isles have recently started behaving strangely.

text.SEOrinthal: Knights of Order have appeared in the Isles. I hear they come from the obelisks.

text.SEKithlan: Knights of Order have come to destroy the Realm!

text.Generic Redguard Male: I understand that the Hearts of Order you find on the Knights can be used to unlock special chests.

text.SEOrinthal: Raven-Biter runs the Choosy Beggar. Not a bad place.

text.SEKithlan: You can stay at the Choosy Beggar in Bliss, but I wouldn't.

text.SEOrinthal: Tilse Areleth has quite a collection of things for sale at Common Treasures.

text.SEKithlan: Common Treasures is full of junk. That's all Tilse Areleth collects.

text.SEOrinthal: The best armor in the city is at The Missing Pauldron.

text.SEKithlan: I'm not about to go to the Missing Pauldron, even if they do sell armor. I'll stay in Crucible, thank you.

text.SEOrinthal: Books of Bliss has quite a selection.

text.SEKithlan: Sontaire may sell a lot of books, but that's not why the men visit her.

text.SEOrinthal: Cutter sells weapons in Crucible, but you won't catch me going there.

text.SEKithlan: I'd buy my weapons at Cutter's. She has... a way with blades.

text.SEOrinthal: That Museum of Oddities is a joke, although I hear Una Armina will pay for certain items.

text.SEKithlan: You should stop by the Museum of Oddities. I understand Una is always looking for more items to display.

text.SEOrinthal: I'd research my own spells before I'd buy them from Earil's Mysteries.

text.SEKithlan: Earil's Mysteries sells a number of unique spells. Doesn't sell any mysteries, though.

text.SEOrinthal: Things Found? More like Things Found in the Trash.

text.SEKithlan: You can find some good deals at Things Found. Ahjazda has an interesting collection.

text.SEOrinthal: I wouldn't be caught dead at Sickly Bernice's... though I imagine her customers might.

text.SEKithlan: Sickly Bernice's isn't a bad place. Just make sure to wash your hands.

text.SEOrinthal: Dumag gro-Bonk at The Missing Pauldron is collecting that Amber you find in the root tunnels.

text.SEKithlan: I hear Cutter collects the Madness Ore to turn into armor.

text.Generic Redguard Male: There are smiths in New Sheoth that collect Amber and Madness Ore.

text.SEOrinthal: I've heard ghosts haunt the ruined city of Vitharn.

text.SEKithlan: Stay away from Vitharn. It's said the dead walk there.

text.Generic Redguard Male: Take care venturing into the ruined city of Vitharn.

text.SEOrinthal: I understand there's a Knight of the Thorn in Hale.

text.SEKithlan: Pyke, the Knight of the Thorn, lives in Hale.

text.Generic Redguard Male: If you visit Hale, you may see Pyke, a Knight of the Thorn.

text.SEOrinthal: The merchants in Crucible are getting tired of Brithaur stealing from them.

text.SEKithlan: Everyone is tired of Brithaur's antics.

text.Generic Redguard Male: I understand the merchants of Crucible are having problems with Brithaur.

text.SEOrinthal: I understand Hirrus Clutumnus is begging for people to kill him.

text.SEKithlan: Someone should put Hirrus Clutumnus out of his misery.

text.Generic Redguard Male: In Crucible, a man named Hirrus Clutumnus has been trying to convince people to kill him.

text.SEOrinthal: I've heard there's someone in Highcross trying to catalogue every living thing in the Isles.

text.SEKithlan: Mirili Ulven in Highcross thinks she can catalogue every creature in the Isles.

text.Generic Redguard Male: If you visit Highcross, speak with Mirili Ulven. She needs help with her project.

text.SEOrinthal: I don't visit the Museum of Oddities, but Una Armina is always looking for new items to display.

text.SEKithlan: If you find something unique, it's worth checking with Una Armina.

text.SEOrinthal: Cindanwe runs a tight ship in Fellmoor.

text.SEKithlan: The workers in Fellmoor aren't too happy with Cindanwe.

text.SEShelden: Fellmoor must be a terrible place to live.

text.SEOrinthal: Amiable Fanriene thinks his house is going to fall in on him.

text.SEKithlan: That Amiable Fanriene is afraid of his own shadow.

text.Generic Redguard Male: There's a man in Bliss who believes his own house will collapse around him.

text.SEOrinthal: Sickly Bernice is convinced she's dying. No wonder no one wants to eat at her Taphouse.

text.SEKithlan: Sickly Bernice is always looking for a miracle cure.

text.Generic Redguard Male: Sickly Bernice in Crucible believes she is dying.

text.SEOrinthal: I heard Tove the Unrestful is building something again.

text.SEKithlan: Tove the Unrestful in Bliss is collecting useless items to build something.

text.Generic Redguard Male: Tove the Unrestful in Bliss is collecting items to build something.

text.SEOrinthal: Ushnar in Crucible is afraid of cats. Cats!

text.SEKithlan: Ushnar is deathly afraid of cats. He makes sure to keep dogs around because of it.

text.Generic Redguard Male: There's an orc in Crucible who is deathly afraid of cats.

text.SEOrinthal: Ahjazda in Crucible believes the world is ending.

text.SEKithlan: Ahjazda thinks the world is ending tomorrow. She's been saving magic items just in case.

text.Generic Redguard Male: There is a Khajiit in Crucible who believes the world is about to end.

text.SEOrinthal: Poor Big Head will never find the Fork of Horripilation.

text.SEKithlan: That fool Big Head is always looking for the Fork of Horripilation.

text.Generic Redguard Male: The Argonian Big Head is always searching for the Fork of Horripilation.

text.SEOrinthal: Every resident of Split has a double living in the town.

text.SEKithlan: Every person in Split has been divided into their Manic and Demented halves.

text.Generic Redguard Male: There are two of everything in Split. Even the residents.
The Imperial Watch seems awfully worried about the Gray Fox. Look at all those wanted posters.

text.Generic Redguard Female: The Imperial Watch seems awfully worried about the Gray Fox. Look at all those wanted posters.

text.Generic Redguard Male: Captain Lex blames the Gray Fox for stealing the tax collection. He wants a bounty put on the Gray Fox, but the Legion Commander has refused.

text.Generic Redguard Female: Captain Lex blames the Gray Fox for stealing the tax collection. He wants a bounty put on the Gray Fox, but the Legion Commander has refused.

text.Generic Redguard Male: There was a murder in the Chapel. It happened when a thief was caught trying to rob Llathasa's tomb.

text.Shelley: There was a murder in the Chapel. It happened when a thief was caught trying to rob Llathasa's tomb.

text.Rellian: Did you hear? The Countess was robbed. Someone stole her family ring.

text.Sherina: Did you hear? The Countess was robbed. Someone stole her family ring.

text.Generic Redguard Male: The Gray Fox made a fool of Hieronymus Lex. While half the Watch was in the Waterfront, thieves made off with half the rest of the city.

text.Generic Redguard Female: The Gray Fox made a fool of Hieronymus Lex. While half the Watch was in the Waterfront, thieves made off with half the rest of the city.

text.Generic Redguard Male: Did you hear? Hieronymus Lex was reassigned to Anvil.

text.Generic Redguard Female: Did you hear? Hieronymus Lex was reassigned to Anvil.

text.Generic Redguard Male: Lady Umbranox has hired a new Captain of the guard.

text.Generic Redguard Female: Lady Umbranox has hired a new Captain of the guard.

text.Generic Redguard Male: Did you hear that the Earl of Imbel's house was robbed?

text.Generic Redguard Female: Did you hear that the Earl of Imbel's house was robbed?

text.Generic Redguard Male: Can you believe that a thief broke into the Imperial Palace itself!

text.Generic Redguard Female: Can you believe that a thief broke into the Imperial Palace itself!

text.Generic Redguard Male: There are rumors that there is a new Gray Fox. Nobody knows what happened to the old one.

text.Generic Redguard Female: There are rumors that there is a new Gray Fox. Nobody knows what happened to the old one.

text.Shameer: I saw Ugak gra-Mogakh earlier. At least, I think it was her. Perhaps it was her sister.

text.Tamika: I saw Ugak gra-Mogakh earlier. At least, I think it was her. Perhaps it was her sister.

text.Shameer: Ugak has some good horses to sell. I sometimes can't tell her from her sister, though.

text.Tamika: Ugak has some good horses to sell. I sometimes can't tell her from her sister, though.

text.Shameer: I need to head over to Colovian Traders and pick up a few things from Gunder. He's got a nice selection.

text.Tamika: I need to head over to Colovian Traders and pick up a few things from Gunder. He's got a nice selection.

text.Shameer: I went to the Chapel to get rid of a rash I'd picked up. Tumindil healed me right away.

text.Tamika: I went to the Chapel to get rid of a rash I'd picked up. Tumindil healed me right away.

text.Shameer: I have no idea why Valandrus Abor even serves at the chapel. He's not very good, though you'd hear differently from him.

text.Tamika: I have no idea why Valandrus Abor even serves at the chapel. He's not very good, though you'd hear differently from him.

text.Shameer: Dion takes his job as Guard Captain very seriously. He's all business when he's working.

text.Tamika: Dion takes his job as Guard Captain very seriously. He's all business when he's working.

text.Shameer: I don't like that Danus Artellian. He's a bit stuck-up for my tastes.

text.Tamika: I don't like that Danus Artellian. He's a bit stuck-up for my tastes.

text.Shameer: Parwen is another one of those goblin hunters at the Fighters Guild. She's always talking about her "goblin killing tactics."

text.Tamika: Parwen is another one of those goblin hunters at the Fighters Guild. She's always talking about her "goblin killing tactics."

text.Shameer: I saw Sulinus Vassinus at the Mages Guild conjure up some sort of creature, right there in the street. Guards took care of it.

text.Tamika: I saw Sulinus Vassinus at the Mages Guild conjure up some sort of creature, right there in the street. Guards took care of it.

text.Shameer: Erthor is causing trouble at the Mages Guild again. Seems his experiments are always blowing up.

text.Tamika: Erthor is causing trouble at the Mages Guild again. Seems his experiments are always blowing up.

text.Shameer: I've heard rumors that someone has been keeping a close eye on Toutius Sextius. Seems harmless enough.

text.Tamika: I've heard rumors that someone has been keeping a close eye on Toutius Sextius. Seems harmless enough.

text.Shameer: Reman Broder is great with a bow. I think he could shoot the grapes off the vines, which is handy, since he works at the vineyard.

text.Tamika: Reman Broder is great with a bow. I think he could shoot the grapes off the vines, which is handy, since he works at the vineyard.

text.Shameer: Uuras is a good shepherd, but his real love is cheese. Of course, there's no money in herding cheese.

text.Tamika: Uuras is a good shepherd, but his real love is cheese. Of course, there's no money in herding cheese.

text.Shameer: Davide Surilie and his brother make some fine wines. It's a really impressive vineyard.

text.Tamika: Davide Surilie and his brother make some fine wines. It's a really impressive vineyard.

text.Shameer: Old Glarthir is a bit out of his mind, I think. He's convinced everyone is out to get him.

text.Tamika: Old Glarthir is a bit out of his mind, I think. He's convinced everyone is out to get him.

text.Generic Redguard Male: If you go to the Fighting Chance, make sure to speak with Rohssan about repairing armor.

text.Generic Redguard Female: If you go to the Fighting Chance, make sure to speak with Rohssan about repairing armor.

text.Generic Redguard Male: I have friends visiting soon, so I told them to stay at the King and Queen Tavern.

text.Generic Redguard Female: I have friends visiting soon, so I told them to stay at the King and Queen Tavern.

text.Generic Redguard Male: I saw Irene Metrick recently. She jumped clear over a table at the inn.

text.Generic Redguard Female: I saw Irene Metrick recently. She jumped clear over a table at the inn.

text.Generic Redguard Male: I understand that Othrelos isn't a bad man to talk to, if you need to learn how not to be seen.

text.Generic Redguard Female: I understand that Othrelos isn't a bad man to talk to, if you need to learn how not to be seen.

text.Generic Redguard Male: If you want luxury, there's nowhere better than the Tiber Septim Hotel.

text.Generic Redguard Female: If you want luxury, there's nowhere better than the Tiber Septim Hotel.

text.Generic Redguard Male: Phintias has the best bookstore in the city. Of course, First Edition is the only bookstore in the city.

text.Generic Redguard Female: Phintias has the best bookstore in the city. Of course, First Edition is the only bookstore in the city.

text.Generic Redguard Male: Thoronir will buy almost anything. And I mean anything.

text.Generic Redguard Female: Thoronir will buy almost anything. And I mean anything.

text.Generic Redguard Male: You'll never leave the Feed Bag on an empty stomach.

text.Generic Redguard Female: You'll never leave the Feed Bag on an empty stomach.

text.Generic Redguard Male: If you need something enchanted, Calindil has the goods.

text.Generic Redguard Female: If you need something enchanted, Calindil has the goods.

text.Generic Redguard Male: The Gilded Carafe. A fine store with a terrible name.

text.Generic Redguard Female: The Gilded Carafe. A fine store with a terrible name.

text.Generic Redguard Male: If there's a complaint about a merchant, speak to Vinicia Melissaeia.

text.Generic Redguard Female: If there's a complaint about a merchant, speak to Vinicia Melissaeia.

text.Generic Redguard Male: Dervera Romalen seems pleased that so many folks drink at the Newlands lodge. She takes great pride in it.

text.Shelley: Dervera Romalen seems pleased that so many folks drink at the Newlands lodge. She takes great pride in it.

text.Generic Redguard Male: Mach-Na runs a good business. He's a grumpy old man, though.

text.Shelley: Mach-Na runs a good business. He's a grumpy old man, though.

text.Generic Redguard Male: I understand Hil the Tall will teach Alteration to anyone willing to pay.

text.Shelley: I understand Hil the Tall will teach Alteration to anyone willing to pay.

text.Generic Redguard Male: I've heard that Naspia Cosma would rather be fighting in the Arena than spending time at the castle. She's excellent with a blade.

text.Shelley: I've heard that Naspia Cosma would rather be fighting in the Arena than spending time at the castle. She's excellent with a blade.

text.Generic Redguard Male: Deetsan must be the happiest Mages Guild member in all of Tamriel. I think it was always his dream to join.

text.Shelley: Deetsan must be the happiest Mages Guild member in all of Tamriel. I think it was always his dream to join.

text.Cirroc: The Tap and Tack is a good place to get a quick bite, and Olav is a good man.

text.Jearl: The Tap and Tack is a good place to get a quick bite, and Olav is a good man.

text.Cirroc: Olfand really has his hands full with Skjorta. I don't know how he has time for business.

text.Jearl: Olfand really has his hands full with Skjorta. I don't know how he has time for business.

text.Cirroc: Apparently, Arentus Falvius at the chapel is quite a conjurer. He'll even teach the skill to those he likes.

text.Jearl: Apparently, Arentus Falvius at the chapel is quite a conjurer. He'll even teach the skill to those he likes.

text.Cirroc: I heard that J'skar at the Mages Guild is quite good at blowing things up.

text.Jearl: I heard that J'skar at the Mages Guild is quite good at blowing things up.

text.Cirroc: Jantus Brolus is apparently an excellent mage.

text.Jearl: Jantus Brolus is apparently an excellent mage.

text.Sherina: The Five Claws Lodge is a nice, clean place. Witseidutsei makes sure of it.
I've heard Tun-Zeeus has some fine blades at the Dividing Line. Of course, he'll talk your ear off about them if you let him.

text.Generic Redguard Male: I like eating at the Flowing Bowl. Maenlorn runs a quality inn.

text.Generic Redguard Female: I like eating at the Flowing Bowl. Maenlorn runs a quality inn.

text.Generic Redguard Male: Azzan at the Fighters Guild is a fine warrior. I understand he can sign you up, if you're interested.

text.Generic Redguard Female: Azzan at the Fighters Guild is a fine warrior. I understand he can sign you up, if you're interested.

text.Generic Redguard Male: I saw Rufrius Vinicius knock a man down with one punch. I wish he'd teach me a bit about hand-to-hand combat.

text.Generic Redguard Female: I saw Rufrius Vinicius knock a man down with one punch. I wish he'd teach me a bit about hand-to-hand combat.

text.Generic Redguard Male: I've heard Carahil is a powerful illusionist. No wonder she's the ranking mage here in Anvil.

text.Generic Redguard Female: I've heard Carahil is a powerful illusionist. No wonder she's the ranking mage here in Anvil.

text.Generic Redguard Male: March Gulitte is a dangerous one. He teaches mages about the Destruction school of magic.

text.Generic Redguard Female: March Gulitte is a dangerous one. He teaches mages about the Destruction school of magic.

text.Generic Redguard Male: Heinrich Oaken-Hull is married to a Bosmer? I suppose the women are less annoying than the men.

text.Generic Redguard Female: Heinrich Oaken-Hull is married to a Bosmer? I suppose the women are less annoying than the men.

text.Generic Redguard Male: Something about Arvena Thelas is a bit odd. I've heard she keeps strange things in her basement.

text.Generic Redguard Female: Something about Arvena Thelas is a bit odd. I've heard she keeps strange things in her basement.

text.TESTRedguard: I enjoy being in the Fighters Guild, though there haven't been quite as many contracts lately.

text.Generic Redguard Male: I sure am glad I don't live in Leyawiin. Too many foreigners.

text.Generic Redguard Female: I sure am glad I don't live in Leyawiin. Too many foreigners.

text.Generic Redguard Male: I'm going over to Northern Goods and Trade. There's always something I need at that place.

text.Generic Redguard Female: I'm going over to Northern Goods and Trade. There's always something I need at that place.

text.Generic Redguard Male: Northern Goods and Trade is an excellent place to buy supplies.

text.Generic Redguard Female: Northern Goods and Trade is an excellent place to buy supplies.

text.Generic Redguard Male: I wanted to get a little practice in with my sword, so I headed to the Fighters Guild. Turns out you have to be a member to train there.

text.Generic Redguard Female: I wanted to get a little practice in with my sword, so I headed to the Fighters Guild. Turns out you have to be a member to train there.

text.Generic Redguard Male: Eugal Belette is an odd one... and I swear I heard strange noises coming from his basement not long ago.

text.Generic Redguard Female: Eugal Belette is an odd one... and I swear I heard strange noises coming from his basement not long ago.

text.Generic Redguard Male: I'm sure you've heard that Glistel and Malintus Ancrus are living together. Simply shameful.

text.Generic Redguard Female: I'm sure you've heard that Glistel and Malintus Ancrus are living together. Simply shameful.

text.Generic Redguard Male: Ah, Chorrol. Easy access to all the other cities of Cyrodiil.

text.Generic Redguard Female: Ah, Chorrol. Easy access to all the other cities of Cyrodiil.

text.Generic Redguard Male: Don't know why anyone would visit the other cities of Cyrodill. Chorrol has it all. And a fairly low murder rate!

text.Generic Redguard Female: Don't know why anyone would visit the other cities of Cyrodill. Chorrol has it all. And a fairly low murder rate!

text.Generic Redguard Male: I understand the Fighters Guild is looking for new members. Seems a bit odd, but that's what I hear.

text.Generic Redguard Female: I understand the Fighters Guild is looking for new members. Seems a bit odd, but that's what I hear.

text.Generic Redguard Male: Ancient Wayshrines of the Nine are scattered through the wilderness. The righteous who pray there receive powerful divine blessings.

text.Generic Redguard Female: Ancient Wayshrines of the Nine are scattered through the wilderness. The righteous who pray there receive powerful divine blessings.

text.Generic Redguard Male: If you've done good deeds, the Nine will bless you and cure diseases when you visit their wayshrines.

text.Generic Redguard Female: If you've done good deeds, the Nine will bless you and cure diseases when you visit their wayshrines.

text.Generic Redguard Male: Wayshrines of the Nine in the wilderness confer blessings on the righteous and faithful.

text.Generic Redguard Female: Wayshrines of the Nine in the wilderness confer blessings on the righteous and faithful.

text.Generic Redguard Male: Those famous for good deeds may receive Blessings of Intelligence and Magicka when they visit Wayshrines of Julianos.

text.Generic Redguard Female: Those famous for good deeds may receive Blessings of Intelligence and Magicka when they visit Wayshrines of Julianos.

text.Generic Redguard Male: Virtuous visitors to Wayshrines of Kynareth may receive Blessings of Agility.

text.Generic Redguard Female: Virtuous visitors to Wayshrines of Kynareth may receive Blessings of Agility.

text.Generic Redguard Male: When you visit a Wayshrine of Zenithar, and you've lived a good life by the Nine, you may receive a Blessing of Luck.

text.Generic Redguard Female: When you visit a Wayshrine of Zenithar, and you've lived a good life by the Nine, you may receive a Blessing of Luck.

text.Generic Redguard Male: Those who live by the Commands of the Nine receive Blessings of Strength when they visit Wayshrines of Tiber Septim.

text.Generic Redguard Female: Those who live by the Commands of the Nine receive Blessings of Strength when they visit Wayshrines of Tiber Septim.

text.Generic Redguard Male: A good man who honors the Nine may visit the Wayshrines of Akatosh for Blessings of Speed and Magicka.

text.Generic Redguard Female: A good man who honors the Nine may visit the Wayshrines of Akatosh for Blessings of Speed and Magicka.

text.Generic Redguard Male: If you've been good, Wayshrines of Dibella may bless your Personality.

text.Generic Redguard Female: If you've been good, Wayshrines of Dibella may bless your Personality.

text.Generic Redguard Male: Wayshrines of Arkay confer Blessings of Health on those who've pleased the Nine by righteous acts.

text.Generic Redguard Female: Wayshrines of Arkay confer Blessings of Health on those who've pleased the Nine by righteous acts.

text.Generic Redguard Male: Please the Nine with good works, and visit Wayshrines of Stendarr for Blessings of Endurance.

text.Generic Redguard Female: Please the Nine with good works, and visit Wayshrines of Stendarr for Blessings of Endurance.

text.Generic Redguard Male: You've seen wayshrines in the wilderness? Those who've pleased the Nine may receive Blessings of Willpower at the Wayshrines of Mara.

text.Generic Redguard Female: You've seen wayshrines in the wilderness? Those who've pleased the Nine may receive Blessings of Willpower at the Wayshrines of Mara.

text.Generic Redguard Male: The Heartlands and Nibenean Valley are the agricultural breadbaskets of Cyrodiil.

text.Generic Redguard Female: The Heartlands and Nibenean Valley are the agricultural breadbaskets of Cyrodiil.

text.Generic Redguard Male: Where does our food come from? The Heartlands. And the Nibenean Valley. And Skingrad? Great wines, cheeses, and tomatoes.

text.Generic Redguard Female: Where does our food come from? The Heartlands. And the Nibenean Valley. And Skingrad? Great wines, cheeses, and tomatoes.

text.Generic Redguard Male: The lowlands of the Great Forest rise to the upland plateau of the Colovian West.

text.Generic Redguard Female: The lowlands of the Great Forest rise to the upland plateau of the Colovian West.

text.Generic Redguard Male: The Great Forest was cleared for agriculture around Lake Rumare, but it's mostly wilderness outside of that.

text.Generic Redguard Female: The Great Forest was cleared for agriculture around Lake Rumare, but it's mostly wilderness outside of that.

text.Generic Redguard Male: The Colovian Highlands are barren wastelands along the border with Hammerfell.

text.Generic Redguard Female: The Colovian Highlands are barren wastelands along the border with Hammerfell.

text.Generic Redguard Male: The Colovian Highlands? Near the Hammerfell border? No one lives there. That's barren wastelands.

text.Generic Redguard Female: The Colovian Highlands? Near the Hammerfell border? No one lives there. That's barren wastelands.

text.Generic Redguard Male: High mountain ranges rise to the borders in the north and east, and marshes and rainforests extend to the southeast borders.

text.Generic Redguard Female: High mountain ranges rise to the borders in the north and east, and marshes and rainforests extend to the southeast borders.

text.Generic Redguard Male: It's our natural barriers that keep us safe, mostly. Mountain borders north and east, open sea to the west, and bogs and rainforest to south.

text.Generic Redguard Female: It's our natural barriers that keep us safe, mostly. Mountain borders north and east, open sea to the west, and bogs and rainforest to south.

text.Generic Redguard Male: Cyrodiil is surrounded to the north and east by the lofty Jerall and Valus mountain ranges.

text.Generic Redguard Female: Cyrodiil is surrounded to the north and east by the lofty Jerall and Valus mountain ranges.

text.Generic Redguard Male: No one wants to live in the Jerall Mountains. Well, maybe in Bruma, but they're like Nords. They don't feel the cold.

text.Generic Redguard Female: No one wants to live in the Jerall Mountains. Well, maybe in Bruma, but they're like Nords. They don't feel the cold.

text.Generic Redguard Male: Western Cyrodiil is called 'Colovia,' and includes the Gold Coast, West Weald, and Colovian Highlands regions.

text.Generic Redguard Female: Western Cyrodiil is called 'Colovia,' and includes the Gold Coast, West Weald, and Colovian Highlands regions.

text.Generic Redguard Male: In the west, in Old Colovia, that's where men are men. That's the Gold Coast, West Weald, and Colovian Highlands.

text.Generic Redguard Female: In the west, in Old Colovia, that's where men are men. That's the Gold Coast, West Weald, and Colovian Highlands.

text.Generic Redguard Male: Nibenay is a region of mixed farmland, parkland, and forest.

text.Generic Redguard Female: Nibenay is a region of mixed farmland, parkland, and forest.

text.Generic Redguard Male: With all the farms in Nibenay, there's still plenty of forest and wilderness open for settlement.

text.Generic Redguard Female: With all the farms in Nibenay, there's still plenty of forest and wilderness open for settlement.

text.Generic Redguard Male: Nibenay is bordered on north and east by rugged mountains and to the south by marshes and rainforest.

text.Generic Redguard Female: Nibenay is bordered on north and east by rugged mountains and to the south by marshes and rainforest.

text.Generic Redguard Male: The people of Nibenay consider themselves to be more civilized and sophisticated than Colovians.

text.Generic Redguard Female: The people of Nibenay consider themselves to be more civilized and sophisticated than Colovians.

text.Generic Redguard Male: I'm not saying Colovians are dumb. They're just hard-headed.

text.Generic Redguard Female: I'm not saying Colovians are dumb. They're just hard-headed.

text.Generic Redguard Male: The Nibeneans think they're slick. 'Slippery' is more like it.

text.Generic Redguard Female: The Nibeneans think they're slick. 'Slippery' is more like it.

text.Generic Redguard Male: Colovia is a land of rugged wastes and highland forests.

text.Generic Redguard Female: Colovia is a land of rugged wastes and highland forests.

text.Generic Redguard Male: Colovia is dotted with isolated farms and settlements, with most of the population in the coastal margin.

text.Generic Redguard Female: Colovia is dotted with isolated farms and settlements, with most of the population in the coastal margin.

text.Generic Redguard Male: The Colovians are proud of their reputation for being independent, rough, and rebellious.

text.Generic Redguard Female: The Colovians are proud of their reputation for being independent, rough, and rebellious.

text.Generic Redguard Male: The Imperial City is located on a large island surrounded by Lake Rumare.

text.Generic Redguard Female: The Imperial City is located on a large island surrounded by Lake Rumare.

text.Generic Redguard Male: The Imperial City is densely urbanized, with a few large parks and waterside dock areas.

text.Generic Redguard Female: The Imperial City is densely urbanized, with a few large parks and waterside dock areas.

text.Generic Redguard Male: The Imperial City itself is a walled city, with separate inner walls protecting the Imperial palace.

text.Generic Redguard Female: The Imperial City itself is a walled city, with separate inner walls protecting the Imperial palace.

text.Generic Redguard Male: The prettiest town in Cyrodiil? Don't know, but the ugliest is Bravil. Shabby, tumbledown shacks. They're big shacks, though.

text.Generic Redguard Female: The prettiest town in Cyrodiil? Don't know, but the ugliest is Bravil. Shabby, tumbledown shacks. They're big shacks, though.

text.Generic Redguard Male: Where to buy weapons? Where to buy anything, if you can afford to travel, is the Market District in the Imperial City.

text.Generic Redguard Female: Where to buy weapons? Where to buy anything, if you can afford to travel, is the Market District in the Imperial City.

text.Generic Redguard Male: My favorite town? Anvil. Lovely old stone buildings, and the harbor at sunset is beautiful.

text.Generic Redguard Female: My favorite town? Anvil. Lovely old stone buildings, and the harbor at sunset is beautiful.

text.Generic Redguard Male: Ayleid ruins? The big thing is to watch out for the traps. Thousands of years old, and still working. Amazing.

text.Generic Redguard Female: Ayleid ruins? The big thing is to watch out for the traps. Thousands of years old, and still working. Amazing.

text.Generic Redguard Male: I've seen plenty of Ayleid ruins. You'd think they'd be picked clean after 2000 years, but, no, there's still great treasures there.

text.Generic Redguard Female: I've seen plenty of Ayleid ruins. You'd think they'd be picked clean after 2000 years, but, no, there's still great treasures there.

text.Generic Redguard Male: It's still pretty wild east of the Niben. Few people, except for bandits, but at least it hasn't been picked clean by treasure-hunters.

text.Generic Redguard Female: It's still pretty wild east of the Niben. Few people, except for bandits, but at least it hasn't been picked clean by treasure-hunters.

text.Generic Redguard Male: Nobody goes into the mountains but hunters and thieves on the lam. Food and shelter is hard to come by.

text.Generic Redguard Female: Nobody goes into the mountains but hunters and thieves on the lam. Food and shelter is hard to come by.

text.Generic Redguard Male: Blackwood isn't so bad, once you get used to the flies. And being lost all the time. And the zombies and will-o-the-wisps.

text.Generic Redguard Female: Blackwood isn't so bad, once you get used to the flies. And being lost all the time. And the zombies and will-o-the-wisps.

text.Generic Redguard Male: There's islands in Niben Bay no one has visited in a hundred years. No telling what you'll find.

text.Generic Redguard Female: There's islands in Niben Bay no one has visited in a hundred years. No telling what you'll find.

text.Generic Redguard Male: Well, it's no problem traveling from the Imperial City to Leyawiin... if you're a wizard and can walk on water. I'd stay off the roads, though.

text.Generic Redguard Female: Well, it's no problem traveling from the Imperial City to Leyawiin... if you're a wizard and can walk on water. I'd stay off the roads, though.

text.Generic Redguard Male: If you're all alone in the woods and you see a troll coming, you run. Problem solved. Next question?

text.Generic Redguard Female: If you're all alone in the woods and you see a troll coming, you run. Problem solved. Next question?

text.Generic Redguard Male: Fighting's easy. Just lead them out on the water and shoot them full of holes. If you've got a bow, of course, and can walk on water.

text.Generic Redguard Female: Fighting's easy. Just lead them out on the water and shoot them full of holes. If you've got a bow, of course, and can walk on water.

text.Generic Redguard Male: The Arena's faked. You think those guys are getting killed? Really? It's just berry syrup and ham-acting.

text.Generic Redguard Female: The Arena's faked. You think those guys are getting killed? Really? It's just berry syrup and ham-acting.

text.Generic Redguard Male: Have you ever met anyone who got rich betting on the Arena? Didn't think so.

text.Generic Redguard Female: Have you ever met anyone who got rich betting on the Arena? Didn't think so.

text.Generic Redguard Male: The Council runs the Arena to amuse the masses, and it pays for itself, with all the fools who lose their shirts gambling.

text.Generic Redguard Female: The Council runs the Arena to amuse the masses, and it pays for itself, with all the fools who lose their shirts gambling.

text.Generic Redguard Male: If you're on a road, you can usually outrun anything. If you're in good shape, and not wearing a tin suit.

text.Generic Redguard Female: If you're on a road, you can usually outrun anything. If you're in good shape, and not wearing a tin suit.

text.Generic Redguard Male: Orcs don't ride horses. They eat horses. And sometimes I think they're the smart ones. Wait, maybe it's Dunmer who eat horses.

text.Generic Redguard Female: Orcs don't ride horses. They eat horses. And sometimes I think they're the smart ones. Wait, maybe it's Dunmer who eat horses.

text.Generic Redguard Male: Take Cheydinhal, for example. Pretty little town. But the Count's a Dark Elf, and it's crawling with Orc thugs and gangsters.

text.Generic Redguard Female: Take Cheydinhal, for example. Pretty little town. But the Count's a Dark Elf, and it's crawling with Orc thugs and gangsters.

text.Generic Redguard Male: The lands surrounding Lake Rumare are studded with small settlements, farms, and woodland game reserves.

text.Generic Redguard Female: The lands surrounding Lake Rumare are studded with small settlements, farms, and woodland game reserves.

text.Generic Redguard Male: The Nibenay Basin grades from rolling farmlands by the river east to the rugged uplands of the Valus Mountains.

text.Generic Redguard Female: The Nibenay Basin grades from rolling farmlands by the river east to the rugged uplands of the Valus Mountains.

text.Generic Redguard Male: On Cyrodiil's northern border is the sparsely populated mountain wilderness called the Valus Mountains.

text.Generic Redguard Female: On Cyrodiil's northern border is the sparsely populated mountain wilderness called the Valus Mountains.

text.Generic Redguard Male: You can't be too careful out in the wilderness. Almost any creature you find is liable to give you a disease.

text.Generic Redguard Female: You can't be too careful out in the wilderness. Almost any creature you find is liable to give you a disease.

text.Generic Redguard Male: Watch yourself around goblins. Some of the nastier ones will toss spells at you.

text.Generic Redguard Female: Watch yourself around goblins. Some of the nastier ones will toss spells at you.
