text.Generic Redguard Male: Imps. I hate 'em. Little buggers flitting around, tossing fireballs at you!

text.Generic Redguard Female: Imps. I hate 'em. Little buggers flitting around, tossing fireballs at you!

text.Generic Redguard Male: I saw a wraith once. It threw a curse on me I'll never forget.

text.Generic Redguard Female: I saw a wraith once. It threw a curse on me I'll never forget.

text.Generic Redguard Male: Have you seen a land dreugh? We call them "Billies." Don't know why. Steer clear of them, though.

text.Generic Redguard Female: Have you seen a land dreugh? We call them "Billies." Don't know why. Steer clear of them, though.

text.Generic Redguard Male: I ran across a ghost once. Seemed to suck the energy right out of me.

text.Generic Redguard Female: I ran across a ghost once. Seemed to suck the energy right out of me.

text.Generic Redguard Male: Watch for minotaurs in the forests. Aggressive beasts. They'll tear right through your armor, too.

text.Generic Redguard Female: Watch for minotaurs in the forests. Aggressive beasts. They'll tear right through your armor, too.

text.Generic Redguard Male: Mudcrabs. What's the point? Annoying buggers, though the meat isn't bad.

text.Generic Redguard Female: Mudcrabs. What's the point? Annoying buggers, though the meat isn't bad.

text.Generic Redguard Male: Only thing worse than an ogre is two ogres. Tough bastards, and spells seem to bounce right off of 'em.

text.Generic Redguard Female: Only thing worse than an ogre is two ogres. Tough bastards, and spells seem to bounce right off of 'em.

text.Generic Redguard Male: Is there anywhere in Tamriel you can avoid rats? Disease spreading little nuisances.

text.Generic Redguard Female: Is there anywhere in Tamriel you can avoid rats? Disease spreading little nuisances.

text.Generic Redguard Male: Best way to take out a skeleton is with a big weapon. Forget spells. Just smack them and watch the bones fly!

text.Generic Redguard Female: Best way to take out a skeleton is with a big weapon. Forget spells. Just smack them and watch the bones fly!

text.Generic Redguard Male: I might swim more if it weren't for the slaughterfish. Sharp teeth, and some carry disease.

text.Generic Redguard Female: I might swim more if it weren't for the slaughterfish. Sharp teeth, and some carry disease.

text.Generic Redguard Male: Spriggans. "Nature's guardians" my foot! Mean things. They'll curse you, or they might call a bear to tear you apart.

text.Generic Redguard Female: Spriggans. "Nature's guardians" my foot! Mean things. They'll curse you, or they might call a bear to tear you apart.

text.Generic Redguard Male: All that stuff about having to set trolls on fire is a bunch of hooey. They don't like fire, but a good sword will cut them up fine.

text.Generic Redguard Female: All that stuff about having to set trolls on fire is a bunch of hooey. They don't like fire, but a good sword will cut them up fine.

text.Generic Redguard Male: I don't even know what a will-o-the-wisp is, much less how to kill one. I think they're just swamp gas, myself.

text.Generic Redguard Female: I don't even know what a will-o-the-wisp is, much less how to kill one. I think they're just swamp gas, myself.

text.Generic Redguard Male: I don't like to think about zombies. Missing arms, legs, heads. They smell awful, and they're hard to kill.

text.Generic Redguard Female: I don't like to think about zombies. Missing arms, legs, heads. They smell awful, and they're hard to kill.

text.Generic Redguard Male: Try combining aloe vera leaves with some venison. It's said to have some restorative properties.

text.Generic Redguard Female: Try combining aloe vera leaves with some venison. It's said to have some restorative properties.

text.Generic Redguard Male: You can find Cairn Bolete growing in caves. They're said to mark the place someone has died.

text.Generic Redguard Female: You can find Cairn Bolete growing in caves. They're said to mark the place someone has died.

text.Generic Redguard Male: It's said that eating taproot can bring you good luck.

text.Generic Redguard Female: It's said that eating taproot can bring you good luck.

text.Generic Redguard Male: Make sure not to eat nightshade. It's very poisonous.

text.Generic Redguard Female: Make sure not to eat nightshade. It's very poisonous.

text.SEOrinthal: Another adventurer is trying to get into the Shivering Isles. If it's a Breton, it'll be the first one in 3.7 years.
Did you know that the Gatekeeper had only a three percent chance of failing? Most interesting that he was defeated.
I can't help but wonder what the percentage chance of the Resonator attracting a particular individual is. Riveting stuff, really.
With his Chalice returned, Thadon seems to smile at least four times as often. That's just an estimation, of course.
It takes an average of three attempts to inflict pain before someone will give up useful information, you know.
The Great Torch burns at a temperature 13 times hotter than the average fire.
There was a 21 percent chance that Dementia would get a new ruler.
There was only a 16 percent chance Thadon's heart would explode.
I heard the Fringe was attacked. I don't yet know exactly how many were lost, but I'll have to find out.
I understand there's a new Gatekeeper. Rebuilt much faster this time around, unless I'm mistaken. And I never am.
Good to see the armies back. Did you know that the average Saint is exactly six feet tall?
I'm rather curious about this disappearance of Sheogorath's. Is he incorporeal, invisible, or has he moved to another plane?
I lost track of the number of times I looked at the sky, waiting for the world to end.

text.SEKithlan: The last thing the Realm needs is one more vagabond sneaking in.
The Gatekeeper is dead. One more sign that the Realm is being run into the ground. This never should've happened.
The Resonator was my idea, you know. People never remember that, but it was. I'm glad it's working again.
Thadon has one less excuse for his sloppy rule over Bliss, now that he has his Chalice again.
This is preposterous. Were I in charge, the culprits would've been found and executed immediately.
The Great Torch burning again is a sign that things aren't completely hopeless. Means someone is doing something right.
I no longer serve Lady Syl. Crucible has a new ruler.
Thadon is dead. Bliss will be even more of a mess than before.
I helped save the Fringe, you know. Not directly, really, but it was ultimately thanks to me.
Rebuilding the Gatekeeper is one of the few things that has gone right lately.
I'm not saying I couldn't do a better job, but at least someone is in charge who can get things done.
I can say without hesitation that none of this is my fault. Could've told you it was coming, though.
You know, of course, that the Realm would still be in jeopardy were it not for me.

text.SERelan: Newcomers mean new pests. New pests mean more blood! More blood means a very busy Relan....

text.SEShelden: I'd like to see this new adventurer try to make it past the Gatekeeper.

text.SERelan: Mighty warrior, the fallen Gatekeeper. Relan wonders if he would be able to do the same.

text.SEShelden: The Gatekeeper was killed. Nobody asked me if I thought that was a good idea. Well, I do.

text.SERelan: People are talking about a Resonator. Unless it makes more pests to kill, Relan does not care.

text.SEShelden: Adventurers are being sucked up by that Xedilian place again.

text.SERelan: Relan hears of this Reversal Chalice. It makes blood special, yes? Relan would like special blood.

text.SEShelden: Thadon has his Chalice back. Doesn't he know a good leader doesn't need any of that? Just his native intelligence. I would know.

text.SERelan: Relan hears of Syl's torture. Relan likes what he hears. Syl is good.

text.SEShelden: Syl's really suspicious of other people. I bet she's the one with something to hide.

text.SERelan: Relan understands the Great Torch burns again. Relan thinks this is a good sign.

text.SEShelden: Some fool lit himself on fire in the city.

text.SERelan: Relan hears there's a new ruler in Crucible. Relan finds this interesting.

text.SEShelden: I bet I'd make a better Duke than the new one.

text.SERelan: Relan hears there's a new ruler in Bliss. Relan finds this interesting.

text.SEShelden: I bet I'd make a better Duke than the new one.

text.SERelan: Visit Passwall once, Relan did. Good that it burned. People there deserve pain.

text.SEShelden: Those Knights of Order are always causing trouble. Don't worry, though. I'll figure out what to do.

text.SERelan: Relan is jealous of the Gatekeeper. Relan wishes that he had swords for arms.

text.SEShelden: The rebuilt the Gatekeeper. I thought they should have done that a long time ago.

text.SERelan: Armies? Pah! Armies are worthless. Killing is best by one man alone. In the dark. Sneak. Sneak. Then blood.

text.SEShelden: The armies are back together now, I hear. I'd never have let them get lost in the first place.

text.SERelan: The Madgod is gone. Can he die?

text.SEShelden: Sheogorath leaves in the middle of the Greymarch. Perhaps I should take over ruling the Realm.

text.SERelan: Much blood has come and gone. Relan is sad. Relan was stuck in Fellmoor for all the war... no blood... no war... poor Relan.

text.SEShelden: Jyggalag's defeated. Took them long enough to get rid of him.

text.Generic WoodElf Male: You're talking to me, and I don't like you. Goodbye.

text.Generic WoodElf Female: You're talking to me, and I don't like you. Goodbye.

text.Generic WoodElf Male: I see no reason to talk to you.

text.Generic WoodElf Female: I see no reason to talk to you.

text.Generic WoodElf Male: I don't like you and don't want to talk to you.

text.Generic WoodElf Female: I don't like you and don't want to talk to you.

text.Generic WoodElf Male: I'm not listening to you. It's because I don't like you.

text.Generic WoodElf Female: I'm not listening to you. It's because I don't like you.

text.Generic WoodElf Male: You're still speaking. Stop.

text.Generic WoodElf Female: You're still speaking. Stop.

text.Foroch: Everyone's talking about the assassination, of course. Here. Take my copy of the new Black Horse Courier. Go ahead. Keep it.

text.Generic WoodElf Female: Everyone's talking about the assassination, of course. Here. Take my copy of the new Black Horse Courier. Go ahead. Keep it.

text.Generic WoodElf Male: Everyone wants to know what really happened in the Temple. What happened to Martin? Was the fiery dragon really Akatosh?

text.Generic WoodElf Female: Everyone wants to know what really happened in the Temple. What happened to Martin? Was the fiery dragon really Akatosh?

text.Generic WoodElf Male: The Fighters Guild is recruiting again. Not a bad way to make some money, if you've got the stones for it.

text.Generic WoodElf Female: The Fighters Guild is recruiting again. Not a bad way to make some money, if you've got the stones for it.

text.Generic WoodElf Male: Anyone looking for work should consider the Fighters Guild. I hear they're always looking for recruits.

text.Generic WoodElf Female: Anyone looking for work should consider the Fighters Guild. I hear they're always looking for recruits.

text.Generic WoodElf Male: I understand the Fighters Guild is hiring new members. Not bad work for some folks.

text.Generic WoodElf Female: I understand the Fighters Guild is hiring new members. Not bad work for some folks.

text.Generic WoodElf Male: Mannimarco is no more! The guild is saved, and we have a new Arch-Mage to lead us.

text.Generic WoodElf Female: I can't believe Arch-Mage Traven sacrificed himself to save us all. How noble of him.

text.Generic WoodElf Male: I don't know what it was, but something important was taken away from Mannimarco. Maybe there is a chance he can be defeated.
Traven might get us through this yet. I hear that the Necromancers were handed a significant defeat at Silorn.
The Council has turned on Traven. Things couldn't possibly get any worse for the guild.
Mannimarco himself is in Cyrodiil, hunting us down. None of us are safe!
Without the Council of Mages to guide us, how will we stand up to the King of Worms?
The Council of Mages has been dissolved. Arch-Mage Traven has been deserted. He's all we have left.
Necromancers have attacked our very homes. What could be next?

text.Generic WoodElf Female: The Bruma guild hall has been decimated. Our hall could be next!
I've heard rumors about the Council of Mages consorting with outside sources. Why are outsiders interfering with our guild?
The Council of Mages has this Necromancer situation under control. They must, or else we'd know about it, right?

text.Generic WoodElf Male: Something has gone seriously wrong at the Arcane University. I heard that a high-ranking member was killed in some sort of ambush.

text.Generic WoodElf Female: I think the rumors about Necromancers are completely untrue. I've heard some crazy things, and I don't believe any of them.

text.Generic WoodElf Male: The Council seems very interested in this new group of Necromancers that has sprung up. I wonder how things will play out.
Have you heard anything more about what the Council knows about these Necromancers? Something's not right.

text.Generic WoodElf Female: It's good to know that valuable research is still going on, even though things seem to be a bit more tense lately.

text.Generic WoodElf Male: Someone finally solved the problems with research at Vahtacen. You'd think the Council would know more about the Ayleids by now.

text.Generic WoodElf Female: It sounds like the Council of Mages has been holding extra meetings recently. I'm not sure what that means.

text.Generic WoodElf Male: I've heard rumors that the Council of Mages is taking advice from outsiders. I'm not sure how I feel about that.
Arch-Mage Traven was right to ban Necromancy from the guild. Look at what they've done; they've gone and killed several of us!

text.Generic WoodElf Female: The Mages Guild has been attacked by Necromancers. This proves they can't be trusted!

text.Generic WoodElf Male: I understand that Dagail is in much better control of her faculties now that Kalthar's plot has been exposed.
Kalthar tried to ruin the Leyawiin guild. Just goes to show you can't trust a Necromancer, even if he claims to be "reformed."

text.Generic WoodElf Female: Did you hear that someone played yet another prank on Jeanne Frasoric in Bruma? I don't know how she keeps falling for these things.

text.Generic WoodElf Male: It sounds like there are an awful lot of problems at the Bruma guild hall. Jeanne does a poor job of running that place.

text.Generic WoodElf Female: The Chorrol guild hall had an unpleasant visit recently, from someone who had a grudge against Teekeeus.

text.Generic WoodElf Male: I hear a new Associate came to Teekeeus's aid recently. Something about an old enemy of his storming into town.
The roads near Anvil are safer now, thanks to Carahil and her guild hall. She's an example for us all.

text.Generic WoodElf Female: The Anvil guild has made quite a name for itself under Carahil. Did you hear about the recent murderer they caught?
Kud-Ei will do anything to help her girls out. She recently got Ardaline out of a bind, and I hear it wasn't completely within guild rules.

text.Generic WoodElf Male: Kud-Ei runs a tight ship in Bruma. She may not always play by the rules, but I wouldn't want her on my bad side.
I can't believe a Mages Guild associate was found dead in Cheydinhal. What kind of place are they running there?

text.Generic WoodElf Female: Did you hear that Falcar left the guild? I think Deetsan is in charge in Cheydinhal now.
I heard that one of the Skingrad mages was assaulted, but I don't know the details.

text.Generic WoodElf Male: Sounds like the Skingrad branch of the guild can't even keep track of its members. How appalling.
I heard that Soris Arenim made himself quite a bit of money recently. He seems very happy about it.

text.Generic WoodElf Female: I heard that Soris Arenim made himself quite a bit of money recently. He seems very happy about it.

text.Generic WoodElf Male: Things in the guild have been different since Traven was named Arch-Mage. They're more structured, but everyone seems tense.

text.Generic WoodElf Female: Things in the guild have been different since Traven was named Arch-Mage. They're more structured, but everyone seems tense.

text.Generic WoodElf Male: Half of the Council of Mages resigned when Traven took over the position of Arch-Mage.

text.Generic WoodElf Female: Half of the Council of Mages resigned when Traven took over the position of Arch-Mage.

text.Generic WoodElf Male: Arch-Mage Traven is the first to take such a hard stance on Necromancy. It upset more than a few people.

text.Generic WoodElf Female: Arch-Mage Traven is the first to take such a hard stance on Necromancy. It upset more than a few people.

text.Generic WoodElf Male: The Mages Guild runs more or less like it always did, but we lost quite a few members when the practice of Necromancy was banned.

text.Generic WoodElf Female: The Mages Guild runs more or less like it always did, but we lost quite a few members when the practice of Necromancy was banned.

text.Generic WoodElf Male: Necromancy may be legal in Cyrodiil, but few will openly admit to practicing it now that the Mages Guild has banned it.

text.Generic WoodElf Female: Necromancy may be legal in Cyrodiil, but few will openly admit to practicing it now that the Mages Guild has banned it.

text.Generic WoodElf Male: Some say that Traven is mis-using the power of the Arch-Mage's position to further his personal agendas.

text.Generic WoodElf Female: Some say that Traven is mis-using the power of the Arch-Mage's position to further his personal agendas.

text.Generic WoodElf Male: I don't know what Arch-Mage Traven has against Necromancy, but the first thing he did after taking over the Mages Guild was to ban its practice.

text.Generic WoodElf Female: I don't know what Arch-Mage Traven has against Necromancy, but the first thing he did after taking over the Mages Guild was to ban its practice.

text.Generic WoodElf Male: Not only has Necromancy been banned from practice in the Mages Guild, but the Guild won't deal with anyone who openly uses it.

text.Generic WoodElf Female: Not only has Necromancy been banned from practice in the Mages Guild, but the Guild won't deal with anyone who openly uses it.

text.Generic WoodElf Male: The Mages Guild has made more than a few enemies since Necromancy was banned.

text.Generic WoodElf Female: The Mages Guild has made more than a few enemies since Necromancy was banned.

text.Maglir: I saw that Earana woman hanging around the Mages Guild again.

text.Generic WoodElf Male: I saw that Erthor is back in town again.

text.Generic WoodElf Female: I hear one of the guild mages has gone missing again.

text.Generic WoodElf Male: It seems quieter than usual at the Mages Guild.
I saw Earana leaving town. She looked very excited.

text.Generic WoodElf Female: Things at the Mages Guild seem tense. That Falcar fellow sure keeps a tight rein on things.

text.Generic WoodElf Male: Falcar at the Mages Guild seems to be angry all the time. I avoid him when I can.
I haven't seen Vidkun around town lately. I guess they're keeping him pretty busy at the Mages Guild.

text.Generic WoodElf Female: I haven't seen Vidkun around town lately. I guess they're keeping him pretty busy at the Mages Guild.

text.Generic WoodElf Male: Varon Vamori seems very glum lately. I guess things aren't going well with Ardaline.
Kud-Ei seems upset about something lately. I'd stay away from the Mages Guild if I were you.

text.Generic WoodElf Female: Kud-Ei seems upset about something lately. I'd stay away from the Mages Guild if I were you.
Those new fellows here in town are making me nervous. Walking around with those big weapons; I hope they leave soon.

text.Maglir: I heard someone broke into the Mages Guild.

text.Generic WoodElf Male: If the Council really did split up, the guild is done for. This is serious.

text.Generic WoodElf Female: If the Council really did split up, the guild is done for. This is serious.

text.Generic WoodElf Male: The Mages Guild seems more disorganized than usual lately.

text.Elsynia: The Mages Guild seems more disorganized than usual lately.

text.Generic WoodElf Female: You better have the right offering, or you're wasting your time here.

text.Engorm: The Nine Divines are boring. Daedra? They're never boring.

text.Telaendril: Oh, I shouldn't... well, all right. Gogron had a pet rabbit as a child! He petted the thing so hard he crushed its skull! Ha ha ha! What a brute!

text.Generic WoodElf Male: They say that when you murder someone, the Dark Brotherhood comes to you in your sleep. It's how they recruit new members.

text.Generic WoodElf Female: They say that when you murder someone, the Dark Brotherhood comes to you in your sleep. It's how they recruit new members.

text.Generic WoodElf Male: Count Leyawiin placed a bounty on the heads of the surviving Black Bow Bandits.

text.Generic WoodElf Female: Count Leyawiin placed a bounty on the heads of the surviving Black Bow Bandits.

text.Generic WoodElf Male: I hear the Count's got someone to sort out that business with Mazoga the so-called knight.
I heard that Velwyn Benirus was killed. The Manor claims another victim.

text.Generic WoodElf Female: I heard that Velwyn Benirus was killed. The Manor claims another victim.

text.Generic WoodElf Male: The new owner sure has turned Benirus Manor around. It's now a welcome addition to our city.

text.Generic WoodElf Female: The new owner sure has turned Benirus Manor around. It's now a welcome addition to our city.

text.Generic WoodElf Male: I have it on good authority that the city watch sent someone to stop that gang of women from robbing the town's men. Good show I say!

text.Generic WoodElf Female: I have it on good authority that the city watch sent someone to stop that gang of women from robbing the town's men. Good show I say!

text.Generic WoodElf Male: I guess Rosentia Gallenus got rid of whatever barnyard animals she was keeping inside her house. Smells much better now.

text.Generic WoodElf Female: I guess Rosentia Gallenus got rid of whatever barnyard animals she was keeping inside her house. Smells much better now.

text.Generic WoodElf Male: Don't know if this is true, but I heard a gang of all female thieves is preying on the married menfolk of the town.

text.Generic WoodElf Female: Don't know if this is true, but I heard a gang of all female thieves is preying on the married menfolk of the town.

text.Generic WoodElf Male: You hear about Gogan? A gang of thieves is running a scam in town, and he fell for it! Hahaha... what an idiot!

text.Generic WoodElf Female: You hear about Gogan? A gang of thieves is running a scam in town, and he fell for it! Hahaha... what an idiot!

text.Generic WoodElf Male: Have you been near Rosentia Gallenus's house recently? Smells horrible... like she left some meat out to spoil.

text.Generic WoodElf Female: Have you been near Rosentia Gallenus's house recently? Smells horrible... like she left some meat out to spoil.

text.Generic WoodElf Male: I was walking past Rosentia Gallenus' home the other day, and I heard these strange animal noises or something from inside... very odd.

text.Generic WoodElf Female: I was walking past Rosentia Gallenus' home the other day, and I heard these strange animal noises or something from inside... very odd.

text.Generic WoodElf Male: I swear that when I passed by Benirus Manor last night, I heard someone scream from inside. Velwyn Benirus will never sell that deathtrap!

text.Generic WoodElf Female: I swear that when I passed by Benirus Manor last night, I heard someone scream from inside. Velwyn Benirus will never sell that deathtrap!

text.Generic WoodElf Male: I heard that Velwyn Benirus is trying to sell off Benirus Manor. Hopefully the new owners will clean that eyesore up.

text.Generic WoodElf Female: I heard that Velwyn Benirus is trying to sell off Benirus Manor. Hopefully the new owners will clean that eyesore up.

text.Glarthir: Yes.  I mean ... I must go now.  But do accept my apologies for your loss.

text.Generic WoodElf Male: We're all talking about the emperor's murder. We have no emperor. And no heir. That's never happened before. I suppose we should all be worried.

text.Generic WoodElf Female: We're all talking about the emperor's murder. We have no emperor. And no heir. That's never happened before. I suppose we should all be worried.
People are subdued. Troubled. A crisis like this tests the people's faith.
I think we're in for some hard times. The death of Uriel Septim and his heirs changes everything.

text.Generic WoodElf Male: The Emperor and his three sons, dead, right under the noses of the Imperial Guard. It's a disgrace.
Have you heard about Kvatch? They say that daedra came from Oblivion and burned the whole city to the ground!

text.Generic WoodElf Female: Everyone's saying there's trouble in Kvatch. The whole town destroyed. Only a few survivors.

text.Generic WoodElf Male: Do you think what happened to Kvatch could happen here?
I heard that the Kvatch Guard is driving back the daedra! Maybe there's hope after all.

text.Generic WoodElf Female: I heard that the Kvatch Guard is driving back the daedra! Maybe there's hope after all.
Everybody's talking about the Hero of Kvatch! They say he actually went into an Oblivion Gate and destroyed it.

text.Generic WoodElf Male: Everybody's talking about the Hero of Kvatch! They say she actually went into an Oblivion Gate and destroyed it.
Hey, you're the one they call the Hero of Kvatch, aren't you? The one that closed the Oblivion Gate and saved the city?

text.Generic WoodElf Female: Hey, you're the one they call the Hero of Kvatch, aren't you? The one that closed the Oblivion Gate and saved the city?

text.Generic WoodElf Male: Good news from Kvatch for a change. The last of the daedra have been driven out.

text.Generic WoodElf Female: Good news from Kvatch for a change. The last of the daedra have been driven out.

text.Generic WoodElf Male: Do you believe any of that talk about more Oblivion Gates opening all over the place?

text.Generic WoodElf Female: I've been hearing disturbing tales about Oblivion Gates opening all across Cyrodiil. I hope it's just wild talk.

text.Generic WoodElf Male: They say that Oblivion Gates have opened outside cities all across Tamriel! Gods preserve us!

text.Generic WoodElf Female: With those Oblivion Gates opening everywhere, it's only a matter of time before another city goes the way of Kvatch.
Did you hear? The lost heir of Uriel Septim rallied the Guard and smashed a horde of daedra outside Bruma!

text.Generic WoodElf Male: They say a lost son of Uriel Septim has reappeared in Bruma. Troops are flocking to his banner from all over Cyrodiil!
I heard that some cult called the Mythic Dawn is behind the Emperor's assassination.

text.Generic WoodElf Female: They're saying some cult murdered the Emperor and are opening the Oblivion Gates. Do you think any of it's true?

text.Generic WoodElf Male: Thank Akatosh the Oblivion Crisis is over! Although with no Emperor and no heir, I wonder what will happen to the Empire?
I plan to visit the Imperial City soon to pay my respects at the Temple of the One. They say the Dragon Statue is 100 feet high!

text.Generic WoodElf Female: I'm sure the Elder Council will find some way to hold the Empire together. At least the Oblivion invasion is over!
I heard that some of the provinces were talking about seceding from the Empire. Probably just talk though. Everything's a bit unsettled now.

text.Generic WoodElf Male: Most people consider Martin's... transformation... a religious or political event, but what interests me is its metaphysical implications.

text.Generic WoodElf Female: Most people consider Martin's... transformation... a religious or political event, but what interests me is its metaphysical implications.
I wish I had witnessed the avatar of divine Akatosh myself. Imagine! Upon the very altar of the Temple of the One!

text.SEBeggarGloorolros: I hear that Earil is fed up with Brithaur's antics. He really wants something done about it.

text.Generic WoodElf Female: I hear that Earil is fed up with Brithaur's antics. He really wants something done about it.

text.SEBeggarBolwing: I try not to burden myself with news of the current goings-on. It gets to be rather distasteful at times. Don't you think?
Fribble! Just Fribble!

text.Generic WoodElf Male: Scalons carry diseases. Lots of them.

text.Generic WoodElf Female: Scalons carry diseases. Lots of them.
Don't run into the water to escape a Scalon. They'll follow you.

text.Generic WoodElf Male: Have to watch for those Scalons. I hear they carry disease.

text.SEThaedil: Have to watch for those Scalons. I hear they carry disease.

text.Generic WoodElf Male: If you see a Gnarl, be careful what spells you use on them.

text.SEThaedil: If you see a Gnarl, be careful what spells you use on them.

text.Generic WoodElf Male: I've heard that Gnarl get stronger when hit by some spells.

text.Generic WoodElf Female: I've heard that Gnarl get stronger when hit by some spells.
The Gnarl are strange creatures. Hit them with a fireball, and they get stronger, but they hate other elements even more.

text.Generic WoodElf Male: Those Shambles are dangerous. Make sure to stand back if you kill one.

text.SEThaedil: Those Shambles are dangerous. Make sure to stand back if you kill one.

text.Generic WoodElf Male: Don't bother using a frost spell on a Shambles.

text.Generic WoodElf Female: Don't bother using a frost spell on a Shambles.
If you see a Shambles dying, stand back. They'll take you with them.

text.Generic WoodElf Male: Flesh Atronachs are dangerous. Some are smart enough to heal themselves when they're hurt.

text.SEThaedil: Flesh Atronachs are dangerous. Some are smart enough to heal themselves when they're hurt.

text.Generic WoodElf Male: Sometimes, a sharp blade is the best way to kill a Flesh Atronach.

text.Generic WoodElf Female: Sometimes, a sharp blade is the best way to kill a Flesh Atronach.
If you have to fight a Flesh Atronach, a good shock spell is the way to go.

text.Generic WoodElf Male: The poison of the Elytra can be debilitating.

text.SEThaedil: The poison of the Elytra can be debilitating.

text.Generic WoodElf Male: The Elytra have wondrous poisons that can drain the very life from you.

text.Generic WoodElf Female: The Elytra have wondrous poisons that can drain the very life from you.
Watch for the Elytra's stingers; their poison can be deadly. They don't like magic much, though.

text.Generic WoodElf Male: The Hunger is one of Lord Sheogorath's favorite pets.

text.SEThaedil: The Hunger is one of Lord Sheogorath's favorite pets.

text.Generic WoodElf Male: Only the Demented can truly appreciate the Hunger.

text.Generic WoodElf Female: Only the Demented can truly appreciate the Hunger.
Like most lesser Daedra, the Hunger has a weakness to shock spells.

text.Generic WoodElf Male: Some say the Grummites are the original inhabitants of the Shivering Isles.

text.SEThaedil: Some say the Grummites are the original inhabitants of the Shivering Isles.

text.Generic WoodElf Male: Who do the Grummites worship? Some say Sheogorath, but I'm not sure.

text.Generic WoodElf Female: Who do the Grummites worship? Some say Sheogorath, but I'm not sure.
Try not to fight a Grummite in the water. Or in the rain. They seem to like that.

text.Generic WoodElf Male: The Baliwog is a dangerous little creature. Some say they grow up to be Scalons.

text.SEThaedil: The Baliwog is a dangerous little creature. Some say they grow up to be Scalons.

text.Generic WoodElf Male: The Baliwog are known to carry Swamp Fever.

text.Generic WoodElf Female: The Baliwog are known to carry Swamp Fever.
The Baliwog will return to the water to heal.

text.Generic WoodElf Male: I've heard that Skinned Hounds don't like fire.

text.SEThaedil: I've heard that Skinned Hounds don't like fire.

text.Generic WoodElf Male: Don't waste your wonderful poisons on Skinned Hounds. They seem to like them.

text.Generic WoodElf Female: Don't waste your wonderful poisons on Skinned Hounds. They seem to like them.
Best way to kill a Skinned Hound is with a fireball, or a good weapon.

text.Generic WoodElf Male: Heretics are misguided worshippers of Arden-Sul.

text.SEThaedil: Heretics are misguided worshippers of Arden-Sul.

text.Generic WoodElf Male: I hear the Heretics in the lands of Mania summon Hungers to fight by their sides.

text.Generic WoodElf Female: I hear the Heretics in the lands of Mania summon Hungers to fight by their sides.
If you want to get close to the Heretics, try putting on their robes.

text.Generic WoodElf Male: The Zealots in the lands of Dementia believe they worship Arden-Sul. Poor, deluded souls.

text.SEThaedil: The Zealots in the lands of Dementia believe they worship Arden-Sul. Poor, deluded souls.

text.Generic WoodElf Male: Zealots have dedicated themselves to the worship of Arden-Sul.

text.Generic WoodElf Female: Zealots have dedicated themselves to the worship of Arden-Sul.
If you want to sneak up on one of those Zealots, wear one of their robes. Fools them every time.

text.Generic WoodElf Male: I understand there's been strange activity near the obelisks around the Isles.

text.SEThaedil: I understand there's been strange activity near the obelisks around the Isles.

text.Generic WoodElf Male: Stay away from the obelisks! Strange things have appeared near them.

text.Generic WoodElf Female: Stay away from the obelisks! Strange things have appeared near them.
The crystal obelisks that dot the Isles have recently started behaving strangely.

text.Generic WoodElf Male: Knights of Order have appeared in the Isles. I hear they come from the obelisks.

text.SEThaedil: Knights of Order have appeared in the Isles. I hear they come from the obelisks.

text.Generic WoodElf Male: Knights of Order have come to destroy the Realm!

text.Generic WoodElf Female: Knights of Order have come to destroy the Realm!
I understand that the Hearts of Order you find on the Knights can be used to unlock special chests.

text.Generic WoodElf Male: Raven-Biter runs the Choosy Beggar. Not a bad place.

text.SEThaedil: Raven-Biter runs the Choosy Beggar. Not a bad place.

text.Generic WoodElf Male: You can stay at the Choosy Beggar in Bliss, but I wouldn't.

text.Generic WoodElf Female: You can stay at the Choosy Beggar in Bliss, but I wouldn't.

text.Generic WoodElf Male: Tilse Areleth has quite a collection of things for sale at Common Treasures.

text.SEThaedil: Tilse Areleth has quite a collection of things for sale at Common Treasures.

text.Generic WoodElf Male: Common Treasures is full of junk. That's all Tilse Areleth collects.

text.Generic WoodElf Female: Common Treasures is full of junk. That's all Tilse Areleth collects.

text.Generic WoodElf Male: The best armor in the city is at The Missing Pauldron.

text.SEThaedil: The best armor in the city is at The Missing Pauldron.

text.Generic WoodElf Male: I'm not about to go to the Missing Pauldron, even if they do sell armor. I'll stay in Crucible, thank you.

text.Generic WoodElf Female: I'm not about to go to the Missing Pauldron, even if they do sell armor. I'll stay in Crucible, thank you.

text.Generic WoodElf Male: Books of Bliss has quite a selection.

text.SEThaedil: Books of Bliss has quite a selection.

text.Generic WoodElf Male: Sontaire may sell a lot of books, but that's not why the men visit her.

text.Generic WoodElf Female: Sontaire may sell a lot of books, but that's not why the men visit her.

text.Generic WoodElf Male: Cutter sells weapons in Crucible, but you won't catch me going there.

text.SEThaedil: Cutter sells weapons in Crucible, but you won't catch me going there.

text.Generic WoodElf Male: I'd buy my weapons at Cutter's. She has... a way with blades.

text.SE07ASESylDouble: I'd buy my weapons at Cutter's. She has... a way with blades.

text.Generic WoodElf Male: That Museum of Oddities is a joke, although I hear Una Armina will pay for certain items.

text.SEThaedil: That Museum of Oddities is a joke, although I hear Una Armina will pay for certain items.

text.Generic WoodElf Male: You should stop by the Museum of Oddities. I understand Una is always looking for more items to display.

text.Generic WoodElf Female: You should stop by the Museum of Oddities. I understand Una is always looking for more items to display.

text.Generic WoodElf Male: I'd research my own spells before I'd buy them from Earil's Mysteries.

text.SEThaedil: I'd research my own spells before I'd buy them from Earil's Mysteries.

text.Generic WoodElf Male: Earil's Mysteries sells a number of unique spells. Doesn't sell any mysteries, though.

text.Generic WoodElf Female: Earil's Mysteries sells a number of unique spells. Doesn't sell any mysteries, though.

text.Generic WoodElf Male: Things Found? More like Things Found in the Trash.

text.SEThaedil: Things Found? More like Things Found in the Trash.

text.Generic WoodElf Male: You can find some good deals at Things Found. Ahjazda has an interesting collection.

text.Generic WoodElf Female: You can find some good deals at Things Found. Ahjazda has an interesting collection.

text.Generic WoodElf Male: I wouldn't be caught dead at Sickly Bernice's... though I imagine her customers might.

text.SEThaedil: I wouldn't be caught dead at Sickly Bernice's... though I imagine her customers might.

text.Generic WoodElf Male: Sickly Bernice's isn't a bad place. Just make sure to wash your hands.

text.Generic WoodElf Female: Sickly Bernice's isn't a bad place. Just make sure to wash your hands.

text.Generic WoodElf Male: Dumag gro-Bonk at The Missing Pauldron is collecting that Amber you find in the root tunnels.

text.SEThaedil: Dumag gro-Bonk at The Missing Pauldron is collecting that Amber you find in the root tunnels.

text.Generic WoodElf Male: I hear Cutter collects the Madness Ore to turn into armor.

text.SE07ASESylDouble: I hear Cutter collects the Madness Ore to turn into armor.

text.Generic WoodElf Female: There are smiths in New Sheoth that collect Amber and Madness Ore.

text.Generic WoodElf Male: I've heard ghosts haunt the ruined city of Vitharn.

text.SEThaedil: I've heard ghosts haunt the ruined city of Vitharn.

text.Generic WoodElf Male: Stay away from Vitharn. It's said the dead walk there.

text.Generic WoodElf Female: Stay away from Vitharn. It's said the dead walk there.
Take care venturing into the ruined city of Vitharn.

text.Generic WoodElf Male: I understand there's a Knight of the Thorn in Hale.

text.SEThaedil: I understand there's a Knight of the Thorn in Hale.

text.Generic WoodElf Male: Pyke, the Knight of the Thorn, lives in Hale.

text.Generic WoodElf Female: Pyke, the Knight of the Thorn, lives in Hale.
If you visit Hale, you may see Pyke, a Knight of the Thorn.

text.Generic WoodElf Male: The merchants in Crucible are getting tired of Brithaur stealing from them.

text.SEThaedil: The merchants in Crucible are getting tired of Brithaur stealing from them.

text.Generic WoodElf Male: Everyone is tired of Brithaur's antics.

text.Generic WoodElf Female: Everyone is tired of Brithaur's antics.
I understand the merchants of Crucible are having problems with Brithaur.

text.Generic WoodElf Male: I understand Hirrus Clutumnus is begging for people to kill him.

text.SEThaedil: I understand Hirrus Clutumnus is begging for people to kill him.

text.Generic WoodElf Male: Someone should put Hirrus Clutumnus out of his misery.

text.Generic WoodElf Female: Someone should put Hirrus Clutumnus out of his misery.
In Crucible, a man named Hirrus Clutumnus has been trying to convince people to kill him.

text.Generic WoodElf Male: I've heard there's someone in Highcross trying to catalogue every living thing in the Isles.

text.SEThaedil: I've heard there's someone in Highcross trying to catalogue every living thing in the Isles.

text.Generic WoodElf Male: Mirili Ulven in Highcross thinks she can catalogue every creature in the Isles.

text.Generic WoodElf Female: Mirili Ulven in Highcross thinks she can catalogue every creature in the Isles.
If you visit Highcross, speak with Mirili Ulven. She needs help with her project.

text.Generic WoodElf Male: I don't visit the Museum of Oddities, but Una Armina is always looking for new items to display.

text.SEThaedil: I don't visit the Museum of Oddities, but Una Armina is always looking for new items to display.

text.Generic WoodElf Male: If you find something unique, it's worth checking with Una Armina.

text.Generic WoodElf Female: If you find something unique, it's worth checking with Una Armina.

text.Generic WoodElf Male: Cindanwe runs a tight ship in Fellmoor.

text.SEThaedil: Cindanwe runs a tight ship in Fellmoor.

text.Generic WoodElf Male: The workers in Fellmoor aren't too happy with Cindanwe.

text.Generic WoodElf Female: The workers in Fellmoor aren't too happy with Cindanwe.
Fellmoor must be a terrible place to live.

text.Generic WoodElf Male: Amiable Fanriene thinks his house is going to fall in on him.

text.SEThaedil: Amiable Fanriene thinks his house is going to fall in on him.

text.Generic WoodElf Male: That Amiable Fanriene is afraid of his own shadow.

text.Generic WoodElf Female: That Amiable Fanriene is afraid of his own shadow.
There's a man in Bliss who believes his own house will collapse around him.

text.Generic WoodElf Male: Sickly Bernice is convinced she's dying. No wonder no one wants to eat at her Taphouse.

text.SEThaedil: Sickly Bernice is convinced she's dying. No wonder no one wants to eat at her Taphouse.

text.Generic WoodElf Male: Sickly Bernice is always looking for a miracle cure.

text.Generic WoodElf Female: Sickly Bernice is always looking for a miracle cure.
Sickly Bernice in Crucible believes she is dying.

text.Generic WoodElf Male: I heard Tove the Unrestful is building something again.

text.SEThaedil: I heard Tove the Unrestful is building something again.

text.Generic WoodElf Male: Tove the Unrestful in Bliss is collecting useless items to build something.

text.Generic WoodElf Female: Tove the Unrestful in Bliss is collecting useless items to build something.
Tove the Unrestful in Bliss is collecting items to build something.

text.Generic WoodElf Male: Ushnar in Crucible is afraid of cats. Cats!

text.SEThaedil: Ushnar in Crucible is afraid of cats. Cats!

text.Generic WoodElf Male: Ushnar is deathly afraid of cats. He makes sure to keep dogs around because of it.

text.Generic WoodElf Female: Ushnar is deathly afraid of cats. He makes sure to keep dogs around because of it.
There's an orc in Crucible who is deathly afraid of cats.

text.Generic WoodElf Male: Ahjazda in Crucible believes the world is ending.

text.SEThaedil: Ahjazda in Crucible believes the world is ending.

text.Generic WoodElf Male: Ahjazda thinks the world is ending tomorrow. She's been saving magic items just in case.

text.Generic WoodElf Female: Ahjazda thinks the world is ending tomorrow. She's been saving magic items just in case.
There is a Khajiit in Crucible who believes the world is about to end.

text.Generic WoodElf Male: Poor Big Head will never find the Fork of Horripilation.

text.SEThaedil: Poor Big Head will never find the Fork of Horripilation.

text.Generic WoodElf Male: That fool Big Head is always looking for the Fork of Horripilation.

text.Generic WoodElf Female: That fool Big Head is always looking for the Fork of Horripilation.
The Argonian Big Head is always searching for the Fork of Horripilation.

text.Generic WoodElf Male: Every resident of Split has a double living in the town.

text.SEThaedil: Every resident of Split has a double living in the town.

text.Generic WoodElf Male: Every person in Split has been divided into their Manic and Demented halves.

text.Generic WoodElf Female: Every person in Split has been divided into their Manic and Demented halves.
There are two of everything in Split. Even the residents.

text.Generic WoodElf Male: Those wanted posters of the Gray Fox are everywhere.

text.Generic WoodElf Female: Those wanted posters of the Gray Fox are everywhere.

text.Generic WoodElf Male: Did you hear that someone broke into an Imperial Legion post and stole the taxes they collected from the Waterfront?

text.Generic WoodElf Female: Did you hear that someone broke into an Imperial Legion post and stole the taxes they collected from the Waterfront?

text.Generic WoodElf Male: Captain Lex blames the Gray Fox for stealing the tax collection. He wants a bounty put on the Gray Fox, but the Legion Commander has refused.

text.Generic WoodElf Female: Captain Lex blames the Gray Fox for stealing the tax collection. He wants a bounty put on the Gray Fox, but the Legion Commander has refused.

text.Generic WoodElf Male: Have you heard? Someone desecrated the tomb of Llathasa. No wonder her ghost haunts that place.

text.Generic WoodElf Female: Have you heard? Someone desecrated the tomb of Llathasa. No wonder her ghost haunts that place.

text.Generic WoodElf Male: One of the castle staff was murdered trying to stop a thief.

text.Generic WoodElf Female: One of the castle staff was murdered trying to stop a thief.

text.Generic WoodElf Male: I heard that thieves broke into the Arcane University, the Imperial Legion Compound, and the Temple, all on the same night!

text.Generic WoodElf Female: I heard that thieves broke into the Arcane University, the Imperial Legion Compound, and the Temple, all on the same night!

text.Generic WoodElf Male: Someone told me that Hieronymus Lex is gone. Reassigned to Anvil. That can't be true!

text.Generic WoodElf Female: Someone told me that Hieronymus Lex is gone. Reassigned to Anvil. That can't be true!

text.Generic WoodElf Male: Is there a new Captain of the guard? I thought I saw him walking the rounds.

text.Generic WoodElf Female: Is there a new Captain of the guard? I thought I saw him walking the rounds.

text.Generic WoodElf Male: I heard that someone broke into the wizard's tower. What kind of a fool would take on Fathis Aren?

text.Generic WoodElf Female: I heard that someone broke into the wizard's tower. What kind of a fool would take on Fathis Aren?

text.Generic WoodElf Male: The Earl of Imbel was attacked and killed in his own home. I heard the body burned in the sunlight.

text.Generic WoodElf Female: The Earl of Imbel was attacked and killed in his own home. I heard the body burned in the sunlight.

text.Generic WoodElf Male: They say a thief actually stole one of the Elder Scrolls from the Imperial Library. Who would have thought it was even possible?

text.Generic WoodElf Female: They say a thief actually stole one of the Elder Scrolls from the Imperial Library. Who would have thought it was even possible?

text.Generic WoodElf Male: I saw Ugak gra-Mogakh earlier. At least, I think it was her. Perhaps it was her sister.

text.Generic WoodElf Female: I saw Ugak gra-Mogakh earlier. At least, I think it was her. Perhaps it was her sister.

text.Generic WoodElf Male: Mog gra-Mogakh runs a fine establishment at the Two Sisters Lodge. And her sister has some quality horses.

text.Generic WoodElf Female: Mog gra-Mogakh runs a fine establishment at the Two Sisters Lodge. And her sister has some quality horses.

text.Generic WoodElf Male: Maybe it's just me, but I find Falanu Hlaalu really odd. And I've seen him hanging around the graveyard with a strange smile on his face.

text.Generic WoodElf Female: Maybe it's just me, but I find Falanu Hlaalu really odd. And I've seen him hanging around the graveyard with a strange smile on his face.

text.Generic WoodElf Male: I don't know if Tumindil ever leaves the chapel. That man works day and night to take care of all of us.

text.Generic WoodElf Female: I don't know if Tumindil ever leaves the chapel. That man works day and night to take care of all of us.

text.Generic WoodElf Male: I suppose Count Hassildor keeps Skingrad running smoothly, but you hardly ever see the man.

text.Generic WoodElf Female: I suppose Count Hassildor keeps Skingrad running smoothly, but you hardly ever see the man.

text.Generic WoodElf Male: I hope nobody tries to get away with anything when Captain Dion is around. He's a tough customer.

text.Generic WoodElf Female: I hope nobody tries to get away with anything when Captain Dion is around. He's a tough customer.

text.Generic WoodElf Male: I heard Ah-Mahlz was out hunting goblins again. Good. They're vermin.

text.Thamriel: I heard Ah-Mahlz was out hunting goblins again. Good. They're vermin.

text.Generic WoodElf Male: Parwen has really got a thing for goblins. I think she and Ah-Malz keep a running tally of who has killed more.

text.Thamriel: Parwen has really got a thing for goblins. I think she and Ah-Malz keep a running tally of who has killed more.

text.Generic WoodElf Male: If you don't know much about Mysticism, Druja is a good person to talk to. She's at the Mages Guild.

text.Generic WoodElf Female: If you don't know much about Mysticism, Druja is a good person to talk to. She's at the Mages Guild.

text.Generic WoodElf Male: I smelled a strange odor coming from the Mages Guild yesterday. Erthor must have been doing another experiment.

text.Generic WoodElf Female: I smelled a strange odor coming from the Mages Guild yesterday. Erthor must have been doing another experiment.

text.Generic WoodElf Male: I love walking by Salmo's place. The smell of her bread baking is amazing.

text.Generic WoodElf Female: I love walking by Salmo's place. The smell of her bread baking is amazing.

text.Generic WoodElf Male: You know, if you need to get better at archery, you should talk to Reman Broder. He's quite a good shot.

text.Generic WoodElf Female: You know, if you need to get better at archery, you should talk to Reman Broder. He's quite a good shot.

text.Generic WoodElf Male: Bernadette Peneles works over at the Tamika Winery. They make a quality wine there.

text.Generic WoodElf Female: Bernadette Peneles works over at the Tamika Winery. They make a quality wine there.

text.Generic WoodElf Male: I bought some wine from Davide Surilie. Excellent body. He's a fine vintner.

text.Generic WoodElf Female: I bought some wine from Davide Surilie. Excellent body. He's a fine vintner.

text.Generic WoodElf Male: Tamika makes some truly fine wines at her winery. I think they're every bit as good as the Surilie Brothers wines.

text.Generic WoodElf Female: Tamika makes some truly fine wines at her winery. I think they're every bit as good as the Surilie Brothers wines.

text.Generic WoodElf Male: I don't know that anyone in Cyrodiil drives a harder bargain than Palonirya at Divine Elegance.

text.Generic WoodElf Female: I don't know that anyone in Cyrodiil drives a harder bargain than Palonirya at Divine Elegance.

text.Generic WoodElf Male: The King and Queen Tavern isn't a bad place to stay if you're visiting the city.

text.Generic WoodElf Female: The King and Queen Tavern isn't a bad place to stay if you're visiting the city.

text.Generic WoodElf Male: I understand old Dovyn Aren can still teach a bit about Alteration.

text.Generic WoodElf Female: I understand old Dovyn Aren can still teach a bit about Alteration.

text.Generic WoodElf Male: Othrelos is a sneaky one. Kind of makes you wonder what he's up to.

text.Generic WoodElf Female: Othrelos is a sneaky one. Kind of makes you wonder what he's up to.

text.Generic WoodElf Male: Samuel Bantien used to be a wild one. They say he used to be quite the "locksmith."

text.Generic WoodElf Female: Samuel Bantien used to be a wild one. They say he used to be quite the "locksmith."

text.Generic WoodElf Male: A lot of mages swear by Rindir's Staffs.

text.Generic WoodElf Female: A lot of mages swear by Rindir's Staffs.

text.Generic WoodElf Male: If you need to get rid of something quickly, check out the Copious Coinpurse.

text.Generic WoodElf Female: If you need to get rid of something quickly, check out the Copious Coinpurse.

text.Generic WoodElf Male: I needed some cash, so I went to see Jensine.

text.Generic WoodElf Female: I needed some cash, so I went to see Jensine.

text.Generic WoodElf Male: Calindil runs a nice place at the Mystic Emporium.

text.Generic WoodElf Female: Calindil runs a nice place at the Mystic Emporium.

text.Generic WoodElf Male: If you need light armor, talk to Maro Rufus at The Best Defense.

text.Generic WoodElf Female: If you need light armor, talk to Maro Rufus at The Best Defense.

text.Generic WoodElf Male: Vinivia Melissaeia takes all the merchant complaints in the city.

text.Generic WoodElf Female: Vinivia Melissaeia takes all the merchant complaints in the city.
There are some quality books at Mach-Na's. Just don't catch him when he's in a bad mood.
Gruiand Garrana can talk her way out of anything. Of course, all she usually talks about is herself.
Naspia Cosma is really skilled with her blade. It's a shame she doesn't compete in the Arena.

text.Uurwen: Ganredhel sure does have a knack for training dogs. I've heard that she will train people as well, for a price.

text.Generic WoodElf Male: I don't think that Gilgondrin really wants to run Silverhome-on-the-Water. He never seems happy when he's there.

text.Generic WoodElf Female: I don't think that Gilgondrin really wants to run Silverhome-on-the-Water. He never seems happy when he's there.

text.Generic WoodElf Male: I'm glad Marz lives here in Bravil. She's an excellent healer.

text.Generic WoodElf Female: I'm glad Marz lives here in Bravil. She's an excellent healer.

text.Generic WoodElf Male: I understand Tadrose Helas has more jobs than she knows what to do with. She's very eager to help out her guild.

text.Generic WoodElf Female: I understand Tadrose Helas has more jobs than she knows what to do with. She's very eager to help out her guild.

text.Generic WoodElf Male: Seems to me that Ardaline has an admirer in Varon Vamori.

text.Generic WoodElf Female: Seems to me that Ardaline has an admirer in Varon Vamori.

text.Generic WoodElf Male: Varon Vamori really has a silver tongue.

text.Generic WoodElf Female: Varon Vamori really has a silver tongue.

text.Generic WoodElf Male: She doesn't leave home much, but apparently Luciana Galena has a lot of experience fighting in light armor.

text.Generic WoodElf Female: She doesn't leave home much, but apparently Luciana Galena has a lot of experience fighting in light armor.

text.Generic WoodElf Male: The Three Sisters Inn is a nice place, but that Shuravi sure is grumpy. I don't think she likes anyone.

text.Generic WoodElf Female: The Three Sisters Inn is a nice place, but that Shuravi sure is grumpy. I don't think she likes anyone.

text.Generic WoodElf Male: The Dividing Line is a good place to buy a sharp blade. Of course, you're likely to hear some of Tun-Zeeus' stories if you hang around.

text.Generic WoodElf Female: The Dividing Line is a good place to buy a sharp blade. Of course, you're likely to hear some of Tun-Zeeus' stories if you hang around.

text.Generic WoodElf Male: I've heard that Dagail knows a lot about Mysticism. And sheep.

text.Elsynia: I've heard that Dagail knows a lot about Mysticism. And sheep.

text.Generic WoodElf Male: Have you spoken to Wilbur at the Count's Arms? He knows a lot about fine wines.

text.Generic WoodElf Female: Have you spoken to Wilbur at the Count's Arms? He knows a lot about fine wines.

text.Generic WoodElf Male: I've heard Azzan can sign you up for the Fighters Guild. That's someone I wouldn't mind working for.

text.Generic WoodElf Female: I've heard Azzan can sign you up for the Fighters Guild. That's someone I wouldn't mind working for.

text.Generic WoodElf Male: I understand that Vigdis at the Fighters Guild has some skill with blunt weapons. He's been training other Fighters Guild members.

text.Generic WoodElf Female: I understand that Vigdis at the Fighters Guild has some skill with blunt weapons. He's been training other Fighters Guild members.

text.Generic WoodElf Male: I understand Carahil knows more about Illusion than any other mage in Anvil. Of course, she only shares that knowledge with the Mages Guild.

text.Generic WoodElf Female: I understand Carahil knows more about Illusion than any other mage in Anvil. Of course, she only shares that knowledge with the Mages Guild.

text.Generic WoodElf Male: Mirabelle Monet is quite a woman. Ask any of the sailors down at the Fo'c's'le.

text.Generic WoodElf Female: Mirabelle Monet is quite a woman. Ask any of the sailors down at the Fo'c's'le.

text.Generic WoodElf Male: I've never read any of Quill-Weave's writings. I've heard they're fairly good, though.

text.Generic WoodElf Female: I've never read any of Quill-Weave's writings. I've heard they're fairly good, though.

text.Maglir: It's good to be a Fighters Guild member, don't you think?

text.Generic WoodElf Male: I found some good pauldrons at the armorer.
The Grey Mare isn't a bad place to stay, especially if you're low on Septims.
Been to Fire and Steel recently? Rasheda has some nice new swords in there. And she's a friendly one, she is.

text.Maglir: I'd like to learn more about spellcasting. Might have to head over to the Mages Guild and see if they're accepting new members.

text.Generic WoodElf Male: I'm not so sure about that Eugal Belette. An odd fellow, and people have said there are strange noises coming from his house at all hours.
I can't believe that Glistel would live with that Malintus Ancrus. Shameful, and her being such a lovely girl.
Sometimes I just go look at the Great Oak. Magnificent, don't you think?
I lived in the Imperial City for a while, but city life just isn't for me. I'm much happier in Chorrol.
Don't get too many folks passing through here these days.
Ancient Wayshrines of the Nine are scattered through the wilderness. The righteous who pray there receive powerful divine blessings.

text.Generic WoodElf Female: Ancient Wayshrines of the Nine are scattered through the wilderness. The righteous who pray there receive powerful divine blessings.

text.Generic WoodElf Male: If you've done good deeds, the Nine will bless you and cure diseases when you visit their wayshrines.

text.Generic WoodElf Female: If you've done good deeds, the Nine will bless you and cure diseases when you visit their wayshrines.

text.Generic WoodElf Male: Wayshrines of the Nine in the wilderness confer blessings on the righteous and faithful.

text.Generic WoodElf Female: Wayshrines of the Nine in the wilderness confer blessings on the righteous and faithful.

text.Generic WoodElf Male: Those famous for good deeds may receive Blessings of Intelligence and Magicka when they visit Wayshrines of Julianos.

text.Generic WoodElf Female: Those famous for good deeds may receive Blessings of Intelligence and Magicka when they visit Wayshrines of Julianos.

text.Generic WoodElf Male: Virtuous visitors to Wayshrines of Kynareth may receive Blessings of Agility.

text.Generic WoodElf Female: Virtuous visitors to Wayshrines of Kynareth may receive Blessings of Agility.

text.Generic WoodElf Male: When you visit a Wayshrine of Zenithar, and you've lived a good life by the Nine, you may receive a Blessing of Luck.

text.Generic WoodElf Female: When you visit a Wayshrine of Zenithar, and you've lived a good life by the Nine, you may receive a Blessing of Luck.

text.Generic WoodElf Male: Those who live by the Commands of the Nine receive Blessings of Strength when they visit Wayshrines of Tiber Septim.

text.Generic WoodElf Female: Those who live by the Commands of the Nine receive Blessings of Strength when they visit Wayshrines of Tiber Septim.

text.Generic WoodElf Male: A good man who honors the Nine may visit the Wayshrines of Akatosh for Blessings of Speed and Magicka.

text.Generic WoodElf Female: A good man who honors the Nine may visit the Wayshrines of Akatosh for Blessings of Speed and Magicka.

text.Generic WoodElf Male: If you've been good, Wayshrines of Dibella may bless your Personality.

text.Generic WoodElf Female: If you've been good, Wayshrines of Dibella may bless your Personality.

text.Generic WoodElf Male: Wayshrines of Arkay confer Blessings of Health on those who've pleased the Nine by righteous acts.

text.Generic WoodElf Female: Wayshrines of Arkay confer Blessings of Health on those who've pleased the Nine by righteous acts.

text.Generic WoodElf Male: Please the Nine with good works, and visit Wayshrines of Stendarr for Blessings of Endurance.

text.Generic WoodElf Female: Please the Nine with good works, and visit Wayshrines of Stendarr for Blessings of Endurance.

text.Generic WoodElf Male: You've seen wayshrines in the wilderness? Those who've pleased the Nine may receive Blessings of Willpower at the Wayshrines of Mara.

text.Generic WoodElf Female: You've seen wayshrines in the wilderness? Those who've pleased the Nine may receive Blessings of Willpower at the Wayshrines of Mara.

text.Generic WoodElf Male: The Heartlands and Nibenean Valley are the agricultural breadbaskets of Cyrodiil.

text.Generic WoodElf Female: The Heartlands and Nibenean Valley are the agricultural breadbaskets of Cyrodiil.

text.Generic WoodElf Male: Where does our food come from? The Heartlands. And the Nibenean Valley. And Skingrad? Great wines, cheeses, and tomatoes.

text.Generic WoodElf Female: Where does our food come from? The Heartlands. And the Nibenean Valley. And Skingrad? Great wines, cheeses, and tomatoes.

text.Generic WoodElf Male: The lowlands of the Great Forest rise to the upland plateau of the Colovian West.

text.Generic WoodElf Female: The lowlands of the Great Forest rise to the upland plateau of the Colovian West.

text.Generic WoodElf Male: The Great Forest was cleared for agriculture around Lake Rumare, but it's mostly wilderness outside of that.

text.Generic WoodElf Female: The Great Forest was cleared for agriculture around Lake Rumare, but it's mostly wilderness outside of that.

text.Generic WoodElf Male: The Colovian Highlands are barren wastelands along the border with Hammerfell.

text.Generic WoodElf Female: The Colovian Highlands are barren wastelands along the border with Hammerfell.

text.Generic WoodElf Male: The Colovian Highlands? Near the Hammerfell border? No one lives there. That's barren wastelands.

text.Generic WoodElf Female: The Colovian Highlands? Near the Hammerfell border? No one lives there. That's barren wastelands.

text.Generic WoodElf Male: High mountain ranges rise to the borders in the north and east, and marshes and rainforests extend to the southeast borders.

text.Generic WoodElf Female: High mountain ranges rise to the borders in the north and east, and marshes and rainforests extend to the southeast borders.

text.Generic WoodElf Male: It's our natural barriers that keep us safe, mostly. Mountain borders north and east, open sea to the west, and bogs and rainforest to south.

text.Generic WoodElf Female: It's our natural barriers that keep us safe, mostly. Mountain borders north and east, open sea to the west, and bogs and rainforest to south.

text.Generic WoodElf Male: Cyrodiil is surrounded to the north and east by the lofty Jerall and Valus mountain ranges.

text.Generic WoodElf Female: Cyrodiil is surrounded to the north and east by the lofty Jerall and Valus mountain ranges.

text.Generic WoodElf Male: No one wants to live in the Jerall Mountains. Well, maybe in Bruma, but they're like Nords. They don't feel the cold.

text.Generic WoodElf Female: No one wants to live in the Jerall Mountains. Well, maybe in Bruma, but they're like Nords. They don't feel the cold.

text.Generic WoodElf Male: Western Cyrodiil is called 'Colovia,' and includes the Gold Coast, West Weald, and Colovian Highlands regions.

text.Generic WoodElf Female: Western Cyrodiil is called 'Colovia,' and includes the Gold Coast, West Weald, and Colovian Highlands regions.

text.Generic WoodElf Male: In the west, in Old Colovia, that's where men are men. That's the Gold Coast, West Weald, and Colovian Highlands.

text.Generic WoodElf Female: In the west, in Old Colovia, that's where men are men. That's the Gold Coast, West Weald, and Colovian Highlands.

text.Generic WoodElf Male: Nibenay is a region of mixed farmland, parkland, and forest.

text.Generic WoodElf Female: Nibenay is a region of mixed farmland, parkland, and forest.

text.Generic WoodElf Male: With all the farms in Nibenay, there's still plenty of forest and wilderness open for settlement.

text.Generic WoodElf Female: With all the farms in Nibenay, there's still plenty of forest and wilderness open for settlement.

text.Generic WoodElf Male: Nibenay is bordered on north and east by rugged mountains and to the south by marshes and rainforest.

text.Generic WoodElf Female: Nibenay is bordered on north and east by rugged mountains and to the south by marshes and rainforest.

text.Generic WoodElf Male: The people of Nibenay consider themselves to be more civilized and sophisticated than Colovians.

text.Generic WoodElf Female: The people of Nibenay consider themselves to be more civilized and sophisticated than Colovians.

text.Generic WoodElf Male: I'm not saying Colovians are dumb. They're just hard-headed.

text.Generic WoodElf Female: I'm not saying Colovians are dumb. They're just hard-headed.

text.Generic WoodElf Male: The Nibeneans think they're slick. 'Slippery' is more like it.

text.Generic WoodElf Female: The Nibeneans think they're slick. 'Slippery' is more like it.

text.Generic WoodElf Male: Colovia is a land of rugged wastes and highland forests.

text.Generic WoodElf Female: Colovia is a land of rugged wastes and highland forests.

text.Generic WoodElf Male: Colovia is dotted with isolated farms and settlements, with most of the population in the coastal margin.

text.Generic WoodElf Female: Colovia is dotted with isolated farms and settlements, with most of the population in the coastal margin.

text.Generic WoodElf Male: The Colovians are proud of their reputation for being independent, rough, and rebellious.

text.Generic WoodElf Female: The Colovians are proud of their reputation for being independent, rough, and rebellious.

text.Generic WoodElf Male: The Imperial City is located on a large island surrounded by Lake Rumare.

text.Generic WoodElf Female: The Imperial City is located on a large island surrounded by Lake Rumare.

text.Generic WoodElf Male: The Imperial City is densely urbanized, with a few large parks and waterside dock areas.

text.Generic WoodElf Female: The Imperial City is densely urbanized, with a few large parks and waterside dock areas.

text.Generic WoodElf Male: The Imperial City itself is a walled city, with separate inner walls protecting the Imperial palace.

text.Generic WoodElf Female: The Imperial City itself is a walled city, with separate inner walls protecting the Imperial palace.

text.Generic WoodElf Male: The prettiest town in Cyrodiil? Don't know, but the ugliest is Bravil. Shabby, tumbledown shacks. They're big shacks, though.

text.Generic WoodElf Female: The prettiest town in Cyrodiil? Don't know, but the ugliest is Bravil. Shabby, tumbledown shacks. They're big shacks, though.

text.Generic WoodElf Male: Where to buy weapons? Where to buy anything, if you can afford to travel, is the Market District in the Imperial City.

text.Generic WoodElf Female: Where to buy weapons? Where to buy anything, if you can afford to travel, is the Market District in the Imperial City.

text.Generic WoodElf Male: My favorite town? Anvil. Lovely old stone buildings, and the harbor at sunset is beautiful.

text.Generic WoodElf Female: My favorite town? Anvil. Lovely old stone buildings, and the harbor at sunset is beautiful.

text.Generic WoodElf Male: Ayleid ruins? The big thing is to watch out for the traps. Thousands of years old, and still working. Amazing.

text.Generic WoodElf Female: Ayleid ruins? The big thing is to watch out for the traps. Thousands of years old, and still working. Amazing.

text.Generic WoodElf Male: I've seen plenty of Ayleid ruins. You'd think they'd be picked clean after 2000 years, but, no, there's still great treasures there.

text.Generic WoodElf Female: I've seen plenty of Ayleid ruins. You'd think they'd be picked clean after 2000 years, but, no, there's still great treasures there.

text.Generic WoodElf Male: It's still pretty wild east of the Niben. Few people, except for bandits, but at least it hasn't been picked clean by treasure-hunters.

text.Generic WoodElf Female: It's still pretty wild east of the Niben. Few people, except for bandits, but at least it hasn't been picked clean by treasure-hunters.

text.Generic WoodElf Male: Nobody goes into the mountains but hunters and thieves on the lam. Food and shelter is hard to come by.

text.Generic WoodElf Female: Nobody goes into the mountains but hunters and thieves on the lam. Food and shelter is hard to come by.

text.Generic WoodElf Male: Blackwood isn't so bad, once you get used to the flies. And being lost all the time. And the zombies and will-o-the-wisps.

text.Generic WoodElf Female: Blackwood isn't so bad, once you get used to the flies. And being lost all the time. And the zombies and will-o-the-wisps.

text.Generic WoodElf Male: There's islands in Niben Bay no one has visited in a hundred years. No telling what you'll find.

text.Generic WoodElf Female: There's islands in Niben Bay no one has visited in a hundred years. No telling what you'll find.

text.Generic WoodElf Male: Well, it's no problem traveling from the Imperial City to Leyawiin... if you're a wizard and can walk on water. I'd stay off the roads, though.

text.Generic WoodElf Female: Well, it's no problem traveling from the Imperial City to Leyawiin... if you're a wizard and can walk on water. I'd stay off the roads, though.

text.Generic WoodElf Male: If you're all alone in the woods and you see a troll coming, you run. Problem solved. Next question?

text.Generic WoodElf Female: If you're all alone in the woods and you see a troll coming, you run. Problem solved. Next question?

text.Generic WoodElf Male: Fighting's easy. Just lead them out on the water and shoot them full of holes. If you've got a bow, of course, and can walk on water.

text.Generic WoodElf Female: Fighting's easy. Just lead them out on the water and shoot them full of holes. If you've got a bow, of course, and can walk on water.

text.Generic WoodElf Male: The Arena's faked. You think those guys are getting killed? Really? It's just berry syrup and ham-acting.

text.Generic WoodElf Female: The Arena's faked. You think those guys are getting killed? Really? It's just berry syrup and ham-acting.

text.Generic WoodElf Male: Have you ever met anyone who got rich betting on the Arena? Didn't think so.

text.Generic WoodElf Female: Have you ever met anyone who got rich betting on the Arena? Didn't think so.

text.Generic WoodElf Male: The Council runs the Arena to amuse the masses, and it pays for itself, with all the fools who lose their shirts gambling.

text.Generic WoodElf Female: The Council runs the Arena to amuse the masses, and it pays for itself, with all the fools who lose their shirts gambling.

text.Generic WoodElf Male: If you're on a road, you can usually outrun anything. If you're in good shape, and not wearing a tin suit.

text.Generic WoodElf Female: If you're on a road, you can usually outrun anything. If you're in good shape, and not wearing a tin suit.

text.Generic WoodElf Male: Orcs don't ride horses. They eat horses. And sometimes I think they're the smart ones. Wait, maybe it's Dunmer who eat horses.

text.Generic WoodElf Female: Orcs don't ride horses. They eat horses. And sometimes I think they're the smart ones. Wait, maybe it's Dunmer who eat horses.

text.Generic WoodElf Male: Take Cheydinhal, for example. Pretty little town. But the Count's a Dark Elf, and it's crawling with Orc thugs and gangsters.

text.Generic WoodElf Female: Take Cheydinhal, for example. Pretty little town. But the Count's a Dark Elf, and it's crawling with Orc thugs and gangsters.

text.Generic WoodElf Male: The lands surrounding Lake Rumare are studded with small settlements, farms, and woodland game reserves.

text.Generic WoodElf Female: The lands surrounding Lake Rumare are studded with small settlements, farms, and woodland game reserves.

text.Generic WoodElf Male: The Nibenay Basin grades from rolling farmlands by the river east to the rugged uplands of the Valus Mountains.

text.Generic WoodElf Female: The Nibenay Basin grades from rolling farmlands by the river east to the rugged uplands of the Valus Mountains.

text.Generic WoodElf Male: On Cyrodiil's northern border is the sparsely populated mountain wilderness called the Valus Mountains.

text.Generic WoodElf Female: On Cyrodiil's northern border is the sparsely populated mountain wilderness called the Valus Mountains.

text.Generic WoodElf Male: You can't be too careful out in the wilderness. Almost any creature you find is liable to give you a disease.

text.Generic WoodElf Female: You can't be too careful out in the wilderness. Almost any creature you find is liable to give you a disease.

text.Generic WoodElf Male: Watch yourself around goblins. Some of the nastier ones will toss spells at you.

text.Generic WoodElf Female: Watch yourself around goblins. Some of the nastier ones will toss spells at you.

text.Generic WoodElf Male: Imps. I hate 'em. Little buggers flitting around, tossing fireballs at you!

text.Generic WoodElf Female: Imps. I hate 'em. Little buggers flitting around, tossing fireballs at you!

text.Generic WoodElf Male: I saw a wraith once. It threw a curse on me I'll never forget.

text.Generic WoodElf Female: I saw a wraith once. It threw a curse on me I'll never forget.

text.Generic WoodElf Male: Have you seen a land dreugh? We call them "Billies." Don't know why. Steer clear of them, though.

text.Generic WoodElf Female: Have you seen a land dreugh? We call them "Billies." Don't know why. Steer clear of them, though.

text.Generic WoodElf Male: I ran across a ghost once. Seemed to suck the energy right out of me.

text.Generic WoodElf Female: I ran across a ghost once. Seemed to suck the energy right out of me.

text.Generic WoodElf Male: Watch for minotaurs in the forests. Aggressive beasts. They'll tear right through your armor, too.

text.Generic WoodElf Female: Watch for minotaurs in the forests. Aggressive beasts. They'll tear right through your armor, too.

text.Generic WoodElf Male: Mudcrabs. What's the point? Annoying buggers, though the meat isn't bad.

text.Generic WoodElf Female: Mudcrabs. What's the point? Annoying buggers, though the meat isn't bad.

text.Generic WoodElf Male: Only thing worse than an ogre is two ogres. Tough bastards, and spells seem to bounce right off of 'em.

text.Generic WoodElf Female: Only thing worse than an ogre is two ogres. Tough bastards, and spells seem to bounce right off of 'em.

text.Generic WoodElf Male: Is there anywhere in Tamriel you can avoid rats? Disease spreading little nuisances.

text.Generic WoodElf Female: Is there anywhere in Tamriel you can avoid rats? Disease spreading little nuisances.

text.Generic WoodElf Male: Best way to take out a skeleton is with a big weapon. Forget spells. Just smack them and watch the bones fly!

text.Generic WoodElf Female: Best way to take out a skeleton is with a big weapon. Forget spells. Just smack them and watch the bones fly!

text.Generic WoodElf Male: I might swim more if it weren't for the slaughterfish. Sharp teeth, and some carry disease.

text.Generic WoodElf Female: I might swim more if it weren't for the slaughterfish. Sharp teeth, and some carry disease.

text.Generic WoodElf Male: Spriggans. "Nature's guardians" my foot! Mean things. They'll curse you, or they might call a bear to tear you apart.

text.Generic WoodElf Female: Spriggans. "Nature's guardians" my foot! Mean things. They'll curse you, or they might call a bear to tear you apart.

text.Generic WoodElf Male: All that stuff about having to set trolls on fire is a bunch of hooey. They don't like fire, but a good sword will cut them up fine.

text.Generic WoodElf Female: All that stuff about having to set trolls on fire is a bunch of hooey. They don't like fire, but a good sword will cut them up fine.

text.Generic WoodElf Male: I don't even know what a will-o-the-wisp is, much less how to kill one. I think they're just swamp gas, myself.

text.Generic WoodElf Female: I don't even know what a will-o-the-wisp is, much less how to kill one. I think they're just swamp gas, myself.

text.Generic WoodElf Male: I don't like to think about zombies. Missing arms, legs, heads. They smell awful, and they're hard to kill.

text.Generic WoodElf Female: I don't like to think about zombies. Missing arms, legs, heads. They smell awful, and they're hard to kill.

text.Generic WoodElf Male: Try combining aloe vera leaves with some venison. It's said to have some restorative properties.

text.Generic WoodElf Female: Try combining aloe vera leaves with some venison. It's said to have some restorative properties.

text.Generic WoodElf Male: You can find Cairn Bolete growing in caves. They're said to mark the place someone has died.

text.Generic WoodElf Female: You can find Cairn Bolete growing in caves. They're said to mark the place someone has died.

text.Generic WoodElf Male: It's said that eating taproot can bring you good luck.

text.Generic WoodElf Female: It's said that eating taproot can bring you good luck.

text.Generic WoodElf Male: Make sure not to eat nightshade. It's very poisonous.

text.Generic WoodElf Female: Make sure not to eat nightshade. It's very poisonous.

text.SEDervenin: How glorious, a newcomer to the Isles! Perhaps they will see the ways of Arden-Sul and join us.

text.SEThadon: Someone new comes to the Isles. Much more interesting than someone old.

text.SEThaedil: There's someone new in town, I hear. Finally, someone with a wider perspective who can appreciate my art!

text.SEDervenin: Arden-Sul has willed it to be... the Gatekeeper is dead and the newcomer to the Isles will join us in praising his name!

text.SEThadon: Gatekeeper's gone. For good. Or not. Might just be on holiday. We'll see.

text.SEThaedil: I wonder...  now that the Gatekeeper is dead, perhaps my fame will finally spread far beyond the Shivering Isles!

text.SEDervenin: The Resonator has been reactivated, and the Isles are no longer open to invasion. Arden-Sul works in mysterious ways.

text.SEThadon: The Resonator sings its sweet song once more. Promises of riches and fame, fulfilled with death and madness. How delightful.

text.SEThaedil: I'm calling my new act "The Restoration of the Resonator." But, I don't think my public is ready for it yet. It's very cutting edge.

text.SEDervenin: My heart fills with joy that Lord Thadon has finally recovered from his doldrums.

text.SEThadon: The Chalice is once again in its rightful place. And places are rightfully mine. And Chalices. Right?

text.SEThaedil: Now that Duke Thadon's happy again, I'm sure he'll invite me to the palace to perform! Oh, who am I kidding....

text.SEDervenin: It is a sad day in this fine city when the stench of torture poisons our spirits.

text.SEThadon: My, my, my. Seems we're all anxious to know something, even if we already know it. Or, Syl knows it. Or not.

text.SEThaedil: Syl has gone on another one of her rampages in Crucible. I'm certainly glad I live on the right side of the wall.
